items.slavonic_text: КАНѠ́НЪ Въскрⷭ҇нъ и҆ Бг҃оро́диченъ, на ѕ҃. и҆ въ Трїѡ́ди на и҃. А҆́ще Препра́зенство Срѣ́те́ніа и҆ли Попра́зенство: Канѡ́нъ Въскрⷭ҇нъ, на д҃. и҆ Пре́пра́зен: и҆ли Пра́ꙁдникꙋ на д҃. и҆ въ Трїѡ́ди, на ѕ҃. Катава́сіа въ Трїѡ́ди, Та́кожде а҆́ще и҆ са́мъ Пра́ꙁдникъ Срѣ́те́ніа. То́чію Катава́сіа Пра́ꙁдникꙋ.
items.english_text: *At Matins: At "God is the Lord": Troparion of the Resurrection of the Tone. And the usual Stichologies. Sessional hymns from the Octoechos. And we read in the Commentary Gospel, whereof the beginning is: "Fearful is this present day..." And the Polyeleos. Hypakoe of the Tone. We read also the Homily concerning the Poor by Saint Gregory the Theologian in three parts, whereof the beginning is: "Men, brethren, and fellow-paupers..." And the homily of Chrysostom, whereof the beginning is: "Beloved brethren, assemble yourselves and give ear..." And another homily of the same saint, whereof the beginning is: "Behold, the time of repentance has drawn near..." Songs of Ascents [Anabathmoi] of the Tone. Gospel. And the rest, even as was shown on the preceding Sunday.*[^209]

items.english_text: *Ode 1. Heirmos:* He was my Helper and Protector unto salvation; this is my God, and I will glorify Him; the God of my father, and I will exalt Him; for gloriously hath He been glorified! (Exod. 15:1–2).

items.english_text: *Refrain:* Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Припѣ́въ. Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ сла́ва тебѣ̀. Дне́ стра́шнагѡ, всенеиꙁглаго́ланнагѡ ти прише́ствіѧ,
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Pondering the dread day of Thine all-ineffable coming...

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Pondering the dread day of Thine all-ineffable coming...

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: трепещꙋ́, и҆ помышлѧ́ѧ, ᲂу҆жа́снѡ прови́ждꙋ. во́ньже прїи́деши живы̑мъ и҆ ме́ртвымъ сꙋди́ти Бж҃е мо́й всеси́льне:
items.english_text: *Troparion (continued):* ...I tremble, and reflecting thereon, with terror do I foresee the day whereon Thou shalt come to judge the living and the dead, O my God almighty!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion (continued):* ...I tremble, and reflecting thereon, with terror do I foresee the day whereon Thou shalt come to judge the living and the dead, O my God almighty!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Е҆гда̀ прїи́деши Бж҃е въ тма́хъ, и҆ ты́сѧщахъ А҆́гг҃лскихъ, нб҃ныхъ нача́лъ. и҆ менѐ на ѡ҆́блацѣхъ срѣ́сти тѧ̀ Хрїстѐ ѡ҆ка́ѧннагѡ сподо́би:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* When Thou shalt come, O God, amidst myriads and thousands of the angelic and heavenly hosts: vouchsafe also me, wretched as I am, to meet Thee upon the clouds, O Christ! (1 Thess. 4:17).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* When Thou shalt come, O God, amidst myriads and thousands of the angelic and heavenly hosts: vouchsafe also me, wretched as I am, to meet Thee upon the clouds, O Christ! (1 Thess. 4:17).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Грѧдѝ, прїимѝ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀, то́й де́нь и҆ ча́съ, е҆гда̀ Бг҃ъ ꙗ҆́вѣ прїи́детъ. и҆ рыда́й, и҆ пла́чи, ѡ҆брѣсти́сѧ чи́ста въ ча́съ и҆спыта́нїѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Come, O my soul, take to heart that day and hour when God shall come manifestly; and lament and weep, that thou mayest be found pure in the hour of trial! (Ps. 49:3 [LXX 49:3 / MT 50:3]).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Come, O my soul, take to heart that day and hour when God shall come manifestly; and lament and weep, that thou mayest be found pure in the hour of trial! (Ps. 49:3 [LXX 49:3 / MT 50:3]).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆дивла́етъ мѧ̀ и҆ страши́тъ ѻ҆́гнь негаси́мый гее́нскїй. и҆ че́рвь го́рькїй, скре́жетъ зꙋбѡ́мъ. но ѡ҆сла́би мѝ, ѡ҆ста́ви, и҆ стоѧ́нїѧ мѧ̀ Хрїстѐ и҆збра́нныхъ твои́хъ сопричтѝ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The unquenchable fire of Gehenna amazes and terrifies me, and the bitter worm and the gnashing of teeth; but remit, forgive me, O Christ, and number me among the assembly of Thine elect! (Mark 9:43–48; Matt. 8:12).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The unquenchable fire of Gehenna amazes and terrifies me, and the bitter worm and the gnashing of teeth; but remit, forgive me, O Christ, and number me among the assembly of Thine elect! (Mark 9:43–48; Matt. 8:12).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Вожделѣ́нный тво́й гла́съ, ст҃ы́ѧ твоѧ̑ зовы́й на ра́дость, да ᲂу҆слы́шꙋ и҆ а҆́зъ ѡ҆ка́ѧнный, и҆ ѡ҆брѧ́щꙋ цр҃твїѧ нб҃нагѡ, неизрече́нное наслажде́нїе:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* That longed-for voice of Thine, calling Thy Saints unto joy—may I also, wretched one, hear it, and find the ineffable delight of the Kingdom of Heaven! (Matt. 25:34).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* That longed-for voice of Thine, calling Thy Saints unto joy—may I also, wretched one, hear it, and find the ineffable delight of the Kingdom of Heaven! (Matt. 25:34).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Не вни́ди со мно́ю въ сꙋ́дъ, носѧ́й моѧ̑ дѣѧ́нїѧ, словеса̀ и҆зыска́ѧй, и҆ и҆справлѧ́ѧй стремле́нїѧ. но въ щедро́тахъ твои́хъ презира́ѧ ми лю̑таѧ, сп҃си́ мѧ всеси́льне:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Enter not into judgment with me, bringing forth my deeds, examining words, and trying impulses; but overlooking my grievous offenses in Thy tender compassions, save me, O Almighty One! (Ps. 142:2 [LXX 142:2 / MT 143:2]).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Enter not into judgment with me, bringing forth my deeds, examining words, and trying impulses; but overlooking my grievous offenses in Thy tender compassions, save me, O Almighty One! (Ps. 142:2 [LXX 142:2 / MT 143:2]).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Трⷪ́ченъ. Трїѵпоста́внаѧ Е҆дини́це, нача́льнѣйшаѧ гж҃е все́хъ, съверше́нное нача́лное пренача́лїе, Сама̀ на́съ сп҃сѝ. Ѻ҆́тче, и҆ Сн҃е, и҆ Дш҃е прест҃ы́й:
items.english_text: *Glory... Triadikon:* O Trinity in three Hypostases, Unity sovereign and Lady over all, perfected primal and transcendent Principle: do Thou Thyself save us, O Father, Son, and all-holy Spirit!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Glory... Triadikon:* O Trinity in three Hypostases, Unity sovereign and Lady over all, perfected primal and transcendent Principle: do Thou Thyself save us, O Father, Son, and all-holy Spirit!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Кто̀ родѝ сн҃а несѣ́ѧнна, ѻ҆́тчимъ зако́номъ; Сегѡ̀ ᲂу҆́бѡ ражда́етъ Ѻ҆́цъ без̾ мт҃ре. Пресла́вное чꙋ́до. ты́ же родила̀ е҆сѝ чтⷭ́аѧ, Бг҃а вкꙋ́пѣ и҆ чл҃ка.
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Who ever gave birth to a Son unsown, according to the law of the Father? For the Father begets Him without a mother. O most marvelous wonder! For thou, O pure Maiden, hast given birth to Him Who is at once God and man!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Both now... Theotokion:* Who ever gave birth to a Son unsown, according to the law of the Father? For the Father begets Him without a mother. O most marvelous wonder! For thou, O pure Maiden, hast given birth to Him Who is at once God and man!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Катава́: Помо́щникъ: Пѣ́снь, г҃. И҆рмо́съ. Оу҆твердѝ Гдⷭи на ка́мени недви́жимомъ за́повѣдей твои́хъ, подви́гшеесѧ срⷣце моѐ. ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ ст҃ъ е҆сѝ и҆ првⷣнъ:
items.english_text: *Katavasia: He was my Helper and Protector...* *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Establish, O Lord, upon the immovable rock of Thy commandments my shaken heart; for Thou alone art holy and righteous! (1 Kings 2:2 [LXX 1 Reg. 2:2 / 1 Sam. 2:2]).[^211]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Katavasia: He was my Helper and Protector...*
*Ode 3. Heirmos:* Establish, O Lord, upon the immovable rock of Thy commandments my shaken heart; for Thou alone art holy and righteous! (1 Kings 2:2 [LXX 1 Reg. 2:2 / 1 Sam. 2:2]).[^211]

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭь грѧде́тъ, и҆ кто̀ сте́рпитъ стра́ха є҆гѡ̀; кто̀ ꙗ҆ви́тсѧ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Lord comes, and who shall endure His fear? Who shall appear...

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The Lord comes, and who shall endure His fear? Who shall appear...

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: ꙗ҆ви́тисѧ лицꙋ̀ є҆гѡ̀; Но гото́ва бꙋ́ди дꙋшѐ моѧ̀ на срѣ́тенїе:
items.english_text: *Troparion (continued):* ...to appear before His face? But be thou ready, O my soul, for the meeting! (Mal. 3:2; Amos 4:12).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion (continued):* ...to appear before His face? But be thou ready, O my soul, for the meeting! (Mal. 3:2; Amos 4:12).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Превари́мъ, и҆ пла́чимсѧ, ᲂу҆вѣща́имсѧ Хрїстꙋ̀ пре́жде конца̀. Стра́шное бо сꙋди́ще, на не́мже всѝ ѿкрове́нно ста́немъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Let us anticipate the end, and weep, and make supplication unto Christ before the end: for dreadful is the judgment-seat, whereon we all shall stand uncovered! (2 Cor. 5:10).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Let us anticipate the end, and weep, and make supplication unto Christ before the end: for dreadful is the judgment-seat, whereon we all shall stand uncovered! (2 Cor. 5:10).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Поми́лꙋй Гдⷭи, поми́лꙋй мѧ̀ вопїю́ ти, е҆гда̀ прїи́деши со А҆́гг҃лы твои́ми, ѿда́ти всѣ̑мъ по достоѧ́нїю содѣѧ́нїй:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Have mercy, O Lord, have mercy upon me, I cry unto Thee, when Thou shalt come with Thine Angels to render unto all according to the desert of their deeds! (Matt. 16:27; Rom. 2:6).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Have mercy, O Lord, have mercy upon me, I cry unto Thee, when Thou shalt come with Thine Angels to render unto all according to the desert of their deeds! (Matt. 16:27; Rom. 2:6).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Непобѣ́дный Гдⷭи гнѣ́въ, ка́кѡ сте́рплю сꙋда̀ твоегѡ̀, преслꙋ́шавъ твоѐ повелѣ́нїе; Но пощадѝ, пощади́ мѧ въ ча́съ сꙋда̀:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* How shall I endure the unendurable wrath of Thy judgment, O Lord, having disobeyed Thy commandment? But spare, spare me in the hour of judgment! (Nah. 1:6).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* How shall I endure the unendurable wrath of Thy judgment, O Lord, having disobeyed Thy commandment? But spare, spare me in the hour of judgment! (Nah. 1:6).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆брати́сѧ, въздохнѝ дꙋшѐ ѡ҆ка́ѧннаѧ, пре́жде да́же житїѧ̀ торжество̀ конца̀ не прїи́метъ, пре́жде да́же две́рїй черто́га не затвори́тъ Гдⷭь:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Turn back, sigh, O wretched soul, before the festival of this life reaches its end, before the Lord shuts the doors of the bridal chamber! (Matt. 25:10–12).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Turn back, sigh, O wretched soul, before the festival of this life reaches its end, before the Lord shuts the doors of the bridal chamber! (Matt. 25:10–12).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Съгрѣши́хъ Гдⷭи, ꙗ҆́коже и҆ны́й никто́же ѿ человѣ̑къ, прегрѣши́въ па́че чл҃ка. Пре́жде сꙋда̀, млⷭтивъ бꙋ́ди ми чл҃колꙋ́бче:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have sinned, O Lord, as no other among men has sinned, having transgressed beyond all men: before the judgment, be Thou merciful unto me, O Lover of mankind! (1 Tim. 1:15).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have sinned, O Lord, as no other among men has sinned, having transgressed beyond all men: before the judgment, be Thou merciful unto me, O Lover of mankind! (1 Tim. 1:15).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Трⷪ́ченъ. Трⷪ́це про́стаѧ, несозда́ннаѧ, безнача́лное є҆стество̀, во Трⷪ́ци въспѣва́емое ѵ҆поста́сїй. сп҃си́ на́съ вѣ́рою покланѧ́ющихъ сѧ держа́вѣ твое́й:
items.english_text: *Glory... Triadikon:* O simple, uncreated Trinity, Nature without beginning, praised in a Trinity of Hypostases: save us who in faith worship Thy dominion!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Glory... Triadikon:* O simple, uncreated Trinity, Nature without beginning, praised in a Trinity of Hypostases: save us who in faith worship Thy dominion!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о: Воздрасти́ла є҆сѝ прчⷭ́таѧ безсѣ́меннымъ рожество́мъ живꙋ́щее сло́во. воплоще́нное во ᲂу҆тро́бѣ твое́й не премѣ́нное. сла́ва Бг҃омт҃и рожествꙋ̀ твое́мꙋ:
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* By an unsown birthgiving, O all-immaculate Maiden, thou didst nurture the living Word, incarnate in thy womb without change: glory, O Mother of God, unto thy childbearing!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Both now... Theotokion:* By an unsown birthgiving, O all-immaculate Maiden, thou didst nurture the living Word, incarnate in thy womb without change: glory, O Mother of God, unto thy childbearing!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Ктва́: Оу҆твердѝ Гдⷭи: Сѣ: Гла́, д҃. По: Гро́бъ тво́й: Сꙋди́ще твоѐ стра́шное, и҆ сꙋ́дъ пра́ведный, дѣла́ же моѧ̑ лю̑таѧ. Но самъ млⷭтиве превари́въ мѧ сп҃сѝ, и҆ мꙋ́ки свободѝ, и҆зба́ви Влⷣко ко́злищъ ча́сти. И҆ сподо́би ѡ҆деснꙋ́ю тебѐ ста́ти Сꙋдїѐ праведнѣ́йшїй:
items.english_text: *Katavasia: Establish, O Lord...* *Sessional Hymn, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thy tomb, O Savior" (Гро́бъ тво́й):*[^212] Dreadful is Thy tribunal, and righteous is Thy judgment, but my deeds are grievous! Yet do Thou Thyself, O merciful One, anticipating me, save me and deliver me from torment; rescue me, O Master, from the portion of the goats, and vouchsafe me to stand at Thy right hand, O most righteous Judge! (Matt. 25:32–33).

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Katavasia: Establish, O Lord...*
*Sessional Hymn, Tone 4, Podoben: "Thy tomb, O Savior" (Гро́бъ тво́й):*[^212] Dreadful is Thy tribunal, and righteous is Thy judgment, but my deeds are grievous! Yet do Thou Thyself, O merciful One, anticipating me, save me and deliver me from torment; rescue me, O Master, from the portion of the goats, and vouchsafe me to stand at Thy right hand, O most righteous Judge! (Matt. 25:32–33).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Всѣ́хъ тво́рца и҆ Бг҃а твое́гѡ, и҆ содѣ́телѧ всенепоро́чнаѧ чтⷭ́аѧ, Дх҃омъ Бж҃ественнымъ въ ᲂу҆тро́бѣ свое́й вмѣсти́ла є҆сѝ, и҆ тлѣ́нїѧ кромѣ̀ роди́ла є҆сѝ, є҆го́же сла́вѧще, тебѐ воспѣва́емъ, Дв҃о, ꙗ҆́кѡ Пала́тꙋ цр҃ѧ сла́вы, и҆ ми́рꙋ и҆збавле́нїе:
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* In thy womb, by the Divine Spirit, O all-immaculate and pure Maiden, thou didst contain the Creator of all and thy God and Maker, and didst give birth unto Him without corruption; glorifying Him, we praise thee, O Virgin, as the palace of the King of glory and the redemption of the world!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* In thy womb, by the Divine Spirit, O all-immaculate and pure Maiden, thou didst contain the Creator of all and thy God and Maker, and didst give birth unto Him without corruption; glorifying Him, we praise thee, O Virgin, as the palace of the King of glory and the redemption of the world!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: И҆́ны Гла́съ, ѕ҃. Помышлѧ́ю де́нь стра́шный, и҆ пла́чꙋсѧ дѣѧ́нїй мои́хъ лꙋка́выхъ. ка́кѡ ѿвѣща́ю безсме́ртномꙋ цр҃ю; кои́мъже дерзнове́нїемъ въззрю̀ на сꙋдїю̀ блꙋ́дный а҆́зъ; Млⷭрдый Ѻ҆́тче, Сн҃е є҆диноро́дный, и҆ Дш҃е Ст҃ый, поми́лꙋй мѧ̀:
items.english_text: *Other Sessional Hymns, Tone 6:*[^213] I reflect upon that dreadful day, and I weep over my evil deeds: how shall I answer the immortal King? And with what boldness shall I, prodigal that I am, look upon the Judge? O compassionate Father, only-begotten Son, and Holy Spirit: have mercy upon me!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Other Sessional Hymns, Tone 6:*[^213] I reflect upon that dreadful day, and I weep over my evil deeds: how shall I answer the immortal King? And with what boldness shall I, prodigal that I am, look upon the Judge? O compassionate Father, only-begotten Son, and Holy Spirit: have mercy upon me!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Во ю҆до́лѣ пла́ча, въ мѣ́стѣ є҆́же положи́лъ є҆сѝ, є҆гда̀ сѧ́деши млⷭтиве сотвори́ти првⷣный сꙋ́дъ, не ѡ҆бличѝ моѧ̑ та̑йнаѧ, нижѐ посрамѝ менѐ преⷣ А҆́гг҃лы, но пощади́ мѧ Бж҃е, и҆ поми́лꙋй мѧ̀.
items.english_text: *Glory...:* In the valley of weeping, in the place which Thou hast appointed, when Thou shalt sit, O merciful One, to execute righteous judgment: expose not my hidden things, neither put me to shame before the Angels; but spare me, O God, and have mercy upon me! (Joel 3:12 [LXX 4:12]; Ps. 83:7 [LXX 83:7 / MT 84:6]).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Glory...:* In the valley of weeping, in the place which Thou hast appointed, when Thou shalt sit, O merciful One, to execute righteous judgment: expose not my hidden things, neither put me to shame before the Angels; but spare me, O God, and have mercy upon me! (Joel 3:12 [LXX 4:12]; Ps. 83:7 [LXX 83:7 / MT 84:6]).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃о: Оу҆пова́нїе ми́рꙋ бл҃га́ѧ Бцⷣе Дв҃о. твоѐ и҆ є҆ди́ное стра́шное застꙋпле́нїе молю̀. ᲂу҆милосе́рдѧсѧ на шестоѧ́нныѧ лю́ди. ᲂу҆молѝ млⷭтивагѡ Бг҃а. и҆зба́вити сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ ѿ всѧ́кагѡ преще́нїѧ є҆ди́на блгⷭве́ннаѧ:
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* O good Mother of God and Virgin, hope of the world: I implore thine only and dreadful protection; take pity upon a defenseless people, and entreat the merciful God that our souls may be delivered from every menace, O only blessed one!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Both now... Theotokion:* O good Mother of God and Virgin, hope of the world: I implore thine only and dreadful protection; take pity upon a defenseless people, and entreat the merciful God that our souls may be delivered from every menace, O only blessed one!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Наста̀ де́нь, ᲂу҆же́ при две́рехъ сꙋ́дъ. Дш҃е бо́дрствꙋй, и҆де́же царїе вкꙋ́пѣ и҆ кнѧ́зи, и҆ бога́тїи, и҆ ᲂу҆бо́зїи собира́ют̾ сѧ, и҆ воспрїи́метъ по достоѧ́нїю содѣ́ѧнныхъ ѿ чл҃вѣкъ ко́ждо:
items.english_text: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* The Prophet heard of Thy coming, O Lord, and was afraid: that Thou wast to be born of a Virgin and appear unto men; and he said: "I heard report of Thee, and was afraid; glory to Thy power!" (Hab. 3:2 [LXX]).[^215]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 4. Heirmos:* The Prophet heard of Thy coming, O Lord, and was afraid: that Thou wast to be born of a Virgin and appear unto men; and he said: "I heard report of Thee, and was afraid; glory to Thy power!" (Hab. 3:2 [LXX]).[^215]

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: В̾ чи́нꙋ свое́мъ, И҆́нокъ, и҆ Ст҃ль, ста́рый и҆ ю҆ны́й. ра́бъ, и҆ влады́ка и҆стѧ́жет̾сѧ. Вдови́ца, и҆ дѣ́ва и҆спра́вит̾ сѧ. И҆ всѣ̑мъ Го́ре тогда̀, неимѣ́вшымъ житїѐ непови́нное:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The day has arrived, the judgment is already at the doors! Be vigilant, O my soul, where kings and princes, rich and poor are gathered together, and each one of men shall receive according to the worth of what he has done! (James 5:9; Rev. 20:12).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The day has arrived, the judgment is already at the doors! Be vigilant, O my soul, where kings and princes, rich and poor are gathered together, and each one of men shall receive according to the worth of what he has done! (James 5:9; Rev. 20:12).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Неᲂу҆мы́тный сꙋ́дъ тво́й, неᲂу҆тае́нное твоѐ сꙋди́ще хїтросло́вїѧ, не вѣ́тїй хꙋдо́жство кра́дꙋщее, не послꙋ́хѡвъ непищева́нїе ѿража́ющее, пра́ведное. въ тебѣ́ бо Бз҃ѣ всѣ́хъ съкрове́ннаѧ предстоѧ́тъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* In his own rank, monk and hierarch, old and young, slave and master shall be examined; widow and virgin shall be judged; and woe unto all then who have not possessed a blameless life!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* In his own rank, monk and hierarch, old and young, slave and master shall be examined; widow and virgin shall be judged; and woe unto all then who have not possessed a blameless life!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Да не прїи́дꙋ въ зе́млю пла́ча. да не ви́ждꙋ мѣ́ста тмы̀, Хрїстѐ мо́й сло́ве, нижѐ да положꙋ̀ рꙋ́цѣ и҆ но́зѣ внѣ̀ черто́га твое́гѡ и҆зве́рженъ. ѡ҆де́ждꙋ нетлѣ́нїѧ ѡ҆скверне́ннꙋ и҆мѣ́ѧ безстра́стный:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Incorruptible is Thy judgment, Thy tribunal admits no concealment of sophistry; it is stolen not by the rhetoric of orators, nor is it deflected by the false testimony of witnesses, but is righteous: for before Thee, O God, stand revealed the secret things of all! (Rom. 2:16; 1 Cor. 4:5).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Incorruptible is Thy judgment, Thy tribunal admits no concealment of sophistry; it is stolen not by the rhetoric of orators, nor is it deflected by the false testimony of witnesses, but is righteous: for before Thee, O God, stand revealed the secret things of all! (Rom. 2:16; 1 Cor. 4:5).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Да не прїи́дꙋ въ зе́млю пла́ча. да не ви́ждꙋ мѣ́ста тмы̀, Хрїстѐ мо́й сло́ве, нижѐ да положꙋ̀ рꙋ́цѣ и҆ но́зѣ внѣ̀ черто́га твое́гѡ и҆зве́рженъ. ѡ҆де́ждꙋ нетлѣ́нїѧ ѡ҆скверне́ннꙋ и҆мѣ́ѧ безстра́стный:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* May I not enter into the land of weeping, may I not see the place of darkness, O Christ my Word; neither let me be cast out with bound hands and feet outside Thy bridal chamber, having defiled the garment of incorruption, O impassible Lord! (Matt. 22:11–13).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* May I not enter into the land of weeping, may I not see the place of darkness, O Christ my Word; neither let me be cast out with bound hands and feet outside Thy bridal chamber, having defiled the garment of incorruption, O impassible Lord! (Matt. 22:11–13).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Внегда̀ ѿлꙋчи́ши грѣ́шныхъ ѿ првⷣныхъ, сꙋдѧ́й мї́рꙋ, є҆ди́нагѡ ѿ ѻ҆ве́цъ мѧ̀ свои́хъ причтѝ. ѿ ко́злищъ разлꙋча́ѧ мѧ чл҃колꙋ́бче. є҆́же ᲂу҆слы́шати ми гла́съ ѻ҆́ный тво́й блгⷭве́нный:
items.english_text: *Troparion (continued):* When Thou shalt separate the sinners from the righteous, judging the world, number me as one of Thy sheep, parting me from the goats, O Lover of mankind, that I may hear that blessed voice of Thine! (Matt. 25:32–34).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion (continued):* When Thou shalt separate the sinners from the righteous, judging the world, number me as one of Thy sheep, parting me from the goats, O Lover of mankind, that I may hear that blessed voice of Thine! (Matt. 25:32–34).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Слы́ша бога́тагѡ во пла́мени мꙋ́кный плаче́внаѧ словеса̀, пла́чꙋсѧ и҆ рыда́ю ѡ҆ка́ѧнный, тогѡ́же сы́й ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїѧ, и҆ мл̅ю́сѧ поми́лꙋй мѧ сп҃се мї́ра въ вре́мѧ сꙋда̀.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Hearing the sorrowful words of the rich man tormented in the flame, I weep and lament, wretched as I am, being subject unto the selfsame condemnation; and I pray: Have mercy upon me, O Savior of the world, in the time of judgment! (Luke 16:24).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Hearing the sorrowful words of the rich man tormented in the flame, I weep and lament, wretched as I am, being subject unto the selfsame condemnation; and I pray: Have mercy upon me, O Savior of the world, in the time of judgment! (Luke 16:24).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: И҆спыта́нїю быва́емꙋ, и҆ кни́гамъ ѿверза́емымъ съдѣ́ѧнныхъ, что̀ сътвори́ши ѽ дꙋшѐ ѡ҆ка́ѧннаѧ; что̀ ѿвѣща́еши на сꙋди́щи; неимꙋ́щаѧ пра́вды плода̀ принестѝ Бг҃ꙋ, и҆ съдѣ́телю си:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* When the examination is made and the books of deeds are opened, what wilt thou do, O wretched soul? What wilt thou answer before the judgment-seat, having no fruit of righteousness to offer unto God and thy Maker? (Dan. 7:10; Rev. 20:12).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* When the examination is made and the books of deeds are opened, what wilt thou do, O wretched soul? What wilt thou answer before the judgment-seat, having no fruit of righteousness to offer unto God and thy Maker? (Dan. 7:10; Rev. 20:12).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Трⷪ́ченъ. [Зрѝ] Сн҃а ѿ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀, и҆ Дх҃а сла́влю, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ сл҃нца свѣ́тъ и҆ лꙋчꙋ̀. Ѻ҆́богѡ ᲂу҆́бѡ ро́жественнѣ, зане́ и҆ рожде́нїе. Ѻ҆́богѡ же происхо́днѣ, зане́ и҆ схожде́нїе. собезнача́лнꙋю Бж҃тве́ннꙋю Трⷪ́цꙋ, покланѧ́емꙋю ѿ всѧ́кїѧ тва́ри.
items.english_text: *Glory... Triadikon:* I glorify the Son from the Father and the Spirit, as light and ray from the sun: the One indeed by way of generation, for He is begotten; the Other by way of procession, for He proceeds; the co-beginningless Divine Trinity, worshipped by every creature![^216]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Glory... Triadikon:* I glorify the Son from the Father and the Spirit, as light and ray from the sun: the One indeed by way of generation, for He is begotten; the Other by way of procession, for He proceeds; the co-beginningless Divine Trinity, worshipped by every creature![^216]

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Дѣ́ва млнⷡца роди́вшаѧ, и҆ чтⷭотꙋ̀ съблю́дшаѧ, чтⷭ́аѧ ты ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ Бг҃а ро́жши и҆ чл҃ка, є҆ди́наго тогѡ̀ во ѻ҆бо́ю зра́кꙋ. чꙋ́до твоѐ Дв҃о Мт҃и ᲂу҆жаса́етъ всѧ́кїй слꙋ́хъ и҆ по́мыслъ:
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* A Virgin giving birth unto an Infant, yet preserving virginity: pure Maiden, thou wast revealed as having given birth unto Him Who is God and man, the selfsame One in both forms; thy wonder, O Virgin Mother, strikes with awe every hearing and thought!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Both now... Theotokion:* A Virgin giving birth unto an Infant, yet preserving virginity: pure Maiden, thou wast revealed as having given birth unto Him Who is God and man, the selfsame One in both forms; thy wonder, O Virgin Mother, strikes with awe every hearing and thought!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Катава́: Оу҆слы́ша Прⷪ́къ: Пѣ́снь, є҃. И҆рмо́съ. И҆з̾ но́щи ᲂу҆́треннюща чл҃колꙋ́бче, просвѣти́ мл̅ю́сѧ. и҆ наста́ви и҆ менѐ во повелѣ́нїи твои́хъ, и҆ назꙋчи́ [наꙋчи́] мѧ при́снѡ твори́ти во́лю твою̀.
items.english_text: *Katavasia: The Prophet heard...* *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Seeking Thee at dawn from early morning out of the night, O Lover of mankind, enlighten me, I pray Thee, and guide me also in Thy commandments, and teach me ever to do Thy will! (Isa. 26:9).[^217]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Katavasia: The Prophet heard...*
*Ode 5. Heirmos:* Seeking Thee at dawn from early morning out of the night, O Lover of mankind, enlighten me, I pray Thee, and guide me also in Thy commandments, and teach me ever to do Thy will! (Isa. 26:9).[^217]

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Тре́петъ непобѣди́мый и҆ стра́хъ та́мѡ. Прїи́детъ бо Гдⷭь, и҆ дѣ́ло съ ни́мъ кого́ждо ѿ чл҃къ, и҆ кто̀ здѣ̀ про́чее себѐ не въспла́четъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Insuperable trembling and fear are there! For the Lord shall come, and with Him the deed of every man: who then will not weep for himself here in this life? (Wis. 1:9; Rev. 22:12).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Insuperable trembling and fear are there! For the Lord shall come, and with Him the deed of every man: who then will not weep for himself here in this life? (Wis. 1:9; Rev. 22:12).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Рѣка̀ ѻ҆́гннаѧ смꙋща́етъ мѧ, и҆ ста́еваетъ мѧ, стрꙋ́жетъ мѧ. скре́жетъ зꙋбѡ́мъ, и҆ тма̀ бе́здны, и҆ ка́кѡ, и҆лѝ что̀ съдѣ́лавъ, Бг҃а ᲂу҆мл̅тиви́ли:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The river of fire confounds me, melts me, and scrapes me; the gnashing of teeth and the darkness of the abyss: how, or by having done what, shall I propitiate God? (Dan. 7:10; Matt. 8:12).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The river of fire confounds me, melts me, and scrapes me; the gnashing of teeth and the darkness of the abyss: how, or by having done what, shall I propitiate God? (Dan. 7:10; Matt. 8:12).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Пощадѝ пощади́ Гдⷭи раба̀ своего̀, да некогда̀ преда́си менѐ го́рькымъ мꙋчи́телемъ А҆́нгелѡвъ напра́сныхъ, в̾ ни́хже нѣ́ст та́мѡ поко́ѧ ѡ҆брѣстѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion (continued):* Spare, spare Thy servant, O Lord, lest Thou deliver me unto the bitter tormentors, the cruel Angels, among whom there is no rest to be found there!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion (continued):* Spare, spare Thy servant, O Lord, lest Thou deliver me unto the bitter tormentors, the cruel Angels, among whom there is no rest to be found there!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Кнѧ́зь, воево́да, та́мѡ вкꙋ́пѣ. бога́тый и҆ безсла́вный. вели́кїй кꋋ́пнѡ и҆ ма́лый и҆спра́вит̾сѧ ра́внѡ, Го́ре комꙋ́ждо про́чее неꙋгото́вленному:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Prince and captain are there together; the rich and the ignoble, the great together with the small shall be judged equally: woe, then, unto everyone who is unprepared! (Job 34:19; Rev. 6:15).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Prince and captain are there together; the rich and the ignoble, the great together with the small shall be judged equally: woe, then, unto everyone who is unprepared! (Job 34:19; Rev. 6:15).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆сла́би, ѿпꙋсти́ Гдⷭи, и҆ простѝ є҆ли̑ка ти съгрѣши́хъ, и҆ непокажи́ мѧ та́мѡ преⷣ А҆́гг҃лы, въ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїи ѻ҆гнѧ̀, и҆ стꙋ́да несконча́емагѡ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Remit, pardon, O Lord, and forgive all wherein I have sinned against Thee, and show me not forth there before the Angels in the condemnation of the fire and of endless shame! (Dan. 12:2).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Remit, pardon, O Lord, and forgive all wherein I have sinned against Thee, and show me not forth there before the Angels in the condemnation of the fire and of endless shame! (Dan. 12:2).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Пощадѝ, Гдⷭи пощадѝ созда́нїе своѐ. съгрѣши́хъ ѡ҆сла́би ми. ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆стество́мъ чи́стъ са́мъ є҆сѝ є҆ди́нъ, и҆ и҆ны́й ра́звѣ тебѐ никто́же є҆́сть внѣ̀ скве́рны:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Spare, O Lord, spare Thine own creation! I have sinned, forgive me: for Thou alone art pure by nature, and none other besides Thee is free from defilement! (Job 14:4; Ps. 50:7 [LXX 50:7 / MT 51:5]).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Spare, O Lord, spare Thine own creation! I have sinned, forgive me: for Thou alone art pure by nature, and none other besides Thee is free from defilement! (Job 14:4; Ps. 50:7 [LXX 50:7 / MT 51:5]).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Сла́: Трⷪ́: Е҆дини́цꙋ є҆стество́мъ тѧ̀ Трⷪ́це воспѣва́ю, безнача́лнꙋю, непости́жнꙋю, нача́льственное црⷭ́кое пресоверше́нное є҆ди́нство. Бл҃гъ свѣ́тъ, и҆ живо́тъ, и҆ содѣ́телѧ мї́рꙋ:
items.english_text: *Glory... Triadikon:* Thee, O Trinity, I praise as a Unity by nature, unoriginate, incomprehensible, sovereign royal all-perfected Unity: good Light, and Life, and Creator of the world!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Glory... Triadikon:* Thee, O Trinity, I praise as a Unity by nature, unoriginate, incomprehensible, sovereign royal all-perfected Unity: good Light, and Life, and Creator of the world!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о: Въ ржⷭтвѣ́ твое́мъ па́че є҆стества̀ чтⷭ́аѧ, зако́ны є҆стества̀ тебѐ разорѝшасѧ ꙗ҆́вѣ, ꙗ҆́кѡ без̾ сѣ́мени ражда́еши превѣ́чнагѡ Бг҃а, ѿ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ рожде́ннагѡ:
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* In thy childbearing beyond nature, O pure Maiden, the laws of nature were manifestly dissolved for thee; for without seed thou dost give birth unto the pre-eternal God begotten of the Father!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Both now... Theotokion:* In thy childbearing beyond nature, O pure Maiden, the laws of nature were manifestly dissolved for thee; for without seed thou dost give birth unto the pre-eternal God begotten of the Father!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Катва́: И҆з̾ но́щи ᲂу҆́треннюща: Пѣ́: ѕ҃. И҆рмо́: Возопи́хъ всѣ̑мъ срⷣцемъ мои́мъ, къ ще́дромꙋ Бг҃ꙋ, и҆ ᲂу҆слы́ша мѧ̀ ѿ а҆́да преиспо́днѧгѡ, и҆ възведѐ ѿ тлѧ̀ живо́тъ мо́й:
items.english_text: *Katavasia: Seeking Thee at dawn from early morning...* *Ode 6. Heirmos:* I cried with my whole heart unto the compassionate God, and He heard me from the lowest hell, and brought up my life from corruption! (Jonah 2:3, 7 [LXX 2:3, 7]).[^218]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Katavasia: Seeking Thee at dawn from early morning...*
*Ode 6. Heirmos:* I cried with my whole heart unto the compassionate God, and He heard me from the lowest hell, and brought up my life from corruption! (Jonah 2:3, 7 [LXX 2:3, 7]).[^218]

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Во стра́шнѣмъ Хрїстѐ прише́ствїи твое́мъ, є҆гда̀ ꙗ҆ви́шисѧ с̾ нб҃се, поста́вѧт̾сѧ Прⷭто́ли, и҆ кни́ги разгну́т̾сѧ. пощадѝ, пощадѝ тогда̀ сп҃се созда́нїе твоѐ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* At Thy dreadful coming, O Christ, when Thou shalt appear from heaven, the thrones shall be set, and the books opened: spare, spare then, O Savior, Thine own creation! (Dan. 7:9–10).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* At Thy dreadful coming, O Christ, when Thou shalt appear from heaven, the thrones shall be set, and the books opened: spare, spare then, O Savior, Thine own creation! (Dan. 7:9–10).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Та́мѡ ничто́же помощѝ мо́жетъ, Бг҃ꙋ сꙋ́щꙋ сꙋдїѝ. ни наказа́нїе, ни хꙋдо́жество, ни сла́ва, ни дрꙋ́жба, ра́звѣ ѿ дѣ̑лъ крѣ́пость ѽ дꙋшѐ моѧ̀:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* There nothing can help when God is the Judge: neither eloquence, nor skill, nor glory, nor friendship, but only the power that comes from deeds, O my soul!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* There nothing can help when God is the Judge: neither eloquence, nor skill, nor glory, nor friendship, but only the power that comes from deeds, O my soul!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Та́мѡ вкꙋ́пѣ кнѧ́зи боѧ́знь, ни́щїи и҆ бога́тїи дꙋшѐ. ни ѻ҆те́цъ възмо́жетъ, ни ма́ти помага́ющи, ни и҆збавлѧ́ѧй бра́тъ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Fear is there alike for princes, poor and rich, O my soul! Neither shall a father be able, nor a mother to help, nor a brother to deliver from condemnation! (Ps. 48:8 [LXX 48:8 / MT 49:7]).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Fear is there alike for princes, poor and rich, O my soul! Neither shall a father be able, nor a mother to help, nor a brother to deliver from condemnation! (Ps. 48:8 [LXX 48:8 / MT 49:7]).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Стра́шное дꙋшѐ и҆стѧза́нїе помышлѧ́ющи сꙋди́йно, ᲂу҆жасни́сѧ ѿню́дꙋ. ᲂу҆гото́ви сло́во, да не ѡ҆сꙋ́дишисѧ ᲂу҆́зами вѣ́чными:
items.english_text: *Troparion (continued):* Reflecting, O my soul, upon the dreadful judicial cross-examination, be utterly filled with awe! Prepare a word of defense, that thou be not condemned unto eternal bonds!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion (continued):* Reflecting, O my soul, upon the dreadful judicial cross-examination, be utterly filled with awe! Prepare a word of defense, that thou be not condemned unto eternal bonds!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Возмѝ своѐ, да не ᲂу҆слы́шꙋ Гдⷭи, ѿсыла́емъ ѿ тебѐ. нижѐ, є҆́же поидѝ въ ѻ҆́гнь проклѧ́тыхъ. Но вожделѣ́ннагѡ гла́са првⷣныхъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* May I not hear, O Lord: "Take what is thine and depart," sent away from Thee; nor: "Depart into the fire of the accursed!" but rather the longed-for voice of the righteous! (Matt. 20:14; 25:41).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* May I not hear, O Lord: "Take what is thine and depart," sent away from Thee; nor: "Depart into the fire of the accursed!" but rather the longed-for voice of the righteous! (Matt. 20:14; 25:41).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: А҆́дскихъ вра́тъ и҆зба́ви мѧ̀ Гдⷭи, про́пасти тмы̀ несвѣ́тимыѧ преиспо́днихъ, и҆ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ негаси́магѡ и҆ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ и҆ны́ѧ мꙋ́ки вѣ́чныѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Deliver me, O Lord, from the gates of Hades, from the chasm of unilluminated darkness in the nether regions, from the unquenchable fire, and from every other eternal torment! (Job 10:21–22).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Deliver me, O Lord, from the gates of Hades, from the chasm of unilluminated darkness in the nether regions, from the unquenchable fire, and from every other eternal torment! (Job 10:21–22).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Трⷪ́: Трⷪ́чнагѡ є҆ди́нства пою̀ Бж҃тво̀. Ѻ҆ц҃а̀, и҆ Сн҃а, и҆ Бж҃твеннагѡ Дх҃а, є҆ди́нагѡ нача́ла держа́вꙋ, сораздѣлѧ́емагѡ тремѝ и҆зѡбраже́нми:
items.english_text: *Glory... Triadikon:* I sing the Godhead of the Trinitarian Unity: the Father, the Son, and the Divine Spirit, the dominion of a single Principle, divided in three personal hypostases!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Glory... Triadikon:* I sing the Godhead of the Trinitarian Unity: the Father, the Son, and the Divine Spirit, the dominion of a single Principle, divided in three personal hypostases!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о: Две́рь ты є҆сѝ, ю҆́же є҆ди́нъ про́йде вше́дый и҆ и҆зше́дый, и҆ ключа̀ не раздрꙋ́шившый дѣ́вства чтⷭ́аѧ І҆и҃съ, созда́вый А҆да́ма, и҆ сн҃ъ тво́й:
items.english_text: *Both now... Theotokion:* Thou art the Gate through which alone Jesus entered and went forth, breaking not the seals of virginity, O pure Maiden: He Who created Adam, and is thy Son! (Ezek. 44:2).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Both now... Theotokion:* Thou art the Gate through which alone Jesus entered and went forth, breaking not the seals of virginity, O pure Maiden: He Who created Adam, and is thy Son! (Ezek. 44:2).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: Катава́сїа. Возопи́хъ всѣ̑мъ срⷣцемъ мои́мъ: Конта́кїонъ. Гла́съ, а҃. Е҆гда̀ прїи́деши Бж҃е на зе́млю съ сла́вою, и҆ трепе́щꙋтъ всѧ́ческаѧ, рѣка́ же ѻ҆́гньнаѧ преⷣ сꙋди́щемъ тече́тъ, кни́ги разгнꙋ́ют̾ сѧ, и҆ та́йнаѧ ѡ҆блича́ют̾сѧ. тогда̀ и҆зба́ви мѧ̀ ѿ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ негаси́магѡ. и҆ сподо́би мѧ̀ ѡ҆деснꙋ́ю тебѐ ста́ти Сꙋдїѐ праведнѣ́йшїй.
items.english_text: *Katavasia: I cried with my whole heart...* *Kontakion, Tone 1:* When Thou shalt come, O God, upon the earth with glory, and all things tremble, and a river of fire flows before the judgment-seat, and the books are opened, and secret things exposed: then deliver me from the unquenchable fire, and vouchsafe me to stand at Thy right hand, O most righteous Judge! (Dan. 7:9–10; Matt. 25:33).[^219]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Katavasia: I cried with my whole heart...*
*Kontakion, Tone 1:* When Thou shalt come, O God, upon the earth with glory, and all things tremble, and a river of fire flows before the judgment-seat, and the books are opened, and secret things exposed: then deliver me from the unquenchable fire, and vouchsafe me to stand at Thy right hand, O most righteous Judge! (Dan. 7:9–10; Matt. 25:33).[^219]

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Sunday of Meatfare
items.slavonic_text: І҆́косъ. Стра́шное сꙋди́ще твоѐ, помышлѧ́ѧ, пребл҃гїй Гдⷭи, и҆ днѐ сꙋднагѡ бою́сѧ и҆ трепещꙋ̀, ѿ совѣ́сти моеѧ̀ ѡ҆блича́емъ. є҆гда̀ и҆́маши сѣ́сти на Прⷭто́лѣ твое́мъ, и҆ твори́ти и҆спыта́нїе. тогда̀ ѡ҆брещи́сѧ грѣхѡ́въ, никто́же възмо́жетъ, и҆́стиннѣ ѡ҆блича́ющей и҆ стра́хꙋ ѡ҆держа́щꙋ. Велмѝ ᲂу҆́бѡ възшꙋми́тъ тогда̀ ѻ҆́гнь гее́нскїй, грѣ́шници же воспла́чꙋтсѧ. Тѣ́мже мѧ̀ поми́лꙋй пре́жде конца̀, и҆ пощадѝ сꙋдїѐ праведнѣ́йшїй:
items.english_text: *Ikos:* Pondering Thy dreadful tribunal, O all-good Lord, and the day of judgment, I fear and tremble, being reproved by mine own conscience, when Thou shalt sit upon Thy throne and make examination: then none shall be able to deny sins, when truth convicts and fear lays hold! Loudly indeed shall the fire of Gehenna roar then, and sinners shall weep: therefore have mercy upon me before the end, and spare me, O most righteous Judge![^220]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ikos:* Pondering Thy dreadful tribunal, O all-good Lord, and the day of judgment, I fear and tremble, being reproved by mine own conscience, when Thou shalt sit upon Thy throne and make examination: then none shall be able to deny sins, when truth convicts and fear lays hold! Loudly indeed shall the fire of Gehenna roar then, and sinners shall weep: therefore have mercy upon me before the end, and spare me, O most righteous Judge![^220]

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion on the Sunday of Meatfare.*[^221]
items.slavonic_text: Сѵнаѯа́ръ. Стїхѝ. { Е҆гда̀ сꙋди́ти зе́мли Сꙋдїе всѣ́хъ ᲂу҆сѧ́деши. / Ѻ҆но́гѡ, Прїи́дѣ́те, гла́са, го́днымъ и҆ менѐ ᲂу҆сꙋдѝ.
items.english_text: *Synaxarion on the Sunday of Meatfare.*[^221]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Synaxarion on the Sunday of Meatfare.*[^221]

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion on the Sunday of Meatfare.*[^221]
items.slavonic_text: Сѵнаѯа́ръ. Стїхѝ. { Е҆гда̀ сꙋди́ти зе́мли Сꙋдїе всѣ́хъ ᲂу҆сѧ́деши. / Ѻ҆но́гѡ, Прїи́дѣ́те, гла́са, го́днымъ и҆ менѐ ᲂу҆сꙋдѝ.
items.english_text:
When Thou, O Judge of all, shalt sit to judge the earth,
Deem me also worthy of that voice: "Come ye!" (Matt. 25:34).

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Належи́тъ кро́мѣ того̀ ви́дѣти, и҆ ᲂу҆важа́ти, же, в̾ пришло́ настꙋпнꙋ́ю Нл҃ю, поча́токъ свѣ́та, и҆ само́е А҆да́мово з̾ Ра́ѧ выгна́нє, поло́жатъ.
items.english_text: On this day, we celebrate the commemoration of the Second and Impartial Coming of Christ, which the most divine Fathers appointed after those two Parables [of the Publican and the Prodigal Son]: to the end that no one, having learned from those parables of God's benevolence toward man, should begin to live carelessly, saying: "God is the Lover of mankind, and whenever we turn away from sin, He is ready and willing to advance us in His goodness." They ordered this dreadful day here, so that through the contemplation of death and the expectation of those fearsome woes, having struck awe into those lying in negligence, they might convert and bring them unto virtue, and teach them not only to place their trust in God's loving-kindness, but also to consider that He is a righteous Judge, Who renders unto each according to his works (Matt. 16:27; Rom. 2:6). Furthermore, after those days that preceded, it was needful that the Judge should also appear. And in a certain manner, this present feast is set forth today as it were the end of all feasts, since it shall indeed be the very last and final one of all concerning us.

provenance.verbatim_source: On this day, we celebrate the commemoration of the Second and Impartial Coming of Christ, which the most divine Fathers appointed after those two Parables [of the Publican and the Prodigal Son]: to the end that no one, having learned from those parables of God's benevolence toward man, should begin to live carelessly, saying: "God is the Lover of mankind, and whenever we turn away from sin, He is ready and willing to advance us in His goodness." They ordered this dreadful day here, so that through the contemplation of death and the expectation of those fearsome woes, having struck awe into those lying in negligence, they might convert and bring them unto virtue, and teach them not only to place their trust in God's loving-kindness, but also to consider that He is a righteous Judge, Who renders unto each according to his works (Matt. 16:27; Rom. 2:6). Furthermore, after those days that preceded, it was needful that the Judge should also appear. And in a certain manner, this present feast is set forth today as it were the end of all feasts, since it shall indeed be the very last and final one of all concerning us.

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Сї́ю за́сь Нл҃ю всѣ́хъ на́шихъ спра́въ коне́цъ, и҆ само́гѡ тогѡ̀ свѣ́та, в̾ Мѧсопꙋ́стной постанови́ли, гамꙋ́ючи, розꙋмѣ́ю, и҆ стиска́ючи роскошъ, и҆ ѡ҆бжерство и҆ ненасы́чонꙋю бꙋдꙋчꙋю хтї́вость, пре́зъ стра́хъ Пра́здника, та́кже в̾зыва́ючи на́съ до сполтерпѣ́нѧ и҆ млⷭрдова́нѧ сѧ наⷣ бли́жними на́шими. И҆ и҆на́чей, Понева́жъ ᲂу҆рокошова́вши сѧ вы́гнаными з̾ Е҆де́ма зоста́лнемы, и҆ поⷣ ѡ҆сꙋже́ємъ и҆ проклѧ́тствомъ бы́лиємы, ве́длꙋгъ тогѡ̀ настоѧ́щїй тꙋ́тъ поло́женъ є҆́стъ Пра́здникъ, и҆ же ма́емъ в̾ дрꙋгꙋ́ю Нл҃ю ве́длꙋгъ фигꙋ́ры то́естъ выѡбраже́нѧ чрез̾ А҆да́ма з̾ Е҆де́ма выгна́ными бы́ти: а҆́жъ по́ки на́съ Хрїсто́съ прише́дши, зно́вꙋ прибе́рнетъ и҆ въпрова́дитъ до Ра́ю.
items.english_text: It is proper, moreover, to see and consider that on the coming Sunday next at hand, they place the beginning of the world and Adam's very expulsion from Paradise.

provenance.verbatim_source: It is proper, moreover, to see and consider that on the coming Sunday next at hand, they place the beginning of the world and Adam's very expulsion from Paradise.

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Вто́рымъ за́сь при́стемъ Хв҃ымъ нн҃ѣшнїй де́нь назва́ный є҆́стъ. Понева́жъ и҆ пе́ршымъ ра́зомъ теле́сне до на́съ пришо́лъ, а҆́ле ба́рзѡ ти́хѡ, и҆ без̾ сла́вы.
items.english_text: This present Sunday, however, they have established on Meatfare as the end of all our affairs and of that world itself—curbing, as I deem, and restraining luxury, gluttony, and insatiable lust through the dread of the Feast, and likewise calling us unto fellow-suffering and showing mercy unto our neighbors. And in another way: since through living luxuriously we were cast out from Eden and fell under condemnation and a curse, in accordance therewith this present Feast is placed here, seeing that on the second Sunday, by way of prefiguration—that is, representation—we are to be cast out from Eden through Adam, until Christ, having come, shall again gather us and lead us into Paradise!

provenance.verbatim_source: This present Sunday, however, they have established on Meatfare as the end of all our affairs and of that world itself—curbing, as I deem, and restraining luxury, gluttony, and insatiable lust through the dread of the Feast, and likewise calling us unto fellow-suffering and showing mercy unto our neighbors. And in another way: since through living luxuriously we were cast out from Eden and fell under condemnation and a curse, in accordance therewith this present Feast is placed here, seeing that on the second Sunday, by way of prefiguration—that is, representation—we are to be cast out from Eden through Adam, until Christ, having come, shall again gather us and lead us into Paradise!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Нн҃ѣ за́сь з̾ чꙋда́ми наⷣприрожо́ными прїи́детъ, и҆ з̾ презнамени́тою ꙗ҆́сностїю з̾ Нб҃а, и҆ з̾ Тѣ́ломъ, же позна́нъ бꙋ́детъ ѿ всѣ́хъ, и҆́жъ то́тъ є҆́стъ кото́рый и҆ пе́рвѣй пришо́лъ, и҆ рожа́й чл҃чїй вы́бавилъ, и҆ кото́рый зно́вꙋ прїитѝ ма́етъ сꙋди́ти є҆гѡ̀, и҆ вы́пытовати, є҆́сли да́нныи и҆ повѣ́роныи є҆мꙋ̀ ре́чи до́бре захова́лъ.
items.english_text: Moreover, this present day is named the Second Coming of Christ, because the first time He also came bodily unto us, yet exceedingly quietly and without glory.

provenance.verbatim_source: Moreover, this present day is named the Second Coming of Christ, because the first time He also came bodily unto us, yet exceedingly quietly and without glory.

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Колѝ за́сь то́е прїи́стє бꙋ́детъ, жа́денъ невѣ́дає. То́е бовѣ́мъ и҆
items.english_text: Now, however, He shall come with supernatural wonders and with pre-eminent radiance from Heaven, and with His Body, so that He shall be recognized by all: that this is He Who came formerly and redeemed the human race, and Who is to come again to judge it and to examine whether it kept well the things given and entrusted unto it!

provenance.verbatim_source: Now, however, He shall come with supernatural wonders and with pre-eminent radiance from Heaven, and with His Body, so that He shall be recognized by all: that this is He Who came formerly and redeemed the human race, and Who is to come again to judge it and to examine whether it kept well the things given and entrusted unto it!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Колѝ за́сь то́е прїи́стє бꙋ́детъ, жа́денъ невѣ́дає. То́е бовѣ́мъ и҆
items.english_text: When, however, that Coming shall be, no one knows. For this indeed...

provenance.verbatim_source: When, however, that Coming shall be, no one knows. For this indeed...

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Повѣда́ютъ те́жъ, же по седмѝ ти́сѧчахъ лѣ́тъ, прїи́стє бꙋ́детъ. А҆ пре́ⷣ є҆гѡ̀ прїи́стемъ, прїи́детъ А҆нтїхрі́стъ, и҆ ᲂу҆роди́тсѧ, ꙗ҆́къ мо́витъ Ст҃ы́й І҆пполи́тъ Ри́мскїй з̾ невѣ́сты нечи́стои, и҆ дѣви́цы мни́мои, ѿ жидо́въ бꙋдꙋ́чи, ѿ поколѣ́нѧ Да́нова, кото́рый бы́лъ сы́номъ І҆а́кѡвовымъ. и҆ бꙋ́детъ ходи́ти, ꙗ҆́кѡ бы, ве́длꙋгъ Хрїста̀ проходѧ́чи житїѐ. И҆ чꙋда̀ чини́ти бꙋ́детъ, кото́рыи и҆ Хрїсто́съ спра́вовалъ. и҆ ме́ртвыхъ въскреша́ти бꙋ́детъ, є҆дна́къ ве́длꙋгъ фанта́змы, то́єстъ ѡ҆блꙋ́дного приви́дѣнїа, всѐ дѣ́ѧти бꙋ́детъ, и҆ наро́жєє, и҆ тѣ́ло, и҆ и҆ны́и всѣ̑ ре́чи, ꙗ҆́къ мо́витъ А҆́пл҃ъ.
items.english_text: ...the Lord concealed and kept hidden from the Apostles (Mark 13:32),[^222] although He revealed that certain signs are to precede it, which signs some of the Saints have explained at greater length in their writings.

provenance.verbatim_source: ...the Lord concealed and kept hidden from the Apostles (Mark 13:32),[^222] although He revealed that certain signs are to precede it, which signs some of the Saints have explained at greater length in their writings.

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: [* 2 Сол: 2. и 4.] *И҆ тогда̀, мо́витъ, ѡ҆крые́тсѧ сы́нъ поги́бели, во вше́лякои мо́ци, и҆ зна́кахъ, и҆ чꙋда́хъ кла́мства. А҆ бша́къ же не са́мъ дїа́волъ в̾ тѣ́ло приѡблоче́тсѧ, и҆ перетвори́тсѧ, [Правосл: славнои вѣры Кн: 4. гл: кн.] ꙗ҆́кѡ з̾ Дама́скꙋ мо́витъ І҆ѡа́нъ, а҆́ле чло́вѣкъ ѿ въшетече́нства ᲂу҆роди́вшисѧ, всю̀ шата́нскꙋю спра́вꙋ прїи́метъ, и҆ зна́гла выникне и҆ повста́нетъ.
items.english_text: They say also that after seven thousand years, the Coming shall take place.[^223] And before His Coming, Antichrist shall come, and shall be born, as Saint Hippolytus of Rome says,[^224] of an impure woman and a supposed virgin, being of the Jews, of the tribe of Dan, who was a son of Jacob (Gen. 49:17). And he shall walk as if living according to Christ, and shall work wonders which Christ also performed, and shall raise the dead; yet according to phantasm—that is, of delusive apparition—he shall perform all things: both his birth, and flesh, and all other things, as says the Apostle.

provenance.verbatim_source: They say also that after seven thousand years, the Coming shall take place.[^223] And before His Coming, Antichrist shall come, and shall be born, as Saint Hippolytus of Rome says,[^224] of an impure woman and a supposed virgin, being of the Jews, of the tribe of Dan, who was a son of Jacob (Gen. 49:17). And he shall walk as if living according to Christ, and shall work wonders which Christ also performed, and shall raise the dead; yet according to phantasm—that is, of delusive apparition—he shall perform all things: both his birth, and flesh, and all other things, as says the Apostle.

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: По́тымъ добротли́вымъ, и҆ скро́мнымъ ѿ всѣ́хъ розꙋмѣ́нъ бꙋ́детъ. И҆ го́лодъ тогда̀ вели́кїй бꙋ́детъ, и҆ в̾ то́мъ го́лодѣ ꙗ҆́кѡ бы люде́й вспомага́ти и҆ ратова́ти бꙋ́детъ. И҆ Бж҃твенныи пи́сма пере́йдетъ. и҆ в̾ по́стѣ цви́читисѧ бꙋ́детъ. и҆ примꙋ́шенъ бꙋ́детъ ѿ люде́й, и҆ кро́лемъ є҆гѡ̀ ѡ҆повѣда́тъ. и҆ ᲂу҆лю́битъ ба́рзѡ жидо́вскїй рожа́й, и҆ въ І҆ерꙋсали́мѣ ѡ҆сѧ́детъ. и҆ божни́цꙋ и҆́хъ понесе́тъ.
items.english_text: "And then," he says, "shall be revealed the son of perdition in all power and signs and lying wonders" (2 Thess. 2:3, 9).[^225] And yet the devil himself shall not be clothed in a body nor transformed, as John of Damascus says,[^226] but a man born of fornication shall receive all the operation of Satan, and shall suddenly emerge and arise.

provenance.verbatim_source: "And then," he says, "shall be revealed the son of perdition in all power and signs and lying wonders" (2 Thess. 2:3, 9).[^225] And yet the devil himself shall not be clothed in a body nor transformed, as John of Damascus says,[^226] but a man born of fornication shall receive all the operation of Satan, and shall suddenly emerge and arise.

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: [Дані: 12] А҆ преⷣ седмѝ лѣ́ты, ꙗ҆́къ мо́витъ Данїи́лъ, прїи́дꙋтъ Е҆нѡ́хъ и҆ И҆лїа̀, проповѣ́даючїи лю́демъ, же́бы не прїимова́ли є҆гѡ̀. А҆ ѡ҆́нъ поима́вши и҆́хъ, мꙋ́чити бꙋ́детъ. По́тымъ и҆ го́ловы и҆́хъ повтина́етъ. ты́и за́сь кото́рыи назва́ны сꙋ́тъ бл҃гочти́выи, дале́кѡ поᲂу҆тѣка́ютъ, кото́рыи меж̾и гора́ми пона́йдовавши, через̾ бѣ́сы кꙋси́ти и҆ зводи́ти бꙋ́дꙋтъ.
items.english_text: Thereafter he shall be deemed by all to be benevolent and modest. And there shall be a great famine then, and in that famine he shall as it were help and rescue people; and he shall study the Divine Scriptures, and shall exercise himself in fasting; and he shall be compelled by the people, and they shall proclaim him king. And he shall greatly love the Jewish race, and shall settle in Jerusalem, and shall rebuild their temple.

provenance.verbatim_source: Thereafter he shall be deemed by all to be benevolent and modest. And there shall be a great famine then, and in that famine he shall as it were help and rescue people; and he shall study the Divine Scriptures, and shall exercise himself in fasting; and he shall be compelled by the people, and they shall proclaim him king. And he shall greatly love the Jewish race, and shall settle in Jerusalem, and shall rebuild their temple.

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: [Мт: 24.] А҆ле з̾корота́тсѧ ѻ҆́ныи се́дмь лѣ́тъ длѧ вы́браныхъ. И҆ го́лодъ бꙋ́дет вели́кїй, гды́сѧ и҆ стихї́а [живїола] всѣ̑ переворачи́ти бꙋ́дꙋтъ, та́къ, же ма́ло всѣ̑ не зни́кнꙋтъ и҆ непоги́нꙋтъ.
items.english_text: And seven years before, as Daniel says,[^227] Enoch and Elijah shall come, preaching unto the people that they should not receive him; but he, having seized them, shall torment them, and thereafter shall cut off their heads (Rev. 11:3, 7). Those, however, who are called pious shall flee far away, and having found them among the mountains, he shall tempt and seduce them through demons.

provenance.verbatim_source: And seven years before, as Daniel says,[^227] Enoch and Elijah shall come, preaching unto the people that they should not receive him; but he, having seized them, shall torment them, and thereafter shall cut off their heads (Rev. 11:3, 7). Those, however, who are called pious shall flee far away, and having found them among the mountains, he shall tempt and seduce them through demons.

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: [Мт: 24. д 29. 30. Мк 13. Лук 21. 1 Кор: 15. 1 Сол: 4. Апок 20.] По́тымъ за́сь, зна́гла ꙗ҆́къ бы блискави́ца з̾ нб҃а Гдⷭнее прїи́стє бꙋ́детъ, гды́ жъ предъ и҆тѝ бꙋ́детъ чтⷭны́й є҆гѡ̀ Крⷭтъ, и҆ рѣ́ка ѻ҆гнїи́стаѧ стра́шно пѣ́нящисѧ переⷣ нимъ потече́тъ, всю̀ зе́млю ѿ зма́ и҆ плюга́вства ѡ҆чища́ючаѧ. В̾ то́й часъ за́разъ по́йманъ бꙋ́детъ А҆нтїхрі́стъ, и҆ є҆гѡ̀ слꙋжебники, и҆ ѿда́нъ бꙋ́дет на вѣ́чный ѻ҆́гнь. И҆ гды̀ затрꙋбѧ́тъ А҆́гг҃лове, прїи́дет до кꙋ́пы з̾громажо́ный ѿ концѡ́въ землѝ, и҆ ѿ всѣ́хъ
items.english_text: Yet those seven years shall be shortened for the sake of the elect (Matt. 24:22).[^228] And there shall be a great famine, when all the elements shall be overturned, so that all shall almost vanish and perish.

provenance.verbatim_source: Yet those seven years shall be shortened for the sake of the elect (Matt. 24:22).[^228] And there shall be a great famine, when all the elements shall be overturned, so that all shall almost vanish and perish.

items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD

items.english_text: Thereafter, suddenly, as it were lightning from heaven, shall be the Coming of the Lord (Matt. 24:27, 29–30; Mark 13:24–26; Luke 21:25–27; 1 Cor. 15:52; 1 Thess. 4:16; Rev. 20:10),[^229] when His Precious Cross shall go before Him, and a river of fire terribly foaming shall flow before Him, cleansing all the earth from filth and defilement! At that hour Antichrist shall immediately be seized, and his ministers, and he shall be given over unto eternal fire. And when the Angels sound the trumpet, there shall come gathered together into one heap from the ends of the earth and from all...

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Вѣ́дати те́жъ и҆ то́ потре́ба, же на то́тъ ча́съ не По́стꙋ, а҆нѝ наготы̀, а҆ни чꙋде́съ ꙗ҆ки́хъ шꙋка́ти в̾ на́съ бꙋ́детъ Хрїсто́съ, а҆́чъ до́брыи сꙋ́тъ и҆ ты́и ре́чи. А҆́ле цно́тъ дале́кѡ на̀ сїи́ зацнѣ́йшихъ, то́єстъ ꙗ҆́лмꙋжны, и҆ млⷭрдя.
items.english_text: ...elements, the whole human race unto Jerusalem, since it is the center of the world.[^230] And there the Thrones are prepared for judgment; and people stand solely with their bodies and souls, when all shall be transformed into incorruption (1 Cor. 15:52) and shall have one form, and the very elements shall receive a change for the better. And with a single word the Lord shall separate the righteous from the sinners (Matt. 25:32); and the doers of good things shall depart, bearing away eternal life, but unto the sinners, eternal torment (Matt. 25:46); and there shall never be any end or cessation of either!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Рече́тъ бовѣ́мъ справедли́вымъ, ше́сть нѣ́которыхъ ре́чїй: Ла́кнꙋлемъ бовѣ́мъ и҆ дали́сте ми ѣ́сти: Пра́гнꙋлем, и҆ напои́листе мѧ: Го́стемъ бы́лемъ, и҆ при́нѧлисте млѧ: На́гїй, и҆ приодѣ́листе мѧ: Хо́рый бы́лемъ, и҆ навѣди́листе млѧ: В̾ вазе́ню бы́лем, и҆ пришли́ є҆сте до ме́не. И҆́ле бовѣ́мъ ᲂу҆чинни́ли є҆сте є҆ди́номꙋ з̾ ты́ меншихъ, мнѣ̀ ᲂу҆чинни́ли є҆сте. Кото́рыи то цно́ты мо́жет по́лнити ко́ждый ве́длꙋгъ си́лы.
items.english_text: It is necessary to know also this: that at that hour Christ will not seek in us fasting, nor nakedness, nor any wonders—though these things also are good—but virtues far more noble than these: that is to say, almsgiving and mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: It is necessary to know also this: that at that hour Christ will not seek in us fasting, nor nakedness, nor any wonders—though these things also are good—but virtues far more noble than these: that is to say, almsgiving and mercy!

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: На то́тъ часъ те́ды вшеля́кїй ꙗ҆зы́къ вызна́ет, же Гдⷭь І҆и҃съ Хрїсто́съ, въ Сла́вꙋ Бг҃а Ѻ҆ц҃а̀. Мꙋ́ки за́сь, кото́рыи Ст҃е́нное Е҆ѵⷢлїе предало̀, ты́и сꙋ́тъ: Та́м бꙋ́детъ пла́чъ, и҆ скрежет̾ же зꙋбѡ́мъ. Роба́къ и҆́хъ не сконча́етсѧ, и҆ ѻ҆́гнь и҆́хъ не пога́снетъ. и҆ ѻ҆́ное, в̾ве́ржѣ́те є҆гѡ̀ до те́мности ѡ҆кроме́шнеи. Кото́рыи то всѣ̑ ре́чи, ꙗ҆́сне и҆ знамени́те Цр҃квь Бж҃їа принѧ́вши, розꙋмѣ́етъ: же ро́скошъ и҆ Црⷭтво нб҃ное є҆́ст, ст҃ы́мъ з̾ Бг҃омъ сполмешка́нє, И҆, же ѻ҆́нымъ Ст҃ы̑мъ ма́етъ бы́ти ᲂу҆ста́вичное ѡ҆свѣче́є и҆ повыше́нє. Та́къ те́жъ, и҆́жъ мꙋ́ка, и҆ те́мность, и҆ ты́мъ подо́бныи, є҆́стъ ѿ Бг҃а ѿдале́нєсѧ, и҆ дꙋ́шъ преⷣ со́вѣсть ᲂу҆тра́та и҆ згꙋ́ба, ꙗ҆́къ ты́ кото́рыи длѧ недба́лства и҆ ро́скоши доча́снои, Бж҃скои ꙗ҆́сности позбы́ли. Невысло́венымъ чл҃колꙋбїемъ твои́мъ Хрїстѐ, Бж҃е пожада́ногѡ твое́гѡ го́лосꙋ на́съ го́дными ᲂу҆чинѝ, и҆ меж̾и стоѧ́чїи, по прави́цы твое́й поли́чи, и҆ зми́лꙋйсѧ наⷣ на́ми, А҆ми́нь.
items.english_text: For He shall say unto the righteous six certain things: "For I was hungry, and ye gave Me to eat; I was thirsty, and ye gave Me drink; I was a stranger, and ye took Me in; naked, and ye clothed Me; I was sick, and ye visited Me; I was in prison, and ye came unto Me. For inasmuch as ye did it unto one of these least, ye did it unto Me" (Matt. 25:35–40). Which virtues everyone can fulfill according to his strength.

For inasmuch as ye did it unto one of these least, ye did it unto Me" (Matt. 25:35–40). Which virtues everyone can fulfill according to his strength.

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. И҆рмо́съ. Согрѣши́хомъ, и҆ беззаконо́вахомъ, и҆ не ѡ҆правди́хомъ преⷣ тобо́ю. Ни соблюдо́хомъ ни сотвори́хомъ, ꙗ҆́коже заповѣ́далъ є҆сѝ на́мъ. но не преда́ждь на́съ до конца̀, ѻ҆тческїй Бж҃е блгⷭве́нъ є҆сѝ:
items.english_text: At that hour, then, every tongue shall confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father (Phil. 2:11). The torments, moreover, which the Holy Gospel has handed down, are these: "There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth" (Matt. 8:12); "Their worm shall not die, and their fire shall not be quenched" (Mark 9:44); and that other: "Cast him into the outer darkness" (Matt. 22:13). Which things all, having received clearly and distinctly, the Church of God understands: that delight and the Kingdom of Heaven is for the Saints a co-dwelling with God, and that for those Saints there is to be continual illumination and exaltation. In like manner also, that torment, and darkness, and the like, is estrangement from God, and the loss and ruin of souls before conscience, as those who for the sake of negligence and temporal luxury have forfeited the Divine radiance. By Thine ineffable love for mankind, O Christ God, make us worthy of Thy longed-for voice, and number us among those standing at Thy right hand, and have mercy upon us! Amen.[^231]

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, з҃. И҆рмо́съ. Согрѣши́хомъ, и҆ беззаконо́вахомъ, и҆ не ѡ҆правди́хомъ преⷣ тобо́ю. Ни соблюдо́хомъ ни сотвори́хомъ, ꙗ҆́коже заповѣ́далъ є҆сѝ на́мъ. но не преда́ждь на́съ до конца̀, ѻ҆тческїй Бж҃е блгⷭве́нъ є҆сѝ:
items.english_text: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* We have sinned, we have transgressed, and we have done unjustly before Thee; neither have we kept nor done as Thou hast commanded us: but deliver us not up utterly, O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou! (Dan. 3:29–30; 3:52 [LXX]).[^232]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* We have sinned, we have transgressed, and we have done unjustly before Thee; neither have we kept nor done as Thou hast commanded us: but deliver us not up utterly, O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou! (Dan. 3:29–30; 3:52 [LXX]).[^232]

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Припаде́мъ и҆ въспла́чемсѧ пре́жде сꙋда̀ ѻ҆́нагѡ всѝ вѣ́рнїи, є҆гда̀ нб҃са̀ поги́бнꙋтъ, ѕвѣ́зды ниспадꙋ́тъ, и҆ всѧ̀ землѧ̀ поколѣ́блетсѧ, да млⷭтива ѡ҆брѧ́щемъ пре́жде конца̀, ѻ҆тце́мъ Бг҃а:
items.english_text: *Troparion (continued):* Let us fall down and weep before that judgment, all we faithful, when the heavens shall perish, the stars fall, and all the earth be shaken, that before the end we may find merciful the God of our fathers! (Matt. 24:29; Heb. 1:11–12; 2 Pet. 3:10).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion (continued):* Let us fall down and weep before that judgment, all we faithful, when the heavens shall perish, the stars fall, and all the earth be shaken, that before the end we may find merciful the God of our fathers! (Matt. 24:29; Heb. 1:11–12; 2 Pet. 3:10).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Неᲂу҆мы́тное и҆стѧза́нїе, стра́шный є҆́стъ та́мѡ сꙋ́дъ. и҆де́же сꙋдїѧ не ᲂу҆тае́нъ є҆́стъ, и҆де́же лица̀ нѣ́сть въ да́рѣхъ прїѧ́ти: Но пощади́ мѧ Влⷣко, и҆ и҆зба́ви всѧ́кагѡ гнѣ́ва твое́гѡ стра́шнагѡ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Incorruptible is the cross-examination, dreadful is the judgment there, where the Judge cannot be deceived, where there is no accepting of persons for bribes: but spare me, O Master, and deliver me from all Thy dreadful wrath! (2 Chron. 19:7 [LXX 2 Paral. 19:7]; Rom. 2:11).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Incorruptible is the cross-examination, dreadful is the judgment there, where the Judge cannot be deceived, where there is no accepting of persons for bribes: but spare me, O Master, and deliver me from all Thy dreadful wrath! (2 Chron. 19:7 [LXX 2 Paral. 19:7]; Rom. 2:11).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Гдⷭь грѧде́тъ сꙋди́ти, кто̀ сте́рпитъ видѣ́нїе є҆гѡ̀; вострепещѝ дꙋшѐ ѡ҆ка́ѧннаѧ, вострепещѝ, и҆ ᲂу҆гото́ви и҆схо́дницꙋ дѣла̀ своѧ̑, да млⷭтива и҆ млⷭрда ѡ҆брѧ́щеши є҆гѡ̀, Ѻ҆тце́мъ Бг҃а блгⷭвена:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Lord comes to judge: who shall endure the vision of Him? Tremble, O wretched soul, tremble, and prepare thy works for departure, that thou mayest find Him merciful and compassionate, the blessed God of our fathers! (Mal. 3:2).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The Lord comes to judge: who shall endure the vision of Him? Tremble, O wretched soul, tremble, and prepare thy works for departure, that thou mayest find Him merciful and compassionate, the blessed God of our fathers! (Mal. 3:2).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Припада́ю ти и҆ приношꙋ̀ тебѣ̀, ꙗ҆́коже сле́зы глаго́лы моѧ̑. съгрѣши́хъ ꙗ҆́коже не согрѣшѝ блꙋдни́ца, и҆ беззаконо́вахъ, ꙗ҆́коже и҆ны́й никто́же на землѝ. но ᲂу҆ще́дри Влⷣко творенїе своѐ, и҆ призови́ мѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I fall down before Thee and offer unto Thee my words as tears: I have sinned as the harlot never sinned, and I have transgressed as no other on earth! But take pity, O Master, upon Thine own creation, and call me back! (Luke 7:37–38).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I fall down before Thee and offer unto Thee my words as tears: I have sinned as the harlot never sinned, and I have transgressed as no other on earth! But take pity, O Master, upon Thine own creation, and call me back! (Luke 7:37–38).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Негаси́мый ѻ҆́гнь смꙋща́етъ мѧ, и҆ го́ркїй скре́жетъ зꙋ́бный. а҆́дъ дꙋшетлѣ́нный страши́тъ мѧ. бл҃гоꙋмиле́нъ никогда́же быва́ю. Но Гдⷭи Гдⷭи, пре́жде конца̀ мѧ̀ ᲂу҆твердѝ стра́хомъ твои́мъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The unquenchable fire confounds me, and the bitter gnashing of teeth; soul-destroying hell terrifies me; never am I filled with good compunction! But O Lord, Lord, before the end establish me in Thy fear! (Matt. 8:12; 25:41).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The unquenchable fire confounds me, and the bitter gnashing of teeth; soul-destroying hell terrifies me; never am I filled with good compunction! But O Lord, Lord, before the end establish me in Thy fear! (Matt. 8:12; 25:41).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆брати́сѧ дꙋшѐ пока́йсѧ, ѿкры́й сокрове́ннаѧ. глаго́ли Бг҃ꙋ всѧ̑ вѣ́дꙋщомꙋ, ты вѣ́си моѧ̑ та̑йнаѧ є҆ди́не сп҃се, но са́мъ мѧ̀ поми́лꙋй, ꙗ҆́коже пое́тъ Дв҃дъ, по млⷭти твое́й:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Turn back, O my soul, repent, uncover thy secret things! Say unto God Who knows all things: "Thou knowest my hidden secrets, O only Savior; yet do Thou Thyself have mercy upon me, as David sings, according to Thy mercy!" (Ps. 50:3 [LXX 50:3 / MT 51:1]).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Turn back, O my soul, repent, uncover thy secret things! Say unto God Who knows all things: "Thou knowest my hidden secrets, O only Savior; yet do Thou Thyself have mercy upon me, as David sings, according to Thy mercy!" (Ps. 50:3 [LXX 50:3 / MT 51:1]).

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Трⷪ́ченъ. Сла́ва: Три є҆ди́но, сꙋ́ществомъ, и҆ трѝ в̾ лицѣ́хъ пою̀ сїѧ̑, Ѻ҆́цъ, Сн҃ъ, и҆ Ст҃ый Дх҃ъ, є҆ди́на си́ла, хотѣ́нїе, и҆ дѣ́йство. є҆ди́нъ Бг҃ъ трист҃ы́й. црⷭтво є҆ди́но, є҆динонача́льнѣйшее:
items.english_text: *Glory... Triadikon:* Three in One by essence, and three in Persons, do I praise these: the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit; one power, will, and operation; one thrice-holy God; one kingdom, supreme in single beginning![^233]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Glory... Triadikon:* Three in One by essence, and three in Persons, do I praise these: the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit; one power, will, and operation; one thrice-holy God; one kingdom, supreme in single beginning![^233]

items.office: Sunday of Meatfare
items.season_or_tone: PART I: PRE-LENTEN PERIOD
items.day_or_date: Synaxarion (continued):
items.slavonic_text: Мѧсопꙋ́стнаѧ. Происхо́дитъ краснѣ́йшій, ѿ черто́га чре́ва твое́гѡ Бг҃ъ, ꙗ́кѡже цр҃ь ѡдѣ́ѧный, Бг҃отка́нною багрѧни́цею, ѡбагре́нїѧ та́йнагѡ прчⷭ҇тыхъ кро́вїй твои́хъ, Бенебѣ́тнаѧ, и црⷭ҇твꙋетъ земле́ю. Катава́сїа. Согрѣши́хомъ: Пѣ́сн̑, и҃. И҆рмо́съ. Е҆го́же во́инства нб҃наѧ сла́вѧтъ: и трепе́щꙋтъ Херꙋві́ми и серафі́ми, всѧ́кое дыха́нїе и тва́рь, по́йте блгⷭ҇вите и превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки. Стра́шнагѡ втора́гѡ Твое́гѡ Гдⷭ҇и прише́ствїѧ помышля́ѧ ꙋсрѣ́тенїе, трепе́щꙋ преще́нїѧ твое́гѡ, бою́ся гнѣ́ва твое́гѡ. ѿ сегѡ́ мя часа зовꙋ́ спаси во вѣ́ки. Тебѣ̀ Бг҃ꙋ сꙋдѧ́щꙋ всѧ́чєскаѧ, кто сте́рпитъ земноро́денъ сы́й и пе́рстенъ. Негаси́мый бо о́гнь тогда̀ и че́рвь скрежещꙋ́щїй велмѝ, ѡсꙋжде́ныхъ прїи́метъ въ вѣ́ки. Вся́кое дыха́нїе є҆гда̀ призове́ши, є҆́же разсꙋди́ти Хрїстѐ в кꙋ́пѣ. вели́кїй стра́хъ тогда̀, велїѧ бѣда̀, то́кмѡ помага́ющимъ дѣѧ́нїемъ въ вѣ́ки. Всѣ́хъ сꙋдїѐ Бж҃е мо́й, и҆ Гдⷭ҇и, да ꙋслы́шꙋ тогда̀ гла́съ тво́й вожделѣ́нный. да ꙋзрю̀ свѣ́тъ тво́й вели́кїй. да вселю́ся въ кро́вы твоѧ̑. да ви́ждꙋ твою̀ сла́вꙋ, ра́дꙋѧся въ вѣ́ки. Правосу́де Сп҃се поми́лꙋй, и и҆зба́ви мѧ̀ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ и преще́нїѧ, є҆́же и҆́мамъ на сꙋдѣ̀ пра́веднѡ поѧ́ти. ѡсла́би ми пре́же конца̀, добродѣ́тели ра́ди и покаѧ́нїѧ. Е҆гда̀ сѧ́деши Сꙋдїѐ ꙗ҆́кѡ млⷭ҇рдъ, и пока́жеши стра́шнꙋю сла́вꙋ свою̀ Хрїстѐ. ѡ коль́ кі́й стра́хъ тогда̀, пе́щи горѧ́щой, и всѣ̑мъ боѧ́щымся непобѣ́днагѡ сꙋди́ща твоегѡ̀. Блгⷭ҇ви́мъ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀, и Сн҃а, и Ст҃гѡ Дх҃а Гдⷭ҇а. Е҆дина́гѡ Бг҃а по сꙋще́ствꙋ чтꙋ̀, три соста́вы пою̀ ѡпредѣли́телнѣ, и҆ны́ѧ но не и҆на́кїѧ, поне́же
items.english_text: *Theotokion (continued):* The Most Comely God comes forth from the bridal chamber of thy womb, as a King arrayed in a purple robe woven by God, dyed by the mystery of thy most pure blood, O unwedded Bride, and He reigns over the earth! (Ps. 44:3 [LXX 44:3 / MT 45:2]).

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion (continued):* The Most Comely God comes forth from the bridal chamber of thy womb, as a King arrayed in a purple robe woven by God, dyed by the mystery of thy most pure blood, O unwedded Bride, and He reigns over the earth! (Ps. 44:3 [LXX 44:3 / MT 45:2]).

items.slavonic_text: Нл҃а. бж҃тво є҆ди́но въ трїе́хъ ли́цѣхъ. И҆́бо Ѻ҆ц҃ъ, Сн҃ъ, и҆ Дх҃ъ Бж҃твенный: Бг҃оро́диченъ. И҆з̾ свѣтлѣ́йшагѡ чре́ва твое́гѡ и҆зше́дъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ жени́хъ и҆з̾ черто́га вои́нъ Хрїсто́съ, свѣ́тъ ве́лїй сꙋ́щымъ въ тмѣ̀. И҆́бо пра́вды сл҃нце ѡ҆блиста́въ просвѣтѝ мі́ръ: Хва́лимъ, блгⷭ҇ви́мъ, покланѧ́емсѧ Гдⷭ҇еви пою́ще и превозносѧ́ще: И҆рмо́съ: Е҆го́же во́инства нб҃наѧ сла́вѧтъ: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. И҆рмо́съ. Безсѣ́менна зача́тїѧ рожество̀ несказа́нное, Мт҃ре безмꙋ́жныѧ безсѣ́менное рожде́нїе. Бж҃їе бо рожество̀ ѡ҆бновлѧ́етъ є҆стества̀. Тѣ́мъ тѧ̀ вси ро́ди, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃а на́шегѡ Мт҃рь правосла́внѡ велича́емъ. Гдⷭ҇ь грѧде́тъ грѣ́шныѧ мꙋ́чити, пра́ведныѧ же сп҃сти. Возпла́чимсѧ и҆ възрыда́имъ, и҆ прїи́мемъ чꙋ́вьство ѻ҆́нагѡ днѐ, во́нже безвѣ́стнаѧ и҆ та́иннаѧ ѡ҆кры́въ чл҃вкѡмъ, ѿда́стъ по достоѧ́нїю: Пристра́шенъ и҆ тре́петенъ бы́сть Мѡѷсе́й, видѣ́въ тѧ̀ ѿ за́днихъ. Ка́кѡже постою̀, лицѐ твоѐ видѧ̀ тогда̀ а҆́зъ ѡ҆каѧ́нный, є҆гда̀ прїи́деши съ нб҃сѐ; Но пощади́ ма Ще́дре, в̾ мл҃тивномъ ти возрѣ́нїи: Данїи́лъ ꙋ҆боѧ́ся часа̀ и҆стѧза́нїѧ. А҆́зъ же что̀ постра́ждꙋ Гдⷭ҇и, на са́мый грѧды́й стра́шный де́нь; Но да́ждь ми пре́жде конца̀, бл҃гоꙋго́днѡ тебѣ̀ послꙋжи́ти, и҆ ꙋ҆лꙋчи́ти црⷭ҇твїе твоѐ: О҆́гнь гото́витсѧ, и҆ че́рвь пригото́влѧетсѧ. Весе́лїе, сла́ва, ѡ҆слабле́нїе, свѣ́тъ невече́рнїй, ра́дость пра́ведныхъ. И҆ кто̀ бл҃же́нный и҆збѣ́гнꙋти не схо́щетъ мꙋче́нїѧ пе́рвыхъ, наслѣ́дити и҆мѣ́ѧй втора̑ѧ: Да мѧ̀ не ѡ҆брати́тъ ѿ лица̀ твое́гѡ Гдⷭ҇и, ꙗ҆́рость твое́гѡ гнѣ́ва. Ни да ꙋ҆слы́шꙋ гла́са проклѧ́тагѡ,
