items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: Thursday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.slavonic_text: И҆рмо́съ. Дѣла̀ смотре́нїѧ твоегѡ̀ Гдⷭи, оу҆диви́ша Прⷪро́ка А҆вваку́ма. и҆зше́лъ бо є҆сѝ въ сп҃сенїе лю́демъ твои́мъ. є҆́же сп҃стѝ бл҃гыѧ своѧ̀ прише́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O divine and all-honored twelvefold company of the Apostles: entreat Christ God for us, we pray, that we may powerfully traverse the forty-day arena of the fast!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* O divine and all-honored twelvefold company of the Apostles: entreat Christ God for us, we pray, that we may powerfully traverse the forty-day arena of the fast!

items.office: Thursday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: Thursday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҆́. И҆рмо́съ. Велѣ́нїѧ мучи́телева: По́стимсѧ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ сла́сти, тꙋча́ще чꙋ́вьства по́стомъ, и҆ оу҆миле́нїѧ пи́тїе те́плѣ пїе́мъ, пою́ще, бл҃ги́те дѣла̀ Гн҃ѧ Гдⷭа: *
items.english_text: *Katavasia: The works of Thy dispensation, O Lord, astonished the Prophet Habakkuk; for Thou didst go forth for the salvation of Thy people, to save Thine elect hast Thou come!* (Hab. 3:1–3, 13)[^714]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Katavasia: The works of Thy dispensation, O Lord, astonished the Prophet Habakkuk; for Thou didst go forth for the salvation of Thy people, to save Thine elect hast Thou come!* (Hab. 3:1–3, 13)[^714]

items.office: Thursday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: Thursday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.slavonic_text: Стоѧ́нїѧ ѡ҆десну́ю ѡ҆бє́щника мѧ бы́ти моли́теся, є҆гда̀ сѧ́дете сꙋди́ти чл҃кѡмъ съ Хрїсто́мъ А҆пл҃и, мно́гимъ грѣхѡ́мъ и҆ сꙋ́ду пови́ннагѡ: *
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: The tyrant's decree [which was contrary to God, the three youths regarded not; and being cast into the midst of the furnace of fire, being moistened with dew, they sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!] (Dan. 3:57–88)*[^715]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 8. Heirmos: The tyrant's decree [which was contrary to God, the three youths regarded not; and being cast into the midst of the furnace of fire, being moistened with dew, they sang: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!] (Dan. 3:57–88)*[^715]

items.office: Thursday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: Thursday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.slavonic_text: На колесни́цꙋ Бж҃ественныхъ добродѣ́телей, по́стомъ ѡ҆чи́стившеся взы́йдемъ, и҆ на воздꙋ́шнꙋю высотꙋ̀ оу҆́мъ впери́мъ, пою́ще бл҃ги́те дѣла̀: *
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Let us fast from every pleasure, nourishing the senses through the fast, and let us fervently drink the draught of compunction, singing: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!"

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion 1:* Let us fast from every pleasure, nourishing the senses through the fast, and let us fervently drink the draught of compunction, singing: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!"

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о: Пребыла̀ є҆сѝ неѡпали́ма, ѻ҆́гнь ро́ждши Бж҃тва̀ дв҃о. но попалѝ стра́сти дꙋша̀, вѣ́рою пою́щихъ ти гла́съ А҆́гг҃ловъ, ра́дости є҆ди́на хода́таице: *
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Entreat that I may become a partaker of the standing at the right hand, when ye sit with Christ to judge mankind, O Apostles—me who am guilty of many sins and subject to judgment! (Matt. 19:28; 25:33)

items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Having cleansed ourselves through the fast, let us ascend the chariot of divine virtues, and give wings unto our mind toward the aerial height, singing: "Bless the Lord, all ye works!" (4 Kings [2 Kings] 2:11)

items.slavonic_text: Трⷪ́цꙋ всест҃ꙋ́ю, въ О҆ц҃ѣ̀, и҆ Сн҃ѣ, и҆ Дх҃ѣ, хва́лѧще пое́мъ, бл҃ги́те, дѣла̀ Гн҃ѧ Гдⷭа: *
items.english_text: *Trinity Hymn:* Praising the all-holy Trinity—in Father, and Son, and Spirit—we sing: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!"

provenance.verbatim_source: *Trinity Hymn:* Praising the all-holy Trinity—in Father, and Son, and Spirit—we sing: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!"

items.office: Thursday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. А҆пл҃и мл҃итеся, въ ми́рѣ на́мъ ѡ҆чисти́телныѧ днѝ сконча́ти, бл҃ги́те вопїю́щихъ дѣла̀ Гн҃ѧ Гдⷭа: *
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* All of us mortals hymn thy ineffable childbearing, piously crying out, O pure Virgin: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!"

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* All of us mortals hymn thy ineffable childbearing, piously crying out, O pure Virgin: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!"

items.office: Thursday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: Thursday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. И҆рмо́съ. Невмѣсти́маго Бг҃а: Ѡ҆верже́нъ въ глубо́кꙋю пучи́нꙋ сла́стей, твое́гѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бїѧ бе́зднꙋ призыва́ю, ко́рмчїй сп҃си́ мѧ: *
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O Apostles, pray that in peace we may finish the cleansing days of the fast, who cry: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!"

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* O Apostles, pray that in peace we may finish the cleansing days of the fast, who cry: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord!"

items.slavonic_text: Оу҆чени́кѡвъ твои́хъ І҆и҃се чт҃ными мл҃енїи, чт҃номоу̀ да́рꙋй ми въскр҃сенїю поклони́тисѧ, и҆ Бж҃твеннымъ твои́мъ Ст҃рте́мъ: *
items.english_text: *Katavasia: Thy highly hymned children, singing in the furnace, O Christ, said: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto all ages!"* (Dan. 3:57–88)[^717]

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о: Ѡ҆небе́сившаѧ на́ше земно́е смѣше́нїе, въ тебѣ̀ всенепоро́чнаѧ, Бж҃їимъ вселе́нїемъ, и҆зба́ви всѣ́хъ бѣ́дъ: *
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: The uncontainable God, [Whom the heavens could not contain, was contained within thy womb, O Mother of God, and bare the Salvation of the world: therefore with unceasing hymns we magnify thee!] (Luke 1:46–55)*[^718]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 9. Heirmos: The uncontainable God, [Whom the heavens could not contain, was contained within thy womb, O Mother of God, and bare the Salvation of the world: therefore with unceasing hymns we magnify thee!] (Luke 1:46–55)*[^718]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ны́й И҆рмо́съ. Велича́емъ Хрїстѐ твоѝ: И҆з̾ и҆сто́чникѡвъ Прⷪро́чески сп҃се́нныхъ, почерпше А҆пл҃и, во́ду безсме́ртїѧ, жа́ждꙋщихъ велѣ́нїемъ жи́зни напаѧ́ютъ всегда̀: *
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Cast into the deep abyss of pleasures, I call upon the deep of Thy compassion: O Pilot, save me!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion 1:* Cast into the deep abyss of pleasures, I call upon the deep of Thy compassion: O Pilot, save me!

items.slavonic_text: Цр҃ѧ̀ Нбⷭнагѡ ꙗ҆ви́вшеся Кн҃зи А҆пл҃и, повинꙋ́ете вселе́нную всю̀, Сего̀ є҆ди́наго честѝ, покланѧ́ти сѧ и҆ славослови́ти ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃а: *
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* O Wellspring of mercy, grant me now a drop of compunction, that I may weep for my wicked deeds, which are measureless beyond the sea!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion 2:* O Wellspring of mercy, grant me now a drop of compunction, that I may weep for my wicked deeds, which are measureless beyond the sea!

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о: Тѧ Мт҃и и҆ Дв҃о чт҃аѧ, оу҆блажа́емъ рѡ́[дъ] ро́дѡвъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ была̀ є҆сѝ ѡ҆чисти́лище мі́рꙋ, сп҃са и҆ содѣ́телѧ, неизгла́ннѡ ро́ждши: *
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Generation of generations, we call thee blessed, O Mother and pure Virgin, for thou wast the cleansing place for the world, having ineffably given birth unto the Savior and Creator! (Luke 1:48)

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Generation of generations, we call thee blessed, O Mother and pure Virgin, for thou wast the cleansing place for the world, having ineffably given birth unto the Savior and Creator! (Luke 1:48)

items.english_text: *Troparion:* As we hymn Thee, the Savior, vouchsafe us, through the company of Thine Apostles, to pass in compunction of heart through all the days of the light-bearing fast!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* As we hymn Thee, the Savior, vouchsafe us, through the company of Thine Apostles, to pass in compunction of heart through all the days of the light-bearing fast!

items.english_text: *Katavasia: We magnify Thee, O Christ, and Thy most pure and all-immaculate Mother, for beyond nature she bare Thee in the flesh, Who deliverest us from all delusion and corruption!*[^720]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Katavasia: We magnify Thee, O Christ, and Thy most pure and all-immaculate Mother, for beyond nature she bare Thee in the flesh, Who deliverest us from all delusion and corruption!*[^720]

items.slavonic_text: На стїх: Ст҃ры Самогла́сны, Гла́съ, г҃. Гдⷭи мнѣ̀ грѣ́шномꙋ положи́лъ є҆сѝ покаѧ́нїе, менѐ недосто́йнаго сп҃ти хотѧ̀, безмѣ́рною млⷭ́тїю твое́ю. тебѣ̀ припада́ѧ молю́ся, по́стомъ дш҃ꙋ мою̀ преклонѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ к̾ тебѣ̀ прибѣго́хъ, є҆ди́номꙋ многомл҃тивомꙋ: *
items.english_text: *Then: "It is truly meet..." Exapostilarion of the Tone.*[^721]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Then: "It is truly meet..." Exapostilarion of the Tone.*[^721]

items.slavonic_text: В҃. Стїхъ, а҃. И҆спо́лнихомся заꙋ́тра: И҆ па́ки тꙋ̀ стїхꙋ̀. стїхъ, в҃. И҆ бꙋ́ди свѣ́тлость: Ꙗ҆́кѡ свѣти́ла въ мі́рѣ сїѧ́ете, и҆ по сме́рти ст҃їи мꙋ́чннци, по́двигомъ до́брымъ подви́гшеся, и҆мꙋ́ще дерзнове́нїе Хрїста̀ моли́те, поми́ловатисѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шимъ: *
items.english_text: *At the Aposticha, Idiomelon Stichera, Tone 3:*[^722]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ нн҃ѣ: Бг҃о: Бц҃е предста́телнице всѣ̑мъ молѧ́щымся тебѣ̀. на те́бе сѧ надѣ́емъ, тобо́ю сѧ хва́лимъ, въ тебѣ̀ все оу҆пова́нїе на́ше є҆́стъ, молѝ и҆з̾ тебѐ ро́ждшагосѧ, за непотре́бныѧ рабы̀ своѧ̀: *
items.english_text: O Lord, Thou hast appointed repentance for me, a sinner, wishing to save me, unworthy though I be, by Thy measureless mercy! Falling down before Thee, I pray: bow down my soul through fasting, for I have fled unto Thee, Who alone art plenteous in mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: O Lord, Thou hast appointed repentance for me, a sinner, wishing to save me, unworthy though I be, by Thy measureless mercy! Falling down before Thee, I pray: bow down my soul through fasting, for I have fled unto Thee, Who alone art plenteous in mercy!

items.slavonic_text: Прⷪро́чества И҆са́їинѧ чте́нїе. Гла́: в҃. Възнесе́тся Гдⷭь є҆ди́нъ въ де́нь ѻ҆́ный. Де́нь бо Гдⷭа Саваѡ́ѳа прихо́ди́тъ на всѧ́каго досади́телѧ, и҆ го́рдаго, и҆ на всѧ́каго высо́каго, и҆ вели́чаваго, и҆ смиря́тсѧ. И҆ на всѧ́кїй ке́дръ Лива́новъ, высо́кїй, и҆ превъзнесе́нный. и҆ на всѧ́кїй дꙋ́бъ же́лꙋда Васа́нска. И҆ на высо́кꙋю го́рꙋ. и҆ на всѧ́кїй хо́лмъ высо́кїй. И҆ на всѧ́кїй сто́лпъ высо́кїй. и҆ на всѧ́кꙋю стѣ́нꙋ высо́кꙋю. И҆ на всѧ́кїй кора́бль морскі́й, и҆ на всѧ́кое видѣ́нїе доброты̀ корабле́й. И҆ смири́тсѧ всѧ́кїй чл҃къ, и҆ паде́тъ высота̀ чл҃кѡвъ. и҆ возвы́ситсѧ Гдⷭь є҆ди́нъ въ де́нь ѻ҆́ный. И҆ рꙋкотворе́ннаѧ всѧ̑ съкрыю́тъ. Вне́сше въ пеще́ры, и҆ разсѣ́лины ка́менїѧ, и҆ верте́пы земны̑ѧ. ѿ лица̀ стра́ха Гн҃ѧ, и҆ ѿ сла́вы крѣ́пости є҆гѡ̀. внегда̀ воста́нетъ раздроуши́ти зе́млю. Въ де́нь бо ѻ҆́ный и҆зло́житъ человѣ́къ ме́рзостнаѧ своѧ̑, сре́брнаѧ, и҆ зла́таѧ, ꙗ҆́же сътвори́ша себѣ̀, въ є҆́же покланѧ́тисѧ сꙋ́етнымъ и҆ нетопыре́мъ. Въ є҆́же вни́ти въ верте́пы тве́рдаго ка́мене, и҆ въ разсѣ́лины ка́менїй ѿ лица̀ стра́ха...

items.english_text: The Lord alone shall be exalted in that day! (v. 11b). For the day of the Lord of Sabaoth is coming upon every insulter and proud one, and upon every high and haughty one, and they shall be brought low (v. 12); and upon every cedar of Lebanon, high and exalted, and upon every oak of the acorn of Bashan (v. 13); and upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill (v. 14); and upon every high tower, and upon every high wall (v. 15); and upon every ship of the sea, and upon every spectacle of the beauty of ships (v. 16). And every man shall be brought low, and the haughtiness of men shall fall; and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day (v. 17). And all handmade idols they shall hide (v. 18), carrying them into caves and into clefts of the rocks and into the dens of the earth, from before the face of the fear of the Lord and from the glory of His strength, when He shall arise to shatter the earth (v. 19). For in that day a man shall cast away his abominations of silver and of gold, which they made for themselves that they might worship vanities and bats (v. 20), to enter into the dens of the solid rock and into the clefts of the stones, from before the face of the fear of the Lord and from the glory of His strength, when He shall arise to shatter the earth! (Isa. 2:21b [LXX]).

По́: Ѽ вели́кагѡ та́инства: Ѽ Крⷭ́та твое́гѡ си́лы, се́й процвѣтѐ Цр҃кви възде́ржанїе, въ Е҆де́мѣ и҆ногда̀ А҆да́мово невъздержа́нїе и҆скоренѐ и҆сто́ргъ, сме́рть оу҆́бѡ ѻ҆́ное принесѐ чл҃кѡмъ. но Се́й нетлѣ́ннѡ и҆сточа́етъ безсме́ртїе мі́рꙋ. ꙗ҆́коже и҆з̾ исто́чника и҆на́гѡ ра́йска, и҆злїѧ́нїемъ твоеѧ̀ живото́чныѧ крове́, вкꙋ́пѣ же и҆ воды̀. ѿню́дꙋже всѧ̑ ѡ҆животвори́шася. и҆́мже на́мъ по́стнꙋю пи́щꙋ Хѐ оу҆сладѝ Бг҃е І҆и҃левъ, и҆мѣ́ѧй ве́лїю млⷭ́ть: *
items.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Enlighten me, who am darkened by the deceits of the adversary, O my Christ, Thou Who of old, hanging upon the Cross, didst darken the sun, and openly didst enlighten the faithful with the true light of forgiveness: that walking in the light of Thy commandments, I may attain unto the saving dawn of Thy Resurrection! (Matt. 27:45; Isa. 2:5)

items.english_text: *Another Sticheron, by Master Theodore, in the same Tone, Podoben: "O the great mystery" (Ѽ вели́кагѡ та́инства):*[^734] O the power of Thy Cross! It has blossomed forth abstinence unto the Church, tearing up by the roots Adam's ancient lack of abstinence in Eden: that brought death unto mankind, but this incorruptibly pours forth immortality unto the world, as from another fountain of paradise, through the outpouring of Thy life-flowing Blood together with water, whence all things have been brought to life! Thereby sweeten for us our fasting food, O Christ, God of Israel, Who hast great mercy! (Gen. 2:9, 3:6; John 19:34)[^735]

Сїѧ̀ Кни́га бытїѧ̀, нб҃сѐ и҆ землѧ̀, є҆гда̀ бы́сть дн҃ь во́нже сотворѝ Гдⷭь Бг҃ъ нб҃о, и҆ зе́млю. [д҃] И҆ всѧ́кїй зла́къ се́лный, пре́жде да́же бъзи́ти на́ землю, и҆ всѧ́кꙋю тра́вꙋ се́лнꙋю, пре́жде да́же бы́ти. не́ бо ѡ҆дождѝ Бг҃ъ на́ землю, и҆ чл҃къ не бѧ́ше дѣ́лати ю҆̀. [є҃] Исто́чникъ же восхожда́ше и҆з̾ землѧ̀, и҆ напаѧ́ше все лицѐ землѧ̀. [ѕ҃] И҆ созда̀ Бг҃ъ чл҃ка, пе́рсть взе́мъ ѿ землѧ̀, и҆ вдꙋ́нꙋ в̾ лицѐ є҆гѡ̀ дыха́нїе жи́зни, и҆ бы́сть чл҃къ в̾ дш҃ꙋ жи́вꙋ. [з҃] И҆ насадѝ Бг҃ъ Ра́й въ Е҆де́мѣ, на восто́цѣхъ, и҆ положѝ та́мѡ чл҃ка, є҆го́же созда̀. [и҃] И҆ прозѧбѐ Бг҃ъ є҆щѐ ѿ землѧ̀, всѧ́кое дре́во кра́сное въ видѣ́нїе, и҆ добро́е въ снѣ́дь, и҆ Дре́во Жи́зни посредѣ̀ Ра́ѧ, и҆ дре́во є҆́же вѣ́дѣти разꙋми́телное добра́гѡ и҆ лꙋка́вагѡ. [ѳ҃] Рѣка́ же и҆сходи́ и҆з̾ Е҆де́ма, напаѧ́ти Ра́й, ѿтꙋ́дѣ разлꙋча́етсѧ въ четы́ри нача́ла. [і҃] И҆́мѧ є҆ди́ной Фисо́нъ, сїѧ̀ ѡ҆крꙋжа́ющаѧ всю зе́млю Е҆ѵила́тскꙋю, та́мѡ оу҆́бѡ е҆́стъ зла́то. [а҃і] Зла́то же землѧ̀ о́ныѧ добро́е, и҆ та́мѡ е҆́стъ А҆́нѳраѯъ, и҆ Ка́мень зелены́й. [в҃і] И҆ и҆́мѧ рѣцѣ̀ второ́й Геѡ́нъ, сїѧ̀ ѡ҆крꙋжа́ющаѧ всю зе́млю Е҆ѳїо́пскꙋю. items.english_text: This is the book of the origin of heaven and earth, when the day was wherein the Lord God made heaven and earth (v. 4); and every plant of the field before it was upon the earth, and every herb of the field before it sprang up; for God had not rained upon the earth, and there was not a man to work it (v. 5). But a fountain went up out of the earth and watered all the face of the earth (v. 6). And God formed man, taking dust from the earth, and breathed into his face the breath of life; and man became a living soul (v. 7). And God planted a Paradise in Eden eastward, and there He put the man whom He had formed (v. 8). And God made to spring up yet out of the earth every tree that is beautiful to the sight and good for food, and the Tree of Life in the midst of Paradise, and the Tree to know understanding of good and evil (v. 9). And a river went forth out of Eden to water Paradise; from thence it was separated into four headwaters (v. 10). The name of the one is Pishon; this is that which encompasses all the land of Havilah, where there is gold (v. 11); and the gold of that land is good; and there is carbuncle and the green stone (v. 12). And the name of the second river is Gihon; this is that which encompasses all the land of Ethiopia (v. 13). And the third river is the Tigris; this is that which flows opposite the Assyrians; and the fourth river is Euphrates (v. 14). And the Lord God took the man whom He had formed, and put him into Paradise, to work it and to keep it (v. 15). And the Lord God commanded Adam, saying: "Of every tree that is in Paradise thou mayest freely eat (v. 16); but of the Tree to know good and evil, ye shall not eat of it; for in whatsoever day ye eat of it, ye shall die by death" (v. 17). And the Lord God said: "It is not good that the man should be alone; let Us make him a helper suitable for him" (v. 18). And God formed yet out of the earth all the beasts of the field and all the birds of the heaven, and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them; and whatsoever Adam called each living soul, that was its name (v. 19).

items.slavonic_text: [ѕ҃і] є҆гѡ̀ в̾ ра́й, дѣ́лати є҆гѡ̀, и҆ храни́ти. И҆ заповѣ́да Гдⷭь Бг҃ъ А҆да́мꙋ гл҃ѧ. Ѿ всѧ́кагѡ дре́ва, є҆́же в̾ ра́и, [з҃і] снѣ́дїю снѣ́си, а҆ ѿ Дре́ва є҆́же разꙋмѣ́ти добро́е и҆ лꙋка́вое, не снѣ́сте ѿ него, во́нже бо дн҃ь а҆́ще снѣ́сте [и҃і] ѿ него, сме́ртїю оу҆́мрете. И҆ речѐ Гдⷭь Бг҃ъ: Не добро̀ бы́ти чл҃кꙋ є҆ди́номꙋ, сътвори́мъ є҆мꙋ̀ помо́щника по не́мꙋ. [ѳ҃і] И҆ созда̀ Бг҃ъ є҆щѐ ѿ землѧ̀ всѧ̑ ѕвѣ́рїѧ се́лныѧ, и҆ всѧ̑ пти́ца нб҃сныѧ, и҆ приведѐ та̀ къ А҆да́мꙋ ви́дѣти, что̀ нарече́тъ та̀. и҆ всѧ́ко є҆́же а҆́ще нарече́ се А҆да́мъ дш҃ꙋ жи́вꙋ, се и҆́мѧ є҆мꙋ̀: Проки́: в҃. Ѱало́мъ, ѕ҃і. Гласъ, д҃. Съхрани́ мѧ Гдⷭи ꙗ҆́кѡ зѣ́ницꙋ ѻ҆́ка. Сти́хъ. Оу҆слы́ши Гдⷭи пра́вдꙋ мою̀. При́тчїй чте́нїе. Гла́ва, г҃. [с: а҃] Сн҃е мо́и зако́ны не забыва́й, глы́ же моѧ̑ да съблюда́етъ твоѐ срⷣце. [в҃] Долготꙋ́ бо житїѧ̀, и҆ лѣ́та живо́та, и҆ ми́ръ приложа́тъ тебѣ̀. [г҃] Мл҃тыни и҆ вѣ́ры да не ѡ҆скꙋдѣва́ютъ ти. ѡ҆бложи́ же на вы́ю, напиши́ та̀ на скрыжа́ли срⷣца твое́гѡ. [д҃] И҆ ѡ҆брѧ́щеши блгⷣть, и҆ промышлѧ́й добра́ѧ преⷣ Гдⷭмъ Бг҃омъ и҆ чл҃вки. [є҃] Бꙋ́ди надѣ́ѧсѧ всѣ́мъ срⷣцемъ на Бг҃а, ѡ҆ твое́й же премꙋ́дрости не възноси́сѧ. [ѕ҃] Въ всѣ́хъ пꙋте́хъ твои́хъ познава́й ню̀, да и҆справлѧ́етъ пꙋти̑ твоѧ̑, нога́ же твоѧ̀ да не преткне́тсѧ. [з҃] Не бꙋ́ди мꙋ́дрыи оу҆ себѐ, бо́исѧ Бг҃а, и҆ оу҆кланѧ́йсѧ ѿ всѧ́кагѡ ѕла̀. [и҃] Тогда̀ и҆зцѣле́нїе бꙋ́детъ тѣлесѝ твоемꙋ̀, и҆ попече́нїе косте́мъ твои̑мъ. [ѳ҃] Чтѝ Гдⷭа ѿ твои́хъ пра́ведныхъ трꙋдѡ́въ, и҆ нача́тлѣ ѡ҆десѧтствꙋ́й є҆мꙋ̀ ѿ твои́хъ
items.english_text: My son, forget not my laws, but let thine heart keep my words (v. 1); for length of life, and years of life, and peace shall they add unto thee (v. 2). Let not mercy and faithfulness forsake thee; bind them upon thy neck, write them upon the tablet of thine heart (v. 3). And thou shalt find grace; and provide good things before the Lord God and men (v. 4). Trust in God with all thine heart, and be not exalted in thine own wisdom (v. 5). In all thy ways acknowledge her, that she may make straight thy paths, and thy foot shall not stumble (v. 6). Be not wise in thine own eyes; fear God, and depart from all evil (v. 7). Then shall there be healing unto thy body, and care unto thy bones (v. 8). Honor the Lord from thy righteous labors, and give tithes unto Him of the first-fruits of thy fruits of righteousness (v. 9). So shall thy barns be filled with fullness of wheat, and thy vats shall overflow with wine (v. 10). My son, despise not the chastening of the Lord, neither faint when thou art reproved by Him (v. 11); for whom the Lord loves He chastens, and scourges every son whom He receives (v. 12). Blessed is the man that finds wisdom, and the mortal that knows understanding (v. 13); for it is better to traffic for her than for treasures of gold and silver (v. 14). Yea, she is more precious than costly stones; nothing that is evil can resist her; she is well-known unto all that approach her, and nothing precious is worthy of her (v. 15). For length of life and years of existence are in her right hand, and in her left hand are riches and glory; [out of her mouth proceeds righteousness, and law and mercy she bears upon her tongue] (v. 16). Her ways are good ways, and all her paths are in peace (v. 17). She is a tree of life unto all that lay hold upon her, and steadfast unto those that rely upon her, as upon the Lord (v. 18).

items.slavonic_text: [і҃] плодѡ́въ пра́вды. Да напо́лнѧт́сѧ съкро́вища твоѧ̑, насыще́нїѧ пшени́ца: вино́ же точи́ла твоѧ̑ да и҆сточа́ютъ. [а҃і] Сн҃е не пренебрега́й наказа́нїѧ Гдⷭнѧ: ни́же ѡ҆слабѣва́й ѿ негѡ̀ ѡ҆блича́емый. [в҃і] Є҆го́же бо лю́битъ Гдⷭь, нака́зꙋетъ, бїе́тъ же всѧ́каго сн҃а, є҆го́же прїе́млетъ. [г҃і] Бл҃женъ чл҃къ, и҆́же ѡ҆брѣ́те прⷭмеⷣроⷭть: и҆ сме́ртенъ и҆́же оу҆вѣ́дѣ ра́зꙋмъ. [д҃і] Лꙋ́чше бо сїю̀ кꙋпова́ти, не́же ли зла́та, и҆ сре́бра, сокро́вища. [є҃і] Чтⷭнѣ́йшаѧ же е҆́стъ ка́менїй многоцѣ́нныхъ: не съпротивлѧ́етсѧ е́й ничто́же лꙋка́вое. бл҃горазꙋ́мна е҆́стъ всѣ̑мъ приближа́ющимсѧ е́й. всѧ́кое же чтⷭное недосто́йнѡ е҆ѧ̀ е҆́ст҃. [ѕ҃і] Долгота̀ бо живота̀, и҆ лѣ́та жи́зни в̾ десни́ци е҆ѧ̀. въ шꙋ́йци же е҆ѧ̀ бога́тство, и҆ сла́ва. [И҆з̾ оу҆́стъ е҆ѧ̀ и҆схо́ди пра́вда, зако́нъ же, и҆ млⷭть на ѧ҆зы́цѣ но́ситъ]. [з҃і] Пꙋ́тїе е҆ѧ̀ пꙋ́тїе до́бры, и҆ всѧ̑ стєзѝ е҆ѧ̀ в̾ ми́рѣ. [и҃і] Дре́во живота̀ е҆́ст҃, всѣ̑мъ прилѣплѧ́ющымсѧ е́й, и҆ оу҆твержа́ющымсѧ на не́й, ꙗ҆́кѡ на Гдⷭа тве́рда: Та́же, Сподо́би Гдⷭи: Та́же, На стї: Сї̑ры самогла́: Глаⷭ, д҃. Жела́юще бж҃твенныѧ Па́схи причасти́тисѧ, не ѿ Е҆гѵ́пта, но и҆з̾ Сїѡ́на грѧдꙋ́щыѧ, грѣхо́вный ква́съ ѿиме́мъ покаѧ́нїемъ, препоѧ́шимъ чресла̀ на́ша оу҆мерщвле́нїемъ сласте́й, оу҆краси́мъ нѡ́ги сапогмѝ возбрани́телными ѿ всѧ́кагѡ дѣ́ла лꙋка́ваго, и҆ оу҆тверди́мсѧ па́лицею вѣ́ры, не ревнꙋ́имъ врагѡ́мъ бл҃чнагѡ Крⷭта̀, боготво́рѧще чре́во. но послѣ́дꙋимъ посто́мъ, на дїа́вола побѣ́дꙋ на́мъ показа́вшомꙋ, сп҃сꙋ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ:

[а҃і] Сн҃е не пренебрега́й наказа́нїѧ Гдⷭнѧ: ни́же ѡ҆слабѣва́й ѿ негѡ̀ ѡ҆блича́емый. [в҃і] Є҆го́же бо лю́битъ Гдⷭь, нака́зꙋетъ, бїе́тъ же всѧ́каго сн҃а, є҆го́же прїе́млетъ. [г҃і] Бл҃женъ чл҃къ, и҆́же ѡ҆брѣ́те прⷭмеⷣроⷭть: и҆ сме́ртенъ и҆́же оу҆вѣ́дѣ ра́зꙋмъ. [д҃і] Лꙋ́чше бо сїю̀ кꙋпова́ти, не́же ли зла́та, и҆ сре́бра, сокро́вища. [є҃і] Чтⷭнѣ́йшаѧ же е҆́стъ ка́менїй многоцѣ́нныхъ: не съпротивлѧ́етсѧ е́й ничто́же лꙋка́вое. бл҃горазꙋ́мна е҆́стъ всѣ̑мъ приближа́ющимсѧ е́й. всѧ́кое же чтⷭное недосто́йнѡ е҆ѧ̀ е҆́ст҃. [ѕ҃і] Долгота̀ бо живота̀, и҆ лѣ́та жи́зни в̾ десни́ци е҆ѧ̀. въ шꙋ́йци же е҆ѧ̀ бога́тство, и҆ сла́ва. [И҆з̾ оу҆́стъ е҆ѧ̀ и҆схо́ди пра́вда, зако́нъ же, и҆ млⷭть на ѧ҆зы́цѣ но́ситъ]. [з҃і] Пꙋ́тїе е҆ѧ̀ пꙋ́тїе до́бры, и҆ всѧ̑ стєзѝ е҆ѧ̀ в̾ ми́рѣ. [и҃і] Дре́во живота̀ е҆́ст҃, всѣ̑мъ прилѣплѧ́ющымсѧ е́й, и҆ оу҆твержа́ющымсѧ на не́й, ꙗ҆́кѡ на Гдⷭа тве́рда: Та́же, Сподо́би Гдⷭи: Та́же, На стї: Сї̑ры самогла́: Глаⷭ, д҃. Жела́юще бж҃твенныѧ Па́схи причасти́тисѧ, не ѿ Е҆гѵ́пта, но и҆з̾ Сїѡ́на грѧдꙋ́щыѧ, грѣхо́вный ква́съ ѿиме́мъ покаѧ́нїемъ, препоѧ́шимъ чресла̀ на́ша оу҆мерщвле́нїемъ сласте́й, оу҆краси́мъ нѡ́ги сапогмѝ возбрани́телными ѿ всѧ́кагѡ дѣ́ла лꙋка́ваго, и҆ оу҆тверди́мсѧ па́лицею вѣ́ры, не ревнꙋ́имъ врагѡ́мъ бл҃чнагѡ Крⷭта̀, боготво́рѧще чре́во. но послѣ́дꙋимъ посто́мъ, на дїа́вола побѣ́дꙋ на́мъ показа́вшомꙋ, сп҃сꙋ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ:
items.english_text: Desiring to partake of the divine Pascha, not that which comes from Egypt, but that which proceeds out of Zion, let us put away the leaven of sin through repentance! Let us gird our loins through the mortification of pleasures; let us adorn our feet with sandals that protect us from every evil deed; and let us be strengthened by the staff of faith! Let us not emulate the enemies of the blessed Cross, making a god of the belly; but through fasting let us follow Him Who showed us victory over the devil, the Savior of our souls! (Exod. 12:11; 1 Cor. 5:7–8; Eph. 6:14–15; Phil. 3:18–19; Matt. 4:1–11)

items.slavonic_text: Ст҃: а҃. К̾ тебѣ̀ възведо́хъ ѻ҆́цѣ моѝ. И҆ па́ки то́й стїхъ. Стї, в҃. Поми́лꙋй на́съ Гдⷭи, поми́лꙋй на́съ. [м:] Прославлѧ́ѧйсѧ въ па́мѧтехъ сты́хъ твои́хъ Хе҃ Бж҃е, ѿ ни́хъ оу҆молѧ́емый, низпосли́ намъ ве́лїю млⷭть: Сла́: И҆ нн҃ѣ: крⷭтово: По́: Ꙗ҆́кѡ до́блѧ: На Крⷭтѣ́ тѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ оу҆зрѣ̀ пригвожде́нна Гдⷭи, А҆́гница и҆ Мт҃и твоѧ̀, дивлѧ́шесѧ. и҆ что̀ видѣ́нїе възꙑва́лаше Сн҃е вожделѣ́нне! сїѧ́ ти невѣ́рный собо́ръ воздаетъ беззако́нный, мнѡ́ги твои́хъ чꙋде́съ наслади́выйсѧ. но сла́ва неизрече́нномꙋ соше́ствїю твое́мꙋ Вл҃ко: Та́же, Нн҃ѣ ѿпꙋща́еши: и҆ про́: ѡ҆бы́чное конча́нїе. Ѡ Тра́пезѣ же оу҆ка́зъ. Ли́стъ, см҃а. Въ то́и же че: а҃ нд҃ли по́ста, Канѡ́нъ, на па́вече́рници. Гл҃: ѕ҃. Пѣ̑: а҃. И҆рм҃: Помо́щникъ: А҆́гнче Бж҃їй, вземлѧ́й грѣхѝ всѣ́хъ, возмѝ бре́мѧ ѿ менѐ тѧ́жкое грѣхо́вное, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ млⷭрдъ, да́ждь ми сле́зы оу҆миле́нїѧ: Не възгнꙋша́йсѧ менѐ Сп҃се. не ѿри́ни твое́гѡ лица̀. возмѝ бре́мѧ ѿ менѐ тѧ́жкое грѣхо́вное, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ млⷭрдъ да́ждь ми грѣхѡ́мъ ѡ҆ставле́нїе: Тебѣ̀ припада́ю І҆и҃се, съгрѣши́хъ ти, ѡ҆чи́сти мѧ̀. возмѝ бре́мѧ ѿ менѐ, тѧ́жкое грѣхо́бное. и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ млⷭрдъ, да́ждь ми сле́зы оу҆миле́нїѧ: Не вни́йди со мно́ю на сꙋ́дъ носѧ̀ моѧ̑ дѣѧ́нїѧ, слѡва̀ и҆зыскꙋ́ѧ, и҆ и҆справлѧ́ѧ стремле́нїѧ. но въ щедро́тахъ твои́хъ презира́ѧ моѧ̑ лю̑таѧ, сп҃си́ мѧ Всеси́лне. Бога́тство дꙋше́вное и҆жди́въ грѣхо́мъ, пꙋ́стъ
items.english_text: *Verse 1: Unto Thee have I lifted up mine eyes, [O Thou that dwellest in heaven! Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hands of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hands of her mistress, so our eyes look unto the Lord our God, until He have mercy on us!] (Ps. 122:1–2 [LXX])*[^746]

items.english_text: When she beheld Thee nailed upon the Cross, O Lord, the Ewe-lamb and Thy Mother marveled, and cried aloud: "What a spectacle is this, O most desired Son? This is what the faithless and lawless assembly renders unto Thee, having enjoyed Thy many wonders! But glory to Thine ineffable condescension, O Master!" (John 19:25–27)

items.slavonic_text: е҆́смь добродѣ́телей бл҃гочести́выхъ. гла́дствꙋѧ же зовꙋ̀, млⷭти пода́телю Гдⷭи сп҃си́ мѧ: Во́лнаѧ и҆ нево́лнаѧ Сп҃се съгрѣше́нїѧ моѧ̑: и҆ ꙗ҆вле́наѧ, и҆ сокрове́наѧ, вѣ́домал и҆ невѣ́домал всѧ̑ прости́въ ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ, ѡ҆чи́сти и҆ сп҃си́ мѧ: Сл҃: Трⷪц: Пресꙋ́щественнаѧ Трⷪце, въ є҆ди́нствѣ покланѧ́емаѧ, возмѝ бре́мѧ ѿ менѐ тѧ́жкое грѣхо́бное. и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ млⷭрдъ да́ждь ми сле́зы оу҆миле́нїѧ: Бг҃: Бц҃е наде́жде, и҆ предста́телнице всѣ̑мъ пою́щимъ тѧ̀, возмѝ бре́мѧ ѿ менѐ тѧ́жкое грѣхо́бное. ꙗ҆́кѡ Вл҃чца ка́ющасѧ прїими́ мѧ: Пѣ́снь, в҃. И҆рмо́съ. Ви́дите ви́дите ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́зъ е҆́смъ Бг҃ъ. Ма́ннꙋ ѡ҆дожди́вый: и҆ во́дꙋ и҆з̾ ка́мене и҆сточи́вый дре́вле въ пꙋсты́ни лю́демъ мои̑мъ, є҆ди́ною десни́цею, и҆ крѣ́постїю мое́ю:. items.slavonic_text: е҆́смь добродѣ́телей бл҃гочести́выхъ. гла́дствꙋѧ же зовꙋ̀, млⷭти пода́телю Гдⷭи сп҃си́ мѧ: Во́лнаѧ и҆ нево́лнаѧ Сп҃се съгрѣше́нїѧ моѧ̑: и҆ ꙗ҆вле́наѧ, и҆ сокрове́наѧ, вѣ́домал и҆ невѣ́домал всѧ̑ прости́въ ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ, ѡ҆чи́сти и҆ сп҃си́ мѧ: Сл҃: Трⷪц: Пресꙋ́щественнаѧ Трⷪце, въ є҆ди́нствѣ покланѧ́емаѧ, возмѝ бре́мѧ ѿ менѐ тѧ́жкое грѣхо́бное. и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ млⷭрдъ да́ждь ми сле́зы оу҆миле́нїѧ: Бг҃: Бц҃е наде́жде, и҆ предста́телнице всѣ̑мъ пою́щимъ тѧ̀, возмѝ бре́мѧ ѿ менѐ тѧ́жкое грѣхо́бное. ꙗ҆́кѡ Вл҃чца ка́ющасѧ прїими́ мѧ: Пѣ́снь, в҃. И҆рмо́съ. Ви́дите ви́дите ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́зъ е҆́смъ Бг҃ъ. Ма́ннꙋ ѡ҆дожди́вый: и҆ во́дꙋ и҆з̾ ка́мене и҆сточи́вый дре́вле въ пꙋсты́ни лю́демъ мои̑мъ, є҆ди́ною десни́цею, и҆ крѣ́постїю мое́ю:. Мꙋ́жа оу҆би́хъ речѐ въ ꙗ҆́звꙋ мнѣ̀, и҆ ю҆́ношꙋ въ стрꙋ́пъ, Ла́мехъ рыда́ѧ вопїѧ́ше: ты́ же не трепе́щеши ѽ дꙋ́ше моѧ̀ ѡ҆кала́вшы пло́ть, и҆ оу҆́мъ ѡ҆скверни́вши: Сто́лпъ оу҆мꙋдри́ласѧ е҆сѝ созда́ти ѽ дꙋ́ше, и҆ оу҆твержде́нїе въздрꙋзи́ти, твои̑мъ по́хотемъ, а҆́ще не бы̀ зижди́тель оу҆держа́лъ совѣ́ты твоѧ̑, и҆ низве́рглъ на зе́мли оу҆хищре́нїѧ твоѧ̑: Ѽ ка́кѡ поревнова́хъ Ла́мехꙋ, пе́рвомꙋ оу҆бїи́цꙋ, дꙋ́шꙋ ꙗ҆́кѡ мꙋ́жа, оу҆́мъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ю҆́ношꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ бра́та же ми тѣ́ло оу҆би́въ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Ка́їнъ оу҆бїи́ца, любосла́стными стремле́нми: Оу҆ꙗ҆зви́хсѧ и҆ оу҆ра́нихсѧ, се стрѣ́лы вра́жїѧ, оу҆ѧзви́вшыѧ ми дꙋ́шꙋ и҆ тѣ́ло, се стрꙋ́пы и҆ гное́нїѧ, и҆ ѡ҆мраче́нїѧ вопїю́тъ, ра́ны самово́лны и҆з̾ страсте́й:
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O how I have emulated Lamech, the former murderer, slaying the soul as a man, the mind as a young man, and my body as a brother, like Cain the murderer, through voluptuous strivings! (Gen. 4:8, 23)

items.slavonic_text: Ѽдождѝ Гдⷭь ѿ Гдⷭа ѻ҆́гнь и҆ногда̀, на безако́нїе гнѣ́вающєє, съзже́же Содомлѧ́ны, ты́ же ѻ҆́гнь възжегла̀ е҆сѝ гее́нскїй, въ не́мже и҆́маши ѽ дꙋ́ше, сожже́на бы́ти: Разꙋмѣ́йте, и҆ ви́дите, ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́зъ е҆́смъ Бг҃ъ, и҆стѧза́ѧй срⷣца. и҆ и҆спыта́ѧй мы́сли, ѡ҆блича́ѧй дѣла̀, и҆ попалѧ́ѧй грѣхѝ, и҆ сꙋдѧ́й си́рꙋ, и҆ смире́ннꙋ и҆ ни́щꙋ: Сл҃: Трⷪичъ. Безна́чалнаѧ несозда́ннаѧ Трⷪце, нераздѣ́лнаѧ Е҆ди́нице, ка́ющасѧ мѧ̀ прїимѝ, съгрѣ́шивша мѧ сп҃сѝ, твое́ е҆́смъ созда́нїе, не пре́зри, но пощадѝ, и҆ и҆зба́ви ѻ҆́гненаго ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїѧ: Бг҃: Чⷭтаѧ Вл҃чце Бг҃ороди́телнице, оу҆пова́нїе к̾ тебѣ̀ прибѣга́ющимъ, и҆ приста́нище въ бꙋ́ри, молѝ млⷭтиваго зижди́телѧ, и҆ Сн҃а твое́го, поми́ловати и҆ менѐ мл҃твами твои́ми: Пѣ́: г҃. И҆рм҃: Оу҆твердѝ Гдⷭи на ка́мени: А҆га́рѣ дре́вле дꙋ́ше, Е҆гѵ́птѧнынѣ, оу҆подо́била сѧ е҆сѝ, порабо́тившисѧ и҆зволе́нїемъ, и҆ ро́ждши но́ваго И҆смаи́ла, презо́рство: І҆а́кѡвлю лѣ́ствицꙋ, разꙋмѣ́ла е҆сѝ дꙋ́ше, ꙗ҆влѧ́емꙋю ѿ землѧ̀ до нб҃се, почто̀ не и҆́маши восхо́да тве́рда, бл҃гоче́стїѧ: Сщ҃енникꙋ Бж҃їю, и҆ цр҃ю оу҆единенꙋ, Хв҃ꙋ подо́бїю, е҆́же в̾ мі́рѣ житїѧ̀, въ чл҃вцѣхъ оу҆подо́бїѧ: Не бꙋ́ди сто́лпъ сла́ный дꙋ́ше, въспѧ́тъ възврати́вшисѧ, при́тча да оу҆страши́тъ тѧ Содо́мскаѧ, горѣ́ въ Сигѡ́ръ сп҃са́й сѧ: Ѡ҆брати́сѧ постенѝ дꙋ́ше ѡ҆каѧ́ннаѧ, пе́рвагѡ
items.english_text: *Troparion 5:* The Lord rained fire from the Lord of old upon lawlessness that provoked His wrath, and burned up the Sodomites! But thou, O my soul, hast kindled the fire of Gehenna, wherein thou art about to be burned! (Gen. 19:24)

И҆рм҃: Оу҆твердѝ Гдⷭи на ка́мени: А҆га́рѣ дре́вле дꙋ́ше, Е҆гѵ́птѧнынѣ, оу҆подо́била сѧ е҆сѝ, порабо́тившисѧ и҆зволе́нїемъ, и҆ ро́ждши но́ваго И҆смаи́ла, презо́рство: І҆а́кѡвлю лѣ́ствицꙋ, разꙋмѣ́ла е҆сѝ дꙋ́ше, ꙗ҆влѧ́емꙋю ѿ землѧ̀ до нб҃се, почто̀ не и҆́маши восхо́да тве́рда, бл҃гоче́стїѧ: Сщ҃енникꙋ Бж҃їю, и҆ цр҃ю оу҆единенꙋ, Хв҃ꙋ подо́бїю, е҆́же в̾ мі́рѣ житїѧ̀, въ чл҃вцѣхъ оу҆подо́бїѧ: Не бꙋ́ди сто́лпъ сла́ный дꙋ́ше, въспѧ́тъ възврати́вшисѧ, при́тча да оу҆страши́тъ тѧ Содо́мскаѧ, горѣ́ въ Сигѡ́ръ сп҃са́й сѧ: Ѡ҆брати́сѧ постенѝ дꙋ́ше ѡ҆каѧ́ннаѧ, пе́рвагѡ

items.slavonic_text: житїѧ̀, коне́цъ прїе́млетъ то́ржество, пре́же да́же две́рь заключи́тъ черто́га Гдⷭь: Сла́ва: Трⷪичъ. Трⷪце про́стаѧ несозда́ннаѧ, безнача́лное є҆стество̀, въ Трⷪци воспѣва́емое соста́вѡвъ, сп҃си́ насъ вѣ́рою покланѧ́ющихсѧ, держа́вѣ твое́й: Бг҃: И҆з̾ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ безлѣ́тна сн҃а, въ лѣ́то Бг҃ороди́телнице, неискꙋсомꙋ́жнѡ роди́ла е҆сѝ, стра́нное чꙋ́до, пребы́вши Дв҃ою доѧ́щи: Пѣ́снь, д҃. И҆рм҃: Оу҆слы́ша Прⷪро́къ: Вре́мѧ живота̀ моегѡ̀, ма́лое и҆ и҆спо́лненное болѣ́зней и҆ лꙋка́вства, но въ покаѧ́нїи мѧ̀ прїимѝ, и҆ въ ра́зꙋмъ призовѝ, да не бꙋ́дꙋ стѧжа́нїе ни бра́шно чꙋждемꙋ̀, сп҃се са́мъ мѧ̀ оу҆ще́дри: Высокоглаго́ливъ нн҃ѣ е҆́смь, без̾ѡ́ченъ же и҆ срⷣцемъ, въ тщѐ и҆ в̾сѐ, да не съ Фарисе́омъ ѡ҆сꙋ́диши мѧ̀, па́че же Мытаре́во смѣре́нїе, пода́ждь ми Е҆ди́не ще́дре, првⷣный Сꙋдїѐ, и҆ семꙋ̀ мѧ̀ причтѝ: Съгрѣши́хъ похꙋ́ливъ, сосꙋ́дъ пло́ти моеѧ̀ вѣ́мъ ще́дре, но въ покаѧ́нїе мѧ̀ прїимѝ, и҆ въ ра́зꙋмъ призовѝ, да не бꙋ́дꙋ стѧжа́нїе ни бра́шно чꙋждемꙋ̀, сп҃се са́мъ мѧ̀ оу҆ще́дри: Са́мое ка́пище бы́хъ страсте́мъ, дш҃ꙋ мою̀ ѡ҆скверни́въ ще́дре, но въ покаѧ́нїе мѧ̀ прїимѝ, и҆ въ ра́зꙋмъ призовѝ, да не бꙋ́дꙋ стѧжа́нїе ни бра́шно чꙋждемꙋ̀, сп҃се са́мъ мѧ̀ оу҆ще́дри: Не послꙋ́шахъ гла́са твое́гѡ, преслꙋ́шахъ писа́нїе твоѐ законополо́жное, но въ покаѧ́нїе мѧ̀ прїимѝ, и҆ въ ра́зꙋмъ призовѝ, да не бꙋ́дꙋ стѧжа́нїе ни пи́ща

items.slavonic_text: чꙋ́ждемꙋ, сп҃се са́мъ мѧ̀ оу҆ще́дри: Сл҃а: Трⷪ: Нераздѣ́лное сꙋщество́мъ, неслїѧ́нное ли́цы, Бг҃осло́влю тѧ̀, Трⷪческое є҆ди́но Бж҃тво̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆диноца́рственное и҆ съпрⷭто́лное, вопїю́ ти пѣ́снь вели́кꙋю, въ вы́шнихъ трегꙋ́бѡ пѣ́снослови́мꙋю: Бг҃: И҆ ражда́еши и҆ дв҃твꙋеши, и҆ пребыва́еши ѡ҆бои́ми е҆стество́мъ дв҃а, роди́выйсѧ ѡ҆бновлѧ́етъ зако́ны е҆стества̀, оу҆тро́ба же ражда́етъ неражда́ющи, Бг҃ъ и҆де́же хо́щетъ, побѣжда́етсѧ е҆стества̀ чи́нъ, твори́тъ бо е҆ли́ка хо́щетъ: Пѣ́снь, є҃. И҆рмо́: И҆з̾ но́щи оу҆́тренююща: Ни́зꙋ съни́чꙋщꙋю подража́ющи дꙋ́ше, пристꙋпѝ и҆ припадѝ к̾ нога́ма І҆и҃совома, да тѧ̀ и҆спра́витъ, и҆ хо́диши пра́вѡ въ пꙋти̑ Гдⷭнѧ: А҆́ще и҆ кла́дѧзь е҆сѝ глꙋбо́кїй Вл҃ко, и҆сточи́ ми во́дꙋ и҆з̾ прчⷭтыхъ си жи́лъ, да ꙗ҆́кѡ Самарѧныни, нектомо̀ въжа́ждꙋсѧ, жи́зни бо стрꙋѧ̀ и҆сточа́еши: Сїлѡа́мъ да бꙋ́дꙋтъ ми сле́зы, Вл҃ко Гдⷭи, да оу҆мы́ю и҆ а҆́зъ зѣ́ницꙋ срⷣца, и҆ ви́ждꙋ тѧ̀ разꙋ́мнѡ, свѣ́тъ превѣ́чный: Сла́ва: Трⷪичъ. Тѧ̀ Трⷪце сла́вимъ, є҆ди́наго Бг҃а, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ е҆сѝ, Ѻ҆́че, и҆ Сн҃е, и҆ Дш҃е, про́стое сꙋщество̀, е҆дини́це при́нѡ покланѧ́емаѧ: Бг҃: И҆з̾ тебѐ ѡ҆блече́сѧ въ моѐ смѣше́нїе, нетлѣ́ннаѧ безмꙋ́жнаѧ Мт҃и Дв҃о, Бг҃ъ созда́вый вѣ́ки, и҆ съединѝ себѣ̀ чл҃в́ческое е҆стество̀: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. И҆рм҃: Възопи́хъ всѣ́мъ срⷣцемъ: Во́зми своѐ, да не оу҆слы́шꙋ Гдⷭи, ѿсыла́емъ

items.slavonic_text: ѿ тебѐ, нижѐ и҆дѝ въ ѻ҆́гнь проклѧ́тый, но бл҃га́го гла́са првⷣныхъ: А҆́зъ е҆́смъ Сп҃се, и҆́же погꙋби́лъ е҆сѝ дре́вле цр҃кꙋю дра́хмꙋ, но вже́гъ свѣти́лникъ Прⷮчꙋ твое́го Сло́ве, взыщѝ ѡ҆брѧ́щи тво́й ѻ҆́бразъ: Сла́ва: Трⷪичъ. Трⷪца е҆́смъ про́ста, нераздѣ́лна, раздѣ́лна ли́чнѣ, и҆ Е҆дини́ца е҆стество́мъ соедине́на, Ѻ҆ц҃ъ речѐ, и҆ Сн҃ъ, и҆ Бж҃твенный Дх҃ъ: Бг҃: Оу҆тро́ба твоѧ̀, Бг҃а на́мъ родѝ, въѡбраже́нна по на́съ, є҆го́же ꙗ҆́кѡ зижди́телѧ всѣ́хъ, молѝ Бц҃е, да твои́ми мл҃твами ѡ҆правди́мъсѧ: Сѣда́ленъ. Глаⷭ, ѕ҃. По́: Оу҆пова́нїе: Стра́шный дн҃ь прише́ствїѧ твое́гѡ, невмы́тнагѡ Хе҃ сꙋди́ща, бою́сѧ, и҆ оу҆жаса́юсѧ, и҆ трепе́щꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆мѣ́ѧй мно́жество съгрѣше́нїй. но пре́жде конца́ мѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ млⷭтивъ Бг҃ъ, ѡ҆братѝ и҆ сп҃си́ мѧ, ро́жшїѧ тѧ мольбами, мл҃рде Сп҃се є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче. items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆брати́сѧ, пока́йсѧ, ѿкры́й съкрове́ннаѧ, гл҃и Бг҃ꙋ всѧ̑ вѣ́дꙋщомꙋ, ты̀ вѣ́си моѧ̑ та̑йнаѧ е҆ди́не сп҃се, но са́мъ мѧ̀ поми́лꙋй, ꙗ҆́кѡже пое́тъ Дв҃дъ, по млⷭти твое́й: Сла́ва: Трⷪичъ. Трⷪце про́стаѧ, нераздѣ́лнаѧ, є҆диносоу́щнаѧ е҆дини́це ст҃а́ѧ, свѣ́тѡве и҆ свѣ́тъ, и҆ ст҃а трѝ, и҆ є҆ди́но ст҃о́е пое́тсѧ Бг҃ъ Трⷪца, но въспо́й и҆ просла́ви, живо́тъ и҆ животы̀, дꙋшѐ всѣ́хъ Бг҃а: Бг҃: Пое́мъ тѧ̀, бл҃вимъ тѧ̀, покланѧ́емъ ти сѧ Бц҃е, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ неразлꙋ́чныѧ Трⷪца, породи́ла е҆сѝ е҆ди́наго Сн҃а и҆ Бг҃а, и҆ ты̀ ѡ҆ве́рзла е҆сѝ намъ, сꙋ́щымъ на̀ землѝ нб҃наѧ: Пѣ́снь, и҃. И҆рм҃: Є҆го́же во́инства: Сле́знꙋю Сп҃се склѧ́нницꙋ, ꙗ҆́коже мѵ́ро и҆стощева́ѧ на гла́вꙋ твою̀, зовꙋ́ ти ꙗ҆́коже блꙋ́дница, млⷭти просѧ́щи, мо́льбꙋ приношꙋ̀, и҆ ѡ҆ставле́нїе и҆щꙋ̀ прїѧ́ти:. А҆́ще и҆ никто́же ꙗ҆́коже а҆́зъ, съгрѣши́хъ тебѣ̀, но ѻ҆ба́че прїимѝ и҆ менѐ, мл҃рде Сп҃се, стра́хомъ ка́ющасѧ, и҆ любо́вїю зовꙋ́ща, съгрѣши́хъ тебѣ̀ є҆ди́не, поми́лꙋй мѧ̀ мл҃тиве: Поща̀ Бж҃е своѐ созда́нїе, и҆ взыщѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ па́стырь поги́бшее, предварѝ заблꙋ́ждшаго, восхитѝ ѿ во́лка, сътвори́ мѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ ѻ҆вча̀, на па́ствѣ твои́хъ ѡ҆ве́цъ. Є҆гда̀ Сꙋдїѧ̀ сѧ́деши ꙗ҆́кѡ мл҃рдъ, и҆ пока́жеши стра́шнꙋю сла́вꙋ твою̀ Сп҃се, ѽ како́вый стра́хъ тогда̀! пе́щи горѧ́щой, всѣ̑мъ боѧ́щымсѧ, непостоѧ́ннаго сꙋди́ща твое́го: Сла́ва: Трⷪичъ. Безна́чалне Ѻ҆́ч҃е, Сн҃е събезна́чалне, оу҆тѣ́шителю

И҆рм҃: Є҆го́же во́инства: Сле́знꙋю Сп҃се склѧ́нницꙋ, ꙗ҆́коже мѵ́ро и҆стощева́ѧ на гла́вꙋ твою̀, зовꙋ́ ти ꙗ҆́коже блꙋ́дница, млⷭти просѧ́щи, мо́льбꙋ приношꙋ̀, и҆ ѡ҆ставле́нїе и҆щꙋ̀ прїѧ́ти:. А҆́ще и҆ никто́же ꙗ҆́коже а҆́зъ, съгрѣши́хъ тебѣ̀, но ѻ҆ба́че прїимѝ и҆ менѐ, мл҃рде Сп҃се, стра́хомъ ка́ющасѧ, и҆ любо́вїю зовꙋ́ща, съгрѣши́хъ тебѣ̀ є҆ди́не, поми́лꙋй мѧ̀ мл҃тиве: Поща̀ Бж҃е своѐ созда́нїе, и҆ взыщѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ па́стырь поги́бшее, предварѝ заблꙋ́ждшаго, восхитѝ ѿ во́лка, сътвори́ мѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ ѻ҆вча̀, на па́ствѣ твои́хъ ѡ҆ве́цъ. Є҆гда̀ Сꙋдїѧ̀ сѧ́деши ꙗ҆́кѡ мл҃рдъ, и҆ пока́жеши стра́шнꙋю сла́вꙋ твою̀ Сп҃се, ѽ како́вый стра́хъ тогда̀! пе́щи горѧ́щой, всѣ̑мъ боѧ́щымсѧ, непостоѧ́ннаго сꙋди́ща твое́го: Сла́ва: Трⷪичъ. Безна́чалне Ѻ҆́ч҃е, Сн҃е събезна́чалне, оу҆тѣ́шителю
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* When as Judge Thou shalt sit as compassionate, and reveal Thy terrible glory, O Savior: O what fear shall there be then, the furnace burning, while all tremble before Thine inexorable judgment seat! (Matt. 25:31; Dan. 7:9–10)

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion 4:* When as Judge Thou shalt sit as compassionate, and reveal Thy terrible glory, O Savior: O what fear shall there be then, the furnace burning, while all tremble before Thine inexorable judgment seat! (Matt. 25:31; Dan. 7:9–10)

items.english_text: *Trinity Hymn:* O unoriginate Father, co-unoriginate Son, good Comforter good Comforter, good Spirit, upright Spirit, Begetter of the Word of God, Word of the unoriginate Father, living and creating Spirit: Trinity, Unity, have mercy on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Trinity Hymn:* O unoriginate Father, co-unoriginate Son, good Comforter...

items.slavonic_text: Бо́: Ѧ҆́кѡ ѿ ѡ҆́броще́нїѧ червлени́ца Прчⷭ҇таѧ, оу҆́мнаѧ багрѧни́це Емману́илева, внꙋ́трь въ чре́вѣ твое́мъ пло́ть и҆стка́сѧ, тѣ́мже тѧ Бцⷣꙋ вои́стиннꙋ почита́емъ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* As from a dye-pot, O all-pure Virgin, the spiritual purple cloth—the flesh of Emmanuel—was woven within thy womb; therefore we honor thee in truth as the Theotokos!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* As from a dye-pot, O all-pure Virgin, the spiritual purple cloth—the flesh of Emmanuel—was woven within thy womb; therefore we honor thee in truth as the Theotokos!

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́: ѳ҃. И҆рмо́. Безсѣ́менна зача́тїѧ:
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: A conception without seed, [an ineffable childbirth, of a Mother unwedded the birth was incorrupt! For the birth of God renews natures; therefore all generations magnify thee in orthodox manner as the Mother of God!] (Luke 1:48)*[^766]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 9. Heirmos: A conception without seed, [an ineffable childbirth, of a Mother unwedded the birth was incorrupt! For the birth of God renews natures; therefore all generations magnify thee in orthodox manner as the Mother of God!] (Luke 1:48)*[^766]

items.day_or_date: Thursday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆миле́рднїсѧ Сп҃се, Сн҃е Дв҃дъ поми́лꙋй, бѣ́снꙋющыхсѧ сло́вомъ и҆сцѣли́выи, гла́съ же млⷭ҇ти́вныи ꙗ҆́кѡ разбо́йникꙋ и҆ мнѣ̀ рцы̀, А҆ми́нь гла҃ю тебѣ̀, съ мно́ю бꙋ́деши въ Раѝ, є҆гда̀ прїи́дꙋ въ сла́вѣ мое́й:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Have mercy on me, O Savior; Son of David, have mercy! (Matt. 9:27; 15:22) Thou Who with a word didst heal the demon-possessed, speak also unto me that merciful voice as unto the thief: "Truly I say unto thee, with Me shalt thou be in Paradise, when I come in My glory!" (Luke 23:43; Matt. 25:31)

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion 1:* Have mercy on me, O Savior; Son of David, have mercy! (Luke 23:43; Matt. 25:31)

items.office: Thursday of the First Week of Great Lent

items.slavonic_text: Разбо́йникъ хꙋлѧ́ше тѧ, разбо́йникъ Бг҃осло́влаше тѧ, ѻ҆́ба бо с̾тобо́ю на Крⷭ҇тѣ̀ ви́сѣста, но ѽ многомлⷭ҇тиве, ꙗ҆́кѡже вѣ́рномꙋ ти разбо́йникꙋ, позна́вшемꙋ тѧ Бг҃а, и҆ мнѣ̀ ѿве́рзи две́рь, сла́внагѡ црⷭ҇твїѧ твое́гѡ:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* One thief reviled Thee, the other thief confessed Thee as God, for both hung with Thee upon the Cross! (Luke 23:39–42) But O most merciful One, as unto Thy faithful thief who acknowledged Thee to be God, open also unto me the door of Thy glorious Kingdom!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion 2:* One thief reviled Thee, the other thief confessed Thee as God, for both hung with Thee upon the Cross! (Luke 23:39–42) But O most merciful One, as unto Thy faithful thief who acknowledged Thee to be God, open also unto me the door of Thy glorious Kingdom!

items.office: Thursday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: Thursday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.slavonic_text: Тва́рь с̾дрыга́шесѧ, распина́ема тѧ зрѧ́щи, го́ры и҆ ка́менїѧ стра́хомъ распада́хꙋсѧ, и҆ землѧ̀ трѧса́шесѧ, и҆ а҆́дъ ѡ҆бнажа́шесѧ, и҆ с̾поме́рче свѣ́тъ въ днѐ, зрѧ̀ тебѐ І҆и҃се пригвожде́нна къ Крⷭ҇тꙋ:
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Creation trembled seeing Thee crucified; mountains and rocks split with fear, the earth shook, Hades was stripped bare, and the light grew dark at midday, seeing Thee, O Jesus, nailed to the Cross! (Matt. 27:45, 51; Luke 23:44–45)

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion 3:* Creation trembled seeing Thee crucified; mountains and rocks split with fear, the earth shook, Hades was stripped bare, and the light grew dark at midday, seeing Thee, O Jesus, nailed to the Cross! (Matt. 27:45, 51; Luke 23:44–45)

items.day_or_date: Thursday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.slavonic_text: Досто́йны покаѧ́нїѧ пло́ды, не и҆стѧжѝ ѿ менѐ, ꙗ҆́ко крѣ́пость моѧ̀ въ мнѣ̀ ѡ҆скꙋдѣ̀, срⷣце ми да́рꙋй прⷭ҇нѡ съкрꙋше́нное, нищетꙋ́ же дх҃овнꙋю, да сїѧ̀ ти принесꙋ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ прїѧ́тнꙋю же́ртвꙋ є҆ди́не Сп҃се:
items.english_text: *Troparion 4:* Demand not of me worthy fruits of repentance, for my strength has failed within me! (Matt. 3:8; Luke 3:8; Ps. 30:11 [LXX]) Grant me ever a contrite heart and spiritual poverty, that I may offer these unto Thee as an acceptable sacrifice, O only Savior! (Ps. 50:19 [LXX]; Matt. 5:3)

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion 4:* Demand not of me worthy fruits of repentance, for my strength has failed within me! (Matt. 3:8; Luke 3:8; Ps. 30:11 [LXX]) Grant me ever a contrite heart and spiritual poverty, that I may offer these unto Thee as an acceptable sacrifice, O only Savior! (Ps. 50:19 [LXX]; Matt. 5:3)

items.office: Thursday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: Thursday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.slavonic_text: Сꙋ́дїе мо́й и҆ вѣ́дче мо́й, и҆мы́й па́ки прїитѝ съ А҆́гг҃лы, сꙋди́ти мі́рꙋ всемꋥ, млⷭ҇ти́внымъ си ѻ҆́комъ, тогда̀ ви́дѣвъ мѧ̀ пощадѝ, и҆ оу҆ще́дри мѧ̀ І҆и҃се, па́че всѧ́кагѡ є҆стества̀ чл҃в́ча съгрѣ́шивша:
items.english_text: *Troparion 5:* O my Judge and my Knower, Who art to come again with the angels to judge all the world: seeing me then with Thy merciful eye, spare me and have compassion upon me, O Jesus, who have sinned beyond all human nature! (Matt. 25:31–32)

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion 5:* O my Judge and my Knower, Who art to come again with the angels to judge all the world: seeing me then with Thy merciful eye, spare me and have compassion upon me, O Jesus, who have sinned beyond all human nature! (Matt. 25:31–32)

items.slavonic_text: А҆ндре́е бл҃же́нне, и҆ Ѻ҆́тче пребл҃женнѣ́йшїй, па́стырю Кри́тскїй, непреста́й молѧ́сѧ, ѡ҆ воспѣва́ющихъ тѧ, да и҆зба́вимсѧ вси гнѣ́ва, и҆ ско́рби и҆ тлѣ́нїѧ, и҆ грѣхо́въ свободи́мсѧ, чтꙋ́щїи твою́ па́мѧть прⷭ҇нѡ.
items.english_text: *To St. Andrew:* O blessed Andrew, father most thrice-blessed, shepherd of Crete: cease not praying for those who praise thee, that we all may be delivered from wrath, affliction, corruption, and be set free from sins, who ever honor thy memory!

provenance.verbatim_source: *To St. Andrew:* O blessed Andrew, father most thrice-blessed, shepherd of Crete: cease not praying for those who praise thee, that we all may be delivered from wrath, affliction, corruption, and be set free from sins, who ever honor thy memory!

items.slavonic_text: И҆ нн҃ѣ: Бо́: Бг҃а є҆ди́на роди́ла є҆сѝ, є҆ди́на Дв҃ою пребы́вши, ѽ стра́нномꙋ ржⷭ҇твꙋ̀! ѽ стра́нномꙋ зача́тїю! зача́тїе безсѣ́менное, и҆ ржⷭ҇тво̀ па́че є҆сте́ствено, ѽ Бг҃оневѣ́сто чтⷭ҇таѧ, соблюдѝ ста́до Сн҃а твое́гѡ, є҆́же стѧжа̀.
items.english_text: *Trinity Hymn:* O consubstantial Trinity, tri-hypostatic Unity, we hymn Thee, glorifying the Father, magnifying the Son, and worshiping the Spirit: the one Essence, truly God, Life and the Living One, Kingdom without end!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Trinity Hymn:* O consubstantial Trinity, tri-hypostatic Unity, we hymn Thee, glorifying the Father, magnifying the Son, and worshiping the Spirit: the one Essence, truly God, Life and the Living One, Kingdom without end!

items.slavonic_text: В ПІА́ТОКЪ ПЕ́РВОИ НД҃ЛИ ПО́СТА. На ꙋ́трени. Оу҆ка́зъ, Зри лї́, рѻ҃в. По в҃, Стїхоло́гїи. Сѣда́: Гла́, в҃. Гдⷭ҇на І҆ѡ́сифа. По́дѡбнъ. Бл҃гоѡ́бразный І҆ѡ́сифъ: Страстьмѝ твои́ми, безстра́стїе всѣ́мъ дарова́й чл҃колꙋ́бче, стра́сти пло́ти моеѧ̀ оу҆мертви́въ, крⷭ҇то́мъ бж҃е́ственнымъ, сподо́би ви́дѣти, и҆ чⷭ҇тно́е въскрⷭ҇нїе твое́ Гдⷭ҇и, по́стомъ бл҃гоꙋгожда́ющꙋ сла́вѣ твое́й, да прїи́мꙋ бога́тнѡ вели́кꙋю твою̀ млⷭ҇ть: в҃.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Alone thou didst bear God, alone remaining a Virgin! O marvelous birthgiving! O marvelous conception! A conception without seed, and a childbirth beyond nature! O pure Bride of God, preserve the flock which thy Son acquired! (Acts 20:28)

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ: Крⷭ҇тобогоро́диченъ. Чⷭ҇тны́мъ Крⷭ҇то́мъ Сн҃а твое́гѡ съхранѧ́еми, Влⷣчце чⷭ҇таѧ Бцⷣе, всѧ́кїй прило́гъ во́рѡга, всѝ оу҆до́бъ побѣжда́емъ. Тѣ́мже тѧ по до́лгꙋ прⷭ҇нѡ оу҆блажа́емъ,
items.english_text: *Then both choirs chant the Heirmos: A conception without seed.*[^767]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ: Крⷭ҇тобогоро́диченъ. Чⷭ҇тны́мъ Крⷭ҇то́мъ Сн҃а твое́гѡ съхранѧ́еми, Влⷣчце чⷭ҇таѧ Бцⷣе, всѧ́кїй прило́гъ во́рѡга, всѝ оу҆до́бъ побѣжда́емъ. Тѣ́мже тѧ по до́лгꙋ прⷭ҇нѡ оу҆блажа́емъ,
items.english_text: By Thy sufferings grant dispassion unto all, O Lover of mankind! Having put to death the passions of my flesh by Thy divine Cross, make me worthy also to behold Thy venerable Resurrection, O Lord, pleasing Thy glory through fasting, that I may richly receive Thy great mercy! (Twice)

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ ны́нѣ: Крⷭ҇тобогоро́диченъ. Чⷭ҇тны́мъ Крⷭ҇то́мъ Сн҃а твое́гѡ съхранѧ́еми, Влⷣчце чⷭ҇таѧ Бцⷣе, всѧ́кїй прило́гъ во́рѡга, всѝ оу҆до́бъ побѣжда́емъ. Тѣ́мже тѧ по до́лгꙋ прⷭ҇нѡ оу҆блажа́емъ,
items.english_text: Preserved by the venerable Cross of thy Son, O pure Lady Theotokos, we easily vanquish every assault of the enemy! Therefore as is due we ever bless thee as the Mother of God and the only hope of our souls!

provenance.verbatim_source:
Preserved by the venerable Cross of thy Son, O pure Lady Theotokos, we easily vanquish every assault of the enemy! Therefore as is due we ever bless thee...
...as the Mother of God and the only hope of our souls!

items.day_or_date: Friday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ нн҃: Крⷭ҇тобо: Дв҃аѧ, и҆ Мт҃и твоѧ̀ Х҃е, на дре́вѣ зрѧ́щи тѧ ме́ртва просте́рта, пла́чꙋщи го́рьцѣ, Сн҃е мо́й, вопїѧ́ше, что̀ стра́нное сѐ та́инство; всѣ́мъ да́рꙋѧй жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю, во́лею на Крⷭ҇тѣ̀ ка́кѡ оу҆мира́еши, сме́ртїю помо́сною:
items.english_text: Being the fountain of purity, preserve us through fasting, O merciful One; look down upon us who fall down before Thee! Give ear unto the lifting up of our hands, Thou Who didst stretch out Thy palms when crucified upon the Wood for all the earthborn, O only Lord of the bodiless hosts! (Twice) (Ps. 140:2 [LXX])

provenance.verbatim_source: Being the fountain of purity, preserve us through fasting, O merciful One; look down upon us who fall down before Thee! Give ear unto the lifting up of our hands, Thou Who didst stretch out Thy palms when crucified upon the Wood for all the earthborn, O only Lord of the bodiless hosts! (Twice) (Ps. 140:2 [LXX])

items.slavonic_text: Трїпѣ́сне. Гла́: а҃. Пѣ́: є҃. И҆рм[о́]: Просвѣще́нїе въ тмѣ̀:
items.english_text: Beholding Thee dead and stretched out upon the Wood, O Christ, the Virgin and Thy Mother weeping bitterly cried out: "O my Son, what is this strange mystery? O Giver of eternal life unto all, how dost Thou die of Thine own will upon the Cross by an ignominious death?"

provenance.verbatim_source: Beholding Thee dead and stretched out upon the Wood, O Christ, the Virgin and Thy Mother weeping bitterly cried out: "O my Son, what is this strange mystery? O Giver of eternal life unto all, how dost Thou die of Thine own will upon the Cross by an ignominious death?"

items.slavonic_text: Въ мнѣ̀ сꙋ́щїй зрѧ̀ грѣ́хъ, лестивомꙋ́дрый, спѣши́тсѧ и҆ содѣ́йствꙋетъ грѣхꙋ̀. ра́дꙋетъ бо сѧ, вои́стиннꙋ мое́й поги́бели. но ты́ ми да́ждь и҆справле́нїе Сп҃се, въ ѻ҆́нагѡ низложе́нїе молѧ́сѧ:
items.english_text: *Then we chant the Canon in the Menaion for six; and the Triodion according to their order. And the Canticle from the Psalter is chanted as usual:*[^770]

items.slavonic_text: Нача́ла побѣди́вый тмы̀, на Крⷭ҇тѣ̀ свое́мъ, си́хъ и҆зми́ мѧ злодѣѧ́нїа, па́дшаго въ глꙋбинꙋ̀ грѣха̀, и҆ въ ꙗ҆́мꙋ безмѣ́стныхъ дѣѧ́нїй, твое́ю же млⷭ҇тїю оу҆пова́юща сп҃тисѧ:
items.english_text: *Triodion, Tone 1. Ode 5. Heirmos: O Light in darkness, [Savior of the hopeless, Christ Who by Thy Cross didst illumine our souls: unto Thee do we rise early, and we hymn Thee, O only Lover of mankind!] (Isa. 9:2; 26:9)*[^771]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Triodion, Tone 1. Ode 5. Heirmos: O Light in darkness, [Savior of the hopeless, Christ Who by Thy Cross didst illumine our souls: unto Thee do we rise early, and we hymn Thee, O only Lover of mankind!] (Isa. 9:2; 26:9)*[^771]

items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мрщве́нныисѧ на Крⷭ҇тѣ̀ просте́ртъ, оу҆мерщвле́ннꙋю грѣхо́мъ ѡ҆живѝ дш҃ꙋ мою̀, и҆ чⷭ҇тно́е твоѐ въскрⷭ҇нїе дости́гнꙋти, въ ми́рѣ Х҃е сподо́би, дѣ́лающа оу҆се́рднѡ твоѧ̀ ѡ҆правда́нїа:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Seeing the sin dwelling within me, the deceitful-minded one hastens and cooperates with sin, for he truly rejoices over my destruction! But do Thou, O Savior, grant me correction, praying for his overthrow!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion 1:* Seeing the sin dwelling within me, the deceitful-minded one hastens and cooperates with sin, for he truly rejoices over my destruction! But do Thou, O Savior, grant me correction, praying for his overthrow!

items.slavonic_text: Бо́: Просвѣще́нїе мое́й немощи, Сп҃нїе ѡ҆мраче́нной
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Having vanquished the principalities of darkness upon Thy Cross, deliver me from their wickedness, who have fallen into the depth of sin and into the pit of improper deeds, yet hoping by Thy mercy to be saved! (Col. 2:15)

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion 2:* Having vanquished the principalities of darkness upon Thy Cross, deliver me from their wickedness, who have fallen into the depth of sin and into the pit of improper deeds, yet hoping by Thy mercy to be saved! (Col. 2:15)

items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* O Thou Who wast stretched out dead upon the Cross, quicken my soul which has been slain by sin, and make me worthy in peace to attain Thy venerable Resurrection, O Christ, fervently working Thy statutes! (Rom. 6:11)

items.slavonic_text: дш҃и мое́й чⷭ҇таѧ, сп҃си́ мѧ сп҃сѝ погиба́юща Ѻ҆трокови́це, и҆ ри́зꙋ нетлѣ́нїѧ мѧ̀ ѡ҆блецы̀, и҆стлѣ́вшаго лю́тыми прегрѣше́ньми:
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos, in the same Tone. Heirmos: The night having passed, [the day has drawn near, and light has shone forth upon the world; therefore the angelic ranks hymn Thee, and glorify Thee, O Lord!] (Rom. 13:12)*[^772]

items.slavonic_text: И҆́ныи И҆рм[о́]: Гл[а́]: то́[жде]. И҆рм[о́]: Но́щи мимоше́дшей:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* On the Place of the Skull Thou didst accept crucifixion in the flesh, O only immortal One, granting immortality unto the human race and refashioning it, O Lord! (Matt. 27:33)

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion 1:* On the Place of the Skull Thou didst accept crucifixion in the flesh, O only immortal One, granting immortality unto the human race and refashioning it, O Lord! (Matt. 27:33)

items.slavonic_text: Ты̀ на мѣ́стѣ ло́бномъ, пло́тїю распѧ́тїѧ принѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, є҆ди́не безсме́ртне, чл҃в́чїй ро́дъ ѡ҆безсме́ртетьвꙋѧ, и҆ въсwбража́ѧ Гдⷭ҇и:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Seeing the insult of Thy passion, all creation was transformed, O Lord, lamenting the murder committed by the Judeans; yet Thou didst endure it, that Thou mightest save all things! (Matt. 27:51)

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion 2:* Seeing the insult of Thy passion, all creation was transformed, O Lord, lamenting the murder committed by the Judeans; yet Thou didst endure it, that Thou mightest save all things! (Matt. 27:51)

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Тр[о́]: Ѽ Трⷪ҇це всест҃а́ѧ, ты̀ на́ше сложе́нїе, ты̀ прибѣ́жище и҆ держа́ва, въ є҆стествѣ̀ є҆ди́но тѧ̀ воспѣва́ющимъ, ѡ҆чище́нїе съгрѣше́нїемъ низпослѝ:
items.english_text: *Trinity Hymn:* O all-holy Trinity, Thou art our structure, Thou art our refuge and might: unto us who hymn Thee as one in essence, send down cleansing from sins!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Trinity Hymn:* O all-holy Trinity, Thou art our structure, Thou art our refuge and might: unto us who hymn Thee as one in essence, send down cleansing from sins!

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бг҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Мі́рꙋ и҆ сꙋ́щымъ въ мі́рѣ, ра́доватисѧ прире́кшымъ, нн҃ѣ ꙗ҆́кѡ Хс҃ꙋ съраспина́еми, претерпи́мъ доса́дꙋ, и҆ рꙋга́нїемъ дрꙋ́гъ, съ ни́мъ бл҃гопросла́вимсѧ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Virgin of many names, rejoice, O Theotokos: Ark, Urn, and Table, light-bearing Lampstand, bush unconsumed by fire, overshadowing Mountain of God! (Heb. 9:4; Exod. 3:2; Hab. 3:3 [LXX])

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* O Virgin of many names, rejoice, O Theotokos: Ark, Urn, and Table, light-bearing Lampstand, bush unconsumed by fire, overshadowing Mountain of God! (Heb. 9:4; Exod. 3:2; Hab. 3:3 [LXX])

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃. И҆рм[о́]: Въ пещи ѻ҆́гненной:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having renounced the world and those in the world, that we might rejoice: now being co-crucified with Christ, let us endure insult and the mockery of companions, that we may be glorified together with Him! (Rom. 8:17; Gal. 2:20; 6:14)

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having renounced the world and those in the world, that we might rejoice: now being co-crucified with Christ, let us endure insult and the mockery of companions, that we may be glorified together with Him! (Rom. 8:17; Gal. 2:20; 6:14)

items.day_or_date: Friday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.slavonic_text: Смѣри́вый себѐ, возне́слсѧ є҆сѝ за млⷭ҇рдїе на Крⷭ҇тъ, въꙁвыша́ѧ па́дшаго снѣ́дїю дре́ва и҆ногда̀. Тѣ́мже тѧ є҆ди́не пребл҃гі́и просла́вленнаго пое́мъ въ вѣ́ки:
items.english_text: *Heirmos: The night having passed, the day has drawn near, and light has shone forth upon the world; therefore the angelic ranks hymn Thee, and glorify Thee, O Lord!*

provenance.verbatim_source: *Heirmos: The night having passed, the day has drawn near, and light has shone forth upon the world; therefore the angelic ranks hymn Thee, and glorify Thee, O Lord!*

items.office: Friday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: Friday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.slavonic_text: Невнима́нїѧ дрема́нїемъ грѣха̀, тѧжкїй подꙋ́хъ со́нъ. но ты̀ оу҆снꙋ́вый на Крⷭ҇тѣ̀ менѐ ра́ди Х҃е мо́й, въздви́гни мѧ̀ па́дша, да мѧ̀ не прїи́метъ нощь сме́ртнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: In the fiery furnace [the children of Israel, as in a crucible, shone more brightly than gold with the beauty of piety, saying: "All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord, hymn and exalt Him above all unto all ages!"] (Dan. 3:57)*[^773]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 8. Heirmos: In the fiery furnace [the children of Israel, as in a crucible, shone more brightly than gold with the beauty of piety, saying: "All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord, hymn and exalt Him above all unto all ages!"] (Dan. 3:57)*[^773]

items.slavonic_text: Невнима́нїѧ дрема́нїемъ грѣха̀, тѧжкїй подꙋ́хъ со́нъ. но ты̀ оу҆снꙋ́вый на Крⷭ҇тѣ̀ менѐ ра́ди Х҃е мо́й, въздви́гни мѧ̀ па́дша, да мѧ̀ не прїи́метъ нощь сме́ртнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* Having humbled Thyself, Thou didst ascend upon the Cross out of compassion, lifting up the one who fell of old through the eating from the tree; therefore we hymn Thee, the only all-good One, glorified unto the ages! (Phil. 2:8; Gen. 3:6)

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion 1:* Having humbled Thyself, Thou didst ascend upon the Cross out of compassion, lifting up the one who fell of old through the eating from the tree; therefore we hymn Thee, the only all-good One, glorified unto the ages! (Phil. 2:8; Gen. 3:6)

items.slavonic_text: Невнима́нїѧ дрема́нїемъ грѣха̀, тѧжкїй подꙋ́хъ со́нъ. но ты̀ оу҆снꙋ́вый на Крⷭ҇тѣ̀ менѐ ра́ди Х҃е мо́й, въздви́гни мѧ̀ па́дша, да мѧ̀ не прїи́метъ нощь сме́ртнаѧ.
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* By the slumber of heedlessness, the heavy sleep of sin has blown upon me; but do Thou Who didst fall asleep upon the Cross for my sake, O my Christ, raise me up who am fallen, that the night of death may not overtake me! (Ps. 12:4 [LXX])

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion 2:* By the slumber of heedlessness, the heavy sleep of sin has blown upon me; but do Thou Who didst fall asleep upon the Cross for my sake, O my Christ, raise me up who am fallen, that the night of death may not overtake me! (Ps. 12:4 [LXX])

items.office: Friday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: Friday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.slavonic_text: Ѽслѣпи́всѧ сластьмѝ, ѡ҆́каѧннꙋю дш҃ꙋ ѡ҆мраче́ннꙋю. и҆ смѣе́тсѧ зрѧ̀ менѐ лестивомꙋ́дрый вра́гъ. тѣ́мже мѧ̀ просвѣтѝ, и҆ и҆зба́ви сегѡ̀ зло́бы, Х҃е въ вѣ́ки:
items.english_text: ...Blinded by pleasures, my wretched and darkened soul is mocked by the deceitful-minded enemy seeing me; therefore enlighten me, and deliver me from his malice, O Christ, unto the ages!

provenance.verbatim_source: ...Blinded by pleasures, my wretched and darkened soul is mocked by the deceitful-minded enemy seeing me; therefore enlighten me, and deliver me from his malice, O Christ, unto the ages!

items.office: Friday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: Friday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.slavonic_text: И҆́ный. И҆рмо́. Въ кꙋпинѣ̀ Мѡѷсе́ꙋ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having spent my life in slothfulness, I have weighed down my soul with the slumber of sin; yet fleeing unto thy sleepless intercession, allow me not, O all-pure Virgin, to fall asleep in death! (Ps. 12:4 [LXX])

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Having spent my life in slothfulness, I have weighed down my soul with the slumber of sin; yet fleeing unto thy sleepless intercession, allow me not, O all-pure Virgin, to fall asleep in death! (Ps. 12:4 [LXX])

items.slavonic_text: Те́рнїемъ вѣнча́всѧ, и҆ въ ѡ҆де́ждꙋ ѿ порфѵ́ры ѡ҆болче́нъ, ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ краснѣ́йшїй Х҃е добро́тою. па́че сыно́въ чл҃чкихъ, сла́вою ѡ҆блиста́ваѧ:
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos. Heirmos: In the bush unto Moses [the Virgin's childbearing upon Mount Sinai was prefigured of old: sing, bless, and exalt Him above all unto all ages!] (Exod. 3:2)*[^774]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Another Heirmos. Heirmos: In the bush unto Moses [the Virgin's childbearing upon Mount Sinai was prefigured of old: sing, bless, and exalt Him above all unto all ages!] (Exod. 3:2)*[^774]

items.slavonic_text: Бл҃ви́[мъ] Ѻ҆ц҃а̀, и҆ Сн҃а, и҆ Ст҃а́гѡ Дх҃а, Гдⷭ҇а. Тр[о́]: Бж҃тво̀ є҆ди́но Тр҃це, нераздѣли́мое є҆стество̀, раздѣ́лнаѧ же ли́цы, неги́блемаѧ держа́во, Ѻ҆́тче, Сн҃е, и҆ Дш҃е, тѧ̀ пѣсносло́вимъ въ всѧ̑ вѣ́ки:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Drinking gall and vinegar, Thou didst pour forth two streams of life and incorruption from Thy divine side for those who hymn Thee with faith and glorify Thee, O Christ, unto all ages! (Matt. 27:34; John 19:34)

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бг҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Крⷭ҇те ски́птре Хв҃ъ, цр҃квамъ ро́гъ, Царе́мъ побѣ́до, храни́телю хрⷭ҇тїа́нѡмъ, ты̀ є҆сѝ просвѣще́нїе моѐ, са́мъ и҆ похвала̀ моѧ̀ въ всѧ̑ вѣ́ки:
items.english_text: *Trinity Hymn:* One Godhead, O Trinity: indivisible Essence, yet divided in Persons; indestructible dominion, O Father, Son, and Spirit: we hymn Thee unto all ages!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Trinity Hymn:* One Godhead, O Trinity: indivisible Essence, yet divided in Persons; indestructible dominion, O Father, Son, and Spirit: we hymn Thee unto all ages!

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Pure Mother of God, heavenly gate, saving portals: receive the supplication of all Christians who bless thee unto all ages!

items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* By the sprinkling of Thy blood, O divine Word, cleanse my soul which is leprous with improper thoughts, and make me a partaker of Thy glory Who didst endure an inglorious crucifixion for my sake, O Christ!

items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Bowed down completely under the weight of improper deeds, O Christ, and grieving, I cry unto Thee, O Lover of mankind: heal the incurable wounds of my soul by Thy precious blood, that I may hymn Thy Godhead!

items.slavonic_text: Ве́сь слѧко́хсѧ тѧгото́ю, безмѣ́стныхъ Х҃е дѣѧ́нїй, и҆ сѣ́тꙋѧ зовꙋ́ ти чл҃колꙋ́бче, дш҃ѧ моеѧ̀ неисцѣ́льныѧ ꙗ҆́звы, и҆сцѣлѝ твое́ю чⷭ҇тно́ю кро́вїю, да пою̀ твоѐ Бж҃тво̀:
items.english_text: *Troparion 3:* Making food out of malice and drink out of negligence, remaining uncorrected in everything, yet untimely rejoicing in abstinence from foods—for the Lord declared that not such is the fast! (Isa. 58:3–6)

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion 3:* Making food out of malice and drink out of negligence, remaining uncorrected in everything, yet untimely rejoicing in abstinence from foods—for the Lord declared that not such is the fast! (Isa. 58:3–6)

items.slavonic_text: Бо́: Напра́снагѡ дре́внягѡ погꙋбле́нїѧ ѿрече́нїе, и҆ пра́мт҃ре и҆справле́нїе, ро́дꙋ же къ Бг҃ꙋ вина̀ присвое́нїѧ, къ зижди́телю мо́стъ, тѧ̀ Бцⷣе велича́емъ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Renunciation of ancient sudden ruin, and correction of our foremother; cause of reconciliation of our race unto God, bridge unto the Creator: thee, O Theotokos, do we magnify!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Renunciation of ancient sudden ruin, and correction of our foremother; cause of reconciliation of our race unto God, bridge unto the Creator: thee, O Theotokos, do we magnify!

items.slavonic_text: И҆́ный И҆рмо́съ. Чⷭ҇тꙋю и҆ прⷭ҇тꙋю:
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos. Heirmos: The pure and most pure [Mother and Virgin let all us faithful magnify in songs of praise as the Mother of God!]*[^776]

items.slavonic_text: На дре́вѣ распе́ншꙋтисѧ тва́рь поколѣба́шесѧ, Бг҃ъ сы́й постра́лъ є҆сѝ пло́тїю, за млⷭ҇рдїе щедро́тъ, да сп҃се́ши на́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion 1:* When Thou wast crucified upon the Wood, creation was shaken! Being God, Thou didst suffer in the flesh out of the mercy of Thy compassions, that Thou mightest save us! (Matt. 27:51)

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion 1:* When Thou wast crucified upon the Wood, creation was shaken! Being God, Thou didst suffer in the flesh out of the mercy of Thy compassions, that Thou mightest save us! (Matt. 27:51)

items.office: Friday of the First Week of Great Lent

items.day_or_date: Friday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇та̀ твое́гѡ Гдⷭ҇и си́ла вели́каѧ, не́ѡ ѡ҆́бразꙋюще сегѡ̀ въ себѣ̀ а҆́бїе бѣсѡ́мъ крѣ́пость ѡ҆тража́емъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion 2:* Great is the power of Thy Cross, O Lord! By portraying it within ourselves, we straightway repel the might of the demons!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion 2:* Great is the power of Thy Cross, O Lord! By portraying it within ourselves, we straightway repel the might of the demons!

items.office: Friday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS

items.slavonic_text: Бо́: Ра́дꙋйсѧ ѡ҆чисти́лище мі́рꙋ Бцⷣе, въ не́же прибѣга́юще вси грѣ́шнїи, къ Бг҃ꙋ грѣхѡ́въ премѣне́нїе ѡ҆брѣта́емъ:.
items.english_text: *Trinity Hymn:* Tri-hypostatic Unity, consubstantial Trinity, Sovereign Lordship, Essence equal in glory, Father, Son, and Divine Spirit: save us all!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Trinity Hymn:* Tri-hypostatic Unity, consubstantial Trinity, Sovereign Lordship, Essence equal in glory, Father, Son, and Divine Spirit: save us all!

items.slavonic_text: И҆рмо́съ. Чⷭ҇тꙋю и҆ пречⷭ҇тꙋю мт҃рь и҆ Дв҃ꙋ пѣ́ньми пѣ́нїй, вси вѣ́рнїи, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бцⷣꙋ велича́емъ:.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Rejoice, propitiation of the world, O Theotokos, in whom fleeing, all we sinners find reconciliation of our sins unto God!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Rejoice, propitiation of the world, O Theotokos, in whom fleeing, all we sinners find reconciliation of our sins unto God!

items.slavonic_text: На сті: сті́ры самогла́сны. Гла́, и҃. По́стное завѣща́нїе ра́достнѡ воспрїи́мемъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Strengthen me by the divine power of Thy Cross, O Lord, that I may offer unto Thee the blameless and pure time of the fast!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Strengthen me by the divine power of Thy Cross, O Lord, that I may offer unto Thee the blameless and pure time of the fast!

items.english_text: *Heirmos: The pure and most pure Mother and Virgin let all us faithful magnify in songs of praise as the Mother of God!*

items.office: Friday of the First Week of Great Lent
items.section: At the Aposticha, Idiomelon Stichera, Tone 8
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS

items.slavonic_text: На сті: сті́ры самогла́сны. Гла́, и҃. По́стное завѣща́нїе ра́достнѡ воспрїи́мемъ.
items.english_text: Joyfully let us receive the precept of the fast for if our forefather had kept this, we would not have suffered the fall from Eden! Beautiful to behold and good for food was the fruit that brought death upon me! Let us not be enticed, nor let our palate be sweetened by foods that are prized but after consumption are dishonored! Let us flee intemperance, and let us not submit to the passions that follow after satiety! Let us mark ourselves with the blood of Him Who was led willingly unto death for our sake, and the destroyer shall not touch us; and we shall eat the most holy Pascha of Christ unto the salvation of our souls! (Twice) (Gen. 2:16–17; 3:6; Exod. 12:13, 23; 1 Cor. 5:7)

provenance.verbatim_source:
Joyfully let us receive the precept of the fast...
...for if our forefather had kept this, we would not have suffered the fall from Eden! Beautiful to behold and good for food was the fruit that brought death upon me! Let us not be enticed, nor let our palate be sweetened by foods that are prized but after consumption are dishonored! Let us flee intemperance, and let us not submit to the passions that follow after satiety! Let us mark ourselves with the blood of Him Who was led willingly unto death for our sake, and the destroyer shall not touch us; and we shall eat the most holy Pascha of Christ unto the salvation of our souls! (Twice) (Gen. 2:16–17; 3:6; Exod. 12:13, 23; 1 Cor. 5:7)

items.slavonic_text: а҆́ще бо бы̀ сїѐ Пра́ѡтецъ съхрани́лъ, Е҆де́мскагѡ ѿпаде́нїѧ непрїѧ́ли бы́хомъ. кра́сный бѣ̀ въ видѣ́нїе, и҆ до́брый въ снѣ́дь, оу҆мори́вый менѐ пло́дъ. Да не восхити́мсѧ, ни да оу҆слади́тсѧ на́мъ горта́нь, почита́емыми бра́шны, по прїѧ́тїи же безчествꙋ́емыми. Бѣжи́мъ невъꙁдержа́нїѧ, и҆ сꙋ́щымъ по насыще́нїи страсте́мъ непокори́мсѧ. Назнамена́имсѧ кро́вїю, на́съ ра́ди веденнагѡ на сме́рть во́лею, и҆ не прикосне́тсѧ на́съ гꙋби́тель. и҆ снѣ́мы Па́схꙋ Хв҃ꙋ ст҃ѣ́йшꙋю, въ сп҃се́нїе дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ: С: д҃:
items.english_text: *We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy... and again the same Sticheron.* (Ps. 89:14 [LXX])

items.slavonic_text: И҆спо́лнихомсѧ заꙋ́тра мл҃ти: и҆ па́ки тꙋ́ ст҃рꙋ. Стї́хъ, в҃. И҆ бꙋ́ди свѣ́тлость Гдⷭ҇а: Та́же, М[ч҃ниченъ]: Что̀ ва́съ нарече́мъ ст҃і́и; Хероѵві́мъ ли, ꙗ҆́кѡ на ва́съ почи́лъ є҆́стъ Хс҃. Серафі́мъ ли, ꙗ҆́кѡ непреста́ннѡ просла́висте є҆гѡ̀. А҆́гг҃лы ли, тѣ́ла бо ѿврати́стесѧ. Си́лы ли, дѣ́йствꙋете бо чꙋдеса̀. мнѡ́гаѧ ва́ша и҆мена̀, и҆ бо́льшаѧ дарова́нїѧ. моли́тесѧ сп҃тисѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ:
items.english_text: *Verse 2: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us... Then, Martyrikon:* (Ps. 89:17 [LXX])

provenance.verbatim_source: *Verse 2: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us... Then, Martyrikon:* (Ps. 89:17 [LXX])

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва, и҆ нн҃ѣ: крⷭ҇тово: По́: Ѽ пресла́: Ꙗ҆́кѡ видѣ́ тѧ Распина́ема на ло́бнемъ Сп҃се, и҆змѣнѧ́шесѧ всѧ̀ тва́рь, и҆ съдрыга́шесѧ дви́жꙋщисѧ нетерпѧ́щи. Дв҃аѧ же чⷭ҇таѧ и҆ Мт҃и твоѧ̀, рыда́ющи тебѣ̀ вопїѧ́ше, Оу҆вы́ мнѣ̀ ѽ ча́до моѐ, Сп҃се мо́й пресладча́йшій, что̀ но́вое сїѐ и҆ пресла́вное, и҆ стра́нное видѣ́нїе!
items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* What shall we call you, O holy ones? Cherubim, for Christ rested upon you? Seraphim, for unceasingly you glorified Him? Angels, for you turned away from the body? Powers, for you work miracles? Many are your names, and greater are your gifts: pray that our souls may be saved!

items.english_text: When she saw Thee crucified upon the Place of the Skull, O Savior, all creation was transformed and trembled, shaking in agitation, unable to endure it! And the pure Virgin and Thy Mother weeping bitterly cried unto Thee: "Woe is me, O my Child, my sweetest Savior! What is this new, most marvelous, and strange sight?" (Matt. 27:33, 51)

Го́ре беззако́нномꙋ, лꙋка́ваѧ по дѣ́лѡмъ рꙋкꙋ̀ є҆гѡ̀ приключа́тсѧ є҆мꙋ̀: ῖ. Лю́дїе моѝ, прист́авници ва́ши пожина́ютъ ва́съ. и҆ и҆стѧзꙋ́ющїи ѡ҆блада́ютъ ва́ми. лю́дїе моѝ, бл҃жа́щыи ва́съ, льстѧ́тъ вы. и҆ стеꙁю̀ нѡ́гъ ва́шихъ възсмꙋща́ютъ. а҃і. Но нн҃ѣ ста́нетъ на сꙋ́дъ Гдⷭ҇ь. и҆ поста́витъ на сꙋ́дъ лю́ди своѧ̀. в҃і. Са́мъ Гдⷭ҇ь на сꙋ́дъ прїи́детъ, съ Ста́рци людї́й, и҆ съ кнѧ̑зи свои́ми:

items.english_text: Come, O ye faithful, let us perform the works of God in the light, that we may walk becomingly as in the day! Let us take away from ourselves every unjust writing concerning our neighbor, placing no stumbling-block unto him as an offense! Let us abandon the voluptuousness of the flesh; let us increase the spiritual gifts of the soul; let us give bread unto those in need, and let us approach Christ, crying out in repentance: "O our God, have mercy on us!" (Twice) (Rom. 13:12–13; 14:13; Isa. 58:6–7)

items.english_text: Come, all ye lovers of the martyrs, let us spiritually rejoice and keep festival! For today the Martyr Theodore sets forth a mystical banquet gladdening us who love the feast, that we may cry unto him: "Rejoice, unconquered passion-bearer, who didst overthrow the threats of the torturers upon earth! Rejoice, who didst give up thy corruptible body unto tortures for Christ God! Rejoice, who in diverse perils didst appear an experienced warrior of the heavenly host! Therefore we pray thee, the adornment of martyrs: pray for our souls!"

items.slavonic_text: та́йнꙋю Мч҃никъ Ѳео́дѡръ, весе́лѧщꙋю празднолю́бцевъ на́съ, є҆́же вопѣ́ти к не́мꙋ. Ра́дꙋйсѧ стрⷭ҇тоте́рпче непобѣди́мый, преще́нїѧ мꙋчи́телей на землѝ разори́вый. Ра́дꙋйсѧ бре́нное своѐ тѣ́ло, за Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а ѿда́вый мꙋ́камъ. Ра́дꙋйсѧ, въ разли́чныѧ бѣда́хъ, и҆скꙋ́сный во́инъ ꙗ҆ви́выйсѧ нб҃нагѡ во́инства. Тѣ́мже мо́лимъ тѧ Мч҃никѡмъ оу҆краше́нїе, моли́сѧ ѡ҆ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ:
items.english_text: *Sticheron 2:* The God-given grace of thy miracles, O Martyr Theodore, thou dost extend unto all who flee unto thee with faith! Therefore we praise thee, saying: thou deliverest the captives, thou healest the sick, thou enrichest the poor, and thou savest those who sail; thou imposest vain flight upon slaves, and makest exposure of thefts unto those who rob, O passion-bearer; and thou dost instruct soldiers to refrain from plundering; unto those who pray thou mercifully grantest petitions; thou art found a fervent protector unto those who celebrate thy sacred memory! Together with them, also for us who hymn thy martyrdom, O most sacred passion-bearer, ask of Christ great mercy![^780]

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃одарова́ннꙋю бл҃гть чꙋде́съ твои́хъ, Мч҃ниче Ѳео́дѡре, всѣ́мъ простира́еши, вѣ́рою к тебѣ̀ притѣка́ющымъ. Е҆́же ра́ди восхва́лѧемъ тѧ, глаго́люще, плѣне́нныѧ и҆збавлѧ́еши, и҆сцѣлѧ́еши болѧ́щыѧ, ни́щыѧ ѡ҆богаща́еши, и҆ сп҃са́еши пла́вающыѧ, сꙋ́етно бѣжа́нїе налага́еши рабѡ́мъ, и҆ тщеты̀ ꙗ҆вле́нїе тво́риши, оу҆крада́ющимъ стра́стче, и҆ во́инны нака́зꙋеши восхище́нїа ѡ҆трѣва́тисѧ, молѧ́щемъ да́рꙋеши млⷭ҇ти́внѡ проше́нїѧ, те́плый ѡ҆брѣта́ешисѧ предста́тель, творѧ́щимъ твою̀ сщ҃еннꙋю па́мѧть. Съ ни́ми же и҆ на́мъ стра́стче сщ҃еннѣ́йшій, воспѣва́ющымъ ти мч҃нїе, просѝ оу҆ Хрⷭ҇та̀ ве́лїю мл҃ть:
items.english_text: *Sticheron 3:* As a greatest gift of God hast thou been shown forth, O Martyr Theodore: for even after thy demise, as one alive thou dost grant petitions unto those who flee unto thee! Therefore when a certain woman's son had of old been snatched away and taken captive by alien soldiers, the widow came and drenched thy temple with tears; and thou as merciful, having descended upon a white horse, didst restore the boy unseen!

items.slavonic_text: и҆ по се́мъ и҆ и҆́нымъ дѣ́йствꙋѧ чꙋдеса̀, непреста́лъ є҆сѝ. но млѝ Хрⷭ҇а̀ Бг҃а, сп҃ти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шимъ: ~ Бж҃твеннымъ даро́мъ тезоимени́тата чтꙋ̀, требл҃же́нне Ѳео́дѡре. свѣ́та бо Бж҃твеннагѡ незаходи́мое свѣти́ло ꙗ҆вле́исѧ, ѡу҆ꙗ҆сни́лъ є҆сѝ страда́ньми свои́ми всю̀ тва́рь, и҆ ѻ҆гнѧ̀ сильнѣ́йшій ꙗ҆ви́всѧ пла́мень ꙋ҆гаси́лъ є҆сѝ. и҆ льсти́вагѡ змі́ѧ главꙋ̀ съкрꙋши́лъ є҆сѝ. Тѣ́мже въ стрⷭ҇тїихъ твои́хъ Хрⷭ҇то́съ преклони́всѧ, вѣнча̀ Бж҃твеннꙋю Гла́вꙋ тво̑ю, великомч҃ниче стрⷭ҇льче, ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆мѣ́ѧй дерзнове́нїе къ Бг҃ꙋ, прилѣ́жнѡ моли́сѧ ѡ҆ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ: ~ Сла́ва: Гла́съ, ѕ҃. Сосꙋ́да ꙋ҆потреби́въ вра́гъ ненави́стныи, ѿстꙋ́пника мꙋчи́телѧ, ꙋ҆мышле́нїемъ лꙋка́вымъ, посто́мъ ѡ҆чища́ющыѧсѧ лю́ди благочти́выѧ. ѿ скве́рныхъ же́ртвъ, ѡ҆скверне́нными бра́шны, ѡ҆кꙋша́шесѧ ѡ҆скверни́ти. Но ты̀ ꙋ҆хищре́нїе, крѣ́пшимъ разрꙋши́лъ є҆сѝ ꙋ҆мышле́нїемъ, въ снѣ̀ предста́лъ тогда́шнемꙋ Ἀрхїере́ю, и҆ глꙋбо́кое ра́зꙋма ѿкрыва́ѧ, и҆ безмѣ́стное начина́нїе ꙗ҆влѧ́ѧ. И҆ ꙋ҆́бѡ тебѣ̀ бл҃годарⷭ҇твенаѧ приносѧ́ще, сп҃сена напи́сꙋемъ. лѣ́тное воспомина́нїе, бы́вшагѡ чꙋдесѐ творѧ́ще, и҆ про́чее млѧ́щесѧ, ѿ ꙋ҆мышле́нїй лꙋка́вагѡ, невреди́мымъ сп҃сти́сѧ, къ Бг҃ꙋ твои́ми мл҃твами Мч҃нче Ѳео́дѡре: ~ И҆ нн҃ѣ: Бг҃о: На рѧ́дꙋ гл҃сꙋ въ ѻ҆кт: Вхо́дъ съ Еѵ҆лїа. Свѣ́те ти́хїй. Про́кименъ. Ѱало́мъ, д҃і. Гла́съ, ѕ҃. Оу҆слы́шитъ тѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇ь въ дн҃ь печа́ли: Стї́хъ. Защити́тъ тѧ̀ и҆́мѧ Бг҃а І҆а́кѡвлѧ. Бытїѧ̀ Чте́нїе. Глава̀, в҃.
items.english_text: ...and after this, working other miracles, thou hast not ceased; but pray thou unto Christ God, that our souls may be saved!

items.english_text: *Sticheron 4, Tone 2:* I honor thee, the namesake of divine gifts, O thrice-blessed Theodore; for having appeared as an unsetting luminary of the divine Light, thou hast illumined the whole creation by thy sufferings, and appearing stronger than fire, thou didst extinguish the flame, and didst crush the head of the deceptive serpent. Therefore in thy sufferings Christ bowed down and crowned thy divine head, O great martyr, athlete: as thou hast boldness unto God, pray fervently for our souls!

items.english_text: Using the apostate tyrant as his tool, the enemy full of hatred sought by an evil design to defile with foods from unclean sacrifices the pious people who were cleansing themselves by fasting. But thou by a stronger counsel didst destroy his stratagem: appearing in a dream unto the Hierarch of that time, revealing the depth of thy wisdom and exposing the unseemly scheme. Therefore, offering thee thanksgiving, we record our salvation, celebrating the annual commemoration of the miracle that was wrought; and we pray that through thy supplications unto God, O Martyr Theodore, we also may be preserved unharmed from the schemes of the evil one![^781]

items.slavonic_text: [И] Наречѐ А҆да́мъ и҆мена̀ всѣ̑мъ скотѡ́мъ, и҆ всѣ̑м пти́цам нб҃нымъ, и҆ всѣ̑мъ ѕвѣ́рем се́лным. А҆да́мꙋ же не ѡ҆брѣ́тесѧ помо́щни подо́бный емꙋ̀. И҆ наложѝ Гдⷭ҇ь Бг҃ъ со́нъ на А҆да́ма, и҆ ꙋ҆спѐ. и҆ взѧ́тъ є҆ди́но ѿ ребръ є҆гѡ̀, и҆ исполнѝ пло́ть в мѣ́сто негѡ̀. И҆ създа̀ Гдⷭ҇ь Бг҃ъ ребро̀, є҆́же взѧ́т ѿ А҆да́ма, в Же́нꙋ, [Иллюстрация / Narrative Woodcut Illustration: Сотворение и грехопадение прародителей (Быт. 2–3) . Слева: сотворение Евы из ребра спящего Адама («СЪЗДАНИЄ ЄVЫ», «АДАМ») . В центре: змей-искуситель на древе познания добра и зла, искушение Адама и Евы («EVA», «ADAM») . Справа вверху: изгнание прародителей из рая ангелом с пламенным мечом («ИЗГНАНИЄ ИЗ РАЯ») . Справа внизу: Адам и Ева трудятся на земле в поте лица, Адам возделывает землю, Ева с младенцем; надпись на свитке: «С ПОТЄМ ЛИЦА СНЄСИ ХЛЄБ ТВОЙ» .] и҆ приведѐ ю҆̀ къ А҆да́мꙋ. И҆ речѐ А҆да́мъ, Се нн҃ѣ кость ѿ косте́й мои́хъ, и҆ плоть ѿ пло́ти моеѧ̀, сїѧ̀ нарече́тсѧ Жена̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ мꙋ́жа своего̀ взѧ́тїѧ. Сегѡ̀ ра́ди ѡ҆ста́витъ чл҃къ ѿца̀ своего̀, и҆ ма́терь, и҆ прилѣпи́тсѧ женѣ̀ свое́й, и҆ бꙋ́дета два въ пло́ть є҆ди́нꙋ. И҆ бѣ́ста два на́га, А҆да́м же и҆ жена̀ є҆гѡ̀, и҆ не стыдѧ́стасѧ. Змі́и же бѣ̀ мꙋдрѣ́йшій всѣ́хъ ѕвѣре́й, сꙋ́щыхъ на землѝ, и҆́хже сътворѝ Гдⷭ҇ь Бг҃ъ. и҆ речѐ змі́и женѣ̀:

И҆ създа̀ Гдⷭ҇ь Бг҃ъ ребро̀, є҆́же взѧ́т ѿ А҆да́ма, в Же́нꙋ, [Иллюстрация / Narrative Woodcut Illustration: Сотворение и грехопадение прародителей (Быт. 2–3) . Слева: сотворение Евы из ребра спящего Адама («СЪЗДАНИЄ ЄVЫ», «АДАМ») . В центре: змей-искуситель на древе познания добра и зла, искушение Адама и Евы («EVA», «ADAM») . Справа вверху: изгнание прародителей из рая ангелом с пламенным мечом («ИЗГНАНИЄ ИЗ РАЯ») . Справа внизу: Адам и Ева трудятся на земле в поте лица, Адам возделывает землю, Ева с младенцем; надпись на свитке: «С ПОТЄМ ЛИЦА СНЄСИ ХЛЄБ ТВОЙ» .] и҆ приведѐ ю҆̀ къ А҆да́мꙋ. И҆ речѐ змі́и женѣ̀: не сме́ртїю ꙋ҆́мрете. Вѣ́даше бо Бг҃ъ. ꙗ҆́кѡ во́ньже а҆́ще де́нь снѣ́сте ѿ негѡ̀, ѿве́рзꙋтсѧ ѻ҆́чи ва́ши и҆ бꙋ́дете ꙗ҆́кѡ Бѡ́зи, вѣ́дꙋщїи до́брое и҆ лꙋка́вое. И҆ видѣ̀ жена̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ добро̀ дре́во въ снѣ́дь, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ ꙋ҆го́дное ѻ҆чи́ма ви́дѣти. и҆ кра́сно є҆́стъ є҆́же ꙋ҆празꙋмѣ́ти. и҆ взе́мши ѿ пло́да є҆гѡ̀, ꙗ҆дѐ. и҆ дадѐ мꙋ́жꙋ своему̀ съ собо́ю, и҆ ꙗ҆до́ста. И҆ ѿве́рзостѣ́сѧ ѻ҆́чи ѡ҆бѣ́ма. и҆ разꙋмѣ́ста ꙗ҆́кѡ на́га бѣ́ста, и҆ съши́ста ли́ствїе смоко́вное, и҆ сътвори́ста себѣ̀ препоѧса́нїѧ. А҆да́ме, гдѣ̀ є҆сѝ; И҆ речѐ є҆мꙋ̀: Гла́са твоегѡ̀ слы́шахъ ходѧ́ща в Раѝ, и҆ ꙋ҆боѧ́хсѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ на́гъ є҆́смь, и҆ съкры́хсѧ. И҆ речѐ Гдⷭ҇ь Бг҃ъ, Змі́ю, ꙗ҆́кѡ сътвори́лъ є҆сѝ се, проклѧ́тъ ты̀ ѿ всѣ́хъ скотѡ́въ, и҆ ѿ всѣ́хъ ѕвѣ́рей сꙋ́щихъ на земли́.

Въ по́тѣ лица̀ твое́гѡ снѣ́си хлѣ́бъ тво́й. доне́лѣже възврати́шисѧ в зе́млю, ѿ неѧ́ же взѧ́т є҆сѝ. ꙗ҆́кѡ землѧ̀ є҆сѝ, и҆ в зе́млю ѿи́деши. И҆ наречѐ А҆да́мъ и҆́мѧ женѣ̀ свое́й жи́знь. ꙗ҆́кѡ та̀ Ма́ти всѣ́хъ живꙋ́щихъ: ~ Про: ѱа҃: к҃. Гл҃, д҃. В чꙋ́вствѣ же є҆гѡ̀ бе́здны разверго́шасѧ, ѡ҆́блаци же и҆сточи́ша ро́сꙋ. Сн҃е да не преми́неши, соблюди́ же мо́й совѣ́тъ, и҆ мы́сль. Да жи́ва бꙋ́детъ дꙋша̀ твоѧ̀, и҆ блгⷭ҇ть бꙋ́детъ, ѡ҆ твое́й вы́и: бꙋ́детъ же и҆сцѣле́нїе пло́темъ твои́мъ, и҆ попече́нїе ко́стемъ
