Возне́слъ сѧ є҆сѝ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀, прободе́нъ былъ є҆сѝ въ ре́бра, же́лчи вкꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, менѐ ра́ди, І҆и҃се ѿ престꙋпле́нїѧ ѡ҆горчи́вшаго тѧ̀: ~ И҆рмо́съ. Непло́днаго ми ꙋ҆ма̀, плодоно́сна Бж҃е покажѝ, дѣ́лателю дꙋша́мъ, и҆ насади́телю до́брымъ, мл҃рдїемъ си: ~ Пѣ́снь, и҃. И҆рмо́съ. Се́дмъ седми́цею: Неꙋсы́пнымъ ѻ҆́комъ, воззрѣ́въ на мѧ̀ ꙋ҆ще́дри, ꙋ҆ны́нїѧ дрѣма́нїемъ ѡ҆держи́ма, и҆ снꙋ̀ рабо́тающа, сла́стнымъ на ѻ҆́дрѣ страсте́мъ, на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ главꙋ̀ преклони́вый, и҆ во́лею ꙋ҆сну́вый, и҆ тмꙋ̀ разорѝвый Хе҃ грѣха̀, свѣ́тъ сы́й пра́вдѣ: ~ Бога́тотво́рными дарова́нїи ꙋ҆краси́въсѧ, ѿ кр҃ще́нїѧ, па́ченницествꙋ злы́хъ возлюби́хъ, и҆ чꙋ́ждъ бы́хъ добродѣ́телїй ѡ҆каѧ́нный а҆́зъ, въ страну̀ дале́че ѿше́дъ зло́бы. тѣ́мже ѡ҆брати́въ прїимѝ мѧ Сп҃се, твои́мъ крⷭ҇то́мъ ѡ҆гражда́ѧ въ всѧ̑ вѣ́ки: ~ Пїѧ́нство страсте́й ѿри́ни, и҆ сле́зъ взыщѝ, чисти́телное поще́нїе, дш҃е, вино̀, срⷣце веселѧ́щее и҆ дш҃ꙋ ꙋ҆маща́ющее, плотскі́ѧ погаша́ющее пе́щи, потщи́сѧ пригвозди́вшомꙋсѧ тебѐ ра́ди на древѣ̀ Хꙋ̀ сꙋраспѧ́тисѧ, и҆ жи́ти въ вѣ́ки: ~ Бг҃о: Бг҃ороди́телнице Всечи́стаѧ, дꙋша̀ моеѧ̀ ꙗ҆́звы

Кто̀ восхвали́ти тѧ ѿ земны́хъ по достоѧ́нїю возмо́жетъ Мт҃и Дв҃о; ты́ бо в жена́хъ є҆ди́на ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ и҆збра́ннаѧ всебл҃же́ннаѧ: ~ Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Возне́слъ сѧ є҆сѝ на крⷭ҇тѣ̀, прободе́нъ былъ є҆сѝ въ ре́бра, же́лчи вкꙋси́лъ є҆сѝ, менѐ ра́ди, І҆и҃се ѿ престꙋпле́нїѧ ѡ҆горчи́вшаго тѧ̀: ~ И҆рмо́съ. Непло́днаго ми ꙋ҆ма̀, плодоно́сна Бж҃е покажѝ, дѣ́лателю дꙋша́мъ, и҆ насади́телю до́брымъ, мл҃рдїемъ си: ~ Пѣ́снь, и҃. И҆рмо́съ. Се́дмъ седми́цею: Неꙋсы́пнымъ ѻ҆́комъ, воззрѣ́въ на мѧ̀ ꙋ҆ще́дри, ꙋ҆ны́нїѧ дрѣма́нїемъ ѡ҆держи́ма, и҆ снꙋ̀ рабо́тающа, сла́стнымъ на ѻ҆́дрѣ страсте́мъ, на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ главꙋ̀ преклони́вый, и҆ во́лею ꙋ҆сну́вый, и҆ тмꙋ̀ разорѝвый Хе҃ грѣха̀, свѣ́тъ сы́й пра́вдѣ: ~ Бога́тотво́рными дарова́нїи ꙋ҆краси́въсѧ, ѿ кр҃ще́нїѧ, па́ченницествꙋ злы́хъ возлюби́хъ, и҆ чꙋ́ждъ бы́хъ добродѣ́телїй ѡ҆каѧ́нный а҆́зъ, въ страну̀ дале́че ѿше́дъ зло́бы. тѣ́мже ѡ҆брати́въ прїимѝ мѧ Сп҃се, твои́мъ крⷭ҇то́мъ ѡ҆гражда́ѧ въ всѧ̑ вѣ́ки: ~ Пїѧ́нство страсте́й ѿри́ни, и҆ сле́зъ взыщѝ, чисти́телное поще́нїе, дш҃е, вино̀, срⷣце веселѧ́щее и҆ дш҃ꙋ ꙋ҆маща́ющее, плотскі́ѧ погаша́ющее пе́щи, потщи́сѧ пригвозди́вшомꙋсѧ тебѐ ра́ди на древѣ̀ Хꙋ̀ сꙋраспѧ́тисѧ, и҆ жи́ти въ вѣ́ки: ~ Бг҃о: Бг҃ороди́телнице Всечи́стаѧ, дꙋша̀ моеѧ̀ ꙗ҆́звы

items.slavonic_text: х҃м҃и. въ срѣ́дꙋ. и҆ грѣхо́внаѧ гное́нїѧ ѡ҆чстити, и҆сто́чники пролива́ющи ѿ ре́бръ рождества́ ти, и҆ ѿ ни́хъ ѡ҆чища́ющи стрꙋѧ́ми, к̾ тебѣ́ бо воззыва́ю, к̾ тебѣ́ прибѣга́ю, и҆ тебе́ молю̀ ѡ҆бра́дованнаѧ: И҆́ныи И҆рмо́. Въ гла́сѣхъ А҆́гг҃лскихъ: Ра́спеншагосѧ пло́тїю, и҆ Бж҃твомъ не пострада́вша І҆и҃са, по́йте А҆́гг҃ли и҆ земнорѡ́днїи, въ всѧ̑ вѣ́кы: Въ ра́спятїи твое́мъ Хе҃, поно́сную сме́рть прїе́мъ, ѡ҆каѧ́ннаго мѧ̀ сп҃лъ є҆сѝ, ѿ тлѧ̀ и҆зба́вивъ: Блгвѝмъ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ и҆ Сн҃а и҆ ст҃гѡ Дх҃а, Гдⷭ҇а. Трⷪ҇ич: Херуві́мски тѧ̀ ѽ Трⷪ҇це, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, пою̀ є҆ди́но Бж҃тво̀, безначя́лное и҆ просто́е, и҆ всѣ́ми непостижи́мое: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Похва́лами тѧ̀ чт҃аѧ свѣ́тлѡ почита́ютъ всѝ ро́ди, зижди́телѧ бо родила́ є҆сѝ. Ѽ чꙋ́до стра́шное, и҆ дѣ́ло пребл҃же́нное: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀: Всѧ̑ претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ во́лею, менѐ сп҃тѝ хотѧ̀ Хе҃, пою̀ твоѐ Распятїе, гво́здїѧ и҆ заколе́нїѧ, въ всѧ̑ вѣ́кы: Хва́лимъ блгвѝмъ покланѧ́емсѧ Гдⷭ҇еви. И҆рмо́съ. Въ гла́сѣхъ А҆́гг҃лскихъ на нб҃се́хъ слави́магѡ похвали́мъ, всѝ земнорѡ́днїи, въ вѣ́ки всѧ̑: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. И҆рмо́. У҆диви́сѧ ꙋ҆́бѡ: Зрѧ́ тѧ просте́рта на крⷭ҇тѣ̀, зарѧ̀ покрыва́ше сл҃нце, всѧ́ же землѧ̀ тре́петомъ преклони́сѧ всецр҃ю̀, во́лею ви́дѧщи стра́ждꙋща, є҆стество́мъ тѧ̀ безстра́стна. тѣ́мже тѧ̀ молю̀, стра́сти дш҃а моеѧ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ врачъ Хе҃ и҆сцѣлѝ: Пꙋ́ти сп҃нїѧ ѡ҆ста́вихъ, въ а҆́дъ ведꙋ́щыѧ ше́ствовахъ, тмꙋ̀ лю́тꙋ имѣ́ѧ, ѡ҆кре́стъ сла́дости, и҆ стра́-

Heirmos: "The heaven was amazed" (У҆диви́сѧ ꙋ҆́бѡ):*[^1817] *Troparion:* Beholding Thee stretched out upon the Cross, O King of all, a dark glow covered the sun, and the whole earth bowed down in trembling, seeing Thee willingly suffering, Who art by nature impassible: Therefore I pray Thee: Heal the passions of my soul, as a physician, O Christ!

items.slavonic_text: х҃м҃ѳ. в҃. нл҃и. є҃: по́ста. и҆ стра́стїй поползнове́нїѧ, и҆ бꙋ́рю помышле́нїй. тѣ́мже тѧ̀ молю̀, твои́мъ крⷭ҇томъ сп҃си́ мѧ Хе҃, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ многомлⷭ҇ти́въ: Зимо́ю содержи́мъ и҆скꙋше́нїй, и҆ страсте́й треволне́нїи погрꙋжа́емъ, и҆ сласте́й волно́ю ѡ҆бꙋрева́емъ лю́тѣ, поще́нїѧ пꙋчи́нꙋ достиго́хъ кро́ткꙋю и҆ ти́хꙋю, в̾ не́й же мѧ̀ ѡ҆корми́въ твои́мъ крⷭ҇то́мъ ще́дре, напра́ви къ сп҃се́нїю: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Зачала̀ є҆сѝ дв҃о без̾ сѣ́мене, всѧ́чєскаѧ содѣ́лавшаго Сло́ва Бж҃їа, без̾ хотѣ́нїѧ пло́тски, без̾ и҆стлѣ́нїѧ же родила̀ є҆сѝ без̾ болѣ́зней ма́терски. тѣ́мже тѧ̀ Бцⷣꙋ и҆ ѧ҆зы́комъ и҆ срⷣцемъ, и҆сповѣ́дающе велича́емъ: И҆́ныи И҆рмо́съ. Дѣ́тво твоѐ Бцⷣе: Во́лею претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ распѧ́тисѧ сп҃се на́шъ, да пода́си всѣ̑мъ жи́знь ѿ сме́рти и҆збавлѧ́ѧ: Дре́вомъ ꙋ҆мертви́хсѧ, и҆ крⷭ҇тнымъ дре́вомъ ѡ҆жи́хъ, на не́мже Хе҃ мо́й пригвозди́всѧ, врага̀ моего̀ ꙋ҆мертвѝ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ сꙋ́ща сн҃а съ ро́дителемъ, и҆ Дх҃а ст҃го съвѣ́ща, є҆диномо́щнѡ велича́емъ: Бг҃о: Чꙋ́до пресла́вное, ꙋ҆жа́сное слы́шанїе, ка́кѡ и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и ражда́еши чт҃аѧ, и҆ не разꙋмѣ́ла є҆сѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ дв҃а, тлѣ́нїѧ: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀: Пою̀ ко́пїе твоѐ, воспѣва́ю и҆ гво́здїи твоѧ̑, гꙋ́бꙋ и҆ тро́сть съ крⷭ҇то́мъ, и҆́миже сп҃лъ мѧ̀ є҆сѝ І҆и҃се Бж҃е. И҆рмо́съ. Дѣ́тво твоѐ Бцⷣе нескве́рнаѧ, є҆го́же не ѡ҆палѝ ѻ҆́гнь Бж҃тва̀, пѣ́сньми немо́лчными велича́емъ:. Та́же, Досто́йно є҆́сть: Свѣти́ленъ, Гла́съ. На сті҃: ст҃и́ра самогла́сна, Гла́съ, н҃ [и҃]. items.slavonic_text: х҃м҃ѳ. в҃. нл҃и. є҃: по́ста. и҆ стра́стїй поползнове́нїѧ, и҆ бꙋ́рю помышле́нїй. тѣ́мже тѧ̀ молю̀, твои́мъ крⷭ҇томъ сп҃си́ мѧ Хе҃, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ многомлⷭ҇ти́въ: Зимо́ю содержи́мъ и҆скꙋше́нїй, и҆ страсте́й треволне́нїи погрꙋжа́емъ, и҆ сласте́й волно́ю ѡ҆бꙋрева́емъ лю́тѣ, поще́нїѧ пꙋчи́нꙋ достиго́хъ кро́ткꙋю и҆ ти́хꙋю, в̾ не́й же мѧ̀ ѡ҆корми́въ твои́мъ крⷭ҇то́мъ ще́дре, напра́ви къ сп҃се́нїю: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Зачала̀ є҆сѝ дв҃о без̾ сѣ́мене, всѧ́чєскаѧ содѣ́лавшаго Сло́ва Бж҃їа, без̾ хотѣ́нїѧ пло́тски, без̾ и҆стлѣ́нїѧ же родила̀ є҆сѝ без̾ болѣ́зней ма́терски. тѣ́мже тѧ̀ Бцⷣꙋ и҆ ѧ҆зы́комъ и҆ срⷣцемъ, и҆сповѣ́дающе велича́емъ: И҆́ныи И҆рмо́съ. Дѣ́тво твоѐ Бцⷣе: Во́лею претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ распѧ́тисѧ сп҃се на́шъ, да пода́си всѣ̑мъ жи́знь ѿ сме́рти и҆збавлѧ́ѧ: Дре́вомъ ꙋ҆мертви́хсѧ, и҆ крⷭ҇тнымъ дре́вомъ ѡ҆жи́хъ, на не́мже Хе҃ мо́й пригвозди́всѧ, врага̀ моего̀ ꙋ҆мертвѝ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ сꙋ́ща сн҃а съ ро́дителемъ, и҆ Дх҃а ст҃го съвѣ́ща, є҆диномо́щнѡ велича́емъ: Бг҃о: Чꙋ́до пресла́вное, ꙋ҆жа́сное слы́шанїе, ка́кѡ и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и ражда́еши чт҃аѧ, и҆ не разꙋмѣ́ла є҆сѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ дв҃а, тлѣ́нїѧ: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀: Пою̀ ко́пїе твоѐ, воспѣва́ю и҆ гво́здїи твоѧ̑, гꙋ́бꙋ и҆ тро́сть съ крⷭ҇то́мъ, и҆́миже сп҃лъ мѧ̀ є҆сѝ І҆и҃се Бж҃е. И҆рмо́съ. Дѣ́тво твоѐ Бцⷣе нескве́рнаѧ, є҆го́же не ѡ҆палѝ ѻ҆́гнь Бж҃тва̀, пѣ́сньми немо́лчными велича́емъ:. Та́же, Досто́йно є҆́сть: Свѣти́ленъ, Гла́съ. На сті҃: ст҃и́ра самогла́сна, Гла́съ, н҃ [и҃]. items.slavonic_text: х҃м҃ѳ. в҃. нл҃и. є҃: по́ста. и҆ стра́стїй поползнове́нїѧ, и҆ бꙋ́рю помышле́нїй. тѣ́мже тѧ̀ молю̀, твои́мъ крⷭ҇томъ сп҃си́ мѧ Хе҃, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ многомлⷭ҇ти́въ: Зимо́ю содержи́мъ и҆скꙋше́нїй, и҆ страсте́й треволне́нїи погрꙋжа́емъ, и҆ сласте́й волно́ю ѡ҆бꙋрева́емъ лю́тѣ, поще́нїѧ пꙋчи́нꙋ достиго́хъ кро́ткꙋю и҆ ти́хꙋю, в̾ не́й же мѧ̀ ѡ҆корми́въ твои́мъ крⷭ҇то́мъ ще́дре, напра́ви къ сп҃се́нїю: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Зачала̀ є҆сѝ дв҃о без̾ сѣ́мене, всѧ́чєскаѧ содѣ́лавшаго Сло́ва Бж҃їа, без̾ хотѣ́нїѧ пло́тски, без̾ и҆стлѣ́нїѧ же родила̀ є҆сѝ без̾ болѣ́зней ма́терски. тѣ́мже тѧ̀ Бцⷣꙋ и҆ ѧ҆зы́комъ и҆ срⷣцемъ, и҆сповѣ́дающе велича́емъ: И҆́ныи И҆рмо́съ. Дѣ́тво твоѐ Бцⷣе: Во́лею претерпѣ́лъ є҆сѝ распѧ́тисѧ сп҃се на́шъ, да пода́си всѣ̑мъ жи́знь ѿ сме́рти и҆збавлѧ́ѧ: Дре́вомъ ꙋ҆мертви́хсѧ, и҆ крⷭ҇тнымъ дре́вомъ ѡ҆жи́хъ, на не́мже Хе҃ мо́й пригвозди́всѧ, врага̀ моего̀ ꙋ҆мертвѝ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ сꙋ́ща сн҃а съ ро́дителемъ, и҆ Дх҃а ст҃го съвѣ́ща, є҆диномо́щнѡ велича́емъ: Бг҃о: Чꙋ́до пресла́вное, ꙋ҆жа́сное слы́шанїе, ка́кѡ и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ Мт҃и ражда́еши чт҃аѧ, и҆ не разꙋмѣ́ла є҆сѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ дв҃а, тлѣ́нїѧ: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀: Пою̀ ко́пїе твоѐ, воспѣва́ю и҆ гво́здїи твоѧ̑, гꙋ́бꙋ и҆ тро́сть съ крⷭ҇то́мъ, и҆́миже сп҃лъ мѧ̀ є҆сѝ І҆и҃се Бж҃е. И҆рмо́съ. Дѣ́тво твоѐ Бцⷣе нескве́рнаѧ, є҆го́же не ѡ҆палѝ ѻ҆́гнь Бж҃тва̀, пѣ́сньми немо́лчными велича́емъ:. Та́же, Досто́йно є҆́сть: Свѣти́ленъ, Гла́съ. На сті҃: ст҃и́ра самогла́сна, Гла́съ, н҃ [и҃]. items.slavonic_text: х҃н҃. въ срѣ́дꙋ. ѡ҆каѧ́нный, и҆ є҆́лѣ жи́въ бы́хъ Гдⷭ҇и, Прⷬ҇ро́ческїи ли́къ презрѣ́въ мѧ̀, и҆ спо́лꙋ видѣ́въ ме́ртва сꙋ́ща, и҆ хи́тростми чловѣ́ческими неисцѣ́лна. тѣ́мже лю́тѣ болѧ̀, въ смире́нїи срⷣца зовꙋ́ ти Хе҃ Бж҃е, и҆злі́й ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ на мѧ̀ вели́кꙋю твоѝ млⷭ҇ть: Гла́, г҃. Ст҃: И҆спо́лнихомсѧ заꙋ́тра: Высотꙋ̀ добродѣ́телей ѡ҆ста́вивши дш҃е моѧ̀, въ глꙋбинꙋ̀ грѣхо́внꙋю снизшла̀ є҆сѝ, въ лꙋка́вныѧ разбо́йники впа́дши, стрꙋ́пѡвъ же смердѧ́щихъ полна̀ сꙋ́щи, и҆ лежи́ши пове́рженна безгла́сна. тѣ́мже возопі́й Хꙋ҃ Бг҃ꙋ за́ тѧ распе́ншомꙋсѧ, и҆ ра́нꙋ во́лею прїе́мшомꙋ, попеци́сѧ ѡ҆ мнѣ̀ сп҃се, и҆ сп҃си́ мѧ: Ст҃, в҃. И҆ бꙋ́ди свѣ́тлость: Трⷪ҇и: Си́лы ст҃ы́хъ А҆́гг҃лъ диви́шасѧ Мч҃нкѡмъ стрⷭ҇темъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ тѣ́ломъ ѡ҆бложе́ни сꙋ́ще, ѡ҆ мꙋ́кахъ неради́ша, подо́бници бы́вше стрⷭ҇темъ сп҃са Ха҃, и҆ млѧ́тъ ѡ҆ на́съ сп҃ти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шимъ: Сла́ва: и҆ ны́нѣ: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ. Зрѧ́щи и҆з̾ тебѐ роже́ннаго всенепоро́чнаѧ, ѡ҆бѣ́шена на дре́вѣ, рыда́ше вопїю́щи, ꙋ҆вы̀ мнѣ̀ сла́вѣ сл҃нце, ка́кѡ за́йде доброта̀, и҆спо́лненнаѧ бл҃гово́нїѧ, тебѐ ꙋ҆добри́вшагѡ чл҃в́чкое є҆ст҃тво̀: На а҃ мъ Ча́сѣ: Стіхо: Ка́: г҃і. Возвели́читѧ Гдⷭ҇и: На г҃ мъ Ча́сѣ, д҃і. К̾ тебѣ̀ Гдⷭ҇и воздвиго́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ: На ѕ҃ мъ Ча́сѣ, е҃і. Ра́дꙋйтесѧ првⷣнїи ѡ҆ Гдⷭ҇ѣ: Въ тꙋ́юже срⷥ: На ѕ҃ сѣ Трⷪ҇: Прⷬ҇ро́чества: Гла́съ, д҃. Стрⷭ҇тьми ст҃ы́хъ ꙗ҆́же по тебѣ̀ прїѧ́ша, ꙋ҆мо-

items.slavonic_text: х҃н҃. въ срѣ́дꙋ. ѡ҆каѧ́нный, и҆ є҆́лѣ жи́въ бы́хъ Гдⷭ҇и, Прⷬ҇ро́ческїи ли́къ презрѣ́въ мѧ̀, и҆ спо́лꙋ видѣ́въ ме́ртва сꙋ́ща, и҆ хи́тростми чловѣ́ческими неисцѣ́лна. тѣ́мже лю́тѣ болѧ̀, въ смире́нїи срⷣца зовꙋ́ ти Хе҃ Бж҃е, и҆злі́й ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ на мѧ̀ вели́кꙋю твоѝ млⷭ҇ть: Гла́, г҃. Ст҃: И҆спо́лнихомсѧ заꙋ́тра: Высотꙋ̀ добродѣ́телей ѡ҆ста́вивши дш҃е моѧ̀, въ глꙋбинꙋ̀ грѣхо́внꙋю снизшла̀ є҆сѝ, въ лꙋка́вныѧ разбо́йники впа́дши, стрꙋ́пѡвъ же смердѧ́щихъ полна̀ сꙋ́щи, и҆ лежи́ши пове́рженна безгла́сна. тѣ́мже возопі́й Хꙋ҃ Бг҃ꙋ за́ тѧ распе́ншомꙋсѧ, и҆ ра́нꙋ во́лею прїе́мшомꙋ, попеци́сѧ ѡ҆ мнѣ̀ сп҃се, и҆ сп҃си́ мѧ: Ст҃, в҃. И҆ бꙋ́ди свѣ́тлость: Трⷪ҇и: Си́лы ст҃ы́хъ А҆́гг҃лъ диви́шасѧ Мч҃нкѡмъ стрⷭ҇темъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ тѣ́ломъ ѡ҆бложе́ни сꙋ́ще, ѡ҆ мꙋ́кахъ неради́ша, подо́бници бы́вше стрⷭ҇темъ сп҃са Ха҃, и҆ млѧ́тъ ѡ҆ на́съ сп҃ти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шимъ: Сла́ва: и҆ ны́нѣ: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ. Зрѧ́щи и҆з̾ тебѐ роже́ннаго всенепоро́чнаѧ, ѡ҆бѣ́шена на дре́вѣ, рыда́ше вопїю́щи, ꙋ҆вы̀ мнѣ̀ сла́вѣ сл҃нце, ка́кѡ за́йде доброта̀, и҆спо́лненнаѧ бл҃гово́нїѧ, тебѐ ꙋ҆добри́вшагѡ чл҃в́чкое є҆ст҃тво̀: На а҃ мъ Ча́сѣ: Стіхо: Ка́: г҃і. Возвели́читѧ Гдⷭ҇и: На г҃ мъ Ча́сѣ, д҃і. К̾ тебѣ̀ Гдⷭ҇и воздвиго́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ: На ѕ҃ мъ Ча́сѣ, е҃і. Ра́дꙋйтесѧ првⷣнїи ѡ҆ Гдⷭ҇ѣ: Въ тꙋ́юже срⷥ: На ѕ҃ сѣ Трⷪ҇: Прⷬ҇ро́чества: Гла́съ, д҃. Стрⷭ҇тьми ст҃ы́хъ ꙗ҆́же по тебѣ̀ прїѧ́ша, ꙋ҆мо-

items.english_text: *Sticheron:* Having abandoned the height of virtues, O my soul, thou didst descend into the depth of sin, having fallen among evil robbers, and being full of foul-smelling sores, thou liest cast down and speechless: Therefore cry aloud, O soul, unto Christ God Who was crucified for thee and willingly received wounds: Care for me, O Savior, and save me!

items.slavonic_text: х҃н҃. въ срѣ́дꙋ. ѡ҆каѧ́нный, и҆ є҆́лѣ жи́въ бы́хъ Гдⷭ҇и, Прⷬ҇ро́ческїи ли́къ презрѣ́въ мѧ̀, и҆ спо́лꙋ видѣ́въ ме́ртва сꙋ́ща, и҆ хи́тростми чловѣ́ческими неисцѣ́лна. тѣ́мже лю́тѣ болѧ̀, въ смире́нїи срⷣца зовꙋ́ ти Хе҃ Бж҃е, и҆злі́й ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ на мѧ̀ вели́кꙋю твоѝ млⷭ҇ть: Гла́, г҃. Ст҃: И҆спо́лнихомсѧ заꙋ́тра: Высотꙋ̀ добродѣ́телей ѡ҆ста́вивши дш҃е моѧ̀, въ глꙋбинꙋ̀ грѣхо́внꙋю снизшла̀ є҆сѝ, въ лꙋка́вныѧ разбо́йники впа́дши, стрꙋ́пѡвъ же смердѧ́щихъ полна̀ сꙋ́щи, и҆ лежи́ши пове́рженна безгла́сна. тѣ́мже возопі́й Хꙋ҃ Бг҃ꙋ за́ тѧ распе́ншомꙋсѧ, и҆ ра́нꙋ во́лею прїе́мшомꙋ, попеци́сѧ ѡ҆ мнѣ̀ сп҃се, и҆ сп҃си́ мѧ: Ст҃, в҃. И҆ бꙋ́ди свѣ́тлость: Трⷪ҇и: Си́лы ст҃ы́хъ А҆́гг҃лъ диви́шасѧ Мч҃нкѡмъ стрⷭ҇темъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ тѣ́ломъ ѡ҆бложе́ни сꙋ́ще, ѡ҆ мꙋ́кахъ неради́ша, подо́бници бы́вше стрⷭ҇темъ сп҃са Ха҃, и҆ млѧ́тъ ѡ҆ на́съ сп҃ти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шимъ: Сла́ва: и҆ ны́нѣ: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ. Зрѧ́щи и҆з̾ тебѐ роже́ннаго всенепоро́чнаѧ, ѡ҆бѣ́шена на дре́вѣ, рыда́ше вопїю́щи, ꙋ҆вы̀ мнѣ̀ сла́вѣ сл҃нце, ка́кѡ за́йде доброта̀, и҆спо́лненнаѧ бл҃гово́нїѧ, тебѐ ꙋ҆добри́вшагѡ чл҃в́чкое є҆ст҃тво̀: На а҃ мъ Ча́сѣ: Стіхо: Ка́: г҃і. Возвели́читѧ Гдⷭ҇и: На г҃ мъ Ча́сѣ, д҃і. К̾ тебѣ̀ Гдⷭ҇и воздвиго́хъ дꙋ́шꙋ: На ѕ҃ мъ Ча́сѣ, е҃і. Ра́дꙋйтесѧ првⷣнїи ѡ҆ Гдⷭ҇ѣ: Въ тꙋ́юже срⷥ: На ѕ҃ сѣ Трⷪ҇: Прⷬ҇ро́чества: Гла́съ, д҃. Стрⷭ҇тьми ст҃ы́хъ ꙗ҆́же по тебѣ̀ прїѧ́ша, ꙋ҆мо-

items.slavonic_text: х҃н҃а. в҃. нл҃и. є҃: по́ста. ꙋ҆моле́нъ бꙋ́ди Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ всѧ̑ на́ша болѣ́зни и҆сцѣлѝ чл҃вколю́бче мл҃имъ тѧ̀: Сла́ва: коне́цъ. И҆ ны́нѣ: ве́ч: Прокі́менъ, Ѱало́мъ, ч҃а. Гла́, д҃. Бл҃го є҆́сть и҆сповѣ́датисѧ Гдⷭ҇ви и҆ пѣ́ти и҆́мени твое́мꙋ вы́шне. Сті́: Возвѣща́ти заꙋ́тра млⷭ҇ть: Прⷬ҇ро́чества И҆са́їина чте́нїе. Гла́ва, ма҃. Си́це гл҃етъ Гдⷭ҇ь, а҆́зъ Бг҃ъ пе́рвый, с҃: д҃. и҆ по си́хъ а҆́зъ є҆́смь. Ви́дѣша ꙗ҆зы́цы и҆ є҃. ꙋ҆боѧ́шасѧ, концы̀ землѧ̀ ꙋ҆жасо́шасѧ, прибли́жишасѧ и҆ прїидо́ша в̾кꙋ́пѣ. Сꙋдѧ́й ко́ждо ѕ҃. бли́жнему, и҆ бра́тꙋ помощѝ хотѧ́й, и҆ рече́тъ, возмо́же. Мꙋ́жъ древодѣ́ль, и҆ кова́чъ бїѧ́й мла́томъ з҃. в̾кꙋ́пѣ ѡ҆сла́бьши, тогда̀ ꙋ҆́бѡ рече́тъ сосложе́нїе добро̀ є҆́стъ, ꙋ҆тверди́ша є҆го̀ въ гво́здѣхъ, положа́тъ ѧ҆, и҆ не подви́жатсѧ. Ты́ же І҆и҃ль ѿро́къ и҃. мо́й, І҆а́кѡвъ є҆го́же и҆збра́хъ, сѣ́мѧ А҆враа́мле є҆́же возлюби́хъ. Є҆го́же прїѧ́хъ ѿ коне́цъ землѧ̀, ѳ҃. ѿ водо́рныхъ мѣ́стъ є҆ѧ̀ призва́хъ тѧ̀, и҆ рѣ́хъ ти: ѿро́къ мо́й є҆сѝ, и҆збра́хъ тѧ̀ и҆ не ѡ҆ста́вихъ тебѐ. Не бо́йсѧ съ тобо́ю бо є҆́смъ не прельща́йсѧ, а҆́зъ бо є҆́смь ῖ. Бг҃ъ тво́й ꙋ҆крѣпи́вый тѧ̀, и҆ помого́хъ ти, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́хъ тѧ̀ десни́цею мое́ю првⷣною. Се постыдѧ́тсѧ а҃і. и҆ посрамѧ́тсѧ всѝ сопротꙇ́влѧющїисѧ тебѣ̀. бꙋ́дꙋтъ бо ꙗ҆́кѡ несꙋ́щїи и҆ поги́бнꙋтъ всѣ сопроти́вници твоѝ. Взы́щеши и҆́хъ и҆ не ѡ҆брѧ́щеши, чловѣ́ки в҃і. и҆́же корчеми́тковати бꙋ́дꙋтъ к̾ тебѣ̀, бꙋ́дꙋтъ бо ꙗ҆́кѡ несꙋ́щїи и҆ не бꙋ́дꙋтъ борю́щїисѧ съ тобо́ю. Ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́зъ є҆́смъ Бг҃ъ тво́й, держа́й десни́цꙋ твою̀, г҃і. гл҃ѧй

items.slavonic_text: х҃н҃а. в҃. нл҃и. є҃: по́ста. ꙋ҆моле́нъ бꙋ́ди Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ всѧ̑ на́ша болѣ́зни и҆сцѣлѝ чл҃вколю́бче мл҃имъ тѧ̀: Сла́ва: коне́цъ. И҆ ны́нѣ: ве́ч: Прокі́менъ, Ѱало́мъ, ч҃а. Гла́, д҃. Бл҃го є҆́сть и҆сповѣ́датисѧ Гдⷭ҇ви и҆ пѣ́ти и҆́мени твое́мꙋ вы́шне. Сті́: Возвѣща́ти заꙋ́тра млⷭ҇ть: Прⷬ҇ро́чества И҆са́їина чте́нїе. Гла́ва, ма҃. Си́це гл҃етъ Гдⷭ҇ь, а҆́зъ Бг҃ъ пе́рвый, с҃: д҃. и҆ по си́хъ а҆́зъ є҆́смь. Ви́дѣша ꙗ҆зы́цы и҆ є҃. ꙋ҆боѧ́шасѧ, концы̀ землѧ̀ ꙋ҆жасо́шасѧ, прибли́жишасѧ и҆ прїидо́ша в̾кꙋ́пѣ. Сꙋдѧ́й ко́ждо ѕ҃. бли́жнему, и҆ бра́тꙋ помощѝ хотѧ́й, и҆ рече́тъ, возмо́же. Мꙋ́жъ древодѣ́ль, и҆ кова́чъ бїѧ́й мла́томъ з҃. в̾кꙋ́пѣ ѡ҆сла́бьши, тогда̀ ꙋ҆́бѡ рече́тъ сосложе́нїе добро̀ є҆́стъ, ꙋ҆тверди́ша є҆го̀ въ гво́здѣхъ, положа́тъ ѧ҆, и҆ не подви́жатсѧ. Ты́ же І҆и҃ль ѿро́къ и҃. мо́й, І҆а́кѡвъ є҆го́же и҆збра́хъ, сѣ́мѧ А҆враа́мле є҆́же возлюби́хъ. Є҆го́же прїѧ́хъ ѿ коне́цъ землѧ̀, ѳ҃. ѿ водо́рныхъ мѣ́стъ є҆ѧ̀ призва́хъ тѧ̀, и҆ рѣ́хъ ти: ѿро́къ мо́й є҆сѝ, и҆збра́хъ тѧ̀ и҆ не ѡ҆ста́вихъ тебѐ. Не бо́йсѧ съ тобо́ю бо є҆́смъ не прельща́йсѧ, а҆́зъ бо є҆́смь ῖ. Бг҃ъ тво́й ꙋ҆крѣпи́вый тѧ̀, и҆ помого́хъ ти, и҆ ꙋ҆тверди́хъ тѧ̀ десни́цею мое́ю првⷣною. Се постыдѧ́тсѧ а҃і. и҆ посрамѧ́тсѧ всѝ сопротꙇ́влѧющїисѧ тебѣ̀. бꙋ́дꙋтъ бо ꙗ҆́кѡ несꙋ́щїи и҆ поги́бнꙋтъ всѣ сопроти́вници твоѝ. Взы́щеши и҆́хъ и҆ не ѡ҆брѧ́щеши, чловѣ́ки в҃і. и҆́же корчеми́тковати бꙋ́дꙋтъ к̾ тебѣ̀, бꙋ́дꙋтъ бо ꙗ҆́кѡ несꙋ́щїи и҆ не бꙋ́дꙋтъ борю́щїисѧ съ тобо́ю. Ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́зъ є҆́смъ Бг҃ъ тво́й, держа́й десни́цꙋ твою̀, г҃і. гл҃ѧй

items.english_text: Thus says the Lord: I God am the first, [v. 4] and unto the things that come after, I am. The nations saw and feared; [v. 5] the ends of the earth were terrified; they drew near and came together. Each one judging [v. 6] for his neighbor, and desiring to help his brother, and he shall say: "Be strong!" The carpenter and the coppersmith striking with the hammer [v. 7] weakened [the iron] together; then shall he say: "The joining is good!" They fastened it with nails; they will place them, and they shall not be moved. But thou, Israel, art My servant, [v. 8] Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham whom I loved; whom I took from the ends of the earth, [v. 9] and called thee from its high places, and said unto thee: "Thou art My servant; I have chosen thee and have not forsaken thee." Fear not, for I am with thee; be not deceived, for I am [v. 10] thy God Who has strengthened thee; and I have helped thee, and have established thee with My righteous right hand. Behold, all that oppose thee shall be put to shame [v. 11] and confounded; for they shall be as though they were not, and all thine adversaries shall perish. Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them—the men [v. 12] who contend with thee insolently; for they shall be as though they were not, and they that fight against thee shall not be. items.slavonic_text: х҃н҃в. въ срѣ́дꙋ. гл҃ѧй ти: не бо́йсѧ а҆́зъ є҆́смь помо́щникъ тво́й. д҃і. Не бо́йсѧ че́рве І҆а́кѡвль, ꙋ҆ма́ленный І҆и҃лю, а҆́зъ помого́хъ ти, гл҃етъ Бг҃ъ тво́й, и҆збавлѧ́ѧй тѧ̀ ст҃ы́й І҆и҃левъ: Прокі́менъ, Ѱало́мъ, ч҃в. Гла́, ѕ҃. Гдⷭ҇ь въцрⷭ҇исѧ и҆ въ лѣ́потꙋ сѧ ѡ҆блече́. Сті́: Ѡ҆блече́сѧ Гдⷭ҇ь въ си́лꙋ и҆ препоѧ́сасѧ. На ѳ҃ мъ Ча́сѣ, стїхо: Ка́: ѕ҃і. Гдⷭ҇и не ꙗ҆́ростїю тво́ею. Въ тꙋ́юже сре́дне по́ста. Вече́, в̾мѣ́сто Къ Гдⷭ҇ꙋ внегда̀ скорбѣ́: стїхо: Ка́: з҃і. Вси ꙗ҆зы́цы: На Гдⷭ҇и воззва: Поста́ви С: л҃. ѿ в̾сѧ̑ плꙋдꙋ́тсѧ въ мрє́: Ст҃и́ра самогла́сна. Гла́съ, н҃ [и҃]. Мои́ми помышле́нїи в̾ разбо́йники впа́дъ, плѣне́нъ бы́хъ ѡ҆каѧ́нный ꙋ҆мо́мъ, и҆ лю́тѣ ꙋ҆ѧзви́хсѧ, всю̀ мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ꙋ҆рани́хъ, и҆ ѿни́дъ лежꙋ̀ на́гъ добродѣ́телїй, на жите́йскомъ пꙋтѝ, сщ҃е́нникъ же ви́дѣвъ мѧ̀ ра́нами болѧ́ща бенецѣ́лна, презрѣ́въ не возрѣ́въ на мѧ̀, Леѵїта́нинъ же па́ки не терпѧ̀ дш҃етлѣ́нныѧ ра́ны, и҆ то́й ви́дѣвъ мѧ̀ мимои́де, ты́ же бл҃гоизво́ливый не ѿ Самарі́а, но ѿ Мр҃їа воплоти́тисѧ Хе҃ Бж҃е, чл҃вколю́бїемъ пода́ждь ми и҆сцѣле́нїе, и҆злива́ѧ на мѧ̀ вели́кꙋю твоѝ млⷭ҇ть: Сті́. Гла́сомъ мои́мъ къ Гдⷭ҇ꙋ воззва́, гла́со мо́и: Па́ки то́. Сті́. Пролїю̀ пре́ нимъ мл҃твꙋ мою̀ и҆ печа́ль мою̀ пре́ ни: Мч҃: А҆́ще ка́ѧ добродѣ́тель, и҆ а҆́ще ка́ѧ похвала̀ подоба́етъ Ст҃ы̑мъ, мече́мъ бо преклони́ша вы́ѧ своѧ̑, тебѐ ра́ди прекло́ншаго нб҃са̀ и҆ соше́дша, пролїѧ́ша кро́вь свою̀, тебѐ ра́ди и҆злїѧ́вшаго себѐ, и҆ зра́къ ра́бїй прїи́мша, смири́шасѧ до сме́рти, нищетѣ̀ твое́й подо-

items.english_text: Having fallen among robbers by my own thoughts, I was taken captive in mind, wretched one, and was grievously wounded, having injured my whole soul; and I lie utterly stripped of virtues on the path of life. The priest, seeing me suffering from incurable wounds, passed me by and looked not upon me; the Levite likewise, unable to bear soul-corrupting wounds, saw me and went by. But Thou Who wast well pleased to become incarnate, not from Samaria, but from Mary, O Christ God: in Thy love for mankind grant me healing, pouring out Thy great mercy upon me!

Не бо́йсѧ че́рве І҆а́кѡвль, ꙋ҆ма́ленный І҆и҃лю, а҆́зъ помого́хъ ти, гл҃етъ Бг҃ъ тво́й, и҆збавлѧ́ѧй тѧ̀ ст҃ы́й І҆и҃левъ: Прокі́менъ, Ѱало́мъ, ч҃в. Гла́, ѕ҃. Гдⷭ҇ь въцрⷭ҇исѧ и҆ въ лѣ́потꙋ сѧ ѡ҆блече́. Сті́: Ѡ҆блече́сѧ Гдⷭ҇ь въ си́лꙋ и҆ препоѧ́сасѧ. На ѳ҃ мъ Ча́сѣ, стїхо: Ка́: ѕ҃і. Гдⷭ҇и не ꙗ҆́ростїю тво́ею. Въ тꙋ́юже сре́дне по́ста. Вече́, в̾мѣ́сто Къ Гдⷭ҇ꙋ внегда̀ скорбѣ́: стїхо: Ка́: з҃і. Вси ꙗ҆зы́цы: На Гдⷭ҇и воззва: Поста́ви С: л҃. ѿ в̾сѧ̑ плꙋдꙋ́тсѧ въ мрє́: Ст҃и́ра самогла́сна. Гла́съ, н҃ [и҃]. Мои́ми помышле́нїи в̾ разбо́йники впа́дъ, плѣне́нъ бы́хъ ѡ҆каѧ́нный ꙋ҆мо́мъ, и҆ лю́тѣ ꙋ҆ѧзви́хсѧ, всю̀ мою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ ꙋ҆рани́хъ, и҆ ѿни́дъ лежꙋ̀ на́гъ добродѣ́телїй, на жите́йскомъ пꙋтѝ, сщ҃е́нникъ же ви́дѣвъ мѧ̀ ра́нами болѧ́ща бенецѣ́лна, презрѣ́въ не возрѣ́въ на мѧ̀, Леѵїта́нинъ же па́ки не терпѧ̀ дш҃етлѣ́нныѧ ра́ны, и҆ то́й ви́дѣвъ мѧ̀ мимои́де, ты́ же бл҃гоизво́ливый не ѿ Самарі́а, но ѿ Мр҃їа воплоти́тисѧ Хе҃ Бж҃е, чл҃вколю́бїемъ пода́ждь ми и҆сцѣле́нїе, и҆злива́ѧ на мѧ̀ вели́кꙋю твоѝ млⷭ҇ть: Сті́. Гла́сомъ мои́мъ къ Гдⷭ҇ꙋ воззва́, гла́со мо́и: Па́ки то́. Сті́. Пролїю̀ пре́ нимъ мл҃твꙋ мою̀ и҆ печа́ль мою̀ пре́ ни: Мч҃: А҆́ще ка́ѧ добродѣ́тель, и҆ а҆́ще ка́ѧ похвала̀ подоба́етъ Ст҃ы̑мъ, мече́мъ бо преклони́ша вы́ѧ своѧ̑, тебѐ ра́ди прекло́ншаго нб҃са̀ и҆ соше́дша, пролїѧ́ша кро́вь свою̀, тебѐ ра́ди и҆злїѧ́вшаго себѐ, и҆ зра́къ ра́бїй прїи́мша, смири́шасѧ до сме́рти, нищетѣ̀ твое́й подо-
items.english_text: If any virtue and if any praise befitting the saints: for by the sword they bent their necks for Thy sake Who didst bow the heavens and come down; they shed their blood for Thy sake Who didst empty Thyself and take the form of a servant; they humbled themselves unto death, imitating Thy poverty:

items.slavonic_text: х҃н҃г. в҃. нл҃и. є҃: по́ста. подобѧ́щесѧ, и҆́хъ же мл҃твами по мно́жествꙋ щедро́тъ твои́хъ, Бж҃е поми́лꙋй на́съ: И҆́ны Ст҃ры, Гла́съ, и҃. По́: Гдⷭ҇и а҆́ще на сꙋди́щи: Ст҃і. Є҆гда̀ и҆счеза́етъ ѿ менѐ дх҃ъ мо́й и҆ ты̀ позна́лъ є҆сѝ: Гдⷭ҇и ты̀ сщ҃енныѧ ꙋ҆ч҃нки своѧ̑, слове́снаѧ нб҃са̀ показа́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆́хъ сщ҃енными хода́тайствы, земны́хъ мѧ̀ и҆зба́ви, воздержа́нїемъ возносѧ̀ ра́зꙋма всегда̀, къ страсте́мъ помышле́нїе моѐ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ще́дръ и҆ чл҃вколю́бецъ: Сті́хъ. На пꙋтѝ се́мъ поне́мже хожда́хъ сокры́ша сѣ́ть мнѣ̀. И҆мꙋ́ще всѝ вре́мѧ поще́нїѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ съпоспѣ́шника Бж҃твеннымъ дѣѧ́нїемъ, пла́чимъ ѿ всего̀ срⷣца, и҆ сп҃сꙋ възопіи́мъ, твои́хъ ра́ди ꙋ҆ч҃никъ Гдⷭ҇и многомлⷭ҇тиве, сп҃сѝ съ стра́хомъ пою́щихъ, мно́гое чл҃вколю́бїе твоѐ: И҆́на Ст҃ра, Кѵ̀р̾ Ѳеѡ́дѡра: Гла́съ, то́: Ст҃: Смотрѧ́хъ ѡ҆деснꙋ́ю и҆ возглѧ́дахъ и҆ не бѣ̀ зна́ѧй менѐ. А҆п҃ли прехвальні́и, мі́рꙋ мл҃твенници, болѧ́щихъ вра́чеве, здра́вїѧ храни́телїе, въ в̾сѧ́кое врѣ́мѧ соблюди́те, поще́нїѧ вре́мѧ проходѧ́щи, въ ѡ҆бо́ихъ Бж҃твеннѡ мирнꙋ́юще, ꙋ҆мъ неи́мощенъ страсте́й и҆збавлѧ́й, да пое́мъ всѝ пѣ́снь Хꙋ҃ въскр҃сшомꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ побѣди́телю: И҆́ны Ст҃ры, к҃д, вели́кагѡ Канѡ́на. Творе́нїе Кѵ̀ Андре́а кри́тскагѡ, по А҆лфави́тꙋ. Гла́съ, д҃. По́: Хотѣ́хъ слеза́ми: Ст҃і. Поги́бе бѣ́гство ѿ менѐ и҆ нѣ́сть взыска́ѧй дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀. Всѐ житїѐ моѐ съ блꙋдни́цами и҆ мытарѧ́ми и҆жди́хъ, ꙋ҆́бѡ возмогꙋ́ ли понѐ въ ста́рости пока́ѧтисѧ; ѡ҆ни́хъ же съгрѣши́хъ, содѣ́телю всѣ-
items.english_text: By their prayers, according to the multitude of Thy tender mercies, O God, have mercy on us![^1835]

items.english_text: *Sticheron:* All-laudable Apostles, intercessors for the world, physicians of the sick, guardians of health! Preserve us at all times as we pass the season of the fast, divinely keeping peace in both [body and soul], delivering the powerless mind from passions, that we all may sing a hymn unto Christ risen, as Conqueror!

Съгрѣши́хъ съгрѣши́хъ, престꙋпи́хъ повелѣ́нїа твоѧ̑ Хе҃ Бж҃е, мл҃тиве бꙋ́ди ми бл҃года́телю, да прозрю̀ внꙋ́трныма ѻ҆чи́ма, и҆ ꙋ҆бѣ́гнꙋ тмы̀, и҆ съ стра́хо[мъ] возопїю̀: Гдⷭ҇и пре́жде да́же до конца̀ не поги́бнꙋ, сп҃си́ мѧ: Ст҃і. Да бꙋ́дꙋтъ ꙋ҆́ши твоѝ внемлѧ́ще гла́сꙋ мл҃твы моеѧ̀. Звѣ́рїе мѧ̀ ди́вїи ѡ҆держа́ша, но ѿ ни́хъ мѧ̀ и҆схитѝ Вл҃ко, хо́щеши бо є҆́же сп҃ти́сѧ, и҆ въ позна́нїе и҆́стинны прїитѝ, всѣ́мъ чл҃вкѡмъ ꙗ҆́кѡ Созда́тель, и҆ съ всѣ́ми и҆ менѐ сп҃сѝ, Гдⷭ҇и пре́жде да́же до конца̀ не поги́бнꙋ, сп҃си́ мѧ: Ст҃і. А҆́ще беззако́нїа на́зриши Гдⷭ҇и, Гдⷭ҇и кто̀ постои́тъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ: Цѣлба̀ бꙋ́ди ми бл҃годѣ́телю, свободи́телю сп҃се мо́й, и҆ не ѡ҆ри́ни менѐ, ви́ждь мѧ̀ лежа́ща без̾зако́ннїи, и҆ возста́ви мѧ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́льный, да и҆ а҆́зъ возвѣщꙋ̀ дѣѧ́нїа твоѧ̑, и҆ вопїю́ ти: Гдⷭ҇и пре́жде да́же до конца̀ не поги́бнꙋ, сп҃си́ мѧ: Ст҃і. Съгрѣши́хъ съгрѣши́хъ, престꙋпи́хъ повелѣ́нїа твоѧ̑ Хе҃ Бж҃е, мл҃тиве бꙋ́ди ми бл҃года́телю, да прозрю̀ внꙋ́трныма ѻ҆чи́ма, и҆ ꙋ҆бѣ́гнꙋ тмы̀, и҆ съ стра́хо[мъ] возопїю̀: Гдⷭ҇и пре́жде да́же до конца̀ не поги́бнꙋ, сп҃си́ мѧ: Ст҃і. Да бꙋ́дꙋтъ ꙋ҆́ши твоѝ внемлѧ́ще гла́сꙋ мл҃твы моеѧ̀. Звѣ́рїе мѧ̀ ди́вїи ѡ҆держа́ша, но ѿ ни́хъ мѧ̀ и҆схитѝ Вл҃ко, хо́щеши бо є҆́же сп҃ти́сѧ, и҆ въ позна́нїе и҆́стинны прїитѝ, всѣ́мъ чл҃вкѡмъ ꙗ҆́кѡ Созда́тель, и҆ съ всѣ́ми и҆ менѐ сп҃сѝ, Гдⷭ҇и пре́жде да́же до конца̀ не поги́бнꙋ, сп҃си́ мѧ: Ст҃і. А҆́ще беззако́нїа на́зриши Гдⷭ҇и, Гдⷭ҇и кто̀ постои́тъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ: Цѣлба̀ бꙋ́ди ми бл҃годѣ́телю, свободи́телю сп҃се мо́й, и҆ не ѡ҆ри́ни менѐ, ви́ждь мѧ̀ лежа́ща без̾зако́ннїи, и҆ возста́ви мѧ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ всеси́льный, да и҆ а҆́зъ возвѣщꙋ̀ дѣѧ́нїа твоѧ̑, и҆ вопїю́ ти: Гдⷭ҇и пре́жде да́же до конца̀ не поги́бнꙋ, сп҃си́ мѧ: Ст҃і. И҆́мени твое́гѡ ра́ди потерпѣ́хъ тѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇и, потерпѣ̀ дꙋша̀: Сокры́хъ тала́нтъ да́нный мнѣ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ несмы́сленый ра́бъ, въ землѝ закопа́хъ, и҆́бо ꙗ҆́коже непотрѣ́бный ѡ҆сꙋди́хсѧ, и҆ не дерзнꙋ̀ про́чее проси́ти тѧ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ неѕло́бивый ꙋ҆ще́дри мѧ̀, да и҆ а҆́зъ въз̾зовꙋ̀, Гдⷭ҇и пре́жде да́же до конца̀ не поги́бнꙋ, сп҃си́ мѧ:. Ст҃і. Ѿ стра́жа ꙋ҆́тренѧѧ до но́щи, ѿ стра́жа ꙋ҆́тренѧѧ да ꙋ҆по: Є҆́зеро и҆сꙋши́вый стра́стїй, кровоточи́выѧ прикоснове́нїемъ кра́ѧ ри́зъ твои́хъ, прїимꙋ̀ ѡ҆ставле́нїе с̾грѣ́-
items.english_text: *Sticheron 7 [Eta]:* I have sinned, I have sinned, I have transgressed Thy commandments, O Christ God! Be merciful unto me, O Benefactor, that I may see with my inner eyes and escape the darkness, and with fear cry aloud: O Lord, before I perish utterly, save me![^1848]

Behold me lying in iniquities, and raise me up as the All-powerful, that I also may declare Thy deeds and cry aloud unto Thee: O Lord, before I perish utterly, save me![^1850]

items.slavonic_text: х҃н҃ѕ. въ срѣ́дꙋ. съгрѣше́нїй, несꙋмнѣ́нною вѣ́рою тебѣ̀ притѣка́ѧ, прїими́ и҆ менѐ ꙗ҆́коже ѻ҆́нꙋю, и҆ и҆сцѣлѝ моѧ̑ болѣ́зни, Гдⷭ҇и пре́жде да́же до конца̀ не поги́бнꙋ, сп҃си́ мѧ: Ст҃і. Ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ Гдⷭ҇а мл҃ть и҆ мно́гое ꙋ҆ негѡ̀ и҆збавле́нїе, и҆ то́й и҆зба́витъ І҆и҃лѧ ѿ всѣ́хъ беззако́нїй є҆гѡ̀. И҆́маши сѣдѣ́ти на прⷭ҇тлѣ, сътвори́вый сло́вомъ нб҃о и҆ зе́млѧ, и҆́мамы всѝ предста́ти, повѣ́дающе тебѣ̀ грѣхы̀ на́ша, пре́жде днѐ ѻ҆́нагѡ, въ покаѧ́нїи мѧ̀ прїимѝ, Гдⷭ҇и пре́жде да́же до конца̀ не поги́бнꙋ, сп҃си́ мѧ: Ст҃і. Хвали́те Гдⷭ҇а всѝ ꙗ҆зы́ци, и҆ похвали́те є҆гѡ̀ всѝ лю́дїе. При́зри ѻ҆́комъ бл҃гоꙋтро́бнымъ, и҆ бꙋ́ди ми мл҃тивъ є҆ди́не сп҃се, то́ки да́рꙋй и҆сцѣле́нїй, бѣ́дной мое́й и҆ ѡ҆каѧ́нной дш҃и, и҆змы́й ѡ҆ка́ла дѣ́лъ мои́хъ, да воспою̀, Гдⷭ҇и пре́жде да́же до конца̀ не поги́бнꙋ, сп҃си́ мѧ: Ст҃і: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ꙋ҆тверди́сѧ мл҃ть є҆гѡ̀ на на́съ, и҆ и҆́стина Гдⷭ҇нѧ: Ме́чъ ꙋ҆гото́ва Велїа́ръ, ꙋ҆лови́ти потща́сѧ смире́ннꙋю мою̀ дш҃ꙋ, стра́нна сотвори́ мѧ ще́дре просвѣще́нїѧ, ра́зꙋма лица̀ твое́гѡ, держа́вный въ крѣ́пости, совсꙋ́дꙋвъ сегѡ̀ и҆схити́ мѧ, Гдⷭ҇и пре́жде да́же до конца̀ не поги́бнꙋ, сп҃си́ мѧ: Ст҃і: К̾ тебѣ̀ възведо́хъ ѻ҆́цѣ моѝ, живꙋ́щомꙋ на нб҃сѝ, се ꙗ҆́кѡ ѻ҆́чи ра̑бъ въ рꙋ́кꙋ госпо́дїй свои́, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѻ҆́цѣ рабы́нѧ въ рꙋ́цѣ госпожа̀ своеѧ̀. та́кѡ ѻ҆́чи на́ши къ Гдⷭ҇ꙋ Бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ, до́ндеже ꙋ҆ще́дри ны̀. Ве́сь страсте́мъ порабо́тихсѧ, ѡ҆ста́вивъ зако́нъ и҆ Бж҃твеннаѧ писа́нїѧ, всего́ мѧ и҆сцѣлѝ бл҃годѣ́телю, менѐ ра́ди на ме́не бы́въ бл҃же, ѡ҆брати́ мѧ ще́дрый, страсте́мъ низложи́телю. Гдⷭ҇и пре́жде да́же до конца̀, не поги́бнꙋ, сп҃си́ мѧ: Ст҃і. Поми́лꙋй на́съ Гдⷭ҇и поми́лꙋй на́съ, ꙗ҆́кѡ помно́гꙋ и҆спо́лнихомсѧ ꙋ҆ничиже́нїа. наипа́че напо́лнисѧ дша̀ на́ша, поноше́нїе гобзꙋ́ющимъ и҆ ꙋ҆ничиже́нїе го́рдымъ:. Бла́-

items.slavonic_text: х҃н҃з. в҃. нл҃и. є҃: по́ста. Блꙋ́дница слеза́ми ѡ҆кроплѧ́етъ, Прⷱ҇чтыи и҆ чⷭ҇тыи но́зѣ твоѣ̑, всѣ́хъ ꙋ҆бѣщева́ющи є҆́же притѣка́ти, и҆ прїима́ти раздрѣше́нїе съгрѣше́нїй свои́хъ, тоѧ̀ вѣ́рꙋ пода́ждь и҆ мнѣ̀ сп҃се, є҆́же вопѣ́ти ти: Гдⷭ҇и пре́жде да́же до конца̀ не поги́бнꙋ, сп҃си́ мѧ: Припѣва́емъ къ про́чіимъ. Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Скве́рнꙋ ѡ҆чстити дш҃а моеѧ̀, менѐ ра́ди ѡ҆бнища́вый, и҆ младенствова́вый пло́тїю, кро́пли мл҃ти твоеѧ̀ низпосла́въ, немо́щномꙋ и҆ ѡ҆каѧ́нномꙋ Хе҃ ѿмы́й ѿ скве́рны, ꙋ҆врачꙋ́й недꙋ́гꙋюща. Гдⷭ҇и пре́жде да́же до конца̀ не поги́бнꙋ, сп҃си́ мѧ: Ст҃і. Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. У҆твердѝ Вл҃ко дш҃ꙋ мою̀, тебѣ̀ прибѣга́ти, и҆ тебѣ̀ работа́ти при́снѡ, покро́въ бо мо́й є҆сѝ и҆ храни́тель, и҆ застꙋпле́нїе и҆ по́мощь, сподо́би Бж҃їй Сло́ве, въспѣ́ти ми въ дерзнове́нїи. Гдⷭ҇и пре́жде да́же до конца̀ не поги́бнꙋ, сп҃си́ мѧ: Ст҃і. Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Стѣ́на нерꙋши́маѧ бꙋ́ди на́мъ І҆и҃се сп҃се, и҆ мл҃тивый Бг҃ъ, нра́вы бо и҆ дѣ́лы прельще́нны падо́хомъ. но возста́ви ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃годѣ́тель созда́нїе, и҆ премѣни́сѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ ще́дръ. Гдⷭ҇и пре́жде да́же до конца̀ не поги́бнꙋ, сп҃си́ мѧ. Ст҃і. Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Сы́нъ блꙋ́дный бы́хъ, расточи́вый бога́тство, гла́домъ ны́нѣ и҆стаѧва́ю, по кро́въ тво́й прибѣга́ю, ꙗ҆́коже ѻ҆́наго прїимѝ Ѻ҆́ч҃е бл҃гі́й, и҆ прича́стника трапе́зы сподо́би, є҆́же вопѣ́ти тебѣ̀: Гдⷭ҇и пре́жде да́же до конца̀ не поги́бнꙋ, сп҃си́ мѧ: Ст҃і. Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бж҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. За́ви-

items.slavonic_text: Бытїѧ чте́нїе. Гла́ва, .з҃і. Бы́сть А҆вра́мъ лѣ́тъ девѧдесѧ́тъ, [С: а҃.] и҆ де́вѧтъ, и҆ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ Гдⷭ҇ь А҆вра́мꙋ, и҆ речѐ є҆мꙋ̀, а҆́зъ є҆́смъ Бг҃ъ тво́й, бл҃гоꙋгоди́ши предо мно́ю, и҆ бꙋ́ди непоро́ченъ. И҆ положꙋ̀ завѣ́тъ [в҃.] мо́й посредѣ̀ мно́ю, и҆ посредѣ̀ тобо́ю, и҆ ꙋ҆мно́жꙋ тѧ̀ зѣлѡ̀. И҆ падѐ А҆вра́мъ на лицы̀ свое́мъ, И҆ гл҃а є҆мꙋ̀ [г҃.] Бг҃ъ, гл҃ѧ: И҆ а҆́зъ, Се завѣ́тъ мо́й съ тобо́ю, и҆ бꙋ́деши [д҃.] ѿте́цъ мно́гимъ ꙗ҆зы́кѡмъ. И҆ не нарече́тсѧ [е҃.] кто́мꙋ и҆́мѧ твоѐ А҆вра́мъ, но бꙋ́детъ и҆́мѧ твоѐ А҆враа́мъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿца̀ мно́гимъ ꙗ҆зы́кѡ, положи́х̾ тѧ. И҆ ꙋ҆мно́жꙋ тѧ̀ зѣлѡ̀ зѣлѡ̀, и҆ положꙋ́ тѧ въ [ѕ҃.] ꙗ҆зы́ки, и҆ цр҃іе и҆с̾ тебѐ и҆зы́идꙋтъ. И҆ положꙋ̀ [з҃.] завѣ́тъ мо́й междꙋ̀ мно́ю, и҆ междꙋ̀ тобо́ю, и҆ междꙋ̀ сѣ́менемъ твои́мъ по тебѣ̀, в̾ ро́ды и҆́хъ, въ завѣ́тъ вѣ́чный, бы́ти тебѣ̀ Бг҃ъ, и҆ сѣ́мени твое́мꙋ по тебѣ̀, И҆ да́мъ тебѣ̀, и҆ сѣ́мени твое́мꙋ [и҃.] по тебѣ̀ землѝ, в̾ не́иже всели́шисѧ, всю̀ зе́млю Ханаа́ню, въ ѡ҆держа́нїе вѣ́чное, и҆ бꙋ́дꙋ и҆́мъ Бг҃ъ. И҆ речѐ Гдⷭ҇ь къ А҆враа́мꙋ. ты́же завѣ́тъ мо́й соблюде́ши, [ѳ҃.] ты́ и҆ сѣ́мѧ твоѐ по тебѣ̀, в̾ ро́ды и҆́хъ: ͠
items.english_text: The Lord is the God of vengeances; the God of vengeances has acted outspokenly!

items.english_text: Abram was ninety and nine years old; [v. 1] and the Lord appeared unto Abram, and said unto him: "I am Thy God; be well-pleasing before Me, and be thou blameless. And I will establish My covenant [v. 2] between Me and Thee, and I will multiply Thee exceedingly." And Abram fell upon his face, and God [v. 3] spoke unto him, saying: "As for Me, behold, My covenant [v. 4] is with Thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations. And Thy name shall no more be called Abram, [v. 5] but Thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made Thee. And I will multiply Thee [v. 6] exceedingly, exceedingly, and I will make nations of Thee, and kings shall come out of Thee. And I will establish [v. 7] My covenant between Me and Thee, and between Thy seed after Thee throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be God unto Thee, and unto Thy seed after Thee. And I will give unto Thee, and unto Thy seed after Thee, [v. 8] the land wherein thou sojournest, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God." And the Lord said unto Abraham: "Thou also shalt keep My covenant, [v. 9] thou and Thy seed after Thee throughout their generations."

items.english_text: A wise son gladdens his father; but a foolish son scoffs at his mother. [v. 21] The paths of a senseless man are void of wisdom; but a wise man walks uprightly. [v. 22] The thoughts of them that honor not counsel are frustrated; but in the hearts of counselors counsel abides. [v. 23] The wicked man shall not listen unto it, nor shall he say anything useful, or good for the common weal. [v. 24] The paths of life are the thoughts of the wise man, that turning aside from Hades, he may be saved. [v. 25] The Lord pulls down the houses of the insolent; but He has established the border of the widows. [v. 26] An unrighteous thought is an abomination unto the Lord; but the words of the pure are honorable. [v. 27] A receiver of bribes destroys himself; but he that hates the taking of bribes shall be saved. [v. 28] By alms and faiths sins are cleansed; and by the fear of the Lord every man departs from evil. [v. 29] The hearts of the righteous meditate on faith; but the mouth of the ungodly answers evil things. [v. 30] The ways of righteous men are acceptable unto the Lord; for because of them even enemies become friends. [v. 31] God is far from the ungodly; but He hears the prayers of the righteous. [v. 32] Better is a small taking with righteousness, than great revenues with unrighteousness.

items.slavonic_text: Та́же, Да и҆спра́витсѧ: И҆ порѧ́дꙋ Бж҃твеннаѧ слꙋ́жба Преждесвѧще́нныхъ.
items.english_text: He that listens unto the reproofs of life shall dwell among the wise; and glory shall precede the humble.[^1872] [v. 3] He that turns away from instruction hates himself; but he that heeds reproofs loves his own soul. [v. 4] The fear of the Lord is instruction and wisdom, and the beginning of glory answers unto it; and glory shall precede the humble: unto man belongs the purpose of the heart, and from the Lord is the answer of the tongue. As much as thou art great, so much humble thyself, and before the Lord God thou shalt find grace. [v. 5] All the works of the humble are manifest before God; but the ungodly shall perish in the evil day. Commit thy works unto the Lord, and thy thoughts shall be established; the Lord has made all things for Himself, but the ungodly shall perish in the evil day. [v. 6] Everyone that is haughty in heart is unclean before the Lord; though hand join in hand unrighteously, he shall not be justified. [v. 7] The beginning of a good way is to do righteous things; and they are more acceptable with God than to sacrifice sacrifices. [v. 8] He that seeks the Lord shall find understanding with righteousness; [v. 9] and they that seek Him uprightly shall find peace. [v. 10] All the works of the Lord are with righteousness; but the ungodly is reserved for the evil day.

items.english_text: *At the trapeza, we do not partake of oil, nor do we drink wine, on account of the labor of the vigil that is to be. And they that attend unto their salvation apply themselves unto abstinence, and especially unto unfeigned fasting.*[^1873]

items.english_text: *If the Annunciation of the most holy Theotokos happen on that same Thursday: The Great Canon is chanted in advance on Tuesday of the same week, with the triodion of Tuesday. And the triodion of the Great Canon we chant with the feast of the Annunciation. The canon of the feast, with the heirmos, to 6, and the triodion to the Apostles, to 8, according to the Lenten order; and at the end, katavasia in the Triodion; and for the feast, the katavasia: "I will open my mouth".*[^1876]

items.slavonic_text: НА Ꙋ҆́ТРНИ, Въ .д҃. ча́ но́щи, собравше́мсѧ в̾ цр҃ковь. быва́етъ нача́ло ѿ І҆ере́ѧ по ѡ҆бы́чаю, и҆ чте́мъ .ѕ҃. ѱалмѡ́въ, и҆ по ѱалмѣ́хъ пое́мъ А҆ллилꙋ́їа. и҆ Трⷪчна гла́сꙋ. Стіхологи́сꙋемъ же Ка̑: є҆ди́нꙋ, .и҃і, Поми́лꙋй мѧ Бж҃е ꙗ҆́кѡ: И҆ глемъ, Ст҃: въ О҆кт: А҆́плскихъ, .в҃. и҆ мч҃нчна. Сла́ва: и҆ нн҃ѣ: Бг҃о: и҆ чте́мъ въ ст҃о́мъ Є҆фре́мѣ. Чте́мъ же и҆ Жи́тїе прпⷣбныѧ Мр҃їа. Та́же ѱало́мъ, .н҃. Пѣ́нїй не стіхосло́вимъ. И҆ начина́емъ ве́: Канѡ́нъ, сокрꙋше́ннымъ срⷣцемъ и҆ стра́хомъ. На ко́йждо Трⷪ: .г҃. мета́нїа. Канѡ́нъ бо є҆́стъ ꙋ҆миле́нїа, и҆ покаѧ́нїѧ и҆спо́лнь. И҆ є҆гда̀ є҆ди́нъ Ли́къ пое́тъ, тогда̀ дрꙋ́гїй твори́ покло́ны, бл҃гочи́нїѧ ра́[ди]. А҆ Канѡ́нъ, .с҃: съ .н҃, а҆ пок: .ѱ҃н: Творе́нїе Ке́р̾ Ѿ А҆ндре́а Кри́тскагѡ, І҆еросолими́ты. Гла́съ, .ѕ҃. Пѣ́снь, .а҃. И҆рмо́съ. Помо́щникъ и҆ покрови́тель бы́сть мнѣ̀ въ сп҃се́нїе. се́й Бг҃ъ мо́й и҆ просла́влю и҆̀, Бг҃ъ О҆ц҃а̀ мое́гѡ и҆ вознесꙋ̀ и҆̀, сла́вно бо просла́висѧ.
items.english_text: *At Matins: In the fourth hour of the night, having gathered into the church, the beginning is made by the priest according to custom, and we read the Six Psalms; and after the Psalms we chant "Alleluia", and the Trinity Hymns of the tone. And we stychologize one Kathisma, 8 [Kathisma 8]: "Have mercy on me, O God, for man has trodden me down" (Ps. 55 LXX). And we say the sessional hymns in the Oktoechos: to the Apostles, 2, and the Martyrikon. Glory... Both now... Theotokion. And we read in Saint Ephrem. We read also the Life of Venerable Mary. Then Psalm 50. We do not stychologize the [Biblical] Canticles.*[^1877]

items.english_text: *And we begin the Great Canon with a contrite heart and fear. At each troparion, 3 metanias; for the canon is full of compunction and repentance. items.slavonic_text: Оу҆вы̀ мнѣ̀ ѡ҆каѧ́ннаѧ дꙋ́ше; что̀ ꙋ҆подо́биласѧ є҆сѝ пе́рвой Еѵ́вѣ; ви́дѣла бо є҆сѝ злѣ̀, и҆ пита́ласѧ є҆сѝ го́рцѣ, и҆ ко́снꙋласѧ є҆сѝ дре́ва, и҆ вкꙋси́ла є҆сѝ де́рзостнѡ, безслове́сныѧ снѣ́ди: ͠
items.english_text: I have recognized myself stripped of God, and of the everlasting kingdom and delight, on account of my sins!

items.slavonic_text: Вмѣ́сто Еѵ́вы чꙋ́вственныѧ, мы́сленаѧ ми бы́сть Еѵ́а, въ пло́ти стра́стный по́мыслъ, показꙋ́ѧй сла́дкаѧ, и҆ вкꙋша́ѧ при́снѡ, го́рькаго напое́нїа: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Woe is me, O wretched soul! Why hast thou likened thyself unto the first Eve? For evil didst thou see, and bitterly wast thou nourished, and thou didst touch the tree, and didst taste daringly of the irrational food![^1880]

items.slavonic_text: Досто́йнѡ и҆з̾ Е҆де́ма и҆згна́ бы́сть, ꙗ҆́кѡ не сохрани́ твою̀ за́повѣдь Сп҃се И҆да́мъ, а҆́зъ же что̀ постра́ждꙋ; ѿмета́ѧ всегда̀ живо́тнаѧ твоѧ̑ словеса̀: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* In place of sensory Eve, a noetic Eve has arisen within me—the passionate thought in the flesh, showing sweet things, yet ever tasting of a bitter drink!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* In place of sensory Eve, a noetic Eve has arisen within me—the passionate thought in the flesh, showing sweet things, yet ever tasting of a bitter drink!

items.slavonic_text: Ка́їново преше́дъ ꙋ҆бі́йство, произволе́нїемъ бы́хъ ꙋ҆бі́йца, совѣ́сти дꙋше́вной, ѡ҆живи́въ пло́ть и҆ воева́въ на ню̀, лꙋка́выми мои́ми дѣ́лыми: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Worthily was Adam cast out of Eden, because he kept not Thy commandment, O Savior; but what shall I suffer, who ever cast away Thy life-giving words?

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Worthily was Adam cast out of Eden, because he kept not Thy commandment, O Savior; but what shall I suffer, who ever cast away Thy life-giving words?

items.slavonic_text: А҆́велевѣ І҆и҃се, не ꙋ҆подо́бихсѧ пра́вдѣ, да́рѡвъ тебѣ̀ пріѧ́тны не принесо́хъ никогда́же, ни дѣѧ́нїи Бж҃естныхъ, ни же́ртвы чⷭ҇тыѧ, ни житїѧ̀ непоро́чнагѡ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Surpassing the murder of Cain, by choice I have become a murderer of the conscience of my soul, having quickened the flesh and warred against it by my wicked deeds!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Surpassing the murder of Cain, by choice I have become a murderer of the conscience of my soul, having quickened the flesh and warred against it by my wicked deeds!

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ Ка́їнъ и҆ мы̀, дꙋ́ше ѡ҆каѧ́ннаѧ, всѣ́хъ содѣ́телю: дѣѧ́нїа скве́рнаѧ и҆ же́ртвꙋ поро́чнꙋю, и҆ непотре́бное житїе, принесо́хѡмъ вкꙋ́пѣ, тѣ́мъ же и҆ ѡ҆сꙋди́ховѣсѧ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have not been likened unto the righteousness of Abel, O Jesus; never have I offered acceptable gifts unto Thee: neither divine deeds, nor a pure sacrifice, nor a blameless life!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have not been likened unto the righteousness of Abel, O Jesus; never have I offered acceptable gifts unto Thee: neither divine deeds, nor a pure sacrifice, nor a blameless life!

items.slavonic_text: Бре́нїе зда́телю живо создѣ́ла́въ, вложи́ ми пло́ть и҆ ко́сти, и҆ дыха́нїе и҆ жи́знь, но ѡ҆ Тво́рче мо́й и҆зба́вителю мо́й и҆ Сꙋдїе, ка́ющасѧ пріими́ мѧ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As Cain, we also, O wretched soul, have offered unto the Creator of all defiled deeds and a flawed sacrifice, and an unprofitable life together; therefore have we also been condemned!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* As Cain, we also, O wretched soul, have offered unto the Creator of all defiled deeds and a flawed sacrifice, and an unprofitable life together; therefore have we also been condemned!

items.slavonic_text: И҆сповѣ́даю ти Сп҃се грѣхѝ, ꙗ҆́же содѣ́ѧхъ, и҆ дꙋшѝ и҆ тѣ́ла мое́гѡ ꙗ҆́звы, ꙗ҆́же внꙋ́трь ꙋ҆бі́йственный по́мыслы, разбо́йнически на мѧ̀ возложи́ша: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having made living clay, O Potter, Thou didst place within me flesh and bones, and breath and life; but O my Creator, my Deliverer, and my Judge: receive me who repent![^1881]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having made living clay, O Potter, Thou didst place within me flesh and bones, and breath and life; but O my Creator, my Deliverer, and my Judge: receive me who repent![^1881]

items.slavonic_text: И҆сповѣ́даю ти Сп҃се грѣхѝ, ꙗ҆́же содѣ́ѧхъ, и҆ дꙋшѝ и҆ тѣ́ла мое́гѡ ꙗ҆́звы, ꙗ҆́же внꙋ́трь ꙋ҆бі́йственный по́мыслы, разбо́йнически на мѧ̀ возложи́ша: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I confess unto Thee, O Savior, the sins which I have committed, and the wounds of my soul and body, which murderous inner thoughts have robber-like laid upon me!

items.slavonic_text: В̾ разбо́йники впады́й, а҆́зъ є҆́смъ помышле́нми мои́ми, и҆ всѐ нн҃ѣ ꙋ҆ѧзви́хсѧ ѿ ни́хъ, и҆ и҆спо́лнихсѧ ранъ. но Са́мъ ми пристѧ́въ, Хе҃ Сп҃се и҆сцѣлѝ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Though I have sinned, O Savior, yet I know that Thou art the Lover of mankind; Thou chastisest with compassion, and art warmly merciful; Thou seest him that weeps, and runnest to meet him even as the father, calling back the prodigal!

items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нникъ мѧ преⷣ ви́дѣвъ мимоидѐ, и҆ Леѵі́тъ ви́дѧ в̾ лю́тыхъ на́га пре́зрѣ, но и҆з̾ Мр҃їа возсїѧ́вый І҆и҃се, ты предста́въ ꙋ҆ще́дри мѧ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Being cast down, O Savior, before Thy gates, at least in mine old age cast me not empty into Hades; but before the end, as Thou art the Lover of mankind, grant me remission of my falls into sin!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Being cast down, O Savior, before Thy gates, at least in mine old age cast me not empty into Hades; but before the end, as Thou art the Lover of mankind, grant me remission of my falls into sin!

items.slavonic_text: А҆́гнче Бж҃їй, взе́млѧй грѣхѝ всѣ́мъ, возмѝ бре́мѧ ѿ менѐ тѧ́жкое грѣхо́вное, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ млⷭ҇рдъ, да́ждь ми Сле́зы ꙋ҆миле́нїѧ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The one who fell among robbers by my thoughts am I, and wholly now have I been wounded by them and filled with sores; but do Thou Thyself, drawing near unto me, heal me, O Christ Savior![^1882]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The one who fell among robbers by my thoughts am I, and wholly now have I been wounded by them and filled with sores; but do Thou Thyself, drawing near unto me, heal me, O Christ Savior![^1882]

items.slavonic_text: Покаѧ́нїѧ вре́мѧ, прихождꙋ̀ к̾ тебѣ̀ содѣ́телю мое́мꙋ. возмѝ бре́мѧ ѿ менѐ тѧ́жкое грѣхо́вное, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоꙋтро́бенъ, да́ждь ми грѣхѡ́въ ѡ҆ставле́нїе:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The priest, having seen me beforehand, passed me by, and the Levite, seeing me naked in grievous misery, looked past me; but O Jesus Who didst dawn forth from Mary, do Thou, standing by, have compassion on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The priest, having seen me beforehand, passed me by, and the Levite, seeing me naked in grievous misery, looked past me; but O Jesus Who didst dawn forth from Mary, do Thou, standing by, have compassion on me!

items.slavonic_text: Не возгнꙋша́йсѧ менѐ Сп҃се, не ѿри́ни твое́гѡ лица̀, возмѝ бре́мѧ ѿ менѐ тѧ́жкое грѣхо́вное, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ млⷭ҇рдъ, да́ждь ми грѣхѡ́въ ѡ҆ставле́нїе: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O Lamb of God, Who takest away the sins of all: take from me the heavy burden of sin, and as Thou art tenderly compassionate, grant me tears of compunction!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* O Lamb of God, Who takest away the sins of all: take from me the heavy burden of sin, and as Thou art tenderly compassionate, grant me tears of compunction!

items.slavonic_text: Во́лнаѧ Сп҃се и҆ не во́лнаѧ съгрѣше́нїѧ, ꙗ҆́вленнаѧ и҆ сокрове́ннаѧ, и҆ вѣ́домаѧ и҆ невѣ́домаѧ всѧ̑, прости́въ ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ, ѡ҆чи́сти и҆ сп҃си́ мѧ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* It is the season of repentance; I come unto Thee, my Creator: take from me the heavy burden of sin, and as Thou art tenderly compassionate, grant me remission of sins!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* It is the season of repentance; I come unto Thee, my Creator: take from me the heavy burden of sin, and as Thou art tenderly compassionate, grant me remission of sins!

items.slavonic_text: Ѿ ю́ности Сп҃се за́повѣди твоѧ̑ престꙋпи́хъ, все стра́стное небрегїй, ꙋ҆ны́нїемъ преидо́хъ житїѐ. тѣ́мже зовꙋ́ ти Сп҃се, понѐ на коне́цъ сп҃си́ мѧ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Abhor me not, O Savior; cast me not away from Thy presence: take from me the heavy burden of sin, and as Thou art tenderly compassionate, grant me remission of sins!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Abhor me not, O Savior; cast me not away from Thy presence: take from me the heavy burden of sin, and as Thou art tenderly compassionate, grant me remission of sins!

items.slavonic_text: Ѿ ю́ности Сп҃се за́повѣди твоѧ̑ престꙋпи́хъ, все стра́стное небрегїй, ꙋ҆ны́нїемъ преидо́хъ житїѐ. тѣ́мже зовꙋ́ ти Сп҃се, понѐ на коне́цъ сп҃си́ мѧ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Sins voluntary and involuntary, O Savior, manifest and hidden, known and unknown—having forgiven them all as God, cleanse and save me!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Sins voluntary and involuntary, O Savior, manifest and hidden, known and unknown—having forgiven them all as God, cleanse and save me!

items.slavonic_text: Ѿ ю́ности Сп҃се за́повѣди твоѧ̑ престꙋпи́хъ, все стра́стное небрегїй, ꙋ҆ны́нїемъ преидо́хъ житїѐ. тѣ́мже зовꙋ́ ти Сп҃се, понѐ на коне́цъ сп҃си́ мѧ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* From my youth, O Savior, have I transgressed Thy commandments; in all passionate carelessness, in despondency have I passed my life: therefore I cry unto Thee, O Savior: At least in the end save me![^1883]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* From my youth, O Savior, have I transgressed Thy commandments; in all passionate carelessness, in despondency have I passed my life: therefore I cry unto Thee, O Savior: At least in the end save me![^1883]

items.slavonic_text: Трⷪ: Пресꙋ́щнаѧ Трⷪце, в̾ є҆ди́нствѣ покланѧ́емаѧ, возмѝ бре́мѧ ѿ менѐ тѧ́жкое грѣхо́вное, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ млⷭ҇рдъ, да́ждь ми Сле́зы ꙋ҆миле́нїѧ: ͠
items.english_text: ...[from] shameful [passions], and reveal us that with faith and love magnificently hymn thee as partakers of the Kingdom of Christ now, we pray![^1884]

provenance.verbatim_source: ...[from] shameful [passions], and reveal us that with faith and love magnificently hymn thee as partakers of the Kingdom of Christ now, we pray![^1884]

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о: Бцⷣе наде́жде, и҆ предста́телнице всѣ̑мъ пою́щимъ тѧ̀, возмѝ бре́мѧ ѿ менѐ тѧ́жкое грѣхо́бное, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ Влⷣчца чⷭ҇таѧ, ка́ющасѧ пріими́ мѧ: ͠
items.english_text: *Trinity Hymn:* O transcendent Trinity, worshipped in unity, take from me the heavy burden of sin, and as Thou art tenderly compassionate, grant me tears of compunction!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Trinity Hymn:* O transcendent Trinity, worshipped in unity, take from me the heavy burden of sin, and as Thou art tenderly compassionate, grant me tears of compunction!

items.slavonic_text: Покрыва́емъ же всѧ́кꙋю Пѣ́снь И҆рмосо́мъ то́йже, ѡ҆́ба ли́ка в̾кꙋ́пѣ. А҆ и҆де́же в̾ Пѣ́сни два Творца̀. Пое́мъ И҆рмосы̀ ѡ҆бои́хъ Творце́въ.
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O Theotokos, hope and protectress of all that hymn thee: take from me the heavy burden of sin, and as pure Sovereign Lady, receive me who repent!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* O Theotokos, hope and protectress of all that hymn thee: take from me the heavy burden of sin, and as pure Sovereign Lady, receive me who repent!

items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Во́нми не́бо и҆ възгл҃ю, зе́мле внꙋша́й гла́съ, ка́ющагосѧ къ Бг҃ꙋ, и҆ воспѣва́юща є҆гѡ̀: ͠
items.english_text: *Ode 2. Heirmos:*[^1885] Attend, O heaven, and I will speak, and I will chant of Christ Who came in the flesh from the Virgin!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 2. Heirmos:*[^1885]
Attend, O heaven, and I will speak, and I will chant of Christ Who came in the flesh from the Virgin!

items.slavonic_text: Во́нми Бж҃е ꙗ҆́кѡ ще́дръ, мл҃тивнымъ си ѻ҆́комъ, и҆ пріими́ моѐ те́плое и҆сповѣ́данїе: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Attend, O heaven, and I will speak; give ear, O earth, unto the voice of one repenting unto God, and chanting unto Him!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Attend, O heaven, and I will speak; give ear, O earth, unto the voice of one repenting unto God, and chanting unto Him!

items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Съгрѣши́хъ па́че всѣ́хъ чл҃къ, є҆ди́нъ съгрѣши́хъ тебѣ̀, но ꙋ҆ще́дри ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гъ, Сп҃се творе́нїе своѐ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Attend, O God, as Thou art compassionate, with Thy merciful eye, and receive my fervent confession!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Attend, O God, as Thou art compassionate, with Thy merciful eye, and receive my fervent confession!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Бꙋ́рѧ мѧ злы́хъ ѡ҆держи́тъ, милосе́рде Гдⷭ҇и, но ꙗ҆́кѡ Петро́ꙋ, и҆ мнѣ̀ рꙋ́кꙋ прострѝ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have sinned more than all men; I alone have sinned against Thee; but as Thou art good, O Savior, have compassion on Thine own creation!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have sinned more than all men; I alone have sinned against Thee; but as Thou art good, O Savior, have compassion on Thine own creation!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Сле́зы ꙗ҆́кѡже блꙋдни́ца, и҆ а҆́зъ ще́дре предлага́ю, ѡ҆чи́сти мѧ Сп҃се милосе́рдїемъ си: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A tempest of evils holds me fast, O merciful Lord; but as unto Peter, extend Thy hand unto me also!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* A tempest of evils holds me fast, O merciful Lord; but as unto Peter, extend Thy hand unto me also!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆мрачи́хъ дꙋше́внꙋю красотꙋ̀, страсті́й сластьмѝ, и҆ всѧ́ко ве́сь ꙋ҆́мъ ка́лъ сотвори́хъ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As the harlot, I also, O compassionate One, offer tears; cleanse me, O Savior, in Thy tender mercy!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* As the harlot, I also, O compassionate One, offer tears; cleanse me, O Savior, in Thy tender mercy!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Раздра́хъ нн҃ѣ ѡ҆де́ждꙋ мою̀ пе́рвꙋю, ю́же ми и҆стка̀ зижди́тель и҆спе́рва, и҆ ѿтꙋ́дꙋ лежꙋ̀ на́гъ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have darkened the beauty of my soul with the pleasures of passions, and entirely turned my whole mind into mud!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have darkened the beauty of my soul with the pleasures of passions, and entirely turned my whole mind into mud!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆блеко́хсѧ въ раздра́ннꙋю ри́зꙋ, ю́же ми и҆стка̀ змі́й совѣ́томъ, и҆ стыждꙋ́сѧ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have now torn my first garment, which the Fashioner wove for me in the beginning, and thence do I lie naked!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have now torn my first garment, which the Fashioner wove for me in the beginning, and thence do I lie naked!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆блеко́хсѧ въ раздра́ннꙋю ри́зꙋ, ю́же ми и҆стка̀ змі́й совѣ́томъ, и҆ стыждꙋ́сѧ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have clothed myself in a torn robe, which the serpent wove for me by his counsel, and I am ashamed!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have clothed myself in a torn robe, which the serpent wove for me by his counsel, and I am ashamed!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Дѣ́лаша на хребтѣ̀ мое́мъ, вси нача́лници страсте́й, продолжа́юще на мнѣ̀, беззако́нїе своѐ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I looked upon the beauty of the garden, and was deceived in my mind; therefore do I lie naked and am ashamed!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I looked upon the beauty of the garden, and was deceived in my mind; therefore do I lie naked and am ashamed!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Погꙋби́хъ первозда́ннꙋю добротꙋ̀, и҆ бл҃голѣ́пїе моѐ, и҆ нн҃ѣ лежꙋ̀ на́гъ и҆ срамлѧ́юсѧ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* All the leaders of the passions have wrought upon my back, lengthening out their iniquity upon me![^1886]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* All the leaders of the passions have wrought upon my back, lengthening out their iniquity upon me![^1886]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Сошива́ше ко́жныѧ ри́зы, грѣ́хъ мнѣ̀ ѡ҆бнажи́вый мѧ, пе́рвыѧ Бг҃отка́нныѧ ѡ҆де́жды: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have destroyed the first-created goodness and my comeliness, and now I lie naked and am ashamed!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have destroyed the first-created goodness and my comeliness, and now I lie naked and am ashamed!

items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆бложе́нъ є҆́смъ ѡ҆дѣѧ́нїемъ стꙋда̀, ꙗ҆́кѡже ли́ствїемъ смоко́внымъ, въ ѡ҆бличе́нїе мои́хъ, самовла́стныхъ страсте́й: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Sin, having stripped me of the first God-woven garment, sewed coats of skin for me![^1887]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Sin, having stripped me of the first God-woven garment, sewed coats of skin for me![^1887]

items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆дѣ́ѧхсѧ сра́мнꙋю ри́зꙋ, и҆ ѡ҆кровавле́нꙋ стꙋ́днѡ, тече́нїемъ стра́стнагѡ, и҆ любосла́стнагѡ живота̀: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I am compassed about with a garment of shame, as with fig leaves, unto the reproof of my self-willed passions!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I am compassed about with a garment of shame, as with fig leaves, unto the reproof of my self-willed passions!

items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆скверни́хъ пло́ти мое́ѧ ри́зꙋ, и҆ ѡ҆кала́хъ є҆́же по ѡ҆́бразꙋ Сп҃се, и҆ по подо́бїю: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have clothed myself with a shameful robe, and one ignominiously bloodied by the flow of a passionate and pleasure-loving life!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have clothed myself with a shameful robe, and one ignominiously bloodied by the flow of a passionate and pleasure-loving life!

items.slavonic_text: В̾падо́хъ въ стра́стнꙋю па́гꙋбꙋ, и҆ въ веще́ственꙋю тлю̀, и҆ ѿто́лѣ до нн҃ѣ, вра́гъ ми досажда́етъ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have defiled the garment of my flesh, and sullied that which is according to Thine image and likeness, O Savior!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have defiled the garment of my flesh, and sullied that which is according to Thine image and likeness, O Savior!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Любове́щное и҆ любоимѣ́ное житїѐ, невоздержа́нїе Сп҃се предпоче́тъ нн҃ѣ, тѧ́жкимъ бре́менемъ ѡ҆бложе́нъ є҆́смь: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have fallen into passionate ruin and into material corruption, and from that time until now the enemy insults me!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have fallen into passionate ruin and into material corruption, and from that time until now the enemy insults me!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆краси́хъ пло́тскїй ѡ҆́бразъ, скве́рныхъ помышле́нїи различны́мъ ѡ҆бложе́нїемъ, и҆ ѡ҆сꙋжда́юсѧ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having preferred a life loving matter and loving possessions, and incontinence, O Savior, now I am compassed about with a heavy burden!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having preferred a life loving matter and loving possessions, and incontinence, O Savior, now I am compassed about with a heavy burden!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Внѣ́шнимъ приле́жнѡ, бл҃гоꙋкраше́нїемъ є҆ди́нѣмъ попеко́хсѧ, внꙋ́трню пре́зрѣвъ, Бг҃оѡ́бразнꙋю скѵні́ю.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have adorned the image of the flesh with the diverse vesture of defiled thoughts, and I am condemned!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have adorned the image of the flesh with the diverse vesture of defiled thoughts, and I am condemned!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: В̾ѡбрази́въ ми страсті́й безобра́зїе, любосла́стными стремле́нми, погꙋби́хъ ꙋ҆́мнꙋю красотꙋ̀: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I took diligent thought only for outward adornment, having neglected the inner God-fashioned tabernacle!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I took diligent thought only for outward adornment, having neglected the inner God-fashioned tabernacle!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Погребо́хъ пе́рваго ѡ҆́браза, добро́тꙋ Сп҃се стра́стми, ю́же ꙗ҆́кѡ дра́хмꙋ, взыска́въ ѡ҆брѧ́щеши: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having depicted in myself the deformity of passions by pleasure-loving impulses, I have destroyed the noetic beauty!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having depicted in myself the deformity of passions by pleasure-loving impulses, I have destroyed the noetic beauty!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Съгрѣши́хъ ꙗ҆́кѡже блꙋдни́ца, вопію́ ти є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have buried the goodness of the first image by passions, O Savior, which do Thou, having sought as the drachma, find!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have buried the goodness of the first image by passions, O Savior, which do Thou, having sought as the drachma, find!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Съгрѣши́хъ ꙗ҆́кѡже блꙋдни́ца, вопію́ ти є҆ди́нъ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have sinned as the harlot; I cry unto Thee: I alone

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have sinned as the harlot; I cry unto Thee: I alone

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆чи́сти ꙗ҆́коже Мыта́рѧ, вопію́ ти, Сп҃се ѡ҆чи́сти мѧ, никто́же бо ѿ сꙋ́щихъ и҆з̾ А҆да́ма, ꙗ҆́коже а҆́зъ согрѣши́хъ тебѣ̀: ͠
items.english_text: have sinned against Thee; as myrrh, O Savior, receive my tears also!

provenance.verbatim_source: have sinned against Thee; as myrrh, O Savior, receive my tears also!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ни сле́зы ни покаѧ́нїѧ и҆́мамъ, ни ꙋ҆миле́нїѧ, но Са́мъ ми Сп҃се, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ сїѧ̑ да́рꙋй: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have slipped as David profligately, and was defiled; but wash me also, O Savior, with tears!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have slipped as David profligately, and was defiled; but wash me also, O Savior, with tears!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Две́рь твою̀ не затвори́ ми тогда̀, Гдⷭ҇и, Гдⷭ҇и. Но ѡ҆тве́рзи ми сїю̀ ка́ющꙋ ми сѧ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Cleanse me as the publican, I cry unto Thee, O Savior, cleanse me![^1888] For none of them that are of Adam has sinned against Thee as I!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Cleanse me as the publican, I cry unto Thee, O Savior, cleanse me![^1888] For none of them that are of Adam has sinned against Thee as I!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Чл҃колю́бче, хотѧ́й всѣ́мъ сп҃ти́сѧ, ты воззови́ мѧ и҆ пріимѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гъ ка́юща сѧ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Neither tears nor repentance have I, nor compunction; but do Thou Thyself, O Savior, grant these unto me as God!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Neither tears nor repentance have I, nor compunction; but do Thou Thyself, O Savior, grant these unto me as God!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Внꙋшѝ воздыха́нїемъ дꙋша̀ моеѧ̀, и҆ ѻ҆́чїю мое́ю пріимѝ ка́плѧ, Гдⷭ҇и и҆ сп҃си́ мѧ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Close not Thy door against me at that time, O Lord, Lord; but open it unto me who repent!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Close not Thy door against me at that time, O Lord, Lord; but open it unto me who repent!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о: Пречⷭ҇таѧ Бцⷣе Дв҃о, є҆ди́на всепѣ́таѧ, моли́сѧ приле́жнѡ во є҆́же сп҃ти́сѧ на́мъ: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O Lover of mankind, Who desirest that all men should be saved: do Thou recall me and receive me as good, repenting!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* O Lover of mankind, Who desirest that all men should be saved: do Thou recall me and receive me as good, repenting!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: И҆ны́й И҆рмо́съ. Ви́дите ви́дите, ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́зъ є҆́смъ Бг҃ъ, ма́ннꙋ ѡ҆дожди́вый, и҆ во́дꙋ и҆с̾ ка́мене и҆сточи́вый, дре́вле въ пꙋсты́ни лю́демъ мои́мъ, є҆ди́ною десни́цею, и҆ крѣ́постїю мое́ю: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Give ear unto the sighings of my soul, and receive the drops from mine eyes, O Lord, and save me!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Give ear unto the sighings of my soul, and receive the drops from mine eyes, O Lord, and save me!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ви́дите ви́дите, ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́зъ є҆́смъ Бг҃ъ внꙋша́й дꙋ́ше моѧ̀, Гдⷭ҇а вопію́ща, и҆ ꙋ҆дали́сѧ пре́жнѧгѡ грѣха̀, и҆ бо́исѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ мсти́телѧ, и҆ Сꙋдїи и҆ Бг҃а: ͠
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Most pure Virgin Theotokos, only all-praised one, pray diligently that we may be saved!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Most pure Virgin Theotokos, only all-praised one, pray diligently that we may be saved!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Всѧ̑ и҆́же пре́жде зако́на, прете́кши ѡ҆ дꙋ́ше, Си́ѳꙋ не ꙋ҆подо́биласѧ є҆сѝ, ни́же Е҆но́сꙋ подража́ла є҆сѝ, ни Е҆нѡ́хꙋ преложе́нїемъ, нижѐ Не́ѡн. но ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ ꙋ҆бо́гаѧ првⷣныхъ жи́зни: ͠
items.english_text: See, see that I am God, Who rained manna and made water flow from the rock of old in the wilderness for My people, by My sole right hand and by My power!

provenance.verbatim_source: See, see that I am God, Who rained manna and made water flow from the rock of old in the wilderness for My people, by My sole right hand and by My power!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Всѧ̑ и҆́же пре́жде зако́на, прете́кши ѡ҆ дꙋ́ше, Си́ѳꙋ не ꙋ҆подо́биласѧ є҆сѝ, ни́же Е҆но́сꙋ подража́ла є҆сѝ, ни Е҆нѡ́хꙋ преложе́нїемъ, нижѐ Не́ѡн. но ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ ꙋ҆бо́гаѧ првⷣныхъ жи́зни: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* "See, see that I am God!" Give ear, O my soul, unto the Lord crying aloud; and depart from thy former sin, and fear Him as an Avenger, and Judge, and God!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* "See, see that I am God!" Give ear, O my soul, unto the Lord crying aloud; and depart from thy former sin, and fear Him as an Avenger, and Judge, and God!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Всѧ̑ и҆́же пре́жде зако́на, прете́кши ѡ҆ дꙋ́ше, Си́ѳꙋ не ꙋ҆подо́биласѧ є҆сѝ, ни́же Е҆но́сꙋ подража́ла є҆сѝ, ни Е҆нѡ́хꙋ преложе́нїемъ, нижѐ Не́ѡн. но ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ ꙋ҆бо́гаѧ првⷣныхъ жи́зни: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unto whom hast thou likened thyself, O much-sinning soul? Woe is me! Unto the first Cain, and that Lamech: having stoned the body with evil deeds, and slain the mind by irrational impulses!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Unto whom hast thou likened thyself, O much-sinning soul? Woe is me! Unto the first Cain, and that Lamech: having stoned the body with evil deeds, and slain the mind by irrational impulses!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Всѧ̑ и҆́же пре́жде зако́на, прете́кши ѡ҆ дꙋ́ше, Си́ѳꙋ не ꙋ҆подо́биласѧ є҆сѝ, ни́же Е҆но́сꙋ подража́ла є҆сѝ, ни Е҆нѡ́хꙋ преложе́нїемъ, нижѐ Не́ѡн. но ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ ꙋ҆бо́гаѧ првⷣныхъ жи́зни: ͠
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having passed through all who were before the Law, O soul, thou hast not been likened unto Seth, nor hast thou imitated Enos, nor Enoch by translation, nor Noah; but thou hast appeared destitute of the life of the righteous![^1890]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having passed through all who were before the Law, O soul, thou hast not been likened unto Seth, nor hast thou imitated Enos, nor Enoch by translation, nor Noah; but thou hast appeared destitute of the life of the righteous![^1890]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́жа ᲂу҆би́хъ речѐ въ ꙗ҆́звꙋ мнѣ̀, и҆ ю҆́ношꙋ въ стрꙋ́пъ, Ламе́хъ рыда́ѧ вопїѧ́ше: ты́ же не трепе́щеши ѽ дш҃е моѧ̀, ѡ҆калѧ́вши пло́ть, а҆ ра́зꙋмъ ѡ҆сквернѧ́ющи:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Alone thou hast opened the cataracts of the wrath of thy God, O my soul, and hast flooded all, as the earth, the flesh and deeds and life; and thou hast remained outside the ark of salvation![^1891]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Alone thou hast opened the cataracts of the wrath of thy God, O my soul, and hast flooded all, as the earth, the flesh and deeds and life; and thou hast remained outside the ark of salvation![^1891]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ѽ ка́кѡ поревнова́хъ Ламе́хꙋ, пе́рвомꙋ ᲂу҆бі́йцѣ, дш҃ꙋ ꙗ҆́кѡ мꙋ́жа, ᲂу҆́мъ ꙗ҆́кѡ ю҆но́шꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ бра́та же ми тѣ́ло ᲂу҆би́въ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Ка́їнъ ᲂу҆бі́йца, любовла́стными стремле́ньми:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* "A man have I slain," he said, "unto my wounding, and a young man to my hurt," Lamech wailing cried aloud;[^1892] but thou tremblest not, O my soul, having defiled the flesh and sullied the understanding!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* "A man have I slain," he said, "unto my wounding, and a young man to my hurt," Lamech wailing cried aloud;[^1892] but thou tremblest not, O my soul, having defiled the flesh and sullied the understanding!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Сто́лпъ ᲂу҆мꙋдри́ласѧ є҆сѝ созда́ти ѽ дш҃е, и҆ ᲂу҆твержде́нїе воздви́гнути, твои́мъ по́хотемъ, а҆́ще не бы Зижди́тель ᲂу҆держа́лъ совѣ́ты твоѧ̑, и҆ низве́рглъ на зе́млю ᲂу҆хищре́нїѧ твоѧ̑:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O how have I rivaled Lamech, the first murderer: slaying the soul as a man, the mind as a young man, and as my brother the body, like Cain the murderer, by lustful impulses!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* O how have I rivaled Lamech, the first murderer: slaying the soul as a man, the mind as a young man, and as my brother the body, like Cain the murderer, by lustful impulses!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ѹѧзви́хсѧ, и҆ ᲂу҆рани́хсѧ, сѐ стрѣ́лы вра́жїѧ, ᲂу҆ѧзви́вшыѧ ми дш҃ꙋ и҆ тѣ́ло, сѐ стрꙋ́пы и҆ гное́нїѧ, и҆ ѡ҆мраче́нїѧ вопїю́тъ, ра́ны самово́лныхъ страсте́й:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* A tower thou didst contrive to build, O soul, and to establish a rampart for thy lusts,[^1893] had not the Creator restrained thy counsels, and cast down thy contrivances to the earth!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* A tower thou didst contrive to build, O soul, and to establish a rampart for thy lusts,[^1893] had not the Creator restrained thy counsels, and cast down thy contrivances to the earth!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ѽдождѝ Гд҃ь ѿ Гд҃а ѻ҆́гнь и҆ногда̀, на беззако́нїе гнѣ́вавщеесѧ, ꙗ҆́коже Содо́млѧны: ты́ же ѻ҆́гнь возжегла̀ є҆сѝ гее́нскїй, въ не́мже и҆́маши ѽ дш҃е, сожже́на бы́ти:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have been wounded, and I have been hurt: behold, the enemy's arrows that have wounded my soul and body! Behold, sores, and festering, and darkenings cry aloud—the wounds of self-willed passions!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have been wounded, and I have been hurt: behold, the enemy's arrows that have wounded my soul and body! Behold, sores, and festering, and darkenings cry aloud—the wounds of self-willed passions!

items.slavonic_text: Ра́зꙋмѣ́йте, и҆ ви́дите, ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́зъ є҆́смь Бг҃ъ, и҆стѧза́ѧй срцѐ, и҆ и҆спыта́ѧй мы̑сли, и҆ ѡ҆блича́ѧй дѣла̀, и҆ попалѧ́ѧй грѣхѝ, и҆ сꙋдѧ́й си́рꙋ, и҆ смѣре́ннꙋ и҆ ни́щꙋ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Lord rained fire from the Lord of old upon iniquity that provoked His wrath, as upon the Sodomites;[^1894] but thou hast kindled the fire of Gehenna, wherein thou art to be burned, O soul!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The Lord rained fire from the Lord of old upon iniquity that provoked His wrath, as upon the Sodomites;[^1894] but thou hast kindled the fire of Gehenna, wherein thou art to be burned, O soul!

items.slavonic_text: Прпⷣбно́й. Просте́рла є҆сѝ рꙋ́цѣ своѝ, къ ще́дромꙋ Бг҃ꙋ, Марї́е въ бе́зднѣ ѕлѡ́хъ погрꙋжа́емаѧ, и҆ ꙗ҆́коже Петро́ви чл҃колꙋ́бецъ рꙋ́кꙋ свою̀ прострѐ по́мощи, ѡ҆браще́нїѧ Бж҃е́стве́нна и҆́щꙋще́й:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Understand, and see that I am God, examining the heart, and proving the thoughts, and reproving the deeds, and consuming sins, and judging the orphan, the humble, and the poor!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Understand, and see that I am God, examining the heart, and proving the thoughts, and reproving the deeds, and consuming sins, and judging the orphan, the humble, and the poor!

items.slavonic_text: Прпⷣбно́й. Просте́рла є҆сѝ рꙋ́цѣ своѝ, къ ще́дромꙋ Бг҃ꙋ, Марї́е въ бе́зднѣ ѕлѡ́хъ погрꙋжа́емаѧ, и҆ ꙗ҆́коже Петро́ви чл҃колꙋ́бецъ рꙋ́кꙋ свою̀ прострѐ по́мощи, ѡ҆браще́нїѧ Бж҃е́стве́нна и҆́щꙋще́й:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having stretched forth thy hands unto the merciful God, O Mary, when sunken in the abyss of evils; and as unto Peter the Lover of mankind stretched forth His hand of help, unto thee seeking divine conversion:[^1895]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having stretched forth thy hands unto the merciful God, O Mary, when sunken in the abyss of evils; and as unto Peter the Lover of mankind stretched forth His hand of help, unto thee seeking divine conversion:[^1895]

items.slavonic_text: А҆ндре́ю. Ви́димъ ви́димъ чл҃колꙋ́бїе ѽ дш҃е, Вл҃ки Вл҃ки, сегѡ̀ ра́ди пре́жде конца̀, семꙋ̀ съ слеза́ми припадѣ́мъ вопїю́ще, А҆ндре́а мл҃твами, Сп҃се поми́лꙋй на́съ:
items.english_text: with all fervor and love thou didst run unto Christ, having turned aside from the former way of sin, and being nourished in the trackless wilderness, and purely fulfilling His divine commandments!

provenance.verbatim_source: with all fervor and love thou didst run unto Christ, having turned aside from the former way of sin, and being nourished in the trackless wilderness, and purely fulfilling His divine commandments!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о: Чи́стаѧ Вл҃чце Бг҃ороди́тельнице, ᲂу҆пова́нїе ќ тебѣ̀ прибѣга́ющымъ, и҆ приста́нище въ бꙋ́ри, молѝ млⷭ҇тиваго Зижди́телѧ и҆ Сн҃а твое́го, поми́ловати и҆ менѐ, мл҃твами твои́ми:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* We see, we see the love toward mankind, O soul, of the Master and Lord; therefore, before the end, let us fall down before Him with tears, crying: By the prayers of Andrew, O Savior, have mercy on us![^1896]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* We see, we see the love toward mankind, O soul, of the Master and Lord; therefore, before the end, let us fall down before Him with tears, crying: By the prayers of Andrew, O Savior, have mercy on us![^1896]

items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆́гнь ѿ Гдⷭ҇а нѣ́когда, Гдⷭ҇ь ѡ҆дожди́въ, зе́млю Содо́мскꙋю дре́вле попали́въ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unoriginate, uncreated Trinity, undivided Unity: receive me who repent, save me who have sinned! I am Thy creation; despise me not, but spare me, and deliver me from the fiery condemnation!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Unoriginate, uncreated Trinity, undivided Unity: receive me who repent, save me who have sinned! I am Thy creation; despise me not, but spare me, and deliver me from the fiery condemnation!
