items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: На горѣ̀ сп҃са́йсѧ дш҃е, ꙗ҆́коже Лѡ́тъ ѻ҆́ный, и҆ въ Сиго́ръ ᲂу҆гонза́й:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* *Troparion:* Pure Lady, Birth-giver of God, hope of them that flee unto thee, and haven in tempest: pray the merciful Creator and thy Son, to have mercy upon me also, by thy prayers!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
*Troparion:* Pure Lady, Birth-giver of God, hope of them that flee unto thee, and haven in tempest: pray the merciful Creator and thy Son, to have mercy upon me also, by thy prayers!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Бѣга́й запале́нїѧ ѽ дш҃е, бѣга́й Содо́мскаго горѣ́нїѧ, бѣга́й тлѣ́нїѧ, Бж҃твеннаго пла́мене:
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Heirmos:*[^1897] On the unshaken rock of Thy commandments, O Christ, establish Thy Church; for Thou alone art holy and upright!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Heirmos:*[^1897]
On the unshaken rock of Thy commandments, O Christ, establish Thy Church; for Thou alone art holy and upright!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: И҆сповѣ́даютисѧ Сп҃се, съгрѣши́хъ, съгрѣши́хъ тебѣ̀, но ѡ҆сла́би ѡ҆ста́ви ми:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Lord rained fire from the Lord of old, burning up the land of Sodom in ancient times!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The Lord rained fire from the Lord of old, burning up the land of Sodom in ancient times!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Съгрѣши́хъ ти є҆ди́нъ а҆́зъ, съгрѣши́хъ па́че всѣ́хъ, Хрⷭ҇ѐ Сп҃се не пре́зри менѐ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Upon the mountain save thyself, O soul, like Lot of old, and flee into Zoar![^1898]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Upon the mountain save thyself, O soul, like Lot of old, and flee into Zoar![^1898]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ты́ є҆сѝ па́стырь до́брый, взыщи́ менѐ а҆́гнца, заблꙋ́ждшаго не пре́зри менѐ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Flee the conflagration, O soul; flee the Sodomite burning; flee the corruption of the divine flame!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Flee the conflagration, O soul; flee the Sodomite burning; flee the corruption of the divine flame!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ты́ є҆сѝ па́стырь до́брый, взыщи́ менѐ а҆́гнца, заблꙋ́ждшаго не пре́зри менѐ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I confess unto Thee, O Savior: I have sinned, I have sinned against Thee! But remit, forgive me!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I confess unto Thee, O Savior: I have sinned, I have sinned against Thee! But remit, forgive me!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ты́ є҆сѝ па́стырь до́брый, взыщи́ менѐ а҆́гнца, заблꙋ́ждшаго не пре́зри менѐ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I alone have sinned against Thee; I have sinned more than all: O Christ Savior, despise me not!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I alone have sinned against Thee; I have sinned more than all: O Christ Savior, despise me not!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ты́ є҆сѝ па́стырь до́брый, взыщи́ менѐ а҆́гнца, заблꙋ́ждшаго не пре́зри менѐ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou art the Good Shepherd: seek me, the lamb; despise not me who have gone astray!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou art the Good Shepherd: seek me, the lamb; despise not me who have gone astray!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Трⷪ҇ич: Ѽ Трⷪ҇це є҆дини́це Бж҃е, сп҃сѝ на́съ ѿ лє́сти, и҆скꙋше́нїй и҆ ѡ҆бстоѧ́нїй:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou art sweet Jesus, Thou art my Creator; in Thee, O Savior, am I justified!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou art sweet Jesus, Thou art my Creator; in Thee, O Savior, am I justified!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́: г҃. І҆рмо́: ᲂу҆твердѝ Гдⷭ҇и, на ка́мени за́повѣдїй твои́хъ, подви́гшеесѧ срⷯце моѐ, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ и҆ пра́веденъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O Trinity, Unity, God: save us from delusion, and temptations, and tribulations!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* O Trinity, Unity, God: save us from delusion, and temptations, and tribulations!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: И҆сто́чникъ живота̀ стѧжа́хъ тебѐ, сме́рти низложи́телѧ, и҆ вопїю́ ти ѿ срⷯца моегѡ̀ пре́жде конца̀, съгрѣши́хъ ѡ҆чи́сти и҆ сп҃си́ мѧ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* *Troparion:* Rejoice, womb that received God! Rejoice, throne of the Lord! Rejoice, Mother of our Life!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
*Troparion:* Rejoice, womb that received God! Rejoice, throne of the Lord! Rejoice, Mother of our Life!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: При Нѡ́и Сп҃се нече́ствовавшихъ подража́хъ, ѻ҆́нѣхъ наслѣ́дствовахъ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїе, въ пото́пѣ погрꙋже́нїѧ:
items.english_text: *Ode 3. Another Heirmos:*[^1899] Establish, O Lord, upon the rock of Thy commandments, my shaken heart; for Thou alone art holy and righteous!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 3. Another Heirmos:*[^1899]
Establish, O Lord, upon the rock of Thy commandments, my shaken heart; for Thou alone art holy and righteous!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Съгрѣши́хъ Гдⷭ҇и, съгрѣши́хъ ти ѡ҆чи́сти мѧ, нѣ́сть бо и҆́же кто̀ съгрѣшѝ въ чл҃вѣцѣхъ, є҆го́же не превъзыдо́хъ прегрѣше́ньми:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have acquired Thee as the fountain of life, the overthrower of death; and I cry unto Thee from my heart before the end: I have sinned, cleanse and save me!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have acquired Thee as the fountain of life, the overthrower of death; and I cry unto Thee from my heart before the end: I have sinned, cleanse and save me!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ха́ма ѻ҆́наго дш҃е, ѿцеро́гателѧ подража́вши, сра́ма не покры́ла є҆сѝ и҆́скренѧгѡ, вспѧ́тъ зрѧ̀ возврати́вшисѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* In the time of Noah, O Savior, I imitated those who acted impiously; I inherited their condemnation of being submerged in the deluge![^1900]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* In the time of Noah, O Savior, I imitated those who acted impiously; I inherited their condemnation of being submerged in the deluge![^1900]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Бл҃гослове́нїѧ Си́мова, не наслѣ́довала є҆сѝ ѽ ѡ҆каѧ́ннаѧ, ни простра́нное ѡ҆держа́нїе ꙗ҆́ки І҆а́фе́дъ, ᲂу҆держа́ла є҆сѝ на землѝ ѡ҆ставле́нїѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have sinned, O Lord, I have sinned against Thee, cleanse me; for there is none among men who has sinned, whom I have not surpassed by my transgressions!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have sinned, O Lord, I have sinned against Thee, cleanse me; for there is none among men who has sinned, whom I have not surpassed by my transgressions!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ѽ земля̀ Харра́нъ, и҆зы́йди ѿ грѣха̀ дш҃е моѧ̀ дне́сь ќ землѝ, точа́щи при́снѡ живо́тное тлѣ́нїе, є҆́же А҆враа́мъ наслѣ́дствова:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having imitated Ham of old, O soul, the scorner of his father, thou hast not covered the shame of thy neighbor, turning back with averted gaze![^1901]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having imitated Ham of old, O soul, the scorner of his father, thou hast not covered the shame of thy neighbor, turning back with averted gaze![^1901]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: А҆враа́ма слы́шала є҆сѝ дш҃е моѧ̀, дре́вле ѡ҆ста́вльша землю̀ ѻ҆те́чества, и҆ бы́вша прише́лца, сегѡ̀ и҆зволе́нїю подража́й:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The blessing of Shem thou hast not inherited, O wretched one, nor a spacious possession like Japhs hast thou obtained in the land of forgiveness!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The blessing of Shem thou hast not inherited, O wretched one, nor a spacious possession like Japhs hast thou obtained in the land of forgiveness!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: А҆враа́ма слы́шала є҆сѝ дш҃е моѧ̀, дре́вле ѡ҆ста́вльша землю̀ ѻ҆те́чества, и҆ бы́вша прише́лца, сегѡ̀ и҆зволе́нїю подража́й:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Depart from the land of Haran, come forth from sin, O my soul, today unto the land that ever flows with living incorruption, which Abraham inherited![^1902]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Depart from the land of Haran, come forth from sin, O my soul, today unto the land that ever flows with living incorruption, which Abraham inherited![^1902]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: А҆враа́ма слы́шала є҆сѝ дш҃е моѧ̀, дре́вле ѡ҆ста́вльша землю̀ ѻ҆те́чества, и҆ бы́вша прише́лца, сегѡ̀ и҆зволе́нїю подража́й:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast heard of Abraham, O my soul, who of old left the land of his fathers and became a sojourner: imitate his choice!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou hast heard of Abraham, O my soul, who of old left the land of his fathers and became a sojourner: imitate his choice!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: І҆саа́ка ѡ҆каѧ́ннаѧ дш҃е моѧ̀, разꙋмѣ́вши но́вꙋю же́ртвꙋ, та́йнѡ всесожже́нꙋ Гдⷭ҇и подража́й є҆гѡ̀ произволе́нїю:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having entertained the Angels, the Patriarch inherited in old age the prey of promise![^1903]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having entertained the Angels, the Patriarch inherited in old age the prey of promise![^1903]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: І҆сма́ила слы́шала є҆сѝ, трезви́сѧ дш҃е моѧ̀, и҆згна́нна ꙗ҆́кѡ рабы́нино ѿрожде́нїе, блюди́ да не ка́кѡ подо́бнѡ что̀ постра́ждеши, ласкосе́рдетвꙋющи:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having understood the new sacrifice of Isaac, O wretched soul of mine, mystically whole burnt-offering unto the Lord, imitate his choice![^1904]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having understood the new sacrifice of Isaac, O wretched soul of mine, mystically whole burnt-offering unto the Lord, imitate his choice![^1904]

items.slavonic_text: А҆га́рѧныни дре́вле дш҃е моѧ̀, Е҆гѵ́петстїи ᲂу҆подо́биласѧ є҆сѝ, порабо́тивши и҆зволе́нїе, и҆ роди́вши но́ваго І҆сма́ила, презо́рство:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast heard of Ishmael, be sober, O my soul, who was cast out as the offspring of a bondwoman; beware lest thou suffer anything similar, living in wantonness![^1905]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou hast heard of Ishmael, be sober, O my soul, who was cast out as the offspring of a bondwoman; beware lest thou suffer anything similar, living in wantonness![^1905]

items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS

items.slavonic_text: І҆а́кѡвли лѣ́ствицꙋ разꙋмѣ́ла є҆сѝ дш҃е моѧ̀, ꙗ҆влѧ́емꙋю ѿ землѧ̀ къ нб҃нымъ, почто̀ неи́маши восхо́да тве́рда, бл҃гоче́стїе:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Unto the Hagarite of old, O my soul, the Egyptian woman, thou hast become like, having enslaved thy choice, and borne a new Ishmael: insolence!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Unto the Hagarite of old, O my soul, the Egyptian woman, thou hast become like, having enslaved thy choice, and borne a new Ishmael: insolence!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST

items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Сщ҃е́нника Бж҃їѧ и҆ Царѧ̀ ᲂу҆единеннагѡ, Хрⷭ҇тово подо́бїе, и҆́же въ мі́рѣ житїе́мъ, въ чл҃вѣцѣхъ подража́й:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast understood Jacob's ladder, O my soul, shown from earth unto heaven; why hast thou not a firm ascent: piety?[^1906]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou hast understood Jacob's ladder, O my soul, shown from earth unto heaven; why hast thou not a firm ascent: piety?[^1906]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Не бꙋ́ди сто́лпъ сла́ный дш҃е, возврати́вшисѧ вспѧ́тъ, при́тча да ᲂу҆страши́тъ тѧ̀ Содо́мскаѧ, горѣ̀ въ Сиго́ръ сп҃са́йсѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Priest of God and solitary King, Christ's likeness, who by life in the world among men, imitate![^1907]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The Priest of God and solitary King, Christ's likeness, who by life in the world among men, imitate![^1907]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Запале́нїѧ ꙗ҆́коже Лѡ́тъ, бѣга́й дш҃е моѧ̀ грѣха̀, бѣга́й Содо́мы и҆ Гомо́ры, бѣга́й пла́мене всѧ́каго, безслове́снагѡ жела́нїѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Be not a pillar of salt, O soul, turning back! Let the Sodomite parable terrify thee; high up in Zoar be saved![^1908]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Be not a pillar of salt, O soul, turning back! Let the Sodomite parable terrify thee; high up in Zoar be saved![^1908]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Поми́лꙋй мѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇и, поми́лꙋй мѧ̀ вопїю́ ти: є҆гда̀ прїи́деши съ А҆́гг҃лы твои́ми, возда́ти всѣ̑мъ по достоѧ́нїю дѣѧ́нїй:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Flee the conflagration like Lot, O my soul; flee from sin; flee Sodom and Gomorrah; flee the flame of every irrational desire!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Flee the conflagration like Lot, O my soul; flee from sin; flee Sodom and Gomorrah; flee the flame of every irrational desire!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Мл҃твꙋ Вл҃ко тебѐ пою́щихъ не пре́зри, но ᲂу҆ще́дри чл҃колꙋ́бче, и҆ пода́ждь вѣ́рою просѧ́щымъ ѡ҆ставле́нїе:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Have mercy on me, O Lord, have mercy on me, I cry unto Thee: when Thou comest with Thine Angels to render unto all according to the worth of their deeds!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Have mercy on me, O Lord, have mercy on me, I cry unto Thee: when Thou comest with Thine Angels to render unto all according to the worth of their deeds!

items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Прпⷣбно́й Марї́е: Содержи́мъ є҆́смь бꙋ́рею, и҆ треволне́нїемъ, ма́ти
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Despise not the prayer of them that sing to Thee, O Master, but be compassionate, O Lover of mankind, and grant forgiveness unto them that ask with faith!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Despise not the prayer of them that sing to Thee, O Master, but be compassionate, O Lover of mankind, and grant forgiveness unto them that ask with faith!

items.english_text: *Troparion:* I am held fast by tempest and surge, O mother

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I am held fast by tempest and surge, O mother

items.slavonic_text: Ра́бское моле́нїе ны́нѣ Прпⷣбнаѧ принесшѝ, къ мл҃тивно́й мл҃тво́й твое́й Бц҃ѣ, ѿве́рзи Бж҃твенныѧ въхо́ды и҆ мнѣ̀:
items.english_text: of sins; but do thou thyself now save me, and lead me unto the haven of divine repentance!

provenance.verbatim_source: of sins; but do thou thyself now save me, and lead me unto the haven of divine repentance!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: А҆ндре́ю. Твои́ми мл҃твами, да́рꙋй и҆ мнѣ̀ ѡ҆ставле́нїе долго́въ, ѽ А҆ндре́е Кри́тскїй предсѣда́телю, покаѧ́нїѧ бо ты та́инникъ преизрѧ́дный:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having now offered a servile supplication, O Venerable Mother, unto the Mother of God who is compassionate in prayer, open the divine entrances unto me also!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having now offered a servile supplication, O Venerable Mother, unto the Mother of God who is compassionate in prayer, open the divine entrances unto me also!

items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о: ѿ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ безлѣ́тна Сн҃а, въ лѣ́то Бг҃ороди́тельнице, неискꙋзомꙋ́жнѡ роди́ла є҆сѝ, стра́нное чꙋ́до, пребы́вши Дв҃ою доѧ́щи:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By thy prayers grant me also the remission of debts, O Andrew of Crete, president; for thou art an exceptional mystagogue of repentance![^1909]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* By thy prayers grant me also the remission of debts, O Andrew of Crete, president; for thou art an exceptional mystagogue of repentance![^1909]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: Дрꙋгі́й Сѣ́: Гла́, и҃. По́: Повеле́нное та́инство: А҆пл҃ьскаѧ двоенадесѧ́тице, Бг҃оизбра́ннаѧ, моле́бꙋ принеси́те, по́стное по́прище всѣ̑мъ нн҃ѣ прейтѝ, соверша́ющымъ въ ᲂу҆миле́нїи мл҃твы, творѧ́щимъ ᲂу҆се́рднѡ добродѣ́тели, ꙗ҆́кѡ да си́це предвари́мъ, ви́дѣти Хрⷭ҇а̀ Бг҃а, сла́вное Воскр҃нїе, сла́вꙋ и҆ хвалꙋ̀, приносѧ́ще:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Simple, uncreated Trinity, unoriginate Essence, hymned in a triad of Hypostases: save us who with faith worship Thy dominion!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Simple, uncreated Trinity, unoriginate Essence, hymned in a triad of Hypostases: save us who with faith worship Thy dominion!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: И҆ нн҃ѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Непостижи́маго Бг҃а Сн҃а, и҆ Сло́во, несказа́ннѡ па́че ᲂу҆ма̀ и҆з́ тебѐ ро́ждшеесѧ, мл҃и Бц҃е съ А҆́пл҃ы, ми́ръ вселе́нной ти́хый пода́ти, и҆ съгрѣше́нїемъ да́ти на́мъ, пре́жде конца̀ проще́нїе, и҆ црⷭ҇твїѧ нбⷭ҇наго кра́йней бл҃гтїю, сподо́бити рабы̑ твоѧ̑:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* *Troparion:* The Son co-eternal with the Father in eternity, in time, O Birth-giver of God, without knowing man thou didst bear—a strange wonder!—remaining a Virgin while nursing!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
*Troparion:* The Son co-eternal with the Father in eternity, in time, O Birth-giver of God, without knowing man thou didst bear—a strange wonder!—remaining a Virgin while nursing!

items.slavonic_text: Та́же чте́мъ Жи́тїе Прпⷣбныѧ Марі́и Е҆гѵ́петскїѧ на дво́е. Пое́мъ ТРІПѢ́СНЕЦЪ Четвертка̀ безъ мета́нїй. Стихоло́гисꙋемъ же Пѣ́снь, д҃.
items.english_text: *Sessional Hymn of Kyr Joseph, Tone 8, Podoben: "Thou didst arise from the tomb" (Воскреслъ еси ѿ гроба):*[^1910][^1911] O light-bearing luminaries, Apostles of the Savior: enlighten us who are in the darkness of life, that as in the day we may now walk becomingly in the light of abstinence, fleeing the passions of the night, and may behold the radiant Passions of Christ, rejoicing!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Sessional Hymn of Kyr Joseph, Tone 8, Podoben: "Thou didst arise from the tomb" (Воскреслъ еси ѿ гроба):*[^1910][^1911]
O light-bearing luminaries, Apostles of the Savior: enlighten us who are in the darkness of life, that as in the day we may now walk becomingly in the light of abstinence, fleeing the passions of the night, and may behold the radiant Passions of Christ, rejoicing!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Та́же чте́мъ Жи́тїе Прпⷣбныѧ Марі́и Е҆гѵ́петскїѧ на дво́е. Пое́мъ ТРІПѢ́СНЕЦЪ Четвертка̀ безъ мета́нїй. Стихоло́гисꙋемъ же Пѣ́снь, д҃.
items.english_text: O apostolic twelve, chosen of God: offer supplication, that all may now traverse the course of the fast, completing prayers in compunction, fervently performing virtues; that so we may anticipate seeing Christ God, His glorious Resurrection, offering glory and praise!

provenance.verbatim_source: O apostolic twelve, chosen of God: offer supplication, that all may now traverse the course of the fast, completing prayers in compunction, fervently performing virtues; that so we may anticipate seeing Christ God, His glorious Resurrection, offering glory and praise!

items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Та́же чте́мъ Жи́тїе Прпⷣбныѧ Марі́и Е҆гѵ́петскїѧ на дво́е. Пое́мъ ТРІПѢ́СНЕЦЪ Четвертка̀ безъ мета́нїй. Стихоло́гисꙋемъ же Пѣ́снь, д҃.
items.english_text: The incomprehensible Son of God and Word, ineffably born of thee beyond understanding: do thou implore, O Mother of God, together with the Apostles, that He may grant peaceful calm unto the universe, and grant us before the end forgiveness of transgressions, and by His utmost goodness vouchsafe Thy servants the heavenly kingdom!

provenance.verbatim_source: The incomprehensible Son of God and Word, ineffably born of thee beyond understanding: do thou implore, O Mother of God, together with the Apostles, that He may grant peaceful calm unto the universe, and grant us before the end forgiveness of transgressions, and by His utmost goodness vouchsafe Thy servants the heavenly kingdom!

items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Та́же чте́мъ Жи́тїе Прпⷣбныѧ Марі́и Е҆гѵ́петскїѧ на дво́е. Пое́мъ ТРІПѢ́СНЕЦЪ Четвертка̀ безъ мета́нїй. Стихоло́гисꙋемъ же Пѣ́снь, д҃.
items.english_text: *Then we read the Life of our Venerable Mother Mary of Egypt in two parts. We sing the TRIODION of Thursday without prostrations. And we recite the scriptural canticle, Ode 4.*[^1913]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Then we read the Life of our Venerable Mother Mary of Egypt in two parts. We sing the TRIODION of Thursday without prostrations. And we recite the scriptural canticle, Ode 4.*[^1913]

items.slavonic_text: Воздержа́нїемъ пожи́вше просвѣще́нїи Хв҃и А҆́пл҃и, воздержа́нїѧ вре́мѧ на́мъ, хода́тайствы Бж҃твенными ᲂу҆тиша́ютъ:
items.english_text: *Ode 4, Tone 8. Heirmos:*[^1914] I heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation, and I understood Thy works, and I glorified Thy Divinity!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Ode 4, Tone 8. Heirmos:*[^1914]
I heard, O Lord, the mystery of Thy dispensation, and I understood Thy works, and I glorified Thy Divinity!

items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS

items.slavonic_text: Двоенадесѧтострꙋ́нный ѡ҆рга́нъ, пѣ́снь възгласѝ сп҃се́ннꙋю, Оу҆чени́кѡвъ ли́къ Бж҃твенный, лꙋка́ваѧ возмꙋща́ѧй гласова́нїѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having lived in abstinence, the enlightened Apostles of Christ soothe for us the time of abstinence by their divine intercessions!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having lived in abstinence, the enlightened Apostles of Christ soothe for us the time of abstinence by their divine intercessions!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ѡдожде́нїемъ дх҃овнымъ, всю̀ подсо́лнечнꙋю напои́сте, сꙋ́шꙋ ѿгна́вше многобо́жїѧ всебл҃же́ннїи:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The twelve-stringed organ, the divine choir of the Disciples, sounded forth a saving hymn, confounding the wicked utterances![^1915]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The twelve-stringed organ, the divine choir of the Disciples, sounded forth a saving hymn, confounding the wicked utterances![^1915]

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о: Смири́вшагосѧ сп҃си́ мѧ, высокоꙋ́мнѡ пожи́вшаго, ро́ждшаѧ возне́сшагѡ, смире́нное є҆стство̀ Дв҃о всечⷭ҇таѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With spiritual raining ye have watered all that is under the sun, having driven away the drought of polytheism, O all-blessed ones!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* With spiritual raining ye have watered all that is under the sun, having driven away the drought of polytheism, O all-blessed ones!

items.slavonic_text: И҆ны́й. І҆рмо́съ Гла́съ то́йже. Оу҆слы́шахъ Гдⷭ҇и: А҆́пл҃ское всече́стное ликостоѧ́нїе, зижди́телѧ всѣ́хъ ᲂу҆моли́те, поми́ловати на́съ восхвалѧ́ющихъ ва́съ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Save me who am humbled, who have lived high-mindedly, O all-pure Virgin, who didst bear Him that exalted our humble nature!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
Save me who am humbled, who have lived high-mindedly, O all-pure Virgin, who didst bear Him that exalted our humble nature!

items.slavonic_text: ꙗ҆́кѡ дѣ́лателе сꙋ́ще Хв҃и А҆́пⷭ҇тли, въ все́мъ мі́рѣ Бж҃твеннымъ Сло́вомъ воздѣ́лавшїи, прино́сите плоды̀ є҆мꙋ̀ всегда̀:
items.english_text: *Another [Canon], Tone 8. Heirmos: I heard, O Lord:*[^1916] O all-honorable assembly of the Apostles: implore the Creator of all to have mercy upon us who praise you!

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Another [Canon], Tone 8. Heirmos: I heard, O Lord:*[^1916]
O all-honorable assembly of the Apostles: implore the Creator of all to have mercy upon us who praise you!

items.slavonic_text: Виногра́дъ бы́сте Хв҃ъ, вои́стиннꙋ возлю́бленный, вино́ бо дх҃о́вное и҆сточи́сте мі́рꙋ А҆́пⷭ҇тли:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As laborers who are the Apostles of Christ, having cultivated the whole world by the divine Word, ye ever bring forth fruits unto Him!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* As laborers who are the Apostles of Christ, having cultivated the whole world by the divine Word, ye ever bring forth fruits unto Him!

items.slavonic_text: Трⷪ҇ич: Пренача́льнаѧ, соѡ́бразнаѧ, всесильнѣ́йшаѧ Трⷪ҇це ст҃а́ѧ, Ѻ҆́ч҃е, Сло́ве, и҆ Дш҃е ст҃ы́й, Бж҃е, свѣ́те, и҆ живо́те сохранѝ ста́до своѐ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Ye were the vineyard of Christ, truly beloved; for ye poured forth spiritual wine unto the world, O Apostles!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Ye were the vineyard of Christ, truly beloved; for ye poured forth spiritual wine unto the world, O Apostles!

items.slavonic_text: И҆ны́й Вели́кагѡ Кано́на, І҆рмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Pre-unoriginate, conformed, all-powerful Holy Trinity, Father, Word, and Holy Spirit, God, Light, and Life: preserve Thy flock!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Pre-unoriginate, conformed, all-powerful Holy Trinity, Father, Word, and Holy Spirit, God, Light, and Life: preserve Thy flock!

items.slavonic_text: И҆ны́й Вели́кагѡ Кано́на, І҆рмо́съ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Rejoice, fiery-radiant throne! Rejoice, light-bearing lampstand! Rejoice, mountain of salvation, ark of life, tabernacle of the Holy of holies!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Дѣ́лъ твои́хъ не пре́зри, созда́нїѧ твое́гѡ не ѡ҆ста́ви, правосꙋ́де. а҆́ще и҆ є҆ди́нъ съгрѣши́хъ ꙗ҆́кѡ человѣ́къ, па́че всѧ́кагѡ чл҃ка чл҃колꙋ́бче, но и҆́маши ꙗ҆́кѡ Гдⷭ҇ь всѣ́хъ, вла́сть ѿпꙋща́ти грѣхѝ:
items.english_text: *Heirmos:*[^1918] The Prophet heard of Thy coming, O Lord, and was afraid, that Thou wast to be born of a Virgin and appear unto men, and he said: I heard the report of Thee and was afraid: glory to Thy power, O Lord!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Приближа́етсѧ дш҃е коне́цъ, приближа́етсѧ и҆ не ради́ши, не гото́вишисѧ, вре́мѧ сокраща́етсѧ, воста́ни бли́зъ при две́рехъ Сꙋдїѧ̀ є҆́стъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ со́нъ ꙗ҆́кѡ цвѣ́тъ, вре́мѧ житїѧ̀ тече́тъ, что̀ всꙋ́е мѧте́мсѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Despise not Thy works, forsake not Thy creation, O righteous Judge! Though I alone have sinned as a man, more than any man, O Lover of mankind, yet hast Thou, as Lord of all, power to forgive sins!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Despise not Thy works, forsake not Thy creation, O righteous Judge! Though I alone have sinned as a man, more than any man, O Lover of mankind, yet hast Thou, as Lord of all, power to forgive sins!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Возникнѝ ѽ дш҃е моѧ̀, дѣѧ́нїа твоѧ̑ ꙗ҆́же содѣ́лала є҆сѝ помышлѧ́й, и҆ та̑ прѣд лицѐ твоѐ принесѝ, и҆ ка́плѧ и҆спꙋстѝ сле́зъ твои́хъ, рцы̀ со дерзнове́нїемъ, дѣѧ́нїа и҆ помышле́нїа Хрⷭ҇ꙋ̀, и҆ ѡ҆правда́йсѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The end draws near, O soul, it draws near, and thou carest not, nor dost thou prepare! The time grows short; arise, the Judge is near at the doors! Like a dream, like a flower, the time of life runs on; why do we trouble ourselves in vain?

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The end draws near, O soul, it draws near, and thou carest not, nor dost thou prepare! The time grows short; arise, the Judge is near at the doors! Like a dream, like a flower, the time of life runs on; why do we trouble ourselves in vain?

items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Не бы́сть въ житїи грѣ́хъ, ни дѣѧ́нїе ни зло́ба, є҆́яже а҆́зъ Сп҃се не съгрѣши́хъ, ᲂу҆мо́мъ и҆ сло́вомъ, и҆ и҆зволе́нїемъ, и҆ предложе́нїемъ, и҆ нра́вомъ, и҆ дѣѧ́нїемъ, съгрѣши́въ, ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆́нъ никто́же когда̀:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Arise, O my soul: ponder thy deeds which thou hast done, and bring them before thy face, and shed drops of thy tears; speak with boldness thy deeds and thoughts unto Christ, and be justified!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Arise, O my soul: ponder thy deeds which thou hast done, and bring them before thy face, and shed drops of thy tears; speak with boldness thy deeds and thoughts unto Christ, and be justified!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: ѿсю́дꙋ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нъ бы́хъ, и҆ препрѣ́нъ бы́хъ а҆́зъ ѡ҆каѧ́нный, ѿ своеѧ̀ со́вѣсти, є҆ѧ́же ничто́же въ мі́рѣ нꙋжднѣ́йше, Сꙋдїѐ, и҆ и҆зба́вителю мо́й, вѣ́дче, пощадѝ и҆зба́ви, и҆ сп҃си́ мѧ ѡ҆каѧ́ннаго:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* There has been no sin in life, nor deed nor wickedness, which I, O Savior, have not committed, in mind and word, and in choice, and purpose, and disposition, and action, having sinned as no other ever!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* There has been no sin in life, nor deed nor wickedness, which I, O Savior, have not committed, in mind and word, and in choice, and purpose, and disposition, and action, having sinned as no other ever!

items.slavonic_text: Лѣ́ствица, ю҆́же ви́дѣ дре́вле, вели́кїй въ Патрїа́рсехъ, при́тча є҆́сть дш҃е моѧ̀, дѣ́лателнагѡ восхожде́нїѧ, разꙋ́мнагѡ возше́ствїѧ. а҆́ще хо́щеши ᲂу҆́бѡ, дѣѧ́нїемъ, ра́зꙋмомъ, и҆ видѣ́нїемъ, живꙋ́щи ѡ҆бнови́сѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Hence am I condemned, and convicted am I, the wretched one, by mine own conscience, than which nothing in the world is more compelling: O Judge and my Deliverer, Who knowest all, spare, deliver, and save me, the wretched one!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Hence am I condemned, and convicted am I, the wretched one, by mine own conscience, than which nothing in the world is more compelling: O Judge and my Deliverer, Who knowest all, spare, deliver, and save me, the wretched one!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS

items.slavonic_text: Зно́й дневны́й претерпѣ̀, лише́нїѧ ра́ди Патрїа́рхъ,
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The ladder which the great one among the Patriarchs saw of old is a figure, O my soul, of active ascent and noetic elevation; if then thou desirest to live in action, understanding, and contemplation, be renewed!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The ladder which the great one among the Patriarchs saw of old is a figure, O my soul, of active ascent and noetic elevation; if then thou desirest to live in action, understanding, and contemplation, be renewed!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Зно́й дневны́й претерпѣ̀, лише́нїѧ ра́ди Патрїа́рхъ,
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The burning heat of the day did the Patriarch endure for the sake of privation,[^1919]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The burning heat of the day did the Patriarch endure for the sake of privation,[^1919]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Жє́ны ми двѣ̀ разꙋмѣ́й, дѣѧ́нїе и҆ ра́зꙋмъ въ видѣ́нїи. Лі́ю ᲂу҆́бѡ дѣѧ́нїе ꙗ҆́кѡ многоча́днꙋ. Рахи́ль же ра́зꙋмъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ многотрꙋ́днꙋ. и҆́бо кро́мѣ трꙋдѡ́въ, ни дѣѧ́нїе ни вѣ́дѣнїе дш҃е и҆спра́витсѧ:
items.english_text: and the night frost he bore, daily making provision, pasturing and laboring and serving, that he might wed the two wives!

provenance.verbatim_source: and the night frost he bore, daily making provision, pasturing and laboring and serving, that he might wed the two wives!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Бдѝ ѽ дш҃е моѧ̀ и҆ мꙋ́жествꙋй, ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле вели́кїй въ Патрїа́рсехъ, да стѧ́жеши дѣѧ́нїе съ ра́зꙋмомъ, да бꙋ́деши ᲂу҆́мъ зрѧ́й Бг҃а, и҆ дости́гнеши незаходѧ́щаго мра́ка въ вѣ́дѣнїи, и҆ бꙋ́деши вели́кїй кꙋпе́цъ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Understand by the two wives, action and knowledge in contemplation: Leah indeed as action, for she was rich in children; but Rachel as knowledge, for she was acquired with much labor.[^1920] For apart from labors, neither action nor contemplation, O soul, shall be set right!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Understand by the two wives, action and knowledge in contemplation: Leah indeed as action, for she was rich in children; but Rachel as knowledge, for she was acquired with much labor.[^1920] For apart from labors, neither action nor contemplation, O soul, shall be set right!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Двана́десѧте Патрїа́рхѡвъ, вели́кїй въ Патрїа́рсехъ роди́въ, та́иннѡ ᲂу҆твердѝ тебѣ̀ лѣ́ствицꙋ, дѣ́йстве́ннагѡ дш҃е моѧ̀ восхоже́нїѧ, дѣ́ти ꙗ҆́кѡ ѡ҆снова́нїѧ, степе́ни ꙗ҆́кѡ восхоже́нїѧ, премꙋ́дрѡ подложѝ.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Watch, O my soul, and play the man, like the great one among the Patriarchs of old, that thou mayest acquire action with knowledge, that thou mayest be a mind seeing God, and reach the unsetting darkness in contemplation, and be a great merchant!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Watch, O my soul, and play the man, like the great one among the Patriarchs of old, that thou mayest acquire action with knowledge, that thou mayest be a mind seeing God, and reach the unsetting darkness in contemplation, and be a great merchant!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: И҆са́ва возненави́дѣннаго, подража́ла є҆сѝ дш҃е, ѿдала̀ є҆сѝ преле́стникꙋ твое́мꙋ, пе́рвыѧ доброты̀ перве́нство, и҆ ѻ҆те́ческїѧ мл҃твы ѿпа́ла є҆сѝ, и҆ два́жды попо́лзнꙋласѧ є҆сѝ ѡ҆каѧ́ннаѧ, дѣѧ́нїемъ и҆ ра́зꙋмомъ, тѣ́мже ны́нѣ пока́йсѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having begotten the twelve Patriarchs, the great one among the Patriarchs mystically established for thee a ladder of active ascent, O my soul: the children as foundations, the steps as ascents, he wisely placed beneath!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having begotten the twelve Patriarchs, the great one among the Patriarchs mystically established for thee a ladder of active ascent, O my soul: the children as foundations, the steps as ascents, he wisely placed beneath!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Е҆дѡ́мъ И҆са́въ нарече́сѧ, кра́йнагѡ ра́ди женонеисто́внагѡ смѣше́нїѧ, невоздержа́нїемъ бо при́снѡ раждиза́емъ, и҆ сластьмѝ ѡ҆сквернѧ́емъ, Е҆дѡ́мъ и҆менова́сѧ, є҆́же глаго́летсѧ раждеже́нїе, дꙋша̀ любогрѣхо́внаѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast imitated the hated Esau, O soul; thou hast given over to thy deceiver the birthright of the first beauty, and hast fallen from thy father's prayer, and twice hast thou slipped, O wretched one, in action and in knowledge; therefore now repent![^1921]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou hast imitated the hated Esau, O soul; thou hast given over to thy deceiver the birthright of the first beauty, and hast fallen from thy father's prayer, and twice hast thou slipped, O wretched one, in action and in knowledge; therefore now repent![^1921]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: І҆ѡ́ва и҆́же на гно́ищи, слы́шавши ѽ дш҃е моѧ̀, ѡ҆правди́вшагосѧ, тогѡ̀ мꙋ́жествꙋ не поревнова́ла є҆сѝ, крѣ́пости не стѧжа́ла є҆сѝ предложе́нїѧ, въ всѣ́хъ ꙗ҆́же вѣ́си, и҆́миже и҆скꙋси́ласѧ є҆сѝ, но ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ нетерпели́ва:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Edom was Esau called, because of his extreme woman-mad passion; for being ever inflamed by intemperance, and defiled by pleasures, he was named Edom, which is interpreted: burning, a soul that loves sin![^1922]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Edom was Esau called, because of his extreme woman-mad passion; for being ever inflamed by intemperance, and defiled by pleasures, he was named Edom, which is interpreted: burning, a soul that loves sin![^1922]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: І҆ѡ́ва и҆́же на гно́ищи, слы́шавши ѽ дш҃е моѧ̀, ѡ҆правди́вшагосѧ, тогѡ̀ мꙋ́жествꙋ не поревнова́ла є҆сѝ, крѣ́пости не стѧжа́ла є҆сѝ предложе́нїѧ, въ всѣ́хъ ꙗ҆́же вѣ́си, и҆́миже и҆скꙋси́ласѧ є҆сѝ, но ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ нетерпели́ва:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having heard of Job on the dunghill, O my soul, who was justified, thou hast not rivaled his courage; thou hast not acquired firmness of purpose in all things that thou knowest, wherein thou hast been tried, but hast appeared impatient![^1923]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having heard of Job on the dunghill, O my soul, who was justified, thou hast not rivaled his courage; thou hast not acquired firmness of purpose in all things that thou knowest, wherein thou hast been tried, but hast appeared impatient![^1923]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ца́рскимъ са́номъ и҆ вѣнце́мъ, и҆ багрѧни́цею ѡ҆дѣ́ѧнъ, многоимѣ́нный чл҃къ и҆ пра́ведный, бога́тствомъ кипѧ̀ и҆ ста́ды, внезаа́пꙋ ѡ҆бнища́въ бога́тства, и҆ сла́вы ца́рскїѧ лише́нъ бы́сть:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* He who was formerly on a throne, now naked on a dunghill, is full of sores; he who was rich in children and renowned, is childless and homeless suddenly: for he accounted the dunghill a palace, and his sores as pearls![^1924]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* He who was formerly on a throne, now naked on a dunghill, is full of sores; he who was rich in children and renowned, is childless and homeless suddenly: for he accounted the dunghill a palace, and his sores as pearls![^1924]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: А҆́ще пра́веденъ бѧ́ше ѻ҆́нъ и҆ непоро́ченъ па́че всѣ́хъ, но не ᲂу҆бѣжѐ ловле́нїѧ льсти́ваго и҆ сѣ́ти, ты́ же грѣхолюби́ваѧ сꙋ́щи, и҆ ѡ҆каѧ́ннаѧ дш҃е что̀ сотвори́ши; а҆́ще чесомꙋ̀ ѿ недовѣ́домыхъ, слꙋчи́тсѧ наити́ тебѣ̀:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Clothed with royal rank and diadem and purple, a man of great possessions and righteous, abounding in wealth and herds, was suddenly deprived of wealth, and stripped of royal glory!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Clothed with royal rank and diadem and purple, a man of great possessions and righteous, abounding in wealth and herds, was suddenly deprived of wealth, and stripped of royal glory!

items.slavonic_text: Тѣ́ло ѡ҆скверни́хъ, и҆ дх҃ъ ѡ҆кала́хъ, ве́сь ѡ҆стрꙋ́пихсѧ. но ꙗ҆́кѡ вра́чъ Хрⷭ҇ѐ, ѡ҆боѧ̀ покаѧ́нїемъ мои́мъ ᲂу҆врачꙋ́й, ѡ҆мы́й ѡ҆чи́сти, и҆ покажѝ па́че снѣ́га, Сп҃се мо́й чистѣ́йша:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* If he was righteous and blameless more than all, yet fled not the snaring and net of the deceiver; what wilt thou do, O wretched soul, that art a lover of sin, if any unforeseen thing should happen unto thee?

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* If he was righteous and blameless more than all, yet fled not the snaring and net of the deceiver; what wilt thou do, O wretched soul, that art a lover of sin, if any unforeseen thing should happen unto thee?

items.slavonic_text: Тѣ́ло своѐ и҆ кро́вь распина́емъ, ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ положи́лъ є҆сѝ Сло́ве. Тѣ́ло ᲂу҆́бѡ да мѧ̀ ѡ҆бнови́ши, Кро́вь же да ѡ҆мы́еши мѧ̀, Дх҃ъ же преда́лъ є҆сѝ, да мѧ̀ приведе́ши Хрⷭ҇ѐ роди́телю свое́мꙋ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have defiled my body, and sullied my spirit, and am all covered with sores; but as Physician, O Christ, heal both by my repentance; wash, cleanse, and show me whiter than snow, O my Savior!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have defiled my body, and sullied my spirit, and am all covered with sores; but as Physician, O Christ, heal both by my repentance; wash, cleanse, and show me whiter than snow, O my Savior!

items.slavonic_text: Содѣ́лалъ є҆сѝ сп҃се́нїе, посредѣ̀ землѝ содѣ́телю да сп҃се́мсѧ, во́лею на дре́вѣ распѧ́лсѧ є҆сѝ, Е҆де́мъ затворе́нный ѿве́рзесѧ, вы́шнѧѧ и҆ ни́жнѧѧ тва́рь, ꙗ҆зы́цы всѝ, сп҃сши́исѧ покланѧ́ютътисѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thy Body and Blood, when crucified, Thou didst lay down for all, O Word: Thy Body indeed, that Thou mightest renew me; and Thy Blood, that Thou mightest wash me; and Thy Spirit Thou didst surrender, that Thou mightest bring me, O Christ, unto Thy Father!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thy Body and Blood, when crucified, Thou didst lay down for all, O Word: Thy Body indeed, that Thou mightest renew me; and Thy Blood, that Thou mightest wash me; and Thy Spirit Thou didst surrender, that Thou mightest bring me, O Christ, unto Thy Father!

items.slavonic_text: Да бꙋ́детъ мѝ кꙋ́пель, кро́вь и҆з́ ре́бръ твои́хъ в́кꙋпѣ и҆ питїѐ, и҆сточи́вшее во́дꙋ ѡ҆ставле́нїѧ, да ѡ҆бою́дꙋ ѡ҆чища́юсѧ, помазꙋ́ѧсѧ и҆ пїѧ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ ма́сть и҆ питїѐ Сло́ве, живо́тнаѧ твоѧ̑ словеса̀:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast worked salvation in the midst of the earth, O Creator, that we might be saved![^1926] Voluntarily wast Thou crucified upon the Tree; Eden, which was shut, is opened; creation on high and below, and all nations, having been saved, worship Thee!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou hast worked salvation in the midst of the earth, O Creator, that we might be saved![^1926] Voluntarily wast Thou crucified upon the Tree; Eden, which was shut, is opened; creation on high and below, and all nations, having been saved, worship Thee!

items.slavonic_text: Да бꙋ́детъ мѝ кꙋ́пель, кро́вь и҆з́ ре́бръ твои́хъ в́кꙋпѣ и҆ питїѐ, и҆сточи́вшее во́дꙋ ѡ҆ставле́нїѧ, да ѡ҆бою́дꙋ ѡ҆чища́юсѧ, помазꙋ́ѧсѧ и҆ пїѧ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ ма́сть и҆ питїѐ Сло́ве, живо́тнаѧ твоѧ̑ словеса̀:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* May the Blood from Thy side be unto me a laver, and together a drink that poured forth the water of remission, that on both sides I may be cleansed, being anointed and drinking, as ointment and drink, O Word, Thy life-bearing words![^1925]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* May the Blood from Thy side be unto me a laver, and together a drink that poured forth the water of remission, that on both sides I may be cleansed, being anointed and drinking, as ointment and drink, O Word, Thy life-bearing words![^1925]

items.slavonic_text: Ча́шꙋ Цр҃ковь стѧжа̀, ре́бра твоѧ̑ живоно́снаѧ и҆з́ни́хъ же сꙋгꙋ́баѧ на́мъ и҆стечѐ, ка́плѧ ѡ҆ставле́нїй и҆ ра́зꙋма, въ ѡ҆́бразъ ве́тхагѡ и҆ но́вагѡ, дво́ихъ в́кꙋпѣ завѣ́тѡвъ Сп҃се на́шъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I am naked of the bridal chamber; I am naked also of the marriage and supper together! The lamp is extinguished, for it lacked oil; the bridal chamber was shut against me while I slept; the supper was eaten; and I, bound hand and foot, am cast out![^1927]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I am naked of the bridal chamber; I am naked also of the marriage and supper together! The lamp is extinguished, for it lacked oil; the bridal chamber was shut against me while I slept; the supper was eaten; and I, bound hand and foot, am cast out![^1927]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Bréмѧ живота̀ мое́гѡ ма́лое, и҆ и҆спо́лненное болѣ́знїй и҆ лꙋка́вства, но въ покаѧ́нїи мѧ̀ прїимѝ, и҆ въ ра́зꙋмъ призовѝ, да не бꙋ́дꙋ стѧжа́нїе ни бра́шно чꙋждемꙋ̀, Сп҃се са́мъ мѧ̀ ᲂу҆ще́дри:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The Church has acquired the cup: Thy life-bearing side, from which gushed forth for us the two-fold stream, a drop of remission and knowledge, in figure of the Old and New, of the two covenants together, O our Savior![^1928]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The Church has acquired the cup: Thy life-bearing side, from which gushed forth for us the two-fold stream, a drop of remission and knowledge, in figure of the Old and New, of the two covenants together, O our Savior![^1928]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Высокоглаго́ливъ ны́нѣ є҆́смъ, безꙋ́менъ же и҆ срⷯцемъ, всꙋ́е и҆ в́сѐ, да не съ Фарисе́ѡмъ ѡ҆сꙋ́диши мѧ̀, па́че же Мытаре́во смире́нїе, пода́ждь ми є҆ди́не ще́дрый, пра́ведный Сꙋдїѐ, и҆ семꙋ́ мѧ сопричтѝ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The time of my life is small, and full of pains and wickedness; but in repentance receive me, and call me unto understanding, that I may not become a possession nor food for the stranger: O Savior, do Thou Thyself have compassion on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The time of my life is small, and full of pains and wickedness; but in repentance receive me, and call me unto understanding, that I may not become a possession nor food for the stranger: O Savior, do Thou Thyself have compassion on me!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Съгрѣши́хъ досади́въ сосꙋ́дꙋ, пло́ти моеѧ̀, вѣ́мъ ще́дре, но въ покаѧ́нїе мѧ̀ прїимѝ, и҆ въ ра́зꙋмъ призовѝ, да не бꙋ́дꙋ стѧжа́нїе ни бра́шно чꙋждемꙋ̀, Сп҃се са́мъ мѧ̀ ᲂу҆ще́дри:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I am high-speaking now, and foolish also in heart, in vain and altogether; let me not be condemned with the Pharisee, but rather grant me the Publican's humility, O only Compassionate, righteous Judge, and number me with him![^1929]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I am high-speaking now, and foolish also in heart, in vain and altogether; let me not be condemned with the Pharisee, but rather grant me the Publican's humility, O only Compassionate, righteous Judge, and number me with him![^1929]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Са́мое ка́пище бы́хъ стра́стемъ, дш҃ꙋ мою̀ ѡ҆скверни́въ ще́дре, но въ покаѧ́нїе мѧ̀ прїимѝ, и҆ в́ ра́зꙋмъ призовѝ, да не бꙋ́дꙋ стѧжа́нїе ни бра́шно чꙋждемꙋ̀, Сп҃се са́мъ мѧ̀ ᲂу҆ще́дри:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have sinned, having insulted the vessel of my flesh, I know, O Compassionate One; but in repentance receive me, and call me unto understanding, that I may not become a possession nor food for the stranger: O Savior, do Thou Thyself have compassion on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have sinned, having insulted the vessel of my flesh, I know, O Compassionate One; but in repentance receive me, and call me unto understanding, that I may not become a possession nor food for the stranger: O Savior, do Thou Thyself have compassion on me!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Не послꙋ́шахъ гла́са твое́гѡ, преслꙋ́шахъ писа́нїе твоѐ законополо́жное, но въ покаѧ́нїи мѧ̀ прїимѝ, и҆ въ ра́зꙋмъ призовѝ, да не бꙋ́дꙋ стѧжа́нїе ни пи́ща чꙋждемꙋ̀, Сп҃се са́мъ мѧ̀ ᲂу҆ще́дри:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have become a very temple for passions, having defiled my soul, O Compassionate One; but in repentance receive me, and call me unto understanding, that I may not become a possession nor food for the stranger: O Savior, do Thou Thyself have compassion on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have become a very temple for passions, having defiled my soul, O Compassionate One; but in repentance receive me, and call me unto understanding, that I may not become a possession nor food for the stranger: O Savior, do Thou Thyself have compassion on me!

items.slavonic_text: Ма́рїи:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I gave not ear unto Thy voice; I disobeyed Thy Scripture of the law; but in repentance receive me, and call me unto understanding, that I may not become a possession nor food for the stranger: O Savior, do Thou Thyself have compassion on me!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I gave not ear unto Thy voice; I disobeyed Thy Scripture of the law; but in repentance receive me, and call me unto understanding, that I may not become a possession nor food for the stranger: O Savior, do Thou Thyself have compassion on me!

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: А҆ндре́е ѻ҆́тческаѧ похвало̀, мл҃твами твои́ми не преста́й молѧ́сѧ, престо́лꙋ Трⷪ҇цѣ предстоѧ́й, ꙗ҆́кѡ да свобо́димсѧ мꙋче́нїѧ, любо́вїю предста́телѧ тѧ бж҃е́ственнагѡ всеблж҃е́не призыва́ющїи, Кри́тꙋ ᲂу҆добре́нїе:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Passing through a bodiless life in the flesh, thou didst truly receive great, acceptable grace with God; protect them that faithfully honor Thee; therefore we pray Thee, deliver us also from every calamity by thy prayers![^1930]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Passing through a bodiless life in the flesh, thou didst truly receive great, acceptable grace with God; protect them that faithfully honor Thee; therefore we pray Thee, deliver us also from every calamity by thy prayers![^1930]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Нераздѣ́лное сꙋ́ществомъ, несли́тное ли́цы Бг҃осло́влю тѧ̀, трⷪ҇ческое є҆ди́но Бж҃тво̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́но црⷪ҇твенное и҆ сопрⷪ҇то́лное, вопїю́ ти пѣ́снь вели́кꙋю, въ вы́шнихъ трегꙋбѡпѣ́сннѡ сла́вимꙋю: *
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Cast down into the deep of great enormities, thou wast not held fast; but thou didst run with higher understanding unto the perfection manifest in deeds of virtue, O glorious Mary, astonishing the nature of the Angels![^1931]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Cast down into the deep of great enormities, thou wast not held fast; but thou didst run with higher understanding unto the perfection manifest in deeds of virtue, O glorious Mary, astonishing the nature of the Angels![^1931]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, є҃. И҆рмо́съ. Ѿ но́щи ᲂу҆́треннююща чл҃вколю́бче, просвѣти́ молю́сѧ, и҆ наста́ви и҆ менѐ на повелѣ́нїѧ твоѧ̑, и҆ наꙋчи́ мѧ Сп҃се, твори́ти во́лю тво́ю.
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O Andrew, boast of the fathers, standing before the throne of the Trinity, cease not praying with thy prayers, that we who with love call upon thee, our divine protector, O all-blessed one, the ornament of Crete, may be delivered from torments![^1932]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* O Andrew, boast of the fathers, standing before the throne of the Trinity, cease not praying with thy prayers, that we who with love call upon thee, our divine protector, O all-blessed one, the ornament of Crete, may be delivered from torments![^1932]

items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Рꙋви́мꙋ подража́хъ ѡ҆каѧ́нный а҆́зъ, содѣ́лахъ беззако́нный и҆ законопрестꙋ́пный совѣ́тъ, на Бг҃а вы́шнѧго, ѡ҆скверни́въ ло́же моѐ, ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́тчее ѻ҆́нъ: *
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Undivided in Essence, unconfused in Persons, I theologize Thee, the one Triune Divinity, as of one kingship and co-enthroned; I cry aloud unto Thee the great song, thrice-hymned and glorified in the highest![^1933]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Undivided in Essence, unconfused in Persons, I theologize Thee, the one Triune Divinity, as of one kingship and co-enthroned; I cry aloud unto Thee the great song, thrice-hymned and glorified in the highest![^1933]

items.slavonic_text: Рꙋви́мꙋ подража́хъ ѡ҆каѧ́нный а҆́зъ, содѣ́лахъ беззако́нный и҆ законопрестꙋ́пный совѣ́тъ, на Бг҃а вы́шнѧго, ѡ҆скверни́въ ло́же моѐ, ꙗ҆́кѡже ѻ҆́тчее ѻ҆́нъ: *
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* *Troparion:* Both bringing forth and keeping virginity, thou remainest in both respects a Virgin by nature: by thy childbearing the laws of nature are renewed, and a womb that bare not gives birth; for where God wills, the order of nature is overcome, for He does whatever He pleases![^1934]

items.english_text: *Troparion:* In night have I passed my life continually, for night was it, and a deep mist unto me, the night of sin; but show me, O Savior, as a son of the day![^1936]

items.slavonic_text: Ѿ срѡ́дникѡвъ првⷣнаѧ дꙋша̀, свѧза́сѧ прода́сѧ въ рабо́тꙋ сла́дкїй, въ ѡ҆́бразъ Гдⷭ҇нь: ты́ же всѧ̀ дꙋшѐ, предала́сѧ є҆сѝ злы́ми свои́ми: *
items.english_text: *Troparion:* I confess unto Thee, O Christ King: I have sinned, I have sinned, as of old the brothers who sold Joseph, the fruit of purity and chastity![^1938]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I confess unto Thee, O Christ King: I have sinned, I have sinned, as of old the brothers who sold Joseph, the fruit of purity and chastity![^1938]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: І҆ѡ́сифа првⷣнаго, и҆ цѣломꙋ́дренаго ᲂу҆ма̀, подража́й ѡ҆каѧ́ннаѧ, и҆ неискꙋ́снаѧ дꙋшѐ, и҆ не любодѣ́йствꙋй въ беззако́нныхъ стремле́нїихъ, при́снѡ беззако́ннꙋющи:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* By his kinsmen was that righteous soul bound; that sweet one was sold into bondage, as a type of the Lord; but thou, O my soul, hast wholly surrendered thyself unto thine evil deeds![^1939]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* By his kinsmen was that righteous soul bound; that sweet one was sold into bondage, as a type of the Lord; but thou, O my soul, hast wholly surrendered thyself unto thine evil deeds![^1939]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: А҆́ще и҆ въ ро́вѣ поживе́тъ нѣ́когда І҆ѡ́сифъ, Влⷣко Гдⷭ҇и, но въ ѡ҆́бразъ Погребе́нїа и҆ Воста́нїа твое́гѡ. а҆́зъ же что̀ тебѣ̀ когда̀, таково́е принесꙋ̀: *
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Emulate the righteous and chaste mind of Joseph, O wretched and untried soul, and commit not fornication with lawless impulses, ever transgressing the law![^1940]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Emulate the righteous and chaste mind of Joseph, O wretched and untried soul, and commit not fornication with lawless impulses, ever transgressing the law![^1940]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Мѡѷсе́ѡвъ слы́шала є҆сѝ ковче́гъ и҆ногда̀ дꙋшѐ, вода́ми, волна́ми носи́мъ рѣ́чными, ꙗ҆́кѡ въ черто́зѣ дре́вле, бѣ́гающи дѣ́ла го́рькаго, совѣ́та Фараѡ́ниска:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Even if Joseph dwelt for a time in a pit, O Master and Lord, yet it was in the figure of Thy Burial and Rising; but what such thing shall I ever bring unto Thee?[^1941]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Even if Joseph dwelt for a time in a pit, O Master and Lord, yet it was in the figure of Thy Burial and Rising; but what such thing shall I ever bring unto Thee?[^1941]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: А҆́ще ба́бы слы́шала є҆сѝ и҆ногда̀, ᲂу҆бива́ющїѧ младе́нцы, мꙋ́жеска по́лꙋ дꙋшѐ ѡ҆каѧ́ннаѧ, цѣломꙋ́дрїа дѣ́ло, нн҃ѣ ꙗ҆́кѡ вели́кїй Мѡѷсе́й, ссѝ пре́мꙋдрость:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast heard of old, O soul, of the ark of Moses, borne by the waters and the waves of the river as in a bridal chamber, fleeing the bitter work of Pharaoh's decree![^1942]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou hast heard of old, O soul, of the ark of Moses, borne by the waters and the waves of the river as in a bridal chamber, fleeing the bitter work of Pharaoh's decree![^1942]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ мѡѷсе́й вели́кїй Е҆гѵптѧ́нина, ᲂу҆ма̀ ᲂу҆ѧзви́вши ѡ҆каѧ́ннаѧ, не ᲂу҆би́ла є҆сѝ сꙋ́дъ дꙋшѐ, и҆ ка́кѡ всели́шисѧ гл҃и, въ пꙋсты́ни страсте́й покаѧ́нїемъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* If thou hast heard of the midwives of old who slew the male infants, O wretched soul, suck thou now wisdom, the work of chastity, like great Moses![^1943]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* If thou hast heard of the midwives of old who slew the male infants, O wretched soul, suck thou now wisdom, the work of chastity, like great Moses![^1943]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Въ пꙋсты́ни всели́сѧ вели́кїй Мѡѷсе́й, грѧдѝ ᲂу҆́бѡ поревнова́й тогѡ̀ житїю̀, да є҆́же въ Кꙋпинѣ̀ Бг҃оѧвле́нїѧ, дꙋшѐ, въ вѣ́дѣнїи бꙋ́деши: *
items.english_text: *Troparion:* As great Moses smote the Egyptian, having wounded thy mind, O wretched soul, thou hast not slain him; and how, tell me, wilt thou dwell in the wilderness of passions through repentance?[^1944]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* As great Moses smote the Egyptian, having wounded thy mind, O wretched soul, thou hast not slain him; and how, tell me, wilt thou dwell in the wilderness of passions through repentance?[^1944]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Мѡѷсе́ѡвъ же́злъ воѡбража́й дꙋшѐ, ᲂу҆дарѧ́ющїи мо́ре, и҆ ѡ҆гꙋсти́вающїи глꙋбинꙋ̀, въ ѡ҆́бразъ Крⷭ҇та̀ Бж҃е́ственнагѡ, и҆́мже мо́жеши и҆ ты̀, вели́каѧ соверши́ти:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Great Moses dwelt in the wilderness; come, therefore, emulate his life, that thou, O soul, mayest also come to the vision of God in the Bush![^1945]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Great Moses dwelt in the wilderness; come, therefore, emulate his life, that thou, O soul, mayest also come to the vision of God in the Bush![^1945]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: А҆арѡ́нъ приноша́ше ѻ҆́гнь Бг҃ꙋ, непоро́чный
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Picture to thyself, O soul, the rod of Moses striking the sea and solidifying the deep, in the figure of the divine Cross, through which thou also canst accomplish great wonders![^1946]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Picture to thyself, O soul, the rod of Moses striking the sea and solidifying the deep, in the figure of the divine Cross, through which thou also canst accomplish great wonders![^1946]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: А҆арѡ́нъ приноша́ше ѻ҆́гнь Бг҃ꙋ, непоро́чный
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Aaron offered unto God unblemished fire,

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Aaron offered unto God unblemished fire,

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡже тѧ́жкїй нра́вомъ, Фараѡ́нꙋ го́ркомꙋ бы́хъ Влⷣко, І҆а́ннїй и҆ А҆мврїй, дꙋше́ю и҆ тѣ́ломъ, погрꙋже́нъ ᲂу҆мо́мъ, но помози́ ми: *
items.english_text: without deceit; but Hophni and Phinehas, even as thou, O soul, offered unto God that which was strange, a defiled life![^1947]

provenance.verbatim_source: without deceit; but Hophni and Phinehas, even as thou, O soul, offered unto God that which was strange, a defiled life![^1947]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ка́ломъ смѣси́хъ сѧ, ѡ҆каѧ́нный ᲂу҆мо́мъ, ѡ҆мы́й мѧ̀ Влⷣко, ба́нею мои́хъ сле́зъ молю́ тѧ, пло́ти моеѧ̀ ѡ҆де́ждꙋ, ᲂу҆бѣли́въ ꙗ҆́кѡ снѣ́гъ: *
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Like hard-hearted Jannes and Jambres unto bitter Pharaoh have I become, O Master, plunged in soul and body and mind; but help Thou me![^1948]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Like hard-hearted Jannes and Jambres unto bitter Pharaoh have I become, O Master, plunged in soul and body and mind; but help Thou me![^1948]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: А҆́ще и҆спыта́ю дѣла̀ Сп҃се, всѧ́кагѡ чл҃вка преше́дша, грѣха́ми себѐ зрю̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ въ ра́зꙋмѣ ᲂу҆ма̀ съгрѣши́хъ, а҆ не въ невѣ́дѣнїи: *
items.english_text: *Troparion:* In the mire have I been mingled, wretched in my mind; wash me, O Master, in the laver of my tears, I pray Thee, making the garment of my flesh white as snow![^1949]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* In the mire have I been mingled, wretched in my mind; wash me, O Master, in the laver of my tears, I pray Thee, making the garment of my flesh white as snow![^1949]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Пощадѝ пощадѝ Гдⷭ҇и созда́нїе твоѐ, согрѣши́хъ ѡ҆сла́би ми, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆сѝ є҆стество́мъ чтⷪ҇ый са́мъ є҆ди́нъ, и҆ и҆́нъ ра́звѣ тебѐ, никто́же є҆́сть кро́мѣ скве́рны: *
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Though I examine my deeds, O Savior, I see that I have surpassed every man in sins; for I have sinned in the knowledge of my mind, and not in ignorance![^1950]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Though I examine my deeds, O Savior, I see that I have surpassed every man in sins; for I have sinned in the knowledge of my mind, and not in ignorance![^1950]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Менѐ ра́ди Бг҃ъ сы́й, воѡбрази́лъсѧ є҆сѝ въ мѧ̀, показа́лъ є҆сѝ чꙋдеса̀, и҆сцѣли́въ прокаже́нныѧ, и҆ Разсла́бленнаго стѧгнꙋ́въ, Кровоточи́вой то́къ ᲂу҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ Сп҃се, прикоснове́нїемъ Ри́зъ: *
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Spare, spare, O Lord, Thy creation! I have sinned, forgive me; for Thou alone art pure by nature, and none other besides Thee is without defilement![^1951]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Spare, spare, O Lord, Thy creation! I have sinned, forgive me; for Thou alone art pure by nature, and none other besides Thee is without defilement![^1951]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Кровоточи́вой подража́й ѡ҆каѧ́ннаѧ дꙋшѐ, притецы̀ ᲂу҆держѝ кра́й Хрⷭ҇та̀, да свободи́шисѧ ра́нъ, ᲂу҆слы́шиши же ѿ него̀: вѣ́ра твоѧ̀ сп҃се́ тѧ: *
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Being God, for my sake Thou didst take form in me; Thou didst display wonders, healing lepers, and strengthening the paralytic, and stopping the flow of the woman with the issue of blood, O Savior, by the touch of Thy garments![^1952]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Being God, for my sake Thou didst take form in me; Thou didst display wonders, healing lepers, and strengthening the paralytic, and stopping the flow of the woman with the issue of blood, O Savior, by the touch of Thy garments![^1952]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ни́зꙋ сни́чꙋщꙋю подража́й ѻ҆̀ дꙋшѐ, прїидѝ, припади́ ќ нога́ма І҆и҃совома, да тѧ̀ и҆спра́витъ, и҆ хо́диши пра́во въ пꙋти̑ Гдⷭ҇нѧ: *
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Emulate the woman with the issue of blood, O wretched soul; run, take hold of the hem of Christ, that thou mayest be freed from plagues, and hear from Him: "Thy faith has saved thee!"[^1953]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Emulate the woman with the issue of blood, O wretched soul; run, take hold of the hem of Christ, that thou mayest be freed from plagues, and hear from Him: "Thy faith has saved thee!"[^1953]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: А҆́ще и҆ кла́дѧзь є҆сѝ глꙋбо́кїй Влⷣко, и҆сточи́ ми во́дꙋ и҆з̾ прⷱ҇чты ти жи́лъ, да ꙗ҆́кѡ Самарѧны́ни, не ктомꙋ̀ бꙋдꙋ жа́ждаѧ, жи́зни бо стрꙋѧ̀ и҆сточа́еши: *
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Emulate the woman bowed down to the earth, O soul; come, fall down at the feet of Jesus, that He may straighten thee, and that thou mayest walk upright in the paths of the Lord![^1954]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Emulate the woman bowed down to the earth, O soul; come, fall down at the feet of Jesus, that He may straighten thee, and that thou mayest walk upright in the paths of the Lord![^1954]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Сїлѡа́мъ да бꙋ́дꙋтъ ми сле́зы моѧ̑ Влⷣко Гдⷭ҇и,
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Though Thou art a deep well, O Master, gush forth for me water from Thy most pure veins, that, like the Samaritan woman, I may thirst no more; for Thou pourest forth the streams of life![^1955]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Though Thou art a deep well, O Master, gush forth for me water from Thy most pure veins, that, like the Samaritan woman, I may thirst no more; for Thou pourest forth the streams of life![^1955]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Сїлѡа́мъ да бꙋ́дꙋтъ ми сле́зы моѧ̑ Влⷣко Гдⷭ҇и,
items.english_text: *Troparion:* May my tears be Siloam unto me, O Master and Lord,

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* May my tears be Siloam unto me, O Master and Lord,

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: И҆зрѧ́днымъ жела́нїемъ пребога́таѧ, Дре́вꙋ вожделѣ́вши, поклони́тисѧ живо́тномꙋ, сподо́биласѧ є҆сѝ жела́нїю, сподо́би ᲂу҆́бѡ и҆ менѐ ᲂу҆лꙋчи́ти вы́шнѧѧ сла́вы: *
items.english_text: that I may wash therewith the pupils of my heart, and behold Thee with understanding, O Light before the ages![^1956]

provenance.verbatim_source: that I may wash therewith the pupils of my heart, and behold Thee with understanding, O Light before the ages![^1956]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ Па́стырей и҆зрѧднѣ́йша, А҆ндре́е премрⷣре, пречтⷪ҇нѣйша сꙋ́ща тѧ, любо́вїю ве́лїею и҆ стра́хомъ мл҃ю, твои́ми мл҃твами сп҃снїе, ᲂу҆лꙋчи́ти и҆ жи́знь вѣ́чнꙋю:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Exceedingly rich with eminent desire, longing to venerate the Life-giving Tree, thou wast vouchsafed thy desire; vouchsafe therefore unto me also to obtain the glory on high![^1957]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Exceedingly rich with eminent desire, longing to venerate the Life-giving Tree, thou wast vouchsafed thy desire; vouchsafe therefore unto me also to obtain the glory on high![^1957]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Тѧ̀ Трⷪ҇це сла́вимъ є҆ди́наго Бг҃а. ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ, ст҃ъ є҆сѝ, О҆́ч҃е, и҆ Сн҃е, и҆ Дш҃е, про́стое Сꙋ́щество, є҆ди́нице при́снѡ покланѧ́емаѧ: *
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having crossed the streams of the Jordan, thou didst find rest from the suffering flesh, having escaped pleasures; from which do thou also deliver us by thy prayers, O venerable mother![^1958]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having crossed the streams of the Jordan, thou didst find rest from the suffering flesh, having escaped pleasures; from which do thou also deliver us by thy prayers, O venerable mother![^1958]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́: ѕ҃. И҆рмо́. Возопи́хъ всѣ́мъ срⷯцемъ мои́мъ, къ ще́дромꙋ Бг҃ꙋ, и҆ ᲂу҆слы́ша мѧ̀ ѿ а҆́да преиспо́днѧго, и҆ возведѐ и҆з̾ тлѧ̀ живо́тъ мо́й:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Knowing thee to be most eminent among pastors, O all-wise Andrew, and most honorable, with great love and fear I pray thee: by thy prayers may I obtain salvation and life eternal![^1959]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Knowing thee to be most eminent among pastors, O all-wise Andrew, and most honorable, with great love and fear I pray thee: by thy prayers may I obtain salvation and life eternal![^1959]

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thee, O Trinity, we glorify, the one God: Holy, Holy, Holy art Thou, Father, and Son, and Spirit, simple Essence, Unity ever worshipped![^1960]

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* *Troparion:* From thee did God Who created the ages clothe Himself in my clay, O undefiled, unwedded Mother and Virgin, and united human nature unto Himself![^1961]

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ю҆ни́ца дꙋшѐ разсвирѣпѣ́вшаѧ, ᲂу҆подо́биласѧ є҆сѝ Е҆фре́мꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ се́рна ѿ тене́та, сохранѝ житїѐ, возвы́сившисѧ дѣѧ́нїемъ и҆ видѣ́нїемъ: *
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos:*[^1962] I cried with all my heart unto the merciful God, and He heard me from the lowest hell, and brought up my life from corruption!

provenance.verbatim_source:

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ю҆ни́ца дꙋшѐ разсвирѣпѣ́вшаѧ, ᲂу҆подо́биласѧ є҆сѝ Е҆фре́мꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ се́рна ѿ тене́та, сохранѝ житїѐ, возвы́сившисѧ дѣѧ́нїемъ и҆ видѣ́нїемъ: *
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The tears of mine eyes, O Savior, and the sighs from the depth I offer purely, while my heart cries: O God, I have sinned against Thee, cleanse me![^1963]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The tears of mine eyes, O Savior, and the sighs from the depth I offer purely, while my heart cries: O God, I have sinned against Thee, cleanse me![^1963]

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ю҆ни́ца дꙋшѐ разсвирѣпѣ́вшаѧ, ᲂу҆подо́биласѧ є҆сѝ Е҆фре́мꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ се́рна ѿ тене́та, сохранѝ житїѐ, возвы́сившисѧ дѣѧ́нїемъ и҆ видѣ́нїемъ: *
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast turned aside, O soul, from thy Lord, even as Dathan and Abiram; but cry aloud from all thy heart: "Spare!", that the chasm of the earth may not cover thee![^1964]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou hast turned aside, O soul, from thy Lord, even as Dathan and Abiram; but cry aloud from all thy heart: "Spare!", that the chasm of the earth may not cover thee![^1964]

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ю҆ни́ца дꙋшѐ разсвирѣпѣ́вшаѧ, ᲂу҆подо́биласѧ є҆сѝ Е҆фре́мꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ се́рна ѿ тене́та, сохранѝ житїѐ, возвы́сившисѧ дѣѧ́нїемъ и҆ видѣ́нїемъ: *
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Like an enraged heifer, O soul, thou hast likened thyself unto Ephraim; like a gazelle from the snare, preserve thy life, having soared aloft by action and contemplation![^1965]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Like an enraged heifer, O soul, thou hast likened thyself unto Ephraim; like a gazelle from the snare, preserve thy life, having soared aloft by action and contemplation![^1965]

items.office: ON THURSDAY OF THE FIFTH WEEK OF THE HOLY FAST
