items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Крⷭ҇тъ ви́дѣти потща́вшисѧ, крⷭ҇тнымъ просвѣще́нїемъ марі́е ѡ҆зари́ласѧ є҆сѝ, крⷭ҇то́мъ бесѣ́довавшагѡ ма́нїемъ бж҃тве́ннымъ, распе́нши сѧ мі́рови досточу́днаѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having formerly been the cause of evils and deceitful pleasure unto many, thou didst shine forth after the likeness of the sun, and wast revealed, O venerable one, as a guide unto all that sin![^2497]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having formerly been the cause of evils and deceitful pleasure unto many, thou didst shine forth after the likeness of the sun, and wast revealed, O venerable one, as a guide unto all that sin![^2497]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Злы́хъ вина̀ пе́рвѣе, сласть лука́ваѧ, мно́гимъ бы́вши, сл҃нца ѡ҆́бразомъ проїѧ́вши, всѣ́мъ наста́вница прпⷣбнаѧ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ согрѣша́ющымъ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thou didst surpass even the heavenly mind, O spiritual heaven of the King of all; for outside the laws of nature, O Pure One, Thou didst bear the Lawgiver and Creator of all![^2498]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Thou didst surpass even the heavenly mind, O spiritual heaven of the King of all; for outside the laws of nature, O Pure One, Thou didst bear the Lawgiver and Creator of all![^2498]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Оу҆́мъ превзышла̀ є҆сѝ и҆ нб҃ны́й, мы́сленное нб҃о всѣ́хъ цр҃ѧ̀, зако́нѡвъ бо є҆стества̀ внѣ̀ чтⷭ҇аѧ, законоде́телѧ и҆ созда́телѧ всѣ́хъ родила̀ є҆сѝ:
items.english_text: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Why hast Thou cast me off from Thy presence, O Light never-setting, and alien darkness has covered me, wretched that I am? But turn me, and direct my paths unto the light of Thy commandments, I pray Thee!*[^2499]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 5. Heirmos: Why hast Thou cast me off from Thy presence, O Light never-setting, and alien darkness has covered me, wretched that I am? But turn me, and direct my paths unto the light of Thy commandments, I pray Thee!*[^2499]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ѱп҃в Недѣ́лѧ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* When the rich man saw Lazarus in the bosom of Abraham, rejoicing in light and glory, he cried out: "Father Abraham, have mercy on me who am held fast in the fire, and have my tongue grievously in flame!"[^2500]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* When the rich man saw Lazarus in the bosom of Abraham, rejoicing in light and glory, he cried out: "Father Abraham, have mercy on me who am held fast in the fire, and have my tongue grievously in flame!"[^2500]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: На ꙗ҆враа́млихъ ло́нѣхъ, ла́зара бога́тый є҆гда̀ ᲂу҆зрѣ̀, въ свѣ́тѣ и҆ сла́вѣ веселѧ́щасѧ, ѻ́ч҃е взыва́ше ꙗ҆враа́ме, поми́луй мѧ̀ въ ѻ҆гнѝ ѡ҆б̾держа́наго, и҆ ꙗ҆зы́къ лю́тѣ въ пла́мени и҆му́ща:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* "Thou didst enjoy thyself, delighting in the wealth of life," Abraham said unto the rich man; "therefore thou art tormented here, being in the eternal fire; while Lazarus the poor man rejoices in unending joy!"[^2501]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* "Thou didst enjoy thyself, delighting in the wealth of life," Abraham said unto the rich man; "therefore thou art tormented here, being in the eternal fire; while Lazarus the poor man rejoices in unending joy!"[^2501]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Наслади́лсѧ є҆сѝ, бога́тствомъ житїѧ̀ веселѧ́сѧ, ꙗ҆враа́мъ гла́ше бога́тому, ѿню́дуже му́чиши сѧ здѣ̀, въ вѣ́чномъ ѻ҆гнѝ сы́й, ни́щїй же въ весе́лїи несконча́емомъ ра́дуетсѧ ла́зарь:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Through the deceit of life I became like the rich man, O Lover of mankind, having squandered all my life in pleasures; but I pray for Thy mercies, that I may be freed from the fire, even as Lazarus was, O Savior![^2502]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Through the deceit of life I became like the rich man, O Lover of mankind, having squandered all my life in pleasures; but I pray for Thy mercies, that I may be freed from the fire, even as Lazarus was, O Savior![^2502]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Житїѧ̀ пре́лестїю, бога́тый бы́хъ, ꙗ҆́кѡже бога́тый житїѐ всѐ, сластьмѝ и҆ждивы́й чл҃вколю́бче: Но молю̀ твои́хъ щедро́тъ, є҆́же свободи́тимисѧ ѻ҆гнѧ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡже сп҃се ла́заръ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Having acquired maternal boldness toward Thy Son, O All-Pure One, despise not kindred care for us, we pray Thee; for Thee alone, as Christians, do we offer unto the Master as an acceptable propitiation![^2503]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Having acquired maternal boldness toward Thy Son, O All-Pure One, despise not kindred care for us, we pray Thee; for Thee alone, as Christians, do we offer unto the Master as an acceptable propitiation![^2503]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о: Мт҃рское дерзнове́нїе къ сн҃у, стѧжа́вши всечⷭ҇таѧ, сроднагѡ промышле́нїѧ ѡ҆ на́съ непре́зри мо́лимтисѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ тебѐ и҆ є҆ди́ну, хрⷭ҇тїа́не къ влⷣцѣ, ᲂу҆млⷭ҇тивле́нїе бл҃гопрїѧ́тное предлага́емъ:
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos, Tone 6. Of Thy theophany, O Christ:*[^2504]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Another Heirmos, Tone 6. Of Thy theophany, O Christ:*[^2504]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: И҆ны́й И҆рмо́съ. Бг҃оѧвле́нїѧ ти хрⷭ҇тѐ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Moses was glorified of old on Sinai, the most glorious one mystically beholding the back parts of God (Exod. 33:23); he described the strange wonder; and now Mary, fervently falling down before the all-pure image of the Manna-receiving Urn, leads an angelic life![^2505]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Moses was glorified of old on Sinai, the most glorious one mystically beholding the back parts of God (Exod. 33:23); he described the strange wonder; and now Mary, fervently falling down before the all-pure image of the Manna-receiving Urn, leads an angelic life![^2505]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Мѡѷсе́й просла́висѧ нѣ́когда на сїна́и, бж҃їаѧ, за́днѧѧ та́инственнѡ ви́дѣвъ пресла́вный, подпи́са стра́нное чу́до, маннопрїе́мной же ста́мнѣ ны́нѣ, ѡ҆́бразу прⷱ҇чтомꙋ те́плѣ припа́дши, ма́рїа а҆́гг҃лское житїѐ но́ситъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Desiring to behold the beauty of Thy temple after the manner of the Psalms, and the noetic habitation of Thy glory (Ps. 25:8 LXX), she who had defiled Thy temple, having through noetic prayers become the temple of Thy Virgin Mother, [cried]: O Christ, make me a temple of the All-Effecting Spirit![^2506]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Desiring to behold the beauty of Thy temple after the manner of the Psalms, and the noetic habitation of Thy glory (Ps. 25:8 LXX), she who had defiled Thy temple, having through noetic prayers become the temple of Thy Virgin Mother, [cried]: O Christ, make me a temple of the All-Effecting Spirit![^2506]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Хра́ма бл҃голѣ́пїѧ твое́гѡ возжела́вши, ѱало́мски ви́дѣти, ᲂу҆́мное же селе́нїе сла́вы твоеѧ̀, тво́й хра́мъ ѡ҆скверни́вшаѧ, ᲂу҆́мными мл҃твами, хрⷭ҇тѐ неискусому́жнагѡ твое́гѡ хра́ма бы́вши, хра́мъ мѧ̀ вседѣ́тельнагѡ сотворѝ дх҃а:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having through the eyes ensnared the members of many by the flesh with brief pleasure and made them food for the devil, she was truly captured by the divine grace of the precious Cross, having become sweeter food for Christ![^2507]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:* Having through the eyes ensnared the members of many by the flesh with brief pleasure...
...and made them food for the devil, she was truly captured by the divine grace of the precious Cross, having become sweeter food for Christ![^2507]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: е҃ а҃ : по́ста Ѱп҃г
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Taught concerning the mystery that is in Thee by mystical theologies, O All-Pure One, the choir of Prophets foretold Thee in diverse manners; and now this Mary, falling down before the all-pure image of the Manna-receiving Urn, is a pledge for sinners unto God![^2508]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Taught concerning the mystery that is in Thee by mystical theologies, O All-Pure One, the choir of Prophets foretold Thee in diverse manners; and now this Mary, falling down before the all-pure image of the Manna-receiving Urn, is a pledge for sinners unto God![^2508]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: сла́стїю кра́ткою, снѣ́дь же дїа́волꙋ си́хъ сътво́ршаѧ, ᲂу҆ло́влена бы́сть всеи́стиннѡ, бж҃твенною бл҃гтїю, крⷭ҇та̀ чⷭ҇тна́гѡ, сла́дшаѧ хв҃и снѣ́дь бы́вши:
items.english_text: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are my iniquities, and bring me up from the abyss of evils, I pray Thee; for unto Thee have I cried, and give ear unto me, O God of my salvation!*[^2509]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 6. Heirmos: Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are my iniquities, and bring me up from the abyss of evils, I pray Thee; for unto Thee have I cried, and give ear unto me, O God of my salvation!*[^2509]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о: Наꙋче́нъ ли́къ прⷪ҇ро́ческїй, та́инству є҆́же ѡ҆ тебѣ̀, та́инственными бг҃осло́вїи прⷱ҇чтаѧ, тебѐ разноѡ҆бра́знѡ предгла̀, маннопрїе́мныѧ же ста́мны ны́нѣ, ѡ҆́бразу прⷱ҇чтомꙋ сїѧ̀ припа́дши, ма́рїа спору́чница грѣ́шнымъ къ бг҃ꙋ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The rich man condemned himself unto the fiery flame by a voluptuous life; but Lazarus the poor man, encompassed by poverty in life, was accounted worthy of unending joy![^2510]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The rich man condemned himself unto the fiery flame by a voluptuous life; but Lazarus the poor man, encompassed by poverty in life, was accounted worthy of unending joy![^2510]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. И҆рмо́съ. Ѡ҆чи́сти мѧ̀ сп҃се:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* In the bosom of Abraham, Lazarus is accounted worthy to delight in eternal life; but in the fire the rich man is condemned in soul and body, being tormented![^2511]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* In the bosom of Abraham, Lazarus is accounted worthy to delight in eternal life; but in the fire the rich man is condemned in soul and body, being tormented![^2511]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Бога́тый себѐ пла́мени ѻ҆́гненному ѡ҆судѝ, присла́стнымъ житїе́мъ: ни́щїй же ла́зарь, ᲂу҆бо́жествомъ ѡ҆б̾ѧ́тъ въ житїѝ, подо́бисѧ несконча́емыѧ ра́дости:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The rich man is condemned unto the fire because of Lazarus: condemn me not, a wretched man, I pray Thee, O Lord Lover of mankind; but like Lazarus, account me worthy of Thy radiance![^2512]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The rich man is condemned unto the fire because of Lazarus: condemn me not, a wretched man, I pray Thee, O Lord Lover of mankind; but like Lazarus, account me worthy of Thy radiance![^2512]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Въ нѣ́дрехъ ꙗ҆враа́млихъ ла́зарь сподоблѧ́етсѧ, вѣ́чнагѡ живота̀ наслажда́ѧсѧ: ѻ҆гни́ же бога́тый дꙋше́ю и҆ тѣ́ломъ ѡ҆суди́сѧ му́чѧсѧ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* May we be delivered from grievous transgressions by Thy prayers, O pure Mother of God, and may we receive divine illumination from the Son of God, Who was ineffably incarnate of Thee![^2513]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* May we be delivered from grievous transgressions by Thy prayers, O pure Mother of God, and may we receive divine illumination from the Son of God, Who was ineffably incarnate of Thee![^2513]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆сужде́нъ є҆́стъ въ ѻ҆́гнь бога́тый ла́зара ра́ди: не ѡ҆судѝ менѐ ѡ҆ка́ѧннаго молю́сѧ, чл҃вколю́бче гдⷭ҇и, но ꙗ҆́кѡ ла́зарѧ свѣ́тлости твоеѧ̀ сподо́би:
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos, Tone 6. The lowest abyss:*[^2514]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Another Heirmos, Tone 6. The lowest abyss:*[^2514]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о: Да и҆зба́вимсѧ лю́тыхъ прегрѣше́нїй мл҃твами твои́ми, бг҃омт҃и чⷭ҇таѧ, и҆ да получи́мъ бж҃твенное просвѣще́нїе, и҆з̾ тебѐ несказаннѡ вопло́щшагосѧ сн҃а бж҃їѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The angelic hosts rejoice over thee, O Mary, beholding in thee, O venerable one, a life equal unto theirs, and they cry aloud glory unto God![^2515]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The angelic hosts rejoice over thee, O Mary, beholding in thee, O venerable one, a life equal unto theirs, and they cry aloud glory unto God![^2515]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: И҆ны́й И҆рмо́съ: Бе́здна послѣ́днѧѧ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The assemblies of gloomy demons are struck with dread at the strength of thy patient endurance, seeing how as a woman, glorious, naked, and alone, thou didst prevail over them![^2516]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The assemblies of gloomy demons are struck with dread at the strength of thy patient endurance, seeing how as a woman, glorious, naked, and alone, thou didst prevail over them![^2516]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ра́дуйсѧ ма́рїе а҆́гг҃лскаѧ во́инства, ра́вное прпⷣбнаѧ житїѐ си́мъ въ тебѣ̀ зрѧ́ще, и҆ сла́ву бг҃у возопїю́тъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou didst shine forth even as the sun, O Mary all-praised and with wonders hast enlightened all the wilderness; therefore clarify me also with light![^2517]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:* Thou didst shine forth even as the sun, O Mary all-praised...
...and with wonders hast enlightened all the wilderness; therefore clarify me also with light![^2517]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ѱп҃д Недѣ́лѧ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* The Angels, enlightened by the glory of Thy childbearing, cried aloud, O Virgin: "Peace on earth unto all of us, and good will unto men!" (Luke 2:14).[^2518]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* The Angels, enlightened by the glory of Thy childbearing, cried aloud, O Virgin: "Peace on earth unto all of us, and good will unto men!" (Luke 2:14).[^2518]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: и҆ пусты́ню чудесы̀ всю̀ просвѣти́ла є҆сѝ, тѣ́мже и҆ менѐ свѣ́томъ ᲂу҆ꙗ҆снѝ:
items.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь):* Having formerly been filled with all manner of harlotry, she is shown forth today through repentance as the bride of Christ, following the angelic citizenship; she destroys all demons by the weapon of the Cross; therefore thou hast been revealed as a betrothed of the Kingdom, O Mary most glorious![^2519]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Kontakion, Tone 3, Podoben: "Today the Virgin" (Дѣ́ва дне́сь):*
Having formerly been filled with all manner of harlotry, she is shown forth today through repentance as the bride of Christ, following the angelic citizenship; she destroys all demons by the weapon of the Cross; therefore thou hast been revealed as a betrothed of the Kingdom, O Mary most glorious![^2519]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о: А҆́гг҃ли просвѣти́вшесѧ сла́вою рожества̀ твоегѡ̀, на землѝ ми́ръ всѣ́мъ на́мъ, и҆ бл҃говоле́нїе чл҃кѡмъ дв҃о возопи́ша:
items.english_text: *Ikos:* Let us hymn now with songs the ewe-lamb and daughter of Christ, Mary ever-memorable, who was revealed as a sheep of Egypt, who also escaped from all their deceit, and was brought unto the Church as a whole offering, struggling in temperance and prayer beyond the measure of human nature; therefore the One Almighty Sovereign exalted the life and deeds of Mary most glorious![^2520]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ikos:* Let us hymn now with songs the ewe-lamb and daughter of Christ, Mary ever-memorable, who was revealed as a sheep of Egypt, who also escaped from all their deceit, and was brought unto the Church as a whole offering, struggling in temperance and prayer beyond the measure of human nature; therefore the One Almighty Sovereign exalted the life and deeds of Mary most glorious![^2520]

items.slavonic_text: Ко́: Гла́, г҃. По́: Дв҃аѧ дне́сь: Блꙋда́ми пе́рвѣе преиспо́лненна всѧ́ческими, хв҃а невѣ́ста дне́сь покаѧ́нїемъ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ, а҆́гг҃лскому гражда́нству послѣ́дующи, де́мѡны всѧ̀ крⷭ҇та̀ ѡ҆рꙋ́жїемъ погублѧ́етъ, сегѡ́ради црⷭ҇твїѧ ѡ҆бру́чница ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ марі́е пресла́внаѧ:
items.english_text: *On the Fifth Sunday of the Holy Great Fast, we celebrate the memory of our Venerable Mother Mary of Egypt, according to the ordinance of the later Holy Fathers. Father, be pleased to read.*[^2521]

items.slavonic_text: Прпⷣбнаѧ марі́а была̀ зъ є҆гѵ́пта, и҆з̾ мо́лодости на́продъ пожи́вши въ бшетенстве пре седмна́дцать лѣ́тъ непобѣга́лнѣ, и҆ презъ такову́ю причи́ну пришла̀ допоку́ты. Оу҆ба́чила молодє́нцовъ нѣ́которыхъ вступа́ючихъ до ѻ҆кро́вта, и҆ запыта́ла и҆́хъ доколѧ̀ бы шлѝ; и҆ реклѝ є҆́й: До і҆ерусали́му, навѣ́дле покло́ну чⷭ҇тному крⷭ҇ту: и҆ проси́ла и҆́хъ, же́бы є҆́и взѧли зъ собо́ю, не длѧ тогѡ́ жебы ѡ҆на̀ мѣ́ла пра́гнути поклони́тисѧ чⷭ҇тному крⷭ҇ту, а҆́ле же несы́тости грѣха̀ была̀ па́лена, и҆ вше́дши въ кора́бль мно́гихъ змаза́ла. А҆ въ і҆ерусали́мѣ бы́вши, заборо́нено є҆́й было̀ войтѝ доворо́тъ цр҃ко́вныхъ пре[зъ] а҆́гг҃ла где збаве́нное де́рево чⷭ҇тна́гѡ крⷭ҇та̀ было̀, и҆ по три кро́ть кусѧ́чися и҆ ᲂу҆силу́ючи войтѝ невошла̀, и҆ намы́слъ собѣ̀ приведши всѣ̀ своѝ грѣхѝ, ᲂу҆ступи́ла въ ᲂу҆́гол притво́ра цр҃ко́вногѡ, и҆ та́мъ ѡ҆ба́чила ѡ҆́бразъ прⷱ҇то́и Бц҃ы [catchword]
items.english_text: *On the first of April Mary found death in the wilderness.*[^2522]

items.english_text: The venerable Mary was from Egypt. From her youth she lived at first in wantonness for seventeen years unrestrainedly; and through this cause she came unto repentance: She beheld certain young men embarking upon a ship, and asked them whither they were going; and they said unto her: "Unto Jerusalem, for the sake of the veneration of the precious Cross." And she begged them to take her with them, not because she desired to venerate the precious Cross, but because she was burned with the insatiability of sin; and having entered into the ship, she defiled many. And being in Jerusalem, she was forbidden by an Angel to enter the church gates where the saving Wood of the precious Cross was; and having tried three times and striving to enter, she entered not; and having recalled unto her mind all her sins, she withdrew into a corner of the church porch, and there beheld an icon of the All-Pure Theotokos; and deeply repenting of her sins, she said: "O All-Pure Theotokos, who didst bear Christ the Savior for all the world! I know, yea, I know that it is not fitting for me, unclean and wanton, to look upon Thy holy icon; and indeed it is a just thing that I should remain in hatred and abomination before God; yet do Thou be a surety for my repentance!" And having said this, she departed into the wilderness, and gave herself over unto great penitence and virtues; and she was so greatly exalted by dispassion that she even crossed watery rivers on foot. And when she prayed unto God, then she was borne aloft in the air. And having crossed the Jordan, she lived in the wilderness forty-seven years,[^2523] toiling uncovered and naked, and saw no man, except the blessed Father Zosimas who saw her, and she never abandoned human nature. And at last, according to God's providence, she appeared unto holy Elder Zosimas, when he had entered into the inner wilderness; and having spoken with him and related everything concerning herself, in the following year she crossed the Jordan on foot again, and having partaken of the All-Pure and Life-Creating Mysteries from the holy man, returned unto her place; and by the stream where she had spoken with Zosimas, she fell asleep [in the Lord]. And the following year, when Zosimas went, he found her relics; and when he could not bury her, a lion came and with its forepaws dug a grave for the blessed woman, by the providence of God; and Elder Zosimas buried her in the Mayum mountains,[^2524] and returned, giving glory unto God, One in Trinity, always, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.[^2525]

items.slavonic_text: Бц҃ы и҆ свои́хъ грѣхѡ́въ пере́ней ка́ючисѧ, мо́вила: Ѡ҆ Прⷱ҇та́ѧ Бц҃е, кото́раѧсь породи́ла Збави́телѧ Хрⷭ҇та̀ всемꙋ̀ свѣ́ту: Вѣ́даю те́ды вѣ́даю, и҆жъ не є҆́стъ ре́чъ слу́шнаѧ, мнѣ̀ нечи́стой и҆ бшетє́чной, на сты́й ѡ҆́бразъ тво́й смотри́ти, и҆ ѡ҆́вшемъ справедли́ваѧ є҆́стъ ре́чъ, же́бымъ въ ненависти и҆ ѡ҆фердли́вости зостава́ла передъ Бг҃омъ: є҆дна́къ ты мнѣ̀ бꙋ́дь рѣкойцемъ мое́и поку́ты: И҆ то ре́кши, ѿошла̀ до пу́щи, и҆ ѡ҆дала̀ себѐ въ вели́кꙋю покутливость и҆ цно́ты, и҆ та́къ ба́рзо вы́вышена є҆́стъ безстра́стїемъ, же и҆ рѣ́ки водни́стыи нога́ми переходи́ла. И҆ гды̀ мл҃ѧ́ласѧ Бг҃ꙋ, тогды̀ поно́шена была̀ на повѣ́тре. А҆ гды̀ прешла̀ I҆орда́нъ, ме́шкала на пу́щи чтырыдесѧ́тъ се́мъ лѣ́тъ, працу́ючи безприкры́та нага́ѧ, и҆ жа́дного чл҃ка неви́дѣла, то́лко бл҃же́дного ѻ҆тца̀ Зо́сима который є҆́и ви́дѣлъ, и҆ чл҃чкого прироже́нѧ не ѿсту́петъ нѣ́гды. А҆ наѡста́токъ ведлꙋ́гъ ѡ҆па́трности Бж҃їои, ѡ҆каза́ласѧ [и҆̀] Зо́симѣ ст҃о́му ста́рцу, гды̀ ѻ҆́нъ въ вну́трнии вшо́лъ бы́лъ пꙋсты́ни, и҆ зни́мъ ѡ҆на̀ розмо́вивши и҆ ѡ҆ собѣ̀ все вы́повѣдавши зно́ву въ при́шлый ро́къ I҆орда́нъ пѣ́ша преше́дши, и҆ причасти́вшисѧ Прⷱ҇тыхъ и҆ Животворѧ́щихъ Та́инъ, ѿ ст҃гѡ, на своѐ верну́ласѧ мѣ́сто, и҆ при пото́цѣ, где зъ Зо́симою розмовлѧ́ла, засну́ла. И҆ въ при́шлый ро́къ ше́дши Зо́сима, знашо́лъ, мо́щи є҆́и, и҆ гды̀ не мо́гъ погрестѝ є҆́и, прише́дши ле́въ передними нога́ми вы́копалъ бл҃же́нной ꙗ҆́му, зъ про́мыслу Бж҃огѡ, и҆ погре́бъ є҆́и ста́рецъ Зо́сима въ гора́хъ Ма́емски, и҆ верну́лсѧ ѿдаю́чи сла́ву Бг҃ꙋ въ Тр҃цы є҆ди́номꙋ, всегда̀ ны́нѣ и҆ прⷭ҇нѡ, и҆ въ вѣ́ки вѣкѡ́въ, А҆ми́нь.

items.slavonic_text: [Пристереже́нїе: Хто хо́четъ ѡ҆ Житїи Прпⷣбнои сеи доскона́лѣй вѣ́дати, неха́й прочита́етъ По́вѣсть ѡ҆ не́й ст҃гѡ Софро́нїа Патрїа́рхи І҆ерли́мскогѡ, кото́раѧсѧ на само́мъ концѝ тои Кни́ги поклада́етъ. Для тогѡ, же не то́лко въ Четверто́къ Пѧ́тои Нд҃ли По́ста, а҆́ле и҆ вели́когѡ Кано́на где вла́сне належи́ть служи́ть, а҆́ле и҆ тꙋ́тъ чита́тисѧ зъ пожиткомъ душевнымъ, ѿ тщали́выхъ мо́жетъ.]

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Incarnate from the virginal womb, Thou wast revealed for our salvation; therefore knowing Thy Mother to be the Theotokos, gratefully we cry aloud: O God of our fathers, blessed art Thou![^2532]

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о: И҆з̾ ᲂу҆тро́бы дѣ́твенныѧ воплоти́выйсѧ, ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ на сп҃се́нїе на́ше. Тѣ́мже твою̀ мт҃рь вѣ́дуще бц҃у, благода́рственнѡ возопїе́мъ: ѻ҆тц҃ъ на́шихъ бж҃е бл҃венъ є҆сѝ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* The most great among fathers, traversing the wilderness, the wise Zosimas was accounted worthy to behold the venerable woman, and cried: Blessed is the God of our fathers![^2534]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* The most great among fathers, traversing the wilderness, the wise Zosimas was accounted worthy to behold the venerable woman, and cried: Blessed is the God of our fathers![^2534]

items.english_text: *Troparion:* "Why, O father, hast thou come to see a strange woman destitute of every active virtue?" the venerable woman cried unto the elder; and she called out: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers![^2535]

items.slavonic_text: Превели́кїй въ ѻ҆тцѣ́хъ, ѡ҆бхождѧ̀ пусты́ню, зо́сима мꙋ́дры, прпⷣбную ви́дѣти сподо́бисѧ, вопїе́тъ же: бл҃венъ бг҃ъ ѡ҆те́цъ на́шихъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having mortified the itchings of thy passions, O blessed woman, thou hast now hastened unto the haven of dispassion, crying: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers![^2536]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having mortified the itchings of thy passions, O blessed woman, thou hast now hastened unto the haven of dispassion, crying: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers![^2536]

items.slavonic_text: Что̀ ѻ҆́ч҃е стра́нное всѧ́кїѧ добродѣ́тели, дѣ́телныѧ ви́дѣти прише́лъ є҆сѝ же́нище, прпⷣбнаѧ взыва́ше ста́рцу бл҃венъ є҆сѝ, зове́тъ же, бж҃е ѻ҆тц҃ъ на́шихъ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Ineffably Thou didst conceive, remaining a virgin, O All-Pure One, and didst bear for the world salvation, Christ our God; therefore all we the faithful magnify Thee with hymns![^2537]

items.slavonic_text: Оу҆мертви́вши бл҃же́ннаѧ, стра́стїй твои́хъ скокта́нїѧ, къ безстра́стїѧ ны́нѣ ᲂу҆стреми́ласѧ є҆сѝ приста́нищу, зовꙋ́щи: бл҃венъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆тц҃ъ на́шихъ:
items.english_text: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Sevenfold the tyrant of the Chaldeans madly kindled the furnace for the pious Children; but seeing them saved by a higher power, he cried unto the Creator and Deliverer: Ye Children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages!*[^2538]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 8. Heirmos: Sevenfold the tyrant of the Chaldeans madly kindled the furnace for the pious Children; but seeing them saved by a higher power, he cried unto the Creator and Deliverer: Ye Children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages!*[^2538]

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о: Зачала̀ є҆сѝ неизрече́ннѡ дв҃ою пребы́вши, прⷱ҇таѧ, и҆ родила̀ є҆сѝ мі́рови сп҃се́нїе хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а на́шегѡ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѝ пѣ́сньми вѣ́рныи велича́емъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* In scarlet raiment, and fine linen, and purple, the wretched rich man arrayed himself brightly of old; while poor Lazarus lay grievously at his gates, desiring to be filled with the crumbs falling from the table, and no one gave unto him; therefore he reigns with Christ in glory![^2539]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* In scarlet raiment, and fine linen, and purple, the wretched rich man arrayed himself brightly of old; while poor Lazarus lay grievously at his gates, desiring to be filled with the crumbs falling from the table, and no one gave unto him; therefore he reigns with Christ in glory![^2539]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, и҃. И҆рмо́съ. Се́дмъ седми́цею:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* At the gates of the rich man lay Lazarus, rotting in his body with wounds, and desired to be filled with food, and no one gave unto him, but even the dogs compassionately licked with their tongues his pus and sores; therefore he was accounted worthy of the paradise of delight![^2540]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:* At the gates of the rich man lay Lazarus, rotting in his body...
...with wounds, and desired to be filled with food, and no one gave unto him, but even the dogs compassionately licked with their tongues his pus and sores; therefore he was accounted worthy of the paradise of delight![^2540]

items.english_text: *Troparion:* I have become rich in pleasures, even as the rich man of old, arraying himself each day in purple; and I, O Plenteous in mercy, in the delights of this life condemn myself by pleasures and deceits; therefore I pray Thee: deliver me from eternal fire, O Christ, unto all ages![^2541]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* I have become rich in pleasures, even as the rich man of old, arraying himself each day in purple; and I, O Plenteous in mercy, in the delights of this life condemn myself by pleasures and deceits; therefore I pray Thee: deliver me from eternal fire, O Christ, unto all ages![^2541]

items.slavonic_text: тѣ́ломъ ра́нами, и҆ хотѧ́ше насыща́тисѧ снѣ́ди, и҆ не даѧ́ше є҆му̀ никто́же, но и҆ псѝ сострада́телно ꙗ҆зы́комъ ѡ҆близова́ху гно́й и҆ стру́пы є҆гѡ̀. Тѣ́мже въ ра́й сла́дости сподо́бисѧ:
items.english_text: *Triadikon:* O thrice-radiant Godhead, shining forth a single radiance from one tripersonal nature: the Unoriginate Begetter, the Word consubstantial with the Father, and the co-existing consubstantial Spirit: ye Children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supremely exalt unto all ages![^2542]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Triadikon:* O thrice-radiant Godhead, shining forth a single radiance from one tripersonal nature: the Unoriginate Begetter, the Word consubstantial with the Father, and the co-existing consubstantial Spirit: ye Children, bless; ye priests, hymn; ye people, supremely exalt unto all ages![^2542]

items.slavonic_text: Въ сла́стехъ ѡ҆богати́хъсѧ, ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле бога́тый, ѡ҆блача́ѧсѧ на всѧ́къ де́нь въ багрѧни́цу, и҆ а҆́зъ многомлⷭ҇тиве въ сла́дости житїѧ̀ сегѡ̀, себѐ ѡ҆сужда́ю сластьмѝ и҆ пре́лестьми. Тѣ́мже молю́тисѧ, ѿ ѻ҆гнѧ́ ми и҆зба́витися хрⷭ҇тѐ вѣ́чнагѡ, въ всѧ̑ вѣ́ки:
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos, Tone 6. Be astonished, O heaven, and afraid:*[^2543]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Another Heirmos, Tone 6. Be astonished, O heaven, and afraid:*[^2543]

items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Трⷪ҇: Трисвѣ́тлое бж҃тво̀, є҆ди́нственнꙋю сїѧ́ющꙋ зарю̀, ѿ є҆ди́наго трїѷпоста́снагѡ є҆стества̀, роди́телѧ безна́чална, є҆диноесте́ственнаже сло́ва ѻ҆ц҃у, и҆ сосꙋще́ствующа є҆диносу́щна дх҃а, дѣ́ти бл҃вите, сщ҃енні́и воспо́йте лю́дїе, и҆ превозноси́те въ всѧ̑ вѣ́ки:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou Who searchest the depths of the heart, foreknowing all our affairs before being: from a distressing life Thou didst snatch her who fled unto Thee, O Savior, who cries out incessantly unto Thy love for mankind: Ye priests, bless; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto ages![^2544]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Thou Who searchest the depths of the heart, foreknowing all our affairs before being: from a distressing life Thou didst snatch her who fled unto Thee, O Savior, who cries out incessantly unto Thy love for mankind: Ye priests, bless; ye people, supremely exalt Him unto ages![^2544]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST

items.slavonic_text: И҆ны́й И҆рмо́съ. Оу҆жасни́сѧ бо́ѧсѧ нб҃о:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* O honorable change, and thy transformation unto the better, O honorable woman! O divine love that didst hate the passions of the flesh! O fervent and divine faith, O all-praised Mary, which we faithfully hymn and supremely exalt![^2545]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* O honorable change, and thy transformation unto the better, O honorable woman! O divine love that didst hate the passions of the flesh! O fervent and divine faith, O all-praised Mary, which we faithfully hymn and supremely exalt![^2545]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Глꙋбины̀ срⷣца и҆спыта́ѧй, пре́жде бытїѧ̀ пред̾вѣ́дый всѧ̑ на́ша, ну́жднагѡ житїѧ̀ и҆схити́лъ є҆сѝ, прибѣ́гшꙋю к̾ тебѣ̀ сп҃се, ну́жднѡ твое́му чл҃колю́бїю вопїю́щую немо́лчнѡ, сщ҃енници бл҃вите, лю́дїе превозноси́те є҆гѡ̀ въ вѣ́ки:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Thou hast found recompense for thy toils, and reward for thy sweats, O honorable Mary, by which thou didst cast down the ancient enemy, and now with the Angels thou singest a hymn, incessantly calling and supremely exalting Christ unto ages![^2546]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:* Thou hast found recompense for thy toils, and reward for thy sweats, O honorable Mary, by which thou didst cast down the ancient enemy, and now with the Angels...
...thou singest a hymn, incessantly calling and supremely exalting Christ unto ages![^2546]

items.slavonic_text: Ѱп҃н Недѣ́лѧ
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* He Who is Master of all the ages renewed me wholly for the sake of goodness in Thy womb, O Pure One, without departing from the properties of His own nature; therefore as the cause of our salvation, we hymn Thee with songs unto all ages![^2547]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* He Who is Master of all the ages renewed me wholly for the sake of goodness in Thy womb, O Pure One, without departing from the properties of His own nature; therefore as the cause of our salvation, we hymn Thee with songs unto all ages![^2547]

items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS

items.slavonic_text: вопїе́ши пѣ́снь, немо́лчнѡ зовꙋ́щи, и҆ превозносѧ́щи хрⷭ҇та̀ въ вѣ́ки:
items.english_text: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Thee, the unwedded Mother of God the Most High, Whom ineffably through the Word Thou didst conceive, higher than the transcendent Hosts: with ceaseless doxologies we magnify!*[^2548]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Ode 9. Heirmos: Thee, the unwedded Mother of God the Most High, Whom ineffably through the Word Thou didst conceive, higher than the transcendent Hosts: with ceaseless doxologies we magnify!*[^2548]

items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ородиченъ: Всегѡ̀ ѡ҆бнови́ мѧ бл҃гти ра́ди, въ ᲂу҆тро́бѣ твое́й чⷭ҇таѧ, нераста́въсѧ своегѡ̀ є҆стества̀ сво́йствъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ всѣ́хъ вѣ́кѡвъ влⷣка. ѿню́дуже тѧ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ вино́вную на́шегѡ сп҃се́нїѧ, пѣ́сньми воспѣва́емъ въ всѧ̑ вѣ́ки:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Make me like poor Lazarus, O Christ, I pray Thee, destroying my desires for pleasures, as Thou art God by nature; and make me rich in virtues, that in faith I may magnify Thee in hymnody![^2549]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Make me like poor Lazarus, O Christ, I pray Thee, destroying my desires for pleasures, as Thou art God by nature; and make me rich in virtues, that in faith I may magnify Thee in hymnody![^2549]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. И҆рмо́съ. Тѧ̀ неискусобра́чную:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Rich and heartless, I have sinned with my mind against the faith of Thy commandments, O Lover of mankind, cast down grievously before the gates; but as Thou art compassionate and plenteous in mercy, raise me up even as of old Thou didst raise Lazarus, Thy four-days-dead friend![^2550]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Rich and heartless, I have sinned with my mind against the faith of Thy commandments, O Lover of mankind, cast down grievously before the gates; but as Thou art compassionate and plenteous in mercy, raise me up even as of old Thou didst raise Lazarus, Thy four-days-dead friend![^2550]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ни́щаго мѧ ла́зара, хрⷭ҇тѐ молю́сѧ содѣ́лай сла́стїй вожделѣ́нїѧ моѧ̀ потреблѧ́ѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆стество́мъ бг҃ъ, добродѣ́телми же мѧ̀, бога́та сотворѝ, да вѣ́рою въ пѣснопѣ́нїихъ велича́ю тѧ̀:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* We have all learned from the Master's parable; let all of us, the faithful, hate the heartlessness of the rich man, that we may escape torment, and ever dance in the bosom of Abraham![^2551]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* We have all learned from the Master's parable; let all of us, the faithful, hate the heartlessness of the rich man, that we may escape torment, and ever dance in the bosom of Abraham![^2551]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Бога́тый и҆ безꙋтро́бный, ᲂу҆́мъ мо́й прегрѣши́хъ, вѣ́рою твои́хъ заповѣ́дїй чл҃вколю́бче, пре[дъ] враты по́верженъ лю́тѣ. Но ꙗ҆́кѡ сострада́теленъ, и҆ любѡще́дръ возста́ви, ꙗ҆́кѡже дре́вле четверодне́вна дрꙋ́га ла́зара:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thee, who didst bear in Thine arms the invisible God Who is hymned in the heavens by every creature, and through Thee ever grants us salvation, we magnify in faith![^2552]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Thee, who didst bear in Thine arms the invisible God Who is hymned in the heavens by every creature, and through Thee ever grants us salvation, we magnify in faith![^2552]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Всѝ и҆звыко́хѡмъ при́тчѣ влⷣчней, всѝ ᲂу҆́бѡ вѣ́рнїи возненави́димъ бога́тагѡ безꙋтро́бное, да му́ки и҆збѣ́гнемъ, и҆ въ нѣ́дрехъ ꙗ҆враа́млихъ прⷭ҇нѡ ликꙋ́емъ:
items.english_text: *Another Heirmos, Tone 6. Lament Me not, O Mother:*[^2553]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Another Heirmos, Tone 6. Lament Me not, O Mother:*[^2553]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃ородиченъ: Тебѐ неви́димагѡ бг҃а носи́вшую ѡ҆б̾ѧ́тїи, на нб҃сехъ воспѣва́емагѡ ѿ всѧ́кагѡ созда́нїѧ, и҆ тобо́ю на́мъ да́рующагѡ всегда̀ сп҃се́нїе, въ вѣ́рѣ велича́емъ:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Readily didst thou endure the wilderness toil, O mother, strengthened by the sovereign power of Christ; for with streams of divine tears didst thou quench the defiled thoughts that assailed thee, O honorable one, height of ascetics, boast of the venerable![^2554]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Readily didst thou endure the wilderness toil, O mother, strengthened by the sovereign power of Christ; for with streams of divine tears didst thou quench the defiled thoughts that assailed thee, O honorable one, height of ascetics, boast of the venerable![^2554]

items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: е҃ а҃ : по́ста Ѱп҃ѳ
items.english_text: *Troparion:* With all-radiant beams the Virgin and Pure One, who alone bare Christ the Light, enlightens thee; she renders thee terrible unto enemies, O honorable woman, and makes thee manifest unto all, O Mary: beauty of fast-runners,[^2555] confirmation of the venerable!

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* With all-radiant beams the Virgin and Pure One, who alone bare Christ the Light, enlightens thee; she renders thee terrible unto enemies, O honorable woman, and makes thee manifest unto all, O Mary: beauty of fast-runners,[^2555] confirmation of the venerable!

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Пресвѣтлѣ́йшими лучáми, просвѣща́етъ тѧ̀ є҆ди́на свѣ́тъ поро́ждшаѧ хрⷭ҇та̀, дв҃а и҆ чⷭ҇таѧ, стра́шную врагѡ́мъ тебѐ поставлѧ́етъ чⷭ҇тнаѧ, ꙗ҆́вственную же всѣ́мъ марі́а ꙗ҆влѧ́етъ тѧ̀, стрѣле́цъ красото̀, прпⷣбнымъ ᲂу҆твержде́нїе:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Having abandoned all earthly things as a yoke, thou wast revealed as an honorable dwelling of the Spirit; pray thou unto Christ, the only Deliverer, that they who faithfully celebrate thy divine memory may be freed from worldly evils![^2556]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Having abandoned all earthly things as a yoke, thou wast revealed as an honorable dwelling of the Spirit; pray thou unto Christ, the only Deliverer, that they who faithfully celebrate thy divine memory may be freed from worldly evils![^2556]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ста́вивши ꙗ҆́рмѡ земна́ѧ всѧ̑, жили́ще чⷭ҇тное дх҃а ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ, мі́рскихъ ᲂу҆́бѡ лю́тыхъ свободи́тисѧ, молѝ є҆ди́нагѡ хрⷭ҇та̀ свободи́телѧ, вѣ́рнѡ соверша́ющымъ бж҃твенную па́мѧть твою̀:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Hidden beyond nature from the laws of nature, O Virgin, Thou didst bear on earth a new Babe, O Pure One, Who is the Lawgiver and the Ancient of Days (Dan. 7:9), the noetic Heaven, the Creator of all; therefore in faith and love we call Thee blessed![^2557]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* Hidden beyond nature from the laws of nature, O Virgin, Thou didst bear on earth a new Babe, O Pure One, Who is the Lawgiver and the Ancient of Days (Dan. 7:9), the noetic Heaven, the Creator of all; therefore in faith and love we call Thee blessed![^2557]

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Бг҃о: Зако́нѡвъ є҆стества̀ дв҃о, па́че є҆стества̀ ᲂу҆таи́вшисѧ, но́вое ѻ҆троча̀ на землѝ родила̀ є҆сѝ чⷭ҇таѧ, законодавца сꙋ́ща и҆ ве́тха деньмѝ, мы́сленное нб҃о, всѣ́хъ творца̀. Тѣ́мъ вѣ́рою и҆ любо́вїю тебѐ ᲂу҆блажа́емъ:
items.english_text: *Exapostilarion, Resurrectional.*[^2558] *Then of the Venerable Mother, Tone 3, Podoben: "Having adorned heaven with stars" (Не́бо ѕвѣзда́ми):*

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Exapostilarion, Resurrectional.*[^2558]
*Then of the Venerable Mother, Tone 3, Podoben: "Having adorned heaven with stars" (Не́бо ѕвѣзда́ми):*

items.office: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.season_or_tone: PART II: THE HOLY AND GREAT FORTY DAYS
items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.slavonic_text: Свѣти́ленъ, вскрⷭ҇нъ.
items.english_text: Having thee as a pattern of repentance, O all-venerable Mary, pray thou unto Christ that in the time of the fast this may be granted unto us, so that in faith and love we may praise thee with hymns![^2559]

provenance.verbatim_source: Having thee as a pattern of repentance, O all-venerable Mary, pray thou unto Christ that in the time of the fast this may be granted unto us, so that in faith and love we may praise thee with hymns![^2559]

items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Та́же Прпⷣбной, По́: Нб҃о ѕвѣзда́ми: Ѡ҆́бразъ
items.slavonic_text: Та́же Прпⷣбной, По́: Нб҃о ѕвѣзда́ми: Ѡ҆́бразъ покаѧ́нїѧ тебѐ и҆мꙋ́ще всепрпⷣбнаѧ, марі́е хрⷭ҇та̀ молѝ, во вре́мени по́ста, семꙋ̀ на́мъ дарова́тисѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ да въ вѣ́рѣ и҆ любвѝ, тѧ̀ пѣ́сньми восхва́лѧемъ:
items.english_text: *Theotokion, Podoben:* O Sweetness of the Angels, Joy of the afflicted, Protectress of Christians, O Virgin Mother of the Lord: intercede for me, and save me from eternal torments![^2560]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion, Podoben:*
O Sweetness of the Angels, Joy of the afflicted, Protectress of Christians, O Virgin Mother of the Lord: intercede for me, and save me from eternal torments![^2560]

items.slavonic_text: На хвали́те стїхи̑ры воскрⷭ҇ны въ ѻ҆кто́ихꙋ, д҃. И҆ а҆нато́лїескїи, д҃. Та́же глаго́лемъ стї́хъ: Воскрⷭ҇нѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е мо́й: Самогла́сна, гла́съ а҃. Нѣ́сть црⷭ҇тво бж҃їе пи́ща и҆ питїѐ: но пра́вда и҆ воздержа́нїе съ ст҃о́стїю. Тѣ́мже ни бога́тїи вни́дутъ въ нѐ, но є҆ли́цы сокро́вища своѧ̑ въ ру́кы ни́щихъ влага́ютъ. Сїѧ̑ и҆ дв҃дъ прⷪ҇ро́къ глаго́лѧ ᲂу҆чи́тъ: Пра́венъ мꙋ́жъ ми́луѧй ве́сь де́нь, наслажда́ѧисѧ гдⷭ҇емъ, и҆ въ свѣ́тѣ ходѧ́й, непоткне́тсѧ. Сїѧ́ [catchword]
items.english_text: The Kingdom of God is not food and drink, but righteousness and temperance with holiness (Rom. 14:17); therefore the rich shall not enter into it, but whosoever lay their treasures into the hands of the poor. These things David the Prophet also teaches, saying: "Righteous is the man that shows mercy all the day (Ps. 36:26 LXX [37:26]); delighting in the Lord, and walking in the light, he shall not stumble!"[^2562]

provenance.verbatim_source: The Kingdom of God is not food and drink, but righteousness and temperance with holiness (Rom. 14:17); therefore the rich shall not enter into it, but whosoever lay their treasures into the hands of the poor. items.slavonic_text: На лѵргїи. Блаже́нна, и҆ про́: Гла́сꙋ. А҆пⷭ҇лъ къ є҆вре́ѡмъ, з҃: тка. Бра́тїе: Хрⷭ҇тосъ прише́дъ а҆рхїере́й: А҆лли: Гла́су. Е҆ѵлїе, ѿ ма́рка, за́: м҃з. Въ вре́мѧ ѻ҆́но: Пое́мъ і҆и҃съ двана́десѧте: Прича́сте, Хвали́те:

items.section: On the same Sunday, at Vespers: The customary beginning. Stichera on 10: of the Oktoechos, 4, as was indicated folio 333 (see fol. 333)[^2567]; and of the Triodion, 6. Tone 1, Podoben: "O all-lauded martyrs" (Прехва́льнїи му́ченицы)

items.day_or_date: FIFTH SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FAST
items.podoben_slavonic_witness: Та́же Прпⷣбной, По́: Нб҃о ѕвѣзда́ми: Ѡ҆́бразъ
items.slavonic_text: Въ тꙋ́юже нл҃ю, в̾ ве́че, ѡ҆бы: Стїхи̑ры на і҃: въ ѻ҆кто́и: д҃. Ꙗ҆́кѡже ᲂу҆каза́сѧ лїс, тл҃г. И҆ ѿ трїѡ́ди, ѕ҃. Гла́съ, а҃. По́: Прехва́льнїи мꙋ́чнцы:
items.english_text: Becoming poor though Thou wast rich, O Christ, Thou hast enriched men with immortality and radiance (2 Cor. 8:9); therefore enrich me with virtues, who have become poor through the pleasures of life, and number me with poor Lazarus, delivering me from the rich man's torment, and from the Gehenna set before me![^2568]

items.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆бнища́въ бога́тъ сы́й хрⷭ҇тѐ, чл҃цы ѡ҆богати́лъ є҆сѝ, безсме́ртїемъ и҆ свѣ́тлостїю. Тѣ́мже ѡ҆бнища́вшаго сластьмѝ житїѧ̀, добродѣ́телми мѧ̀ ѡ҆богатѝ, и҆ ни́щому ла́зарю причтѝ, бога́тагѡ мѧ̀ муче́нїѧ и҆зба́ви, и҆ гее́нны предлежа́щїѧ мѝ:
items.english_text: I have become rich in malice grievously, and have loved wanton feeding, and have delighted in the sweet things of life, O Lord, and am condemned unto the fire of Gehenna; melting away with hunger in mind, despised like Lazarus, cast down before the gates of divine deeds, have compassion on me, O Master![^2569]

items.slavonic_text: И҆ны́и. Гла́съ, а҃. По: О҆́блакъ тѧ̀ легкі́й:
items.english_text: Diligently beginning the sixth week of the honorable fasts, O faithful, let us offer unto the Lord a forefeast hymn of the Palms, unto Him Who comes in glory by the power of the Godhead into Jerusalem to slay death; therefore let us piously prepare symbols of victory, branches of virtues, crying aloud: "Hosanna!" unto the Creator of all![^2570]

items.slavonic_text: Сла́ва: (ст҃му а́ще и́матъ,) И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Вхо́дъ ѡ҆бы́чный. Проки́менъ вели́кїй. Гла́съ, и҃. Да́лъ є҆сѝ достоѧ́нїе: Съ стїхѝ є҆гѡ̀, И҆щѝ въ нл҃ю а҃ю по́ста. Ли́стъ, тл҃г. И҆ про́чее с Покло́ны. На Стїхо́внѣ Ст҃ры Гла́съ, д҃. Чю́денъ сп҃совъ насъ ра́ди чл҃колю́бный нра́въ, хотѧ́щихъ ᲂу҆́бѡ бы́ти ра́зумъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ мимоходѧ́щи имѣ́ѧ, Ла́зарево и҆ бога́тагѡ житїѐ ѡ҆бличѝ. Ѽбо́ю коне́цъ сматрѧ́юще, ѡ҆ва́гѡ ᲂу҆́бѡ бѣжи́мъ немлⷭ҇рдїѧ и҆ безчловѣ́чїѧ, ѡ҆ва́гѡ же поревну́имъ терпѣ́нїю и҆ долгодушїю, во є҆́же съ ни́мъ на А҆враа́мовыхъ нѣ́драхъ ᲂу҆тѣша́ємымъ вопи́ти: Пра́ведный су́дїе Гдⷭ҇и, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Мл҃твами Гдⷭ҇и всѣ́хъ ст҃ы́хъ и҆ Бцⷣы, тво́й ми́ръ да́ждь на́мъ, и҆ поми́луй на́съ ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́нъ ще́дръ: Нбⷭ҇нымъ чи́нѡмъ ра́дованїе, и҆ на землѝ чл҃кѡмъ крѣ́пкаѧ помо́щнице, чⷭ҇таѧ Дв҃о, сп҃си ны к̾ тебѣ̀ прибѣга́ющихъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ на тѧ̀ ᲂу҆пова́нїе съ Бг҃омъ Бцⷣе возложи́хомъ:
items.english_text: *Glory: (unto the Saint, if he have one,) Both now: Theotokion.*[^2572]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Glory: (unto the Saint, if he have one,) Both now: Theotokion.*[^2572]

items.slavonic_text: ПОНЕДѢ́ЛНИКЪ .Ѕ҃. НЕДѢ́ЛИ СТ҃ГО ПО́СТА. НА ОУ҆́ТРНИ, По А҆ллилу́їа, Трⷪ҇чна Гла́су. По а҃й стїхоло́гїи, Сѣда́лна въ Ѻ҆кто́ихꙋ. По в҃ стїхоло: Сѣда́лна. Гла́съ, а҃. По́: Ка́мени зна́менану: Ка́мень ѡ҆вали́лъ є҆сѝ невѣ́жествїѧ Гдⷭ҇и, ѿ моегѡ̀ срⷣца, ᲂу҆мерщвле́нну страстьмѝ, воздви́гни дш҃у мою̀ бл҃гі́й, принести́ тебѣ̀ вѣ́твїѧ добродѣ́телей, ꙗ҆́кѡ побѣди́телю а҆́да, въ ᲂу҆миле́нїи Вл҃ко сподоби, ꙗ҆́кѡ
items.english_text: Wonderful is the Savior's disposition of love for mankind toward us! For possessing as passing knowledge the things that are to come, He exposed the life of Lazarus and of the rich man. Considering the end of both, let us flee from the pitilessness and inhumanity of the one, and emulate the patience and longsuffering of the other, that being comforted with him in the bosom of Abraham, we may cry aloud: O righteous Judge, Lord, glory to Thee![^2574]

provenance.verbatim_source: Wonderful is the Savior's disposition of love for mankind toward us! For possessing as passing knowledge the things that are to come, He exposed the life of Lazarus and of the rich man. Considering the end of both, let us flee from the pitilessness and inhumanity of the one, and emulate the patience and longsuffering of the other, that being comforted with him in the bosom of Abraham, we may cry aloud: O righteous Judge, Lord, glory to Thee![^2574]

items.slavonic_text: да вѣ́чный живо́тъ ᲂу҆лучу̀, пѣсносло́вѧ твоѐ держа́ву, и҆ млⷭ҇рдїе твоѐ, є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче: Б҃о: Чю́до чюдесе́мъ ѡ҆брадо́ваннаѧ, ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ зрѧ́щи тва́рь ра́дуетсѧ, зачала́ бо є҆сѝ безсѣ́меннѡ, и҆ родила́ є҆сѝ неска́заннѡ, є҆го́же чинонача́лїа а҆́гг҃лскаѧ зрѣ́ти немо́гутъ, тогѡ̀ Бцⷣе мл҃и ѡ҆ дш҃ахъ на́шихъ: По г҃. Стїхо: сѣ: Гла́, а҃. По́: Ка́мени зна́менану: Ше́стую нл҃ю по́ста и҆му́ще, предпра́зднственное пѣ́нїе, ва́їа принесе́мъ хрⷭ҇ту̀, грѧду́щому на́съ дѣ́лѧ сѣ́сти на жребѧ́ти ѻ҆́сли, ꙗ҆зы́ческое поклони́ти ꙗ҆́кѡ цр҃ь безслове́сїе, родите́лю, вѣ́тви добродѣ́телей тому̀ вси ᲂу҆гото́вимъ. ꙗ҆́кѡ да въскр҃нїе є҆гѡ̀ ра́дующесѧ ᲂу҆́зримъ: Сла́ва: паки то. И҆ ны́нѣ: бо: Ру́цѣ твоѝ бж҃е́ственнѡ просте́рши. и҆́миже тво́рца носи́ла є҆сѝ, Дв҃о прⷱ҇чтаѧ, воплоще́нна бл҃гости ᲂу҆молѝ и҆зба́вити на́съ ѿ напа́стїй, и҆ страсте́й и҆ бѣ́дъ восхва́лѧющихъ тѧ̀ любо́вїю, и҆ вопїю́щихъ к̾ тебѣ̀, сла́ва все́льшомꙋсѧ въ тѧ̀, сла́ва проше́дшому и҆з̾ тебѐ, сла́ва свободи́вшому на́съ рожество́мъ твои́мъ: ТРІПѢ́СНЕЦЪ, Гла́съ, а҃. Пѣ́снь, а҃. И҆рмо́съ. Пѣ́снь побѣ́дную: Стра́сти ᲂу҆мертви́мъ възде́ржанїемъ, и҆ дх҃ъ ѡ҆живи́мъ бж҃е́ственными дѣ́телми, ꙗ҆́кѡ да ᲂу҆́зримъ ст҃рть хрⷭ҇то́ву все чⷭ҇тну́ю чи́стымъ ᲂу҆мо́мъ: Неми́лостиваго поревнова́вша, бога́тагѡ нра́вомъ, многомл҃тиве гдⷭ҇и молю́ тѧ причти́ мѧ Ла́зарю ни́щому, и҆збавлѧ́ѧ мѧ̀ пла́мене, и҆ негаси́маго ѻ҆гнѧ̀. Ѿ всѣ́хъ пости́хъсѧ и҆справле́нїй, въ сы́тость
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O wonder of wonders, thou who art full of grace! Beholding thee, creation rejoices; for thou didst conceive without seed, and didst bear ineffably Him Whom the ranks of the Angels cannot behold; pray Him, O Mother of God, for our souls![^2579]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Theotokion:*
O wonder of wonders, thou who art full of grace! Beholding thee, creation rejoices; for thou didst conceive without seed, and didst bear ineffably Him Whom the ranks of the Angels cannot behold; pray Him, O Mother of God, for our souls![^2579]

items.english_text: Having the sixth week of the fast, let us offer unto Christ a forefeast hymn of palms, unto Him Who comes for our sake to sit upon the foal of an ass, to bow the irrationality of the Gentiles unto His Father as King; let us all prepare for Him branches of virtues, that rejoicing we may behold His Resurrection![^2580]

Glory to Him that came forth from thee! Glory to Him that hath freed us by thy childbearing![^2581]

items.slavonic_text: наслади́хсѧ прегрѣше́нїй Гдⷭ҇и, нн҃ѣ ᲂу҆́бѡ а҆́лчуща мѧ̀, сп҃се́нныхъ и҆ чⷭ҇тныхъ насы́ти бра́шенъ: Б҃о: Менѐ ѡ҆сужде́ннагѡ въ ѡ҆сужде́нїи, Прⷱ҇чтаѧ Вл҃чце, поверженнагѡ дѣ́лы мои́ми, сп҃сѝ, ᲂу҆ще́дри, всеще́драгѡ Сꙋдїѝ поро́ждшаѧ: И҆ны́й И҆рмо́съ. Гла́съ, а҃. Помо́гшому Бг҃у: Цвѣтоно́сный пра́здникъ, ча́ющимъ вѣ́рні́и, предпразднству́юще є҆гѡ̀ ѿ дне́сь свѣ́тлѡ ꙗ҆́кѡ да Живоно́сную сподо́бимсѧ ст҃рть ви́дѣти: Грѧде́тъ, и҆де́тъ ХС҃, къ І҆ерл҃и́му ꙗ҆́кѡ Цр҃ь, сѣдѧ̀ на жребѧ́ти ѻ҆́сли, ꙗ҆зы́ческое подклони́ти безслове́сїе подъ ꙗ҆ре́мъ Ѻ҆́чїй: Трⷪ҇ичъ. Въ Бж҃твѣ̀ є҆ди́номъ, трїѵпоста́снаѧ є҆ди́нице, Ѻ҆́тче нерожде́нне Бж҃е, и҆ Сн҃е є҆диноро́дне, и҆ є҆ди́не ст҃ы́й Дш҃е, є҆диноцр҃твеннаѧ держа́во, сп҃сѝ покланѧ́ющыѧ ти сѧ: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Пресла́внаѧ возглаго́лашасѧ ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ всѝ дх҃омъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ родила̀ є҆сѝ пло́тїю всѣ́хъ тво́рца, Бцⷣе Мр҃і́е всепѣ́таѧ и҆ неискусобра́чнаѧ: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бг҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Сѐ грѧде́тъ ХС҃ къ гра́ду Виѳсфа́гїи, ра́дуйсѧ Ла́зарево ѻ҆́тч҃ко Виѳа́нїа, ꙗ҆́кѡ тебѣ̀ пока́жетъ чю́до ве́лїе, Ла́зара възставлѧ́ѧ и҆з̾ ме́ртвыхъ: И҆рмо́. Помо́гшому Бг҃у, въ є҆гѵ́птѣ Мсѡѵсе́ѡви, и҆ тѣ́мъ Фараѡ́ново все во́инство пото́пльшомꙋ, побѣ́дную пѣ́снь воспои́мъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́висѧ. Пѣ́снь, и҃. И҆рмо́съ. Е҆го́же ᲂу҆жаса́ютсѧ: Непло́дными ѡ҆богати́хъсѧ, ѡ҆ка́ѧнный, помышле́нми, дш҃у ѡ҆скверни́хъ нечи́стыми сластьмѝ, и҆ тма̀ ѡ҆кружа́етъ мѧ̀ ѿча́нїѧ, ѡ҆зари́ ми сїѧ́нїе, Бж҃е мо́й покаѧ́нїа:
items.english_text: *Theotokion:* O all-pure Sovereign Lady, who didst bear the all-compassionate Judge: save me and have pity on me who am condemned in judgment, cast down by my deeds![^2586]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Theotokion:* O all-pure Sovereign Lady, who didst bear the all-compassionate Judge: save me and have pity on me who am condemned in judgment, cast down by my deeds![^2586]

Сѐ грѧде́тъ ХС҃ къ гра́ду Виѳсфа́гїи, ра́дуйсѧ Ла́зарево ѻ҆́тч҃ко Виѳа́нїа, ꙗ҆́кѡ тебѣ̀ пока́жетъ чю́до ве́лїе, Ла́зара възставлѧ́ѧ и҆з̾ ме́ртвыхъ: И҆рмо́. Помо́гшому Бг҃у, въ є҆гѵ́птѣ Мсѡѵсе́ѡви, и҆ тѣ́мъ Фараѡ́ново все во́инство пото́пльшомꙋ, побѣ́дную пѣ́снь воспои́мъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́висѧ. Пѣ́снь, и҃. И҆рмо́съ. Е҆го́же ᲂу҆жаса́ютсѧ: Непло́дными ѡ҆богати́хъсѧ, ѡ҆ка́ѧнный, помышле́нми, дш҃у ѡ҆скверни́хъ нечи́стыми сластьмѝ, и҆ тма̀ ѡ҆кружа́етъ мѧ̀ ѿча́нїѧ, ѡ҆зари́ ми сїѧ́нїе, Бж҃е мо́й покаѧ́нїа:
items.english_text: *Ode 8, Tone 1. Heirmos: "Him Whom the Angels fear" (Е҆го́же ᲂу҆жаса́ютсѧ):*[^2594] *Troparion:* Wretched that I am, I have become rich in barren thoughts, I have defiled my soul with unclean pleasures, and the darkness of despair encompasses me; shine forth upon me the radiance of repentance, O my God![^2595]

items.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле просвѣти́лъ є҆сѝ слѣпа́го ѿ роже́нїѧ, дш҃у мою̀ просвѣтѝ, неви́дѧщу свѣ́та твое́гѡ мл҃тиве, но въ тмѣ̀ лю́тѣ, лю́тагѡ забве́нїа погре́бшуюсѧ, и҆ печа́лми жите́йскими: По́стивсѧ И҆лїа̀ ѡ҆ве́рзе нб҃са̀, и҆ ту́чами напоѝ жа́ждущу ю зе́млю: пости́мсѧ, стру̑ѧ почерпа́юще душевныхъ сле́зъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ да поми́луємсѧ: Ꙗ҆́кѡ ѡ҆душевленны́й виногра́дъ, процвѣла̀ є҆сѝ на́мъ гро́здъ зрѣ́лый, и҆сточа́ющїй на́мъ чⷭ҇таѧ Дв҃о вїно̀ ѡ҆ставле́нїа, и҆ грѣхо́вное и҆зсуша́ющее пїѧ́нство: И҆ны́й И҆рмо́съ. Пѣ́снь ти прино́симъ: Ѡ҆ве́рзесѧ преддве́рїе Ла́зарева животворе́нїѧ, ХС҃ бо грѧде́тъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ сна̀ воздви́гнути ᲂу҆ме́ршаго, побори́ти жи́знїю сме́рть: Ве́лїѧ ти похвала̀ сѐ Виѳа́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ зижди́телѧ странопрїѧ́ти сподо́биласѧ є҆сѝ, вопїю́щи: бл҃вите дѣ́: Бл҃ви́мъ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ и҆ Сн҃а и҆ ст҃гѡ Дх҃а, Гдⷭ҇а. Трⷪ҇ичъ. Тѧ̀ пресу́щнаѧ, трегу́баѧ є҆дини́це, совокуплѧ́ємаѧ, въ раздѣле́нїи зра́комъ лицъ. Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ и҆ Сн҃а и҆ Дх҃а Бж҃твеннагѡ сла́вимъ: Б҃о: Є҆́же Ра́дуйсѧ вѣща́емъ ти съ А҆́гг҃лы ꙗ҆́кѡ воздви́гла є҆сѝ ра́дость: Сп҃са ми́ра, є҆го́же мл҃и Дв҃о всепѣ́таѧ: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бг҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Пѣ́нїе тебѣ̀ прино́симъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ на жребѧ́ти носи́шисѧ, въ вы́шнихъ на Херуві́мѣхъ ѣ҆здѧ́й, да всѣ́хъ повинѐши Хрⷭ҇те держа́вѣ твое́й: Хва́лимъ бл҃ви́мъ покланѧ́емсѧ Гдⷭ҇и. И҆рмо́. Пѣ́снь ти прино́симъ безпло́тныхъ, ꙗ҆́кѡже дѣ́ти въ пе́щи. и҆ пою́ще глаго́лемъ: Бл҃вите и҆ превозноси́те Хрⷭ҇та̀ въ вѣ́ки:
items.english_text: *Troparion:* Even as of old Thou didst enlighten the man blind from birth, enlighten my soul which sees not Thy light, O Merciful One, but is buried in bitter darkness of bitter oblivion and in worldly cares![^2596]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Troparion:* Even as of old Thou didst enlighten the man blind from birth, enlighten my soul which sees not Thy light, O Merciful One, but is buried in bitter darkness of bitter oblivion and in worldly cares![^2596]

items.english_text: *Troparion:* Great is thy boast, O Bethany! For thou wast vouchsafed to receive as a guest the Creator, crying aloud: "Bless the works of the Lord, ye works of the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto all ages!"[^2601]

items.slavonic_text: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. И҆рмо́съ. Живоно́сный и҆сто́чникъ: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ бы́въ мнѡ́гими прегрѣше́нми небреже́нїа, въ гро́бѣ ѡ҆держи́мъ є҆́смъ, ка́мень ѿча́нїа и҆мѣ́ѧ належа́щїй. є҆го́же расто́ргъ ХС҃ свое́ю мл҃тїю. ꙗ҆́коже Ла́зара пре́жде, ны́нѣ въскреси́ мѧ: Бога́таго ᲂу҆бѣжи́мъ подо́бїа, ѡ҆сужде́ннагѡ въ пла́мень неᲂугаси́мый, и҆ Ла́зара възлюби́мъ въ болѣ́знехъ терпѣ́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ да ѿсю́ду на́мъ ѿше́дшимъ. Живоно́сный и҆сто́чникъ: Оу҆мерщвле́нъ бы́въ мнѡ́гими прегрѣше́нми небреже́нїа, въ гро́бѣ ѡ҆держи́мъ є҆́смъ, ка́мень ѿча́нїа и҆мѣ́ѧ належа́щїй. є҆го́же расто́ргъ ХС҃ свое́ю мл҃тїю. ꙗ҆́коже Ла́зара пре́жде, ны́нѣ въскреси́ мѧ: Бога́таго ᲂу҆бѣжи́мъ подо́бїа, ѡ҆сужде́ннагѡ въ пла́мень неᲂугаси́мый, и҆ Ла́зара възлюби́мъ въ болѣ́знехъ терпѣ́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ да ѿсю́ду на́мъ ѿше́дшимъ. А҆враа́мъ въ ло́нѣ прїи́метъ: Стра́ствоᲂу҆би́йцу По́стъ възлюби́мъ, въ мл҃твахъ приле́жнѡ ᲂу҆праздни́мсѧ, пла́чимъ, рыда́имъ и҆ те́плѣ воздохне́мъ. ꙗ҆́кѡ да на́съ І҆и҃съ ᲂу҆тѣ́шитъ, и҆ цр҃твїа ѡ҆б̾щники сътвори́тъ: Б҃о: Дѣ́вства бж҃твенный сосꙋ́дъ, Пра́ѡтецъ є҆ди́ное и҆справле́нїе, исто́чникъ точа́щїй бл҃гоᲂу҆тро́бїа бе́зⷣну, добро́то І҆а́кѡвлѧ, Бцⷣе. тобо́ю сп҃сае́мїи пое́мъ тѧ̀: И҆ны́й И҆рмо́съ. Тебѐ ви́дѣнїи: Дне́сь ХС҃ сказу́етсѧ, ѡ҆бо́нъ страну̀ І҆орда́на ходѧ́щу. болѣ́знь Ла́зарева, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ прови́децъ гле́тъ: болѣ́знь сїѧ̀ нѣ́сть ны́нѣ къ сме́рти: Бл҃гоᲂу҆гото́висѧ Виѳа́нїе, ᲂу҆красѝ своѧ̑ бж҃е́ственныѧ вхо́ды, разширѝ преддво́рїѧ. Се́ бо Вл҃ка прихо́дитъ съ А҆́пл҃ы, ѻ҆́вчѧ своѐ ѡ҆живлѧ́ѧ: Трⷪ҇ичъ. Тѧ̀ трїѵпоста́вную є҆дини́цу, нераздѣ́лное существо̀, є҆́же Шестокры́лнаѧ, славосло́вѧтъ во́инства, и҆ чл҃вѣ́чїй ро́дъ пѣ́снми велича́емъ: Б҃о: Тебѐ ѿ Ѻ҆ц҃а̀ безлѣ́тнѡ, и҆ ѿ Мт҃ре неска́заннѡ, въ лѣ́то ро́ждшагосѧ въ всѣ́хъ сп҃снїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ

items.slavonic_text: тво́рца и҆ Вл҃ку, въ пѣ́снехъ велича́емъ: Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бг҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀. Съ добротворе́нїа вѣ́твми, и҆ чⷭ҇тоты̀ носѧ́ще ва́їа, ᲂу҆гото́вимъсѧ всѝ Хрⷭ҇ту̀ на срѣ́тенїе, къ І҆ерл҃и́му грѧду́щому ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃у на́шему: И҆рмо́. Тебѐ ви́дѣную две́рь, І҆езекїи́лемъ Прⷪ҇рокомъ, є҆́ѧже никто́же про́йде, то́кмо Бг҃ъ є҆ди́нъ: Бцⷣе Дв҃о пѣ́снми велича́емъ. Досто́йно є҆́стъ: Та́же, Свѣти́лна. На Ст҃і: Ст҃ры самогла́: Гла́съ, а҃. Не ѡ҆судѝ менѐ ХС҃ въ пла́мени гее́нстѣмъ, ꙗ҆́коже бога́таго, ра́ди Ла́зарѧ, но да́руй и҆ мнѣ̀ понѐ пла́че просѧ́щу ка́плѧ, чл҃колю́бїѧ Бг҃е и҆ поми́луй мѧ̀: Бл҃же́нно во́инство Цр҃ѧ нбⷭ҇нагѡ, а́ще бо и҆ земноро́дні́и бы́ша ст҃роте́рпцы, но а҆́гг҃лскїй са́нъ потща́шасѧ дости́гнути, ѡ҆ тѣлесѣ́хъ небре́гше, свои́ми стра́нми, безпло́тныхъ чⷭ҇ти сподо́бишасѧ, тѣ́мже мл҃твами и҆́хъ Гдⷭ҇и, сп҃сѝ дш҃а на́ша: Сла́ва: И҆ ны́нѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ, Гла́съ, то́: Бл҃го́тнаѧ хода́тайствуй твои́ми мл҃твами, и҆ и҆спросѝ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ, мно́жество щедро́тъ, и҆ ѡ҆чище́нїе мно́гихъ прегрѣше́нїй, мо́лимъ сѧ: В ТОЙЖЕ ДНЕ́: .Ѕ҃. НЛ҃И ПО́СТА НА .Ѕ҃. ЧАСѢ́. Тропа́рь Прⷪ҇ро́чества, Гла́съ, ѕ҃. Се́й є҆́стъ Бг҃ъ стра́шный днѣ̀. є҆го́же дости́гнути ве́чера ненадѣ́ємсѧ. и҆ сегѡ̀ ви́дѣти на́съ, чл҃колю́бнѡ сподо́билъ є҆сѝ, трⷪ҇ты́й сла́ва тебѣ̀: Сла́ва: коне́цъ, И҆ ны́нѣ: то́е. Про: ѱа҃: рд҃. Гла́, ѕ҃.

items.english_text: *Martyrikon:* Blessed is the army of the heavenly King! For though the passion-bearers were earthly-born, yet they hastened to attain unto the angelic dignity, taking no heed for their bodies; by their sufferings they were vouchsafed the honor of the bodiless ones; therefore by their prayers, O Lord, save our souls![^2619]

provenance.verbatim_source:

Blessed is the army of the heavenly King! For though the passion-bearers were earthly-born, yet they hastened to attain unto the angelic dignity, taking no heed for their bodies; by their sufferings they were vouchsafed the honor of the bodiless ones; therefore by their prayers, O Lord, save our souls![^2619]

items.slavonic_text: Да возвесели́тъ сѧ срⷣце и҆́щущихъ Гдⷭ҇а. Ст҃х. И҆сповѣ́дайтесѧ Гдⷭ҇еви, и҆ призыва́йте и҆́мѧ є҆гѡ̀. Прⷪ҇ро́чества И҆са́їина чте́нїе, Гла, м҃и. Си́це глаго́летъ Гдⷭ҇ь, и҆збавлѧ́ѧй тѧ̀ ст҃ы́й І҆и҃левъ, а҆́зъ Гдⷭ҇ь Бг҃ъ тво́й, показа́хъ ти ѡ҆брѣстѝ тебѣ̀ пу́ть во́нже по́йдеши по не́мъ. И҆ а́ще бы є҆сѝ послу́шалъ за́повѣдїй мои́хъ, бы́лъ бы ᲂу҆́бѡ ꙗ҆́кѡ рѣка̀ ми́ръ тво́й, и҆ пра́вда твоѧ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ волна̀ морска́ѧ. И҆ бы́ло бы ᲂу҆́бѡ ꙗ҆́кѡ пѣсо́къ морскі́й сѣ́мѧ твоѐ. и҆ и҆сча́дїѧ твоегѡ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ пе́рсть землѧ̀. и҆ нижѐ ны́нѣ потребле́нъ бу́деши, нижѐ поги́бнетъ и҆́мѧ твоѐ предо мно́ю. И҆зы́йди, ѿ Вавѵло́на бѣжа̀ ѿ Халде́ѡвъ, гла́съ весе́лїа возвѣсти́те, и҆ да слы́шано бу́детъ сїѐ, возвѣсти́те да́же до послѣ́днихъ землѝ, гл҃ите: и҆зба́ви Гдⷭ҇ь раба̀ своего̀ І҆а́кѡва. И҆ є҆гда̀ возжа́ждутъ въ пусты́ни поведетъ ѧ̀, во́ду и҆з̾ ка́мене и҆зведе́тъ и҆̀мъ, разсѧ́детъ сѧ ка́мень, и҆ потече́тъ вода̀, и҆ пїю́тъ лю́дїе моѝ. Нѣ́сть ра́доватися нечести́вымъ, гл҃етъ Гдⷭ҇ь. Послу́шайте менѐ ѡ҆́стровы, и҆ внемли́те ꙗ҆зы́цы, чрезъ мно́гое вре́мѧ стоѧ́ти бу́детъ, гл҃етъ Гдⷭ҇ь: ѿ ᲂу҆тро́бы въззва́ мѧ. и҆ ѿ чре́ва ма́тере моеѧ̀, наречѐ и҆́мѧ моѐ. И҆ положѝ ᲂу҆ста̀ моѧ̑ ꙗ҆́кѡ ме́чъ ѻ҆стрый. и҆ покро́въ рукѝ своеѧ̀ сокры́ мѧ, положи́ мѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ стрѣ́лу и҆збра́нную, и҆ въ ту́лѣ свое́мъ сокры́ мѧ. И҆ рече́ ми, ра́бъ мо́й є҆сѝ ты̀ І҆и҃лю, и҆ въ тебѣ̀ просла́влюсѧ. И҆ а́зъ рѣ́хъ: въ тщѐ труди́хсѧ, въсу́е

По́: Всѐ ѿло́жше: Мнѡ́гими прегрѣше́нїи, и҆ сла́стми житїѧ̀, неду́гующу, стѧжа́хъ дш҃у ѡ҆каѧ́нный, и҆ лежꙋ̀ на ѻ҆дрѣ̀ всегда̀ лѣ́ности Вл҃ко, и҆ въспїю́ ти мл҃тиве прише́дъ посѣтѝ, здра́вїе ми подаѧ̀ и҆ мл҃ть, и҆ не ѡ҆ста́ви менѐ, да некогда̀ ᲂу҆сну̀ въ сме́рть, и҆ възра́дуетсѧ вра́гъ ѡ҆ поги́бели мое́й, и҆щѧ́й всегда̀ сп҃се въ а҆́дову глубинꙋ̀ низвести́ мѧ: Немилосе́рдїѧ бога́таго, въ безꙋ́мїи поревнова́въ. сла́достнѡ веселю́сѧ сла́стми и҆ страстьмѝ погружа́ѧсѧ. и҆ ви́дѧ лежа́ща всегда̀ преⷣ две́рьми, покаѧ́нїѧ, ꙗ҆́коже Ла́зара ᲂу҆ма̀ моего̀ Гдⷭ҇и, сегѡ̀ нечу́вственнѡ прехожду̀, гла́доже болѣ́знующа, и҆ ѡ҆струплѧ́ема страстьмѝ. тѣ́мже гее́нскомꙋ пови́ненъ бы́хъ пла́мени. ѿ негѡ́же и҆зба́ви мѧ̀ Вл҃ко, є҆ди́не многомл҃тиве: И҆́на Ст҃ра кѵ̀ Ѳео́дѡра. Гл҃: є҃. По́: Гдⷭ҇и при Мѡѵсе́ин: Гдⷭ҇и ѡ҆бону̀ страну̀ І҆орда́на, пло́тїю ше́ствуѧ. проре́клъ є҆сѝ Ла́зареву болѣ́знь къ сме́рти не бы́ти. но ѡ҆ твое́й Бл҃ншегѡ сла́вѣ, быва́ти. Сла́ва вели́чїю дѣ́лъ твои́хъ, и҆ вседержи́телству твое́му, ꙗ҆́кѡ низложи́лъ є҆сѝ сме́рть, за мно́гую мл҃ть чл҃колю́бче: Та́к Меней. Ве́черъ, Проки́: Ѱал҃: р҃ѕ. Гла́, д҃.
items.english_text: With many transgressions and the pleasures of life diseased, wretched that I am, I have acquired an ailing soul, and I lie upon the bed of sloth always, O Master; and I cry unto Thee, O Merciful One: come and visit me, granting me health and mercy, and leave me not, lest at any time I sleep unto death, and the enemy rejoice over my destruction, who seeks always to cast me down into the depth of Hades, O Savior![^2634]

items.english_text: Having emulated the pitilessness of the rich man in foolishness, I delightfully rejoice, plunging myself into pleasures and passions; and seeing the repentance of my mind lying always before the gates like Lazarus, O Lord, I heedlessly pass him by, ailing with hunger and covered with sores of passions; therefore I have become liable unto the fire of Gehenna, from which deliver me, O Master, Who alone art many-merciful![^2635]

items.english_text: *Another Sticheron of Sir Theodore, Tone 5, Podoben: "Lord, in the days of Moses" (Гдⷭ҇и при Мѡѵсе́ин):* O Lord, journeying in the flesh beyond the Jordan, Thou didst foretell that the sickness of Lazarus was not unto death, but that it should be for the glory of Thine exceeding goodness; glory to the greatness of Thy deeds and to Thine almighty dominion, for Thou hast cast down death through Thy manifold mercy, O Lover of mankind![^2636]

items.slavonic_text: И҆сповѣ́дайтесѧ Гдⷭ҇еви, ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гъ ꙗ҆́кѡ въ вѣ́ки мл҃ть є҆гѡ̀. Ст҃х. Да реку́тъ и҆збавле́нїи прѐ Гдⷭ҇мъ: Бытїѧ̀ Чте́нїе. Глава̀, к҃з. Бы́сть по внегда̀ състарѣ́тисѧ І҆саа́кови, и҆знемого́стѣ ѻ҆́чѣ є҆го̀ є҆́же ви́дѣти. призва̀ И҆са́ѵа сы́на свое́гѡ старѣ́йшаго, и҆ речѐ є҆му̀, сн҃у мо́й, и҆ речѐ, Сѐ а҆́зъ. И҆ речѐ є҆му̀ състарѣ́хсѧ, и҆ невѣ́мъ днѐ сконча́нїѧ мое́го. Нн҃ѣ ᲂу҆́бѡ възмѝ сосꙋ́дъ тво́й, тꙋ́лъ же и҆ лу́къ, и҆ зы́йди на́ поле, И҆ ᲂу҆лови́ ми ло́въ, и҆ сътвори́ ми снѣ́дь, ꙗ҆́коже люблю̀ а҆́зъ, и҆ принеси́ ми да ꙗ҆́мъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ да бл҃ви́тъ тѧ̀ дш҃а моѧ̀, пре́жде да́же не ᲂу҆́мру. Реве́кка же слы́ша гл҃юща І҆саа́ка къ И҆са́ѵу сн҃у своєму̀. И҆зы́йде же И҆са́ѵъ на́ поле ᲂу҆лови́ти ло́въ ѻ҆тцу̀ своєму̀. Реве́кка же речѐ къ І҆а́кѡву сн҃у своєму̀ мнѣ́йшому, Сѐ слы́шахъ ѻ҆тца̀ твое́гѡ гл҃юща, къ И҆са́ѵу бра́ту твое́му, гл҃юща принеси́ ми ло́въ, и҆ сотвори́ ми снѣ́дь, да ꙗ҆ды́й бл҃влю́ тѧ преⷣ Бг҃омъ, пре́жде да́же не ᲂу҆́мру. Нн҃ѣ ᲂу҆́бѡ сы́ну мо́й послу́шай менѐ, ꙗ҆́коже а҆́зъ заповѣ́даю ти. И҆ ше́дъ въ ѻ҆́вца, приведи́ ми ѿту́ду два ко́злища ма́кка и҆ добра̀, и҆ сътвори́ ѧ снѣ́ди ѻ҆тцу̀ твоему̀ ꙗ҆́коже лю́битъ, И҆ внесе́ши ѻ҆тцу̀ твое́му и҆ снѣ́стъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ да бл҃ви́тъ тѧ̀ ѻ҆те́цъ тво́й, пре́жде да́же не ᲂу҆́мретъ. Рече́ же І҆а́кѡвъ, къ Реве́цѣ ма́тери свое́й, є҆́стъ И҆са́ѵъ бра́тъ мо́й му́жъ косма́тый, а҆́з же му́жъ гла́дкїй. Да нека́кѡ ѡ҆сѧ́же ма ѻ҆те́цъ мо́й, и҆ бу́ду преⷣ ни́мъ
items.english_text: O give thanks unto the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy endures unto the ages! *Verse:* Let the redeemed of the Lord say so, whom He hath redeemed![^2637]

items.slavonic_text: ꙗ҆́кѡ нера́дѧ, и҆ наведу̀ на себѐ кла́твꙋ, а҆ не бл҃венїе. Рече́ же є҆му̀ ма́ти: на менѐ кла́тва твоѧ̀ ча́до, то́кмѡ послу́шай гла́са моего̀, и҆ ше́дъ принеси́ ми. Ше́дъ же взѧ́тъ и҆ принесѐ ма́тери. и҆ сотворѝ мт҃и є҆го̀ ꙗ҆стїѧ̀, ꙗ҆́коже люблѧ́ше ѻ҆те́цъ є҆гѡ̀. И҆ прїи́мши Реве́кка ѡ҆де́ждꙋ И҆са́ѵа сы́на своего̀ старѣ́йшаго до́брꙋю, ꙗ҆́же бы́сть ᲂу҆ неѧ̀ въ домо̀, ѡ҆блечѐ сы́на своего̀ мнѣ́йшаго, И҆ ко́жницами козля́чими, ѡ҆бви́тъ мы́шца є҆гѡ̀. И҆ дадѐ снѣ́ди и҆ хлѣ́бы ꙗ҆́же сотворѝ, въ ру́цѣ І҆а́кѡвꙋ сы́ну своєму̀, и҆ внесѐ ѻ҆тцу̀ своєму̀. Рече́ же: Ѽ́че. Ѻ҆́нъ же речѐ, Сѐ а҆́зъ, кто́ ты є҆сѝ ча́до. И҆ речѐ І҆а́кѡвъ ѻ҆тцу̀ своєму̀, а҆́зъ є҆́смъ И҆са́ѵъ перворожде́нный тво́й, сотвори́хъ ꙗ҆́коже заповѣ́далъ ми є҆сѝ. въста́въ сѧ́ди и҆ ꙗ҆́ждь ѿ ло́ва мое́гѡ, да бл҃ви́тъ мѧ̀ дш҃а твоѧ̀. Рече́ же І҆саа́къ сы́ну своєму̀, что́ се є҆́же ско́рѡ ѡ҆брѣ́лъ є҆сѝ сн҃у ча́до. Ѻ҆́нъ же речѐ, є҆́же преда́лъ є҆́стъ Гдⷭ҇ь Бг҃ъ предо мно́ю. Рече́ же І҆саа́къ І҆а́кѡвꙋ, прибли́жи сѧ къ мнѣ̀ и҆ ѡ҆сѧжу́ тѧ ча́до, а҆́ще ты є҆сѝ сы́нъ мо́й И҆са́ѵъ, и҆ли́ ни; Прибли́жисѧ І҆а́кѡвъ къ І҆саа́ку ѻ҆тцꙋ̀ своєму̀, и҆ ѡ҆сѧза̀ є҆гѡ̀, и҆ речѐ, гла́съ ᲂу҆́бѡ гла́съ І҆а́кѡвль, рꙋ́цѣ же ру́цѣ И҆са́ѵовѣ, И҆ непозна̀ є҆гѡ̀, бѣ́стѣ бо ру́цѣ є҆гѡ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ ру́цѣ И҆са́ѵа бра́та є҆гѡ̀ косма́тѣ, и҆ непозна̀ є҆гѡ̀, и҆ бл҃вѝ є҆гѡ̀, и҆ речѐ, Ты́ ли є҆сѝ И҆са́ѵъ сы́нъ мо́й; ѻ҆́нъ же речѐ, а҆́зъ. И҆ речѐ: Принеси́ ми и҆ ꙗ҆́мъ ѿ ло́ва твое́гѡ ча́до. да бл҃ви́тъ тѧ дш҃а моѧ̀. и҆ принесѐ є҆му̀, и҆ ꙗ҆дѐ. и҆ внесѐ є҆му̀ вино̀, и҆ пи́тъ. И҆ речѐ є҆му̀ І҆саа́къ

items.slavonic_text: ꙗ҆́кѡ нера́дѧ, и҆ наведу̀ на себѐ кла́твꙋ, а҆ не бл҃венїе. Рече́ же є҆му̀ ма́ти: на менѐ кла́тва твоѧ̀ ча́до, то́кмѡ послу́шай гла́са моего̀, и҆ ше́дъ принеси́ ми. Ше́дъ же взѧ́тъ и҆ принесѐ ма́тери. и҆ сотворѝ мт҃и є҆го̀ ꙗ҆стїѧ̀, ꙗ҆́коже люблѧ́ше ѻ҆те́цъ є҆гѡ̀. И҆ прїи́мши Реве́кка ѡ҆де́ждꙋ И҆са́ѵа сы́на своего̀ старѣ́йшаго до́брꙋю, ꙗ҆́же бы́сть ᲂу҆ неѧ̀ въ домо̀, ѡ҆блечѐ сы́на своего̀ мнѣ́йшаго, И҆ ко́жницами козля́чими, ѡ҆бви́тъ мы́шца є҆гѡ̀. И҆ дадѐ снѣ́ди и҆ хлѣ́бы ꙗ҆́же сотворѝ, въ ру́цѣ І҆а́кѡвꙋ сы́ну своєму̀, и҆ внесѐ ѻ҆тцу̀ своєму̀. Рече́ же: Ѽ́че. Ѻ҆́нъ же речѐ, Сѐ а҆́зъ, кто́ ты є҆сѝ ча́до. И҆ речѐ І҆а́кѡвъ ѻ҆тцу̀ своєму̀, а҆́зъ є҆́смъ И҆са́ѵъ перворожде́нный тво́й, сотвори́хъ ꙗ҆́коже заповѣ́далъ ми є҆сѝ. въста́въ сѧ́ди и҆ ꙗ҆́ждь ѿ ло́ва мое́гѡ, да бл҃ви́тъ мѧ̀ дш҃а твоѧ̀. Рече́ же І҆саа́къ сы́ну своєму̀, что́ се є҆́же ско́рѡ ѡ҆брѣ́лъ є҆сѝ сн҃у ча́до. Ѻ҆́нъ же речѐ, є҆́же преда́лъ є҆́стъ Гдⷭ҇ь Бг҃ъ предо мно́ю. Рече́ же І҆саа́къ І҆а́кѡвꙋ, прибли́жи сѧ къ мнѣ̀ и҆ ѡ҆сѧжу́ тѧ ча́до, а҆́ще ты є҆сѝ сы́нъ мо́й И҆са́ѵъ, и҆ли́ ни; Прибли́жисѧ І҆а́кѡвъ къ І҆саа́ку ѻ҆тцꙋ̀ своєму̀, и҆ ѡ҆сѧза̀ є҆гѡ̀, и҆ речѐ, гла́съ ᲂу҆́бѡ гла́съ І҆а́кѡвль, рꙋ́цѣ же ру́цѣ И҆са́ѵовѣ, И҆ непозна̀ є҆гѡ̀, бѣ́стѣ бо ру́цѣ є҆гѡ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ ру́цѣ И҆са́ѵа бра́та є҆гѡ̀ косма́тѣ, и҆ непозна̀ є҆гѡ̀, и҆ бл҃вѝ є҆гѡ̀, и҆ речѐ, Ты́ ли є҆сѝ И҆са́ѵъ сы́нъ мо́й; ѻ҆́нъ же речѐ, а҆́зъ. И҆ речѐ: Принеси́ ми и҆ ꙗ҆́мъ ѿ ло́ва твое́гѡ ча́до. да бл҃ви́тъ тѧ дш҃а моѧ̀. и҆ принесѐ є҆му̀, и҆ ꙗ҆дѐ. и҆ внесѐ є҆му̀ вино̀, и҆ пи́тъ. И҆ речѐ є҆му̀ І҆саа́къ
items.english_text: And he said: Bring it near to me, and I will eat of thy venison, child, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he ate; and he brought him wine, and he drank.[^2662]

items.slavonic_text: ѡ҆те́цъ є҆гѡ̀, прибли́жисѧ ко мнѣ̀ и҆ ѡ҆блобыза́й мѧ̀ ча́до. И҆ прибли́жисѧ лобза̀ є҆гѡ̀, и҆ ѡ҆ню́ха во́ню ри́зъ є҆гѡ̀. и҆ блг҃сви є҆гѡ̀, и҆ речѐ, Се во́нѧ сы́на моегѡ̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ во́нѧ села̀ и҆спо́лненна, є҆го́же блг҃сви Гдⷭ҇ь. И҆ да да́стъ ти Бг҃ъ ѿ росы̀ нб҃сныѧ, и҆ ѿ бла́ги земны́ѧ, и҆ мно́жество пшени́ца и҆ вина̀. И҆ да послу́жатъ ти ꙗ҆зы́цы, и҆ да покло́нѧтътисѧ Кнѧ́зи, и҆ бу́ди Господи́нъ бра́ту твоему̀, и҆ покло́нѧтъ ти сѧ сыно́ве ѿца̀ твоегѡ̀. проклина́ѧй тѧ̀ проклѧ́тъ, блг҃слѧ́ѧйжета блг҃све́нъ. И҆ бы́сть ꙗ҆́кѡ преста̀ І҆саа́къ блг҃слѧ̀ сн҃а своего̀ І҆а́кѡва. и҆ бы́сть є҆ли́кѡ и҆зы́иде І҆а́кѡвъ ѿ лица̀ І҆саа́ка ѿца̀ своего̀, и҆ И҆са́ѵъ бра́тъ є҆гѡ̀ пріи́де ѿ ло́ва. И҆ сотворѝ и҆ то́й ꙗ҆де́нїа. и҆ принесѐ ѿцу̀ своему̀. и҆ речѐ да воста́нетъ ѿте́цъ моѝ, и҆ да ꙗ҆́стъ ѿ ло́ва сы́на своего̀, да блг҃сви́тъ мѧ̀ дш҃а твоѧ̀. И҆ речѐ є҆му̀ І҆саа́къ ѿте́цъ є҆гѡ̀, кто́ ты є҆сѝ; Ѻ҆́нъ же речѐ, Сынъ тво́й первороже́нный И҆са́ѵъ. У҆жасе́жесѧ І҆саа́къ оу҆́жасомъ вели́кимъ зѣ́лѡ, и҆ речѐ кто оу҆́бѡ є҆́стъ оу҆лови́вый ми ло́въ, и҆ внесы́й ми и҆ ꙗ҆до́хъ ѿ всѣ́хъ, пре́жде да́же не прише́лъ є҆сѝ ты. и҆ блг҃сви́хъ є҆гѡ̀ и҆ блг҃све́нъ бу́детъ. Бы́сть же є҆гда̀ оу҆слы́ша И҆са́ѵъ гл҃ы ѿца̀ своего̀ І҆саа́ка. възопѝ гла́сомъ вели́кимъ и҆ го́ркимъ зѣ́лѡ, и҆ речѐ, блг҃сви оу҆́бѡ и҆ менѐ ѿче; Рече́ же є҆му̀: прише́дъ оу҆́бѡ бра́тъ тво́й съ ле́стїю прїѧ́тъ блг҃све́нїе твоѐ. И҆ речѐ И҆са́ѵъ, во пра́вду нарече́сѧ и҆́мѧ є҆му̀ І҆а́кѡвъ. попѧ́ти бо мѧ̀ Се оу҆жѐ втори́цею, перве́нство моѐ взѧ́тъ, и҆ нн҃ѣ взѧ́тъ блг҃све́нїе моѐ. и҆ речѐ И҆са́ѵъ
items.english_text: ...Come near unto me, and kiss me, my child! And he came near and kissed him; and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said: Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a full field, which the Lord hath blessed;[^2664] and may God give thee of the dew of heaven, and of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine;[^2665] and let nations serve thee, and princes bow down unto thee; and be thou lord over thy brother, and let the sons of thy father bow down unto thee; he that curses thee is cursed, and he that blesses thee is blessed![^2666]

Дꙋшевре́днагѡ лихои́мїѧ свободи́ ны, и҆ съ Ла́заремъ ни́щи въ ло́нѣхъ А҆враа́мовѣхъ, причти́ сп҃се, ты́ бо въ млⷭ҇техъ бога́тъ сы́й, во́лею насъ дѣ́лѧ ѡ҆бнища́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ ѿ тлѧ̀ на нетлѣ́нїе преве́лъ є҆сѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ млⷭ҇тивъ Бг҃ъ, и҆ чл҃колю́бецъ:— Стихи́ ѡ҆бы́чныи. Ст҃ы́хъ Мч҃никъ прїе́мый терпѣ́нїе, и҆ ѿ на́съ прїимѝ пѣ́нїе чл҃колю́бче, да́руй намъ тѣ́хъ мл҃твами ве́лїю млⷭ҇ть:— Сла́ва: И҆ нн҃ѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ. И҆зба́ви насъ ѿ ну́ждъ на́шихъ, Мт҃и Хрⷭ҇та̀ Бг҃а, ро́ждшаѧ всѣ́хъ тво́рца, да всѝ зове́м ти: Ра́дуйсѧ Преⷭ҇та́телнице ду́шъ на́шихъ:— ВЪ ВТО́РО ЦВѢ́ТНОИ НД҃ЛИ, НА ОУ҆́ТРНИ. По А҆ллилу́їа, Трⷪ҇чна Гла́су. По а҃-й Стїхоло́гїи Сѣⷣ: въ Октои́ху. По в҃-й Стїхоло́гїи Сѣⷣ: Кѵ́р І҆ѡ́сифа. Гла́съ, ѕ҃. Под: А҆́гг҃льскїѧ си́лы: Грѣхо́внымъ неду́гомъ и҆стаѧва́емъ, на ѻ҆́дрѣ ѡ҆тча́ѧнїѧ низле... тѣ́мже мѧ врачу́ болѧ́щихъ

After the 2nd Stichology, Sessional Hymn of Sir Joseph, Tone 6, Podoben: "The Angelic Powers" (А́ггельскїя силы):* Being wasted with the disease of sin, upon the bed of despair I lie prostrate; therefore, O Physician of the ailing visit me in Thy love for mankind, and suffer me not to sleep grievously unto death, O all-bountiful One, that I may cry fervently unto Thee: O Giver of mercy, Lord, glory to Thee![^2695]

items.slavonic_text: посѣтѝ, твои́мъ чл҃вколю́бїемъ, и҆ неѡста́ви мене оу҆сну́ти лю́тѣ въ сме́рть, всеще́дрыи, да вопїю́ ти те́плѣ, мл҃ти пода́телю, Гнⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ́:— Сла́ва: И҆ нн҃ѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Нача́ло сп҃се́нїѧ Гаврїи́лово вѣща́нїе къ Дв҃ѣ бы́сть, слы́ша бо є҆́же Ра́дуйсѧ, не ѡ҆бѣ́же цѣлова́нїѧ, не оу҆сумни́сѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ Са́рра въ сѣ́ни, но си́це гла́ше: Се раба̀ Гдⷭ҇нѧ, бу́ди ми по гл҃у твоему̀:— По г҃ стїхо: сѣⷣ: кѵ́р Ѳео́дѡра. Гл҃: є҃. По: Сїѧ́ет дне́: Вчера̀ и҆ дне́сь болѣ́знь Ла́зарева, сїю́ бо Хрⷭ҇ту̀ сказу́ютъ сро́дницѣ, ра́достїю вита́нїе оу҆готови́сѧ, жизнода́вца оу҆гости́ти и҆ Цр҃ѧ, с на́ми вопи́ти, Гнⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ́:— Сла́ва: И҆ нн҃ѣ: Бг҃о: Мт҃и Бж҃їѧ Всест҃а́ѧ, стѣ́но Хрⷭ҇тїа́нѡмъ, и҆зба́ви лю́ди твоѧ̑ ѡ҆бы́чнѡ, вопїю́щыѧ ти приле́жнѡ, проти́воста́ни скве́рнымъ, и҆ возно́сливым по́мыслѡмъ, да вопїе́мъ ти, Ра́дуйсѧ при́снѡ дв҃о:— Трипѣ́снецъ, Кѵ́р І҆ѡ́сифа. Гла́, ѕ҃. Пѣ́: в҃. И҆рмо́съ. Ви́дите ви́дите ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́зъ є҆́смъ Бг҃ъ, Ма́нну ѡ҆дожди́вый, и҆ во́ду и҆з ка́мене и҆сточи́вый, дре́вле въ пусты́ни лю́демъ мои̑, є҆ди́ною десни́цею, и҆ крѣ́постїю мое́ю:— Во́лею ѡ҆бнища́лъ є҆сѝ, є҆стество́мъ бога́тый Хе҃, въз̾алка́лъ є҆сѝ во́лею, насыща́ѧй всѧ́кое живо́тное. тѣ́мже млю́сѧ, насы́ти а҆́лчущаго твое́ѧ блг҃ти, и҆ покажѝ та́мошныѧ Тра́пезы Сло́ве ѡ҆бще́щника:— Ла́зара ни́щаго мѧ покажѝ грѣхѡ́въ Хе҃, и҆ расточѝ бога́тство є҆́же злѣ̀ собра́хъ, и҆ соверше́нное твоѐ ѧ҆вле́нїе ще́дре и҆спо́лнивъ, та́мошнагѡ и҆зба́ви мѧ муче́нїѧ стра́шнагѡ:
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* The beginning of salvation was Gabriel's greeting unto the Virgin; for hearing the "Rejoice," she fled not from the salutation, nor did she doubt like Sarah in the tent, but spake thus: Behold the handmaid of the Lord, be it unto me according to thy word![^2696]

items.slavonic_text: посѣтѝ, твои́мъ чл҃вколю́бїемъ, и҆ неѡста́ви мене оу҆сну́ти лю́тѣ въ сме́рть, всеще́дрыи, да вопїю́ ти те́плѣ, мл҃ти пода́телю, Гнⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ́:— Сла́ва: И҆ нн҃ѣ: Бг҃оро́диченъ. Нача́ло сп҃се́нїѧ Гаврїи́лово вѣща́нїе къ Дв҃ѣ бы́сть, слы́ша бо є҆́же Ра́дуйсѧ, не ѡ҆бѣ́же цѣлова́нїѧ, не оу҆сумни́сѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ Са́рра въ сѣ́ни, но си́це гла́ше: Се раба̀ Гдⷭ҇нѧ, бу́ди ми по гл҃у твоему̀:— По г҃ стїхо: сѣⷣ: кѵ́р Ѳео́дѡра. Гл҃: є҃. По: Сїѧ́ет дне́: Вчера̀ и҆ дне́сь болѣ́знь Ла́зарева, сїю́ бо Хрⷭ҇ту̀ сказу́ютъ сро́дницѣ, ра́достїю вита́нїе оу҆готови́сѧ, жизнода́вца оу҆гости́ти и҆ Цр҃ѧ, с на́ми вопи́ти, Гнⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ́:— Сла́ва: И҆ нн҃ѣ: Бг҃о: Мт҃и Бж҃їѧ Всест҃а́ѧ, стѣ́но Хрⷭ҇тїа́нѡмъ, и҆зба́ви лю́ди твоѧ̑ ѡ҆бы́чнѡ, вопїю́щыѧ ти приле́жнѡ, проти́воста́ни скве́рнымъ, и҆ возно́сливым по́мыслѡмъ, да вопїе́мъ ти, Ра́дуйсѧ при́снѡ дв҃о:— Трипѣ́снецъ, Кѵ́р І҆ѡ́сифа. Гла́, ѕ҃. Пѣ́: в҃. И҆рмо́съ. Ви́дите ви́дите ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́зъ є҆́смъ Бг҃ъ, Ма́нну ѡ҆дожди́вый, и҆ во́ду и҆з ка́мене и҆сточи́вый, дре́вле въ пусты́ни лю́демъ мои̑, є҆ди́ною десни́цею, и҆ крѣ́постїю мое́ю:— Во́лею ѡ҆бнища́лъ є҆сѝ, є҆стество́мъ бога́тый Хе҃, въз̾алка́лъ є҆сѝ во́лею, насыща́ѧй всѧ́кое живо́тное. тѣ́мже млю́сѧ, насы́ти а҆́лчущаго твое́ѧ блг҃ти, и҆ покажѝ та́мошныѧ Тра́пезы Сло́ве ѡ҆бще́щника:— Ла́зара ни́щаго мѧ покажѝ грѣхѡ́въ Хе҃, и҆ расточѝ бога́тство є҆́же злѣ̀ собра́хъ, и҆ соверше́нное твоѐ ѧ҆вле́нїе ще́дре и҆спо́лнивъ, та́мошнагѡ и҆зба́ви мѧ муче́нїѧ стра́шнагѡ:
items.english_text: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* All-holy Mother of God, rampart of Christians: deliver thy people as is thy wont, who cry diligently unto thee; stand against defiled and haughty thoughts, that we may cry unto thee: Rejoice, ever-Virgin![^2698]

provenance.verbatim_source: *Glory... Both now... Theotokion:* All-holy Mother of God, rampart of Christians: deliver thy people as is thy wont, who cry diligently unto thee; stand against defiled and haughty thoughts, that we may cry unto thee: Rejoice, ever-Virgin![^2698]

items.english_text: *Triodion Canon of Sir Joseph, Tone 6. Ode 2. Heirmos:* See, see that I am God, Who rained down manna, and poured forth water from the rock of old in the wilderness for My people, by My right hand alone and by My power![^2699]

items.slavonic_text: Ѻ҆тро́ки оу҆крѣпи́въ твердѣ́йшыѧ ѻ҆гнѧ̀, и҆но́гда въ Вавѷлѡ́нѣ содѣ́ла пое́тъ. тѣ́мъ поревнова́вши ѽ дш҃е моѧ̀, не оу҆ныва́й, но ѻ҆́гнь сладостра́стїй дх҃а оу҆гаси́ши росо́ю:— Бг҃о: Ра́дуйсѧ тебѣ̀ вопїе́мъ ро́жшой ра́дость, Бцⷣе Дв҃о, ѡ҆бра́дованнаѧ, Бг҃а є҆го́же роди́ла є҆сѝ оу҆молѝ, и҆зба́витисѧ ѡ҆ бѣ́дъ и҆ тлѧ̀, воспѣва́ющым тѧ̀ при́снѡ:— И҆ны́й И҆рмо́: Кѵ́р Ѳео́дѡра. Гл҃: є҃. Види́те ви́дите: Ви́дите, ви́дите ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́зъ є҆́смъ Бг҃ъ, и҆́же ѡ҆но́ну стра́ну І҆орда́на хождꙋ̀, слы́шавъ ꙗ҆́кѡ Ла́зарь боли́тъ, и҆ реки́й, ꙗ҆́кѡ не оу҆́мретъ, є҆́стъ бо не ѡ҆ сла́вѣ мое́й:— Рыда́нїемъ ѡ҆бложи́вшесѧ Ла́заревы Се́стры, стоѧ́тъ тебѣ̀, вѣдѣ́телю всѣ́хъ ꙗ҆влѧ́ютъ, но пребыва́еши ма́ло, да въз̾дви́гнеши чу́до, и҆ пока́жеши оу҆чн҃нкѡмъ твои́мъ стра́шнаѧ:— Трⷪ҇ич: Е҆диноцѣве́ннаѧ, трїѷпоста́внаѧ є҆дини́це, Гдⷭ҇тво и҆ Црⷭ҇тво вѣкѡ́въ, тебѐ сла́вѧт Ѻ҆ц҃а, и҆ Сн҃а и҆ Ст҃гѡ Дх҃а, мно́жество А҆́гг҃лъ, и҆ всѧ́кое є҆стество̀ чл҃чкое:— Кто не диви́лбысѧ зрѧ̀ въ тебѣ̀ содѣ́телѧ Дв҃о, Бг҃о: назда́вшаго А҆да́ма па́дшаго, несказа́ннымъ съединенїемъ, и҆з тебѐ пло́тїю роже́нна, неимѣ́ннѡ, въ сп҃се́нїе на́ше:— Сла́ва тебѣ̀ Бг҃е на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀: Нн҃ѣ оу҆краси́сѧ ѽ Виѳа́нїе ра́достїю, сотвори́вши прїѧ́телнице цр҃ѧ всѣ́хъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ прїи́детъ к тебѣ̀, да Ла́зара пока́же па́ки текꙋ́ща, ѿ тлѣ́нїѧ в живо́тъ:— И҆рмо́съ. Ви́дите ви́дите ꙗ҆́кѡ а҆́зъ є҆́смъ Бг҃ъ, въ пло́ть ѡ҆болки́исѧ хотѣ́нїемъ во́лнымъ, да сп҃су А҆да́ма ѿ ле́сти па́дшаго, преступле́нїемъ ѕмїи́нымъ:— Пѣ́снь, и҆. И҆рмо́. И҆з пла́мене ст҃ы́мъ ро́су и҆сточи́:

items.english_text: *Theotokion:* Rejoice, we cry unto thee who didst bear Joy, O Virgin Theotokos full of grace: pray God Whom thou didst bear, that they may be delivered from perils and corruption who ever hymn thee![^2703]
